target: The Prismatic Dice has limited uses. You can typically only use it twice per match.

source: "Xúc Xắc Rực Rỡ" có thể được ném lại giống như các xúc xắc khác.
target: Prismatic Dice can be rerolled just like other dice.

source: "Xúc Xắc Rực Rỡ" có thể được ném lại giống như các xúc xắc khác.
target: The Prismatic Dice can be rerolled like other dice.

source: "Xúc Xắc Rực Rỡ" đã sở hữu có thể được trang bị đồng thời cho nhiều nhân vật khác nhau, hãy thoải mái kết hợp nhé.
target: The Prismatic Dice you own can be equipped by multiple different characters at the same time, so feel free to mix and match as you like.

source: "Đấu Trí Tiêu Chuẩn" là chế độ chơi thông thường của Chiến Tranh Tiền Tệ. Khiêu chiến Đấu Trí Tiêu Chuẩn để thăng hạng.
target: "Standard Gambit" is the regular game mode for Currency Wars. Challenging Standard Gambit allows you to be promoted in rank.

source: "Đấu Trí Ép Xung" là chế độ nhanh với thời gian chơi ngắn hơn, có thể dùng để hoàn thành phần thưởng nhiệm vụ Tích Điểm Tuần.
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, and can be used to complete Weekly Points mission rewards.

source: "Đấu Trí Ép Xung" là một chế độ nhanh với thời gian chơi ngắn hơn, mỗi Vị Diện đều có ít điểm mốc hơn.
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, with fewer progression nodes in each plane.

source: "Đậu Vị Kỳ Quái" sẽ tự động tìm kiếm và tấn công kẻ địch thường, tiêu hao 1 điểm Bí Kỹ lập tức tiêu diệt mục tiêu, và sẽ không vào chiến đấu.
target: "Funky Munch Bean" will automatically search for and attack Normal Enemies. Consume 1 Technique Point to immediately defeat them without entering combat.

source: "Đổ Xúc Xắc Nào! Băng Lực Chiến!!" - Cách Chơi Sự Kiện
target: Cosmicon, Roll On!: Event Gameplay

source: "กระต่ายรางดาว" ผู้พัฒนาเกม "JUMP ทะลุมิติ!" ได้จัดวางภูตธุลีไร้ชื่อที่มีบุคลิกแตกต่างกันไปทั่วทุกที่ เข้าใกล้เพื่อโต้ตอบเมื่ออยู่นอก JUMP! หรือสัมผัสขณะอยู่ใน JUMP! เพื่อรวบรวมภูตธุลีไร้ชื่อ
target: The developers of the Interplanar Jump! game "Star Rabbit" have placed nameless wispae with diverse personalities across different sites. You can gather them by interacting up close outside the Jump or by touching them inside the Jump.

source: "กระต่ายรางดาว" มีโหมดเกมทั้งหมดสองแบบ โดยในตอนเริ่มต้นจะเลือกได้แค่ "โหมดนรก" เท่านั้น แต่เมื่อรวบรวมภูตธุลีไร้ชื่อในบริเวณนั้นได้ครบ จะสามารถปลดล็อก "โหมดโกง" ได้
target: Star Rabbit has two game modes. At first, you can only select Hell Mode, but once you've collected the nearby nameless wispae, you can unlock Cheat Mode.

source: "กลไกขับเคลื่อนเส้นทางลับ" จะเชื่อมต่อกับเส้นทางลับของ Janus ทั่วทั้ง Amphoreus เมื่อเปิดใช้งานแล้ว เส้นทางลับทั้งหมดที่ปลดล็อกแล้ว จะเข้าสู่สถานะ "เปิดใช้งานทันที"
target: The Secret Path Mechanism connects to all Janus's Hidden Passages across Amphoreus. Once activated, all unlocked passages will enter an Instant Activation state.

source: "กล่องอึ้งทึ่งขำ" จะช่วยในการต่อสู้ เมื่อมันแอ็กชันจะเกิดเอฟเฟกต์พิเศษ เพื่อช่วยเหลือในการต่อสู้
target: The Surprise Box will assist in combat. When it takes action, it triggers special effects that help during battles.

source: "กล่องเชื้อไฟ" เป็นภาชนะที่ใช้เก็บของสำคัญ เมื่อเปิดใช้งาน "กล่องเชื้อไฟ" แล้ว ด้านนอกของมันจะปรากฏรูกุญแจขึ้น และจะเปิดใช้งานชิ้นส่วนกุญแจในจำนวนที่สอดคล้องกัน
target: The Coreflame Casket is used to contain important items. When activated, keyholes will appear on the exterior of the Coreflame Casket and activate the corresponding number of key fragments.

source: "การทดสอบสุดท้าย"
target: Final Trial

source: "การทดสอบสุดท้าย" นั้นเป็นการต่อสู้ต่อเนื่องหลายชั้น ซึ่งจะมีเวลานับถอยหลังอยู่ 6 รอบด้วยกัน และศัตรูระดับบอสจะมีกลไกการต่อสู้พิเศษ
target: The Final Trial is a continuous battle with a countdown timer of 6 Cycles. Boss enemies in the trial will have their special battle mechanics.

source: "การประชุมมื้อค่ำ" จะจัดขึ้นเป็นระยะตามกำหนดการ ซึ่งจะได้รับ "เงินทุนขบวนรถไฟ" จำนวนมากตามผลการรายงาน ใช้สิ่งนี้เป็นเป้าหมายเพื่อเดินหน้าต่อไปเลยสิ
target: Dinner Meetings will be held periodically in the schedule, and you can gain a large amount of Express Funds based on your report results. Treat that as your main goal.

source: "การแข่งขันซูเปอร์ลีกแห่งเมือง Boulder"
target: Boulder Town Super League

source: "ขนมซิ่งบุกตะลุย" เป็นการแข่งขันวิ่งวิบากที่ผลงานสิ่งมีชีวิตจัดขึ้นเอง โดยในแต่ละแมตช์จะมีผู้เล่น 8 คน มาเข้าชมและร่วมเชียร์ผู้เข้าแข่งขัน
target: Snack Dash is an obstacle race event spontaneously organized by the creations, where 8 players can participate as spectators and cheer for the contestants.

source: "คลื่นทมิฬระอุ" เป็นสถานะ Debuff ประเภท DMG ต่อเนื่อง โดยที่ DMG ต่อเนื่องนี้จะมาจาก DMG ส่วนหนึ่งที่เป้าหมายได้รับ ซึ่งเมื่อซ้อนทับแล้ว จะรีเฟรชเทิร์นต่อเนื่องของ "คลื่นทมิฬระอุ"
target: "Black Tide Fever" is a type of DoT debuff. The DoT originates from a part of the DMG that the target takes. When stacking, it resets the duration of "Black Tide Fever."

source: "ความโลภ" กัดกร่อน
target: Voracity Corrosion

source: "ค่าการรับรู้" ปัจจุบันและ "ขอบเขตเป้าหมายของค่าการรับรู้" จะแสดงอยู่บน "แถบการรับรู้" ซึ่งสามารถตรวจสอบได้ที่ด้านบนของกระดาน ส่วน "ค่าการรับรู้" ที่จำเป็นในการปลดล็อก "ความลับ" จะแสดงอยู่ที่ด้านบนของ "ความลับ" นั้นๆ
target: Current Cognition Value and Cognition Value Target Range are both displayed in the Cognition Bar. Check it at the top of the board. The Cognition Value required to unlock each Secret is displayed above the Secret.

source: "ค่าวิญญาณนักสู้" ที่สะสมในการต่อสู้ จะสามารถเพิ่ม "ระดับวิญญาณนักสู้" ได้ เมื่อเข้าสู่ "วิญญาณนักสู้ระดับที่ 4: พลังพลันตื่น" จะได้รับ Buff ของด่านที่ทรงพลัง ซึ่งสามารถเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการต่อสู้ได้เป็นอย่างมาก
target: Accumulating Grit Value during battle can elevate your Grit Phase. When entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken", you can obtain powerful stage buffs and significantly improve your combat effectiveness.

source: "ถั่วรสพิลึก" จะตามหา และโจมตีศัตรูธรรมดา โดยอัตโนมัติ ซึ่งจะใช้แต้มเทคนิค 1 แต้ม เพื่อกำจัดศัตรูทันที โดยไม่เข้าสู่การต่อสู้
target: "Funky Munch Bean" will automatically search for and attack Normal Enemies. Consume 1 Technique Point to immediately defeat them without entering combat.

source: "นกกระดาษตะลุมบอน" คือ เกมท้าดวลแบบเรียงสาม คุณจะต้องกำจัดผลไม้ให้ได้ ภายในจำนวนมูฟที่กำหนด และเพิ่มพลังต่อสู้ของนกน้อย
target: Origami Bird Clash is a Match Three battling game where you have to eliminate fruits within a certain number of moves to increase the Origami Bird's Combat Power.

source: "นกกระดาษตะลุมบอน" คือ เกมท้าดวลแบบเรียงสาม คุณจะต้องกำจัดผลไม้ให้ได้ภายในจำนวนมูฟที่กำหนด และเพิ่มพลังต่อสู้ของนกน้อย
target: Origami Bird Clash is a Match Three battling game where you have to match and clear fruits within a certain number of moves and increase the Origami Bird's Combat Power.

source: "นกกระดาษตะลุมบอน" คือ เกมท้าดวลแบบเรียงสาม เมื่ออยู่ในโหมดศึกประชันฝูงนก แต่ละแมตช์จะมีผู้เล่น เข้าร่วมท้าดวลทั้งหมด 30 คนด้วยกัน
target: "Origami Bird Clash" is a match-3 battle game. In the Best of the Flock mode, each match features 30 players competing against each other.

source: "นักแสดงตลก" สามารถได้รับ "ระดับกลั้นหัวเราะ" ซึ่งชาร์จพลังให้กับ "กล่องอึ้งทึ่งขำ" ได้ ยิ่ง "ระดับกลั้นหัวเราะ" สูงเท่าไหร่ เอฟเฟกต์ของ "กล่องอึ้งทึ่งขำ" ก็จะยิ่งแข็งแกร่งขึ้นเท่านั้น
target: The Comedian can charge the Surprise Box by gaining Giggle Gauge. The higher the Giggle Gauge, the stronger the effect of the Surprise Box.

source: "บุปผาหยั่งรู้"
target: Cognos Bloom

source: "ผลึกความทรงจำ" สามารถช่วยให้คุณแลกเปลี่ยนไอเทมในร้านค้าที่กำหนด หรือทำให้ "หุ่นตัดชุด" บอกตำแหน่งของแมลงทั้งหมดที่ยังไม่ได้รวบรวมให้คุณได้
target: Memory Crystal Shards can help you to redeem items in specific shops, or let the Garmentmaker point out the location of nymphs you have not collected.

source: "มิติระนาบทั่วไป" ประกอบไปด้วยพื้นที่สำรวจที่แตกต่างกันออกไปถึง 7 ชั้น ซึ่งใน "มิติระนาบทั่วไป" นี้ จะสามารถสะสมพรและวัตถุหายากจำนานมาก สำหรับการต่อสู้สุดหินใน "การทดสอบสุดท้าย" ได้
target: Ordinary Planes are made up of 7 different explorable domains. You can accumulate a vast amount of Blessings and Curios in Ordinary Planes before challenging the highly difficult Final Trial.

source: "ลูกเต๋าปริซึม" ที่มีอยู่ สามารถสวมใส่ให้กับตัวละครหลายตัวพร้อมกันได้ ดังนั้นสามารถจับใส่ได้ตามที่ต้องการเลย
target: The Prismatic Dice you own can be equipped by multiple different characters at the same time, so feel free to mix and match as you like.

source: "ลูกเต๋าปริซึม" บางชนิดจะมีหน้าลูกเต๋าพิเศษ เมื่อทอยออกมาและเลือกใช้ จะทำให้เกิดเอฟเฟกต์พิเศษ!
target: Some Prismatic Dice have special Dice Faces that trigger unique effects when rolled and selected!

source: "ลูกเต๋าปริซึม" มีจำนวนการใช้งานที่จำกัด โดยปกติแล้ว ในแต่ละเกม จะสามารถใช้ได้เพียงสองครั้งเท่านั้น
target: The Prismatic Dice has limited uses. You can typically only use it twice per match.

source: "ลูกเต๋าปริซึม" สามารถทอยใหม่ ได้เหมือนกับลูกเต๋าอื่นๆ
target: The Prismatic Dice can be rerolled like other dice.

source: "ลูกเต๋าปริซึม" สามารถทอยใหม่ได้ เหมือนกับลูกเต๋าอื่นๆ
target: Prismatic Dice can be rerolled just like other dice.

source: "วัตถุหายากดัดแปลง" และ "พรลิมิเต็ด"
target: Transformed Curios and Exclusive Blessings

source: "ศึกดวลพลังกาแล็กซี" คือเกมเพลย์ที่ทำการประลอง โดยใช้การ์ดตัวละคร และลูกเต๋าที่สอดคล้องกับ มุมขวาบนของการ์ด
target: "Cosmicon Collective" is a gameplay mode where you battle using character cards and their corresponding dice shown in the top-right corner of the cards.

source: "ศึกดวลพลังกาแล็กซี" คือเกมเพลย์ที่ใช้การ์ดตัวละคร และลูกเต๋าที่สอดคล้องกับมุมขวาบนของการ์ด เพื่อทำการดวล
target: "Cosmicon Collective" is a gameplay mode where you battle using character cards and their corresponding dice shown in the top-right corner of the cards.

source: "หัตถ์ Zagreus" คือร่างมรดกอันศักดิ์สิทธิ์ของไททันแห่งเพทุบาย Zagreus หลังจากที่ไททันตนนี้ล่มสลาย ผู้คนใน Amphoreus ก็เรียนรู้วิธีการดัดแปลงมัน เพื่อให้กลายเป็นสิ่งที่พวกเขาใช้งานได้
target: Hand of Zagreus is the divine body left behind by Zagreus, the Trickery Titan. After the Titan had fallen, the people of Amphoreus learned to modify and utilize them.

source: "หัตถ์ Zagreus" สามารถใช้เพื่อเคลื่อนย้ายสิ่งของได้
target: The Hand of Zagreus can be used for transportation.

source: "อุปกรณ์ห้วงเวลา" คืออุปกรณ์ประกอบพิธีลำดับเวลาที่นักบวช Oronyx สร้างขึ้น มีหลากหลายขนาดและรูปแบบ การทำลาย "อุปกรณ์ห้วงเวลา" จะทำให้เวลาในบริเวณรอบๆ หยุดนิ่ง
target: The Chrono Vessel is a temporal ritual tool crafted by Oronyx's priests, with various sizes and styles. Breaking the Chrono Vessel will pause time in the area around it.

source: "เป้าหมายแถวหลัง" ที่อยู่ด้านหลังแนวรบในสนาม จะไม่สามารถถูกเลือกด้วยสกิลประเภท "โจมตีเดี่ยว" และ "กระจาย" ได้ สกิลประเภท "โจมตีหมู่", "จู่โจม", "โจมตีต่อเนื่อง" สามารถโจมตีศัตรูเป้าหมายแถวหลังได้
target: "Back Row Target" is located in the back of the formation on the field and cannot be selected by "Single Target ATK" and "Blast"-type abilities. "AoE ATK," "Bounce," and "Follow-Up ATK" abilities can hit enemy Back Row Targets.

source: "เพื่อนใหม่ในขวดเก่า": ผสมเครื่องดื่ม
target: "Old Brews & New Friends": Mixing Drinks

source: "เศษความทรงจำ" คือเศษเสี้ยวของสสารความทรงจำในโลก Amphoreus ซึ่งบรรจุช่วงเวลาในวันวานเอาไว้ สามารถมองเห็นภาพเงาแห่งอดีตในนั้นได้
target: Fragments of Recollection are memoria residues in the world of Amphoreus. They bear bygone days, and you can glean images of the past from within.

source: "เหรียญพลัง" สามารถนำไปแลกการ์ดใหม่ได้ที่ร้านค้า ส่วน "ผงพลัง" สามารถนำไปใช้ "เคลือบเงา" ให้กับการ์ดที่มีอยู่แล้ว
target: Power Tokens can be used to exchange for new cards in the Store, while Power Dust can be used to "Gild" your obtained cards.

source: "เหรียญพลัง" และ "เหรียญพลังแห่งชัยชนะ" สามารถนำไปแลกการ์ดใหม่และ "ลูกเต๋าปริซึม" ได้ที่ร้านค้า ส่วน "ผงพลัง" สามารถนำไปใช้ "เคลือบเงา" ให้กับการ์ดที่มีอยู่แล้วได้
target: Power Tokens and Victorious Power Tokens can be used to exchange for new cards and Prismatic Dice in the Store, while Power Dust can be used to "Gild" your obtained cards.

source: "แบบอย่างชั้นเลิศ" สามารถเพิ่มเลเวลเข้าเวรของสมาชิกทั้งหมด จนถึงเลเวลเข้าเวรสูงสุดที่มีในทีมได้
target: The Passenger Paragons card can elevate all members' Duty Level to match the highest Duty Level within the team.

source: "โหมดปกติ" คือโหมดเกมเพลย์ทั่วไปของสงครามเงินตรา ท้าทายโหมดปกติเพื่อเลื่อนขั้นแรงก์
target: "Standard Gambit" is the regular game mode for Currency Wars. Challenging Standard Gambit allows you to be promoted in rank.

source: "โอเวอร์คล็อก" เป็นโหมดเร่งด่วน ที่ใช้เวลาเล่นสั้นกว่า สามารถเล่นเพื่อรับรางวัล การสำเร็จภารกิจสะสมคะแนนรายสัปดาห์
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, and can be used to complete Weekly Points mission rewards.

source: "โอเวอร์คล็อก" เป็นโหมดเร่งด่วน ที่ใช้เวลาเล่นสั้นกว่า โดยแต่ละมิติระนาบจะมี จำนวนโหนดที่น้อยลง
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, with fewer progression nodes in each plane.

source: 14행 대수식 배리어가 해제되었습니다. 스크루룸이 δme-13 데이터 공간에 다수의 가속 링을 배치하여 「겨우살이」호의 해킹 효율을 증가시켰습니다

source: A Parede de Fotos permite que você exiba companheiros, fotos e Cones de Luz arquivados no Banco de Dados.
target: The Wall of Photos lets you showcase companions, photos, and Light Cones archived in the data bank.

source: A Perícia Suprema de Yao Guang ativa imediatamente 1 Instante Aha adicional. Quando Yao Guang possui "Mandou Bem", a equipe inteira causa Dano de Euforia adicional.
target: Yao Guang's Ultimate immediately triggers 1 additional Aha Instant. When Yao Guang possesses "Certified Banger," the entire team deals additional Elation DMG.

source: A Perícia Suprema pode ser utilizada quando a Energia de um personagem estiver totalmente carregada. Use-a no momento certo para ganhar mais ações.
target: Ultimates can be used when a character's Energy is fully charged. Ultimates can be unleashed at any time. Use it at the right moment to give you more actions.

source: A Pontuação de Audiência será acumulada ao conduzir a Arrancada Turbo e resgatar suprimentos. Acione os requisitos quantas vezes puder para conquistar a Pontuação de Audiência alvo!
target: Audience Score will be accumulated by conducting Turbo Dash, picking up supplies, or slamming into opponents or obstacles while invulnerable. Trigger the events above as many times as you can to achieve the target Audience Score!

source: A Pontuação de Audiência será acumulada ao conduzir as Cenas de Ação e resgatar suprimentos. Acione os requisitos quantas vezes puder para conquistar a Pontuação de Audiência alvo!
target: Audience Score will be accumulated by conducting Action Scenes, picking up supplies, or slamming into opponents or obstacles while invulnerable. Trigger the events above as many times as you can to achieve the target Audience Score!

source: A Prece de Oronyx pode ser usada para retroceder a Estátua Porta-Esfera para quando sua base não estava danificada.
target: Oronyx's Prayer can be used to rewind the Ball-Holder Statue to when its base is undamaged.

source: A Prece de Oronyx pode ser usada para retroceder temporariamente a ponte flutuante desmoronada para seu estado de levitação.
target: Oronyx's Prayer can be used to temporarily rewind the collapsed floating bridge to its levitating state.

source: A Tenacidade inicial dos inimigos é 50% de suas Tenacidades máximas.
target: Enemies' initial Toughness is 50% of their Max Toughness.

source: A VEL afeta o intervalo entre as ações de um alvo. Quanto mais rápida a velocidade, menor o intervalo. Ao mesmo tempo, a VEL também afeta a Ordem de Ação ao entrar na batalha.
target: SPD will affect the interval between a target's actions. The faster their speed, the shorter the interval. At the same time, SPD also affects the Action Order when entering battle.

source: A Versão Ensombrada de Você é um inimigo que imitará rigorosamente suas ações anteriores e avançará de acordo até que os passos registrados terminem. Lembre-se: não faça contato com ela.
target: The enshadowed version of you is a foe that will strictly follow your previous actions and advance accordingly until the recorded steps have ended. Remember: Do not make contact with them.

source: A algunos diales emocionales del paisaje onírico les falta cierto engranaje y no se pueden ajustar.
target: There are Emo Dials missing specific gear in the Dreamscape and cannot be tuned.

source: A alma de Nikador foi separada em 4 partes pelos Kremnoanos e está selada nas 4 estátuas na Zona da Forja das Almas. Insira as espadas gigantes nas mãos dessas estátuas na base para liberar um fragmento da divindade de Nikador.
target: Nikador's soul has been severed into 4 parts by the Kremnoans and is sealed into the 4 statues in the Soul-Forging Zone. Insert the giant swords in these statues' hands into the base to release one fragment of Nikador's divinity.

source: A barreira de expressões algébricas quatorzain foi desativada. Screwllum implantou múltiplos Anéis de Aceleração no espaço de dados δme-13 para aumentar a eficiência de hacking do Visco.
target: The quatorzain algebraic expressions barrier has been deactivated. Screwllum has deployed multiple Acceleration Rings in the δme-13 dataspace to enhance Mistletoe's hacking efficiency.

source: A base da Estátua Porta-Esfera pode ser destruída por ataques, fazendo com que a bola role na direção para a qual a estátua está voltada, quebrando obstáculos em seu caminho e abrindo portas entreabertas.
target: The Ball-Holder Statue's base can be destroyed by attacks, causing the ball to roll in the direction the statue faces, breaking obstacles along its path, and pushing open slightly ajar doors.

source: A batalha inteira circulará entre "Dia" e "Noite"
target: The entire battle will cycle between Day and Night.

source: A cada 8 cartas usadas, Saber ganha 1 ponto de energia mágica. A contagem acumula entre as rodadas.
target: For every 8 cards used, Saber gains 1 point of magical energy. The tally carries over between turns.

source: A carta Passageiro Modelo pode elevar o Nível de Serviços de todos os membros para igualar ao maior Nível de Serviços da equipe.
target: The Passenger Paragons card can elevate all members' Duty Level to match the highest Duty Level within the team.

source: A chave para revitalizar o museu encontra-se em localizar as obras perdidas. Prossiga com as operações para continuar encontrando pistas!
target: The key to revitalizing the museum lies in finding the lost exhibits. Continue operations to keep finding clues!

source: A cor da luz guia do Localizador de Objetos Doméstico pode mostrar a distância do alvo. A luz vermelha indica uma distância maior, enquanto a luz verde indica uma distância mais próxima.
target: Home-Use Object Finder's guidance light color can show the distance to the target. Red light indicates a longer distance, while green light indicates a close distance.

source: A diferencia de los duelos, en las batallas multijugador no se obtienen movimientos extra. ¡Elimina objetos dentro del tiempo y los movimientos establecidos, mejora el poder de combate de tu pajarito, y procura sobrevivir!
target: Unlike in Duo Duel, multiplayer battles do not grant extra moves. Please make eliminations within the allotted time and moves. Increase your bird's combat power, and try to stay alive!

source: A duração do Escudo exibido corresponde à porcentagem de PV máximos do personagem que o efeito de Escudo remanescente representa.
target: The displayed Shield length corresponds to the percentage of the character's Max HP that the remaining Shield Effect represents.

source: A duração do filme é limitada no Modo Filme. A barra de progresso abaixo indica o progresso da filmagem.
target: The film's length is limited in Movie Mode. The progress bar below indicates the filming progress.

source: A energia pode ser acumulada ao acionar Arrancada Turbo e resgatar suprimentos. Quando a energia estiver completa, você pode entrar na Blitz das Sementinhas e experienciar um longo período de invencibilidade.
target: Energy can be accumulated by triggering Turbo Dash and picking up supplies. When energy is full, you will enter Nutty Blitz and experience a long period of invulnerability.

source: A energia pode ser acumulada ao melhorar a Cena de Ação e resgatar suprimentos. Quando a energia estiver completa, você acionará a Hora do Hanu e entrará em um longo período de invencibilidade.
target: Energy can be accumulated by conducting Action Scenes and picking up supplies. When energy is full, you will trigger Hanu Time and enter a long period of invulnerability.

source: A experiência que você ganhou durante a Missão da Finalidade também pode ser vista nas Encruzilhadas do Destino.
target: The experience you gained during the Finality Mission can also be viewed in Fate's Atlas.

source: A gravidade da realidade está te pesando? Não se preocupe! Em Astrópolis, basta seguir os caminhos iluminados para desafiar a gravidade e caminhar pelas paredes, sem precisar de nenhum equipamento especial.
target: Is the gravity of reality weighing you down? Don't worry! In Astropolis, just follow the glowing paths to defy gravity and walk right up the wall surfaces, no special gadgets required.

source: A habilidade "Automatizar" permite que a funcionária entregue refeições, limpe e envie pedidos à cozinha automaticamente
target: The Automate skill allows staff to automatically deliver meals, clean, and place orders with the kitchen

source: A loja dentro do Domínio - Trégua pode Aprimorar Bênçãos limitadas do evento. Em cada loja, todas as Bênçãos podem ser Aprimoradas 1 vez.
target: The store within Domain — Respite can Enhance event-limited Blessings. In each store, all Blessings can be Enhanced 1 time.

source: A los camareros se les puede caer comida mientras la sirven y bloquear el paso.
target: The waiters might spill food while serving, blocking a path

source: A luz do Orbe Milagroso transformará a área iluminada em outro espaço-tempo.
target: The light from the Miracle Orb will invert the illuminated area into the other space-time.

source: A maioria dos Domínios pode ser aprimorada. Após aprimorar um Domínio, seu conteúdo também será aprimorado.
target: Most Domains can be leveled up. After leveling up a Domain, its contents will be enhanced.

source: A maioria dos Domínios pode ter Sinalizadores anexados a eles, criando todos os tipos de efeitos interessantes. Cada Domínio pode ter até 3 Sinalizadores anexados.
target: Most Domains can have beacons attached to them, creating all kinds of interesting effects. Each Domain can have up to 3 beacons attached.

source: A medida que aumenta el progreso de renovación, la decoración de la habitación se irá mejorando poco a poco.
target: As your renovation progress increases, your room's overall décor will also be refined.

source: A medida que aumenta tu nivel, será más fácil encontrar personajes de mayor costo al actualizar la tienda.
target: As your level increases, higher cost characters will appear more frequently in the Store.

source: A medida que aumente el número de rondas, aparecerán quimeras de mayor rareza en la tienda.
target: As the number of Cycles increases, higher rarity chimeras will appear in the Store.

source: A medida que desbloqueas las etapas, más comediantes participarán en el espectáculo. El comediante de tu equipo pondrá en la Caja de la risa distintos Regalos sorpresa que proporcionan distintos tipos de beneficios en el combate.
target: As you unlock more stages, more Comedians will join the show. The Comedian in your team will put different Surprise Gifts into the Surprise Box, providing various benefits in combat.

source: A onda atual de inimigos e o número de inimigos derrotados na onda atual serão exibidos na batalha.
target: The current wave of enemies and the number of enemies defeated in the current wave will be displayed during battle.

source: A operação manual só pode fazer ajustes mínimos aos contêineres de carga na linha de montagem. As luzes do painel de controle indicam a amplitude possível desses ajustes.
target: Manual operation can only make minor adjustments to the freight containers on the assembly line. The lights on the control panel indicate the range of the adjustments that can be performed.

source: A partida da "Guerra Monetária" consiste em 3 Planos. Cada Plano contém vários Nódulos de diferentes tipos.
target: The Currency Wars match consists of 3 Planes. Each Plane contains several Nodes of different types.

source: A pontuação final será calculada com base na soma total de pontos marcados nas batalhas do Nódulo 1 e do Nódulo 2.
target: The final points will be calculated based on the sum of points scored in the Node 1 and Node 2 battles.

source: A pontuação final será calculada com base nos pontos totais marcados nas batalhas do Nódulo 1 e do Nódulo 2.
target: The final score will be calculated based on the total points scored in the Node 1 and Node 2 battles.

source: A quantidade de Fragmentos Cósmicos necessários para sobrescrever aumenta com cada tentativa de sobrescrição. Há um limite para a quantidade de vezes que cada Bancada da Criação pode sobrescrever Componentes.
target: The Cosmic Fragments required for overwriting increases with each overwriting attempt. There is a limit to the number of times each Workbench of Creation can overwrite Components.

source: A quantidade de Fragmentos Cósmicos necessários para sobrescrever uma Equação aumenta com cada tentativa de substituição. Há um limite para a quantidade de vezes que cada Bancada da Criação pode sobrescrever Equações.
target: The number of Cosmic Fragments required to overwrite an Equation increases with each overwriting attempt. There is a limit to the number of times each Workbench of Creation can overwrite Equations.

source: A quimera invocada será exibida na fila de invocação antes de entrar em combate.
target: The summoned chimera will be displayed in the summon queue before joining combat.

source: A veces, la flor del conocimiento puede estar afectada por la corrosión. Aunque retroceda en el tiempo, puede regresar a su estado anterior al retroceso.
target: Cognos Bloom sometimes becomes corrupted. Even after it has been Rewound, it will still return to its state before the ability was used.

source: A veces, los objetos cargados de recuerdos pueden estar corroídos por la marea oscura. Aunque retrocedan en el tiempo, pueden volver a destruirse al cabo de poco tiempo y regresar a su estado anterior a la activación de la habilidad.
target: Sometimes, memory-laden objects may be corroded by the black tide. Even if they were rewound, they might become shattered again after a short time, returning to the state before activating the power.

source: A versão aprimorada do equipamento avançado com o mesmo nome. Além de possuir atributos mais poderosos, seus efeitos únicos de combate também serão fortalecidos.
target: The enhanced version of advanced equipment with the same name. In addition to having more powerful stats, its unique combat effects will also be strengthened.

source: A zona vermelha em forma de leque representa obstáculos que bloqueiam o caminho e a rota não pode passar por eles. Certifique-se de evitá-los ao conectar a rota.
target: The red fan-shaped zone represents obstacles that block the path, and the route cannot pass through them. Be sure to avoid them when connecting the route.

source: A área de Estatuetas exibe lembranças que você coletou em suas viagens, e você também pode colocar itens especiais no espaço central!
target: The figure zone is for displaying mementos you've picked up on your travels, and you can place special items in the center spot too!

source: A área de medalhas exibe provas de suas glórias conquistadas em desafios e registra os Caminhos desbloqueados que você já desbloqueou.
target: The medal zone showcases proof of glory earned from Challenges and records your unlocked Paths.

source: A única coisa que pode puni-lo é o poder de Oronyx. Quando próximo a uma Moeda do Capricho, use os poderes de retrocesso fornecidos pela "Prece de Oronyx" nas fissuras por onde o ladrão escapa para fazer o Ladrão Espiritual voltar.
target: The only thing that can punish them is Oronyx's power. When near a Coin of Whimsy, use the rewinding powers provided by Oronyx's Prayer upon the fissures the thief escapes through to get the Spirithief to come back.

source: ATK musuh meningkat pesat. Saat musuh menyerang rekan tim, akan mengakibatkan serangan mematikan pada rekan tim.
target: Enemy ATK is greatly increased. When they attack, they will deal killing blows to allies.

target: Enemy ATK is greatly increased. When they attack, they will deal killing blows to allies.

target: Complete designated combat actions and achieve Highlights during the matches to gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Accumule de la valeur de combat en infligeant une Rupture de faiblesse à un ennemi ou en attaquant des ennemis en Rupture de faiblesse.
target: Break the enemy's Weakness or attack Weakness Broken enemies to accumulate Grit Value.

source: Accumulez des points en utilisant le Bazook-Hanu pour détruire des cibles. Gagnez un maximum de points pour atteindre les objectifs de cette vague. Plus vous remplissez d'objectifs de vague, plus les récompenses sont importantes.
target: Gain Points by launching Hanu Rocket to break targets. Gain more Points to reach the target for this wave. The more times you reach the wave target, the better the rewards you will receive at the end.

target: Watch out for moving objects. They may collide with the Trailblazer. You may get hurt if you're not being careful.

source: Achte auf den Rhythmus und reagiere zum richtigen Zeitpunkt.
target: Pay attention to the music's rhythm and react at the correct moment.

source: Achte auf die Laufwege der Monster und nutze die Objekte auf der Karte, um ihnen die Sicht zu versperren. Erreiche das Ziel, ohne von den Monstern bemerkt zu werden.
target: Please observe the monsters' paths and utilize objects in the map to obstruct their line of sight. Reach the destination without being detected by the monsters.

source: Achte gut auf diese Menschen! Du wirst zusätzliche Überraschungen erhalten, wenn du sie alle reparierst, ticktack!
target: Pay lots of attention to these people! You'll receive additional surprises once you've fixed all of them, tick tock!

source: Activa el Ojo del sueño para cambiar a la vista del Soñador. En este modo, las rutas desconectadas con diferentes alturas se conectarán de una manera sorprendente.
target: Activating the Dream's Eye allows you to switch to the Dreamweaver's View. In this mode, disconnected paths or those with height discrepancies will be connected in an incredible way.

source: Activa el combate automático para usar las habilidades automáticamente. Sin embargo, en algunos combates especiales este modo estará desactivado.
target: Use auto-battle to cast abilities and fight automatically. However, auto-battle cannot be used in some special combat situations.

source: Activa la velocidad doble para poder disfrutar de un combate más rápido. Sin embargo, en algunos combates especiales este modo estará desactivado.
target: Use 2× speed to experience quicker battles. However, 2× speed will be temporarily turned off in some special combat situations.

target: Activating the Dream's Eye allows you to switch to the Dreamweaver's View. In this mode, disconnected paths or those with height discrepancies will be connected in an incredible way.

target: Fate's Ensemble

source: Acumula valor de Coraje durante la batalla para cargarlo completamente y entrar en la fase de Coraje tumultuoso, en la que obtienes una poderosa bonificación de etapa y mejoras en gran medida tu efectividad en combate.
target: Accumulate Grit Value during battle. Upon fully filling the gauge, enters the Surging Grit phase that grants powerful stage buffs and significantly improves combat efficiency.

source: Acumular "Valor de Bravura" durante a batalha eleva sua Fase de Bravura. Ao entrar na "Fase de Bravura 4: Poder Desperto", é possível obter melhorias de estágio poderosas e aumentar significativamente a sua eficácia em combate.
target: Accumulating Grit Value during battle can elevate your Grit Phase. When entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken", you can obtain powerful stage buffs and significantly improve your combat effectiveness.

source: Acumular valor de Coraje durante la batalla aumenta tu fase de Coraje. Cuando entres en Coraje fase 4: El despertar del poder, puedes obtener poderosas bonificaciones de etapa y mejorar en gran medida tu efectividad en combate.
target: Accumulating Grit Value during battle can elevate your Grit Phase. When entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken", you can obtain powerful stage buffs and significantly improve your combat effectiveness.

source: Acumule "Valor de Bravura" durante a batalha. Ao carregar completamente a barra, você entra na fase de "Surto de Bravura" que concede melhorias de estágio poderosas e aumenta significativamente a eficiência de combate.
target: Accumulate Grit Value during battle. Upon fully filling the gauge, enters the Surging Grit phase that grants powerful stage buffs and significantly improves combat efficiency.

source: Acumule mais "Portão da Babilônia!" e utilize um golpe devastador!
target: Get more "Gate of Babylon!" and unleash an earth-shattering strike!

source: Acércate a una fuente de burbujas e interactúa con ella para obtener cargas de burbujas de ensueño.
target: Approach Bubble Tower and interact with it to obtain Bubble Charges.

source: Ada banyak pemain yang bersedia memainkan pertandingan "Kekuatan Galaksi" denganmu di Planarcadia. Kalau kamu melihat ikon khusus ini, artinya setelah menang bermain melawan mereka, kamu bisa mendapatkan kartu baru.
target: In Planarcadia, there are many card players willing to challenge you to a "Cosmicon Collective" match. When you see this special icon, it means you can earn new cards after defeating them in a match.

source: Ada beberapa potongan "Puzzle Mimpi" yang tidak stabil. Saat berinteraksi, potongan-potongan tersebut akan kabur dari puzzle dan menyebar di posisi lain di dalam latar tempat.
target: Some Dream Jigsaw pieces are unstable and may move to another location in the scene during interaction.

source: Ada beberapa stan spesial dari berbagai tempat di galaksi. Kamu dapat mengundang karakter yang kamu kenal untuk menjadi asisten dan bekerja sama denganmu untuk mengelola pameran.
target: The venue has unique booths from all over the cosmos. You can invite familiar characters as assistants to run the exhibition together.

source: Ada dua jenis putaran pada kompas, yaitu putaran yang mengikuti arah jarum jam dan putaran yang berlawanan dengan arah jarum jam.
target: Two types of rotations exist: Clockwise and counterclockwise.

source: Ada fungsi lain di terminal yang dapat digunakan untuk memeriksa pengembangan Aether Spirit.
target: The terminal has other functions as well. You can check how to build your Aether Spirits

source: Ada kotak khusus yang memiliki fungsi teleport. Kalau melewati kotak tersebut, kamu akan di-teleport ke kotak lain yang sama. Jadi berhati-hatilah!
target: You can use certain blocks to teleport. When you tread on one such block, you will be teleported to another one of the same color. Be careful how you use them.

source: Ada pemain lain yang berpartisipasi dalam Perang Aetherium di dunia. Pergilah berduel dan raihlah kemenangan. Memenangkan duel akan membuka lawan baru untukmu.
target: There are other Aetherium Wars players in the world. Heading into matches and claiming victory will continuously unlock new opponents for you.

source: Ada tombol khusus di peta yang setelah diinjak akan mereset sekelompok portal teleport dengan warna energi yang sama. Tombol tidak akan muncul saat portal teleport berstatus terbuka.
target: There are special buttons on the map. Stepping on them will reset a set of teleporters of the same energy color. The buttons will not appear while the teleporters are active.

source: Además de aumentar sus atributos, el efecto de Empoderamiento de personaje también mejorará tras mejorar su nivel de estrellas. Por ejemplo: el Dr. Ratio puede lanzar tizas de forma consecutiva para atacar a los enemigos durante el combate.
target: After a character is upgraded, besides gaining stat increases, their Character Empowerment effects will also be enhanced. For example: Dr. Ratio can consecutively throw chalks to attack enemies in combat.

source: Además de invitar a amigos, también puedes invitar a otros personajes para desafiar juntos a enemigos poderosos.
target: Besides inviting Friends, you can also invite other characters to take on formidable foes.

source: Además de las misiones trazacaminos con las que avanzas en la historia, también encontrarás otras misiones durante tu exploración.
target: Aside from completing Trailblaze Missions to progress the storyline, other missions can also be encountered in the exploration.

source: Además, en la reunión de la cena del turno puedes elegir y enviar informes de trabajo. Según la valoración que le otorgue Pom-Pom, conseguirás más fondos del Expreso.
target: At the same time, during the Dinner Meeting phase of every duty period, you can choose to submit the Duty Reports and additionally obtain Express Funds based on the score from Pom-Pom.

source: Además, lanzar un contraataque, aplicar Envenenamiento, Espinas y otras acciones similares también pueden otorgar puntos tácticos.
target: Additionally, performing Counters, inflicting Poison and Thorns, and other such actions may also grant Tactics Points.

source: Además, las formaciones de equipo con diferentes perspectivas son independientes entre sí, pero comparten efectos de estados, PV, puntos de técnica, etc.
target: Moreover, team lineups across different POVs are independent of each other but share their Status Effects, HP, Technique Points, etc.

source: Además, puedes completar las misiones diarias para obtener las recompensas correspondientes.
target: Aside from that, you can also complete Daily Missions to obtain corresponding rewards.

source: Adicione personagens com o mesmo Traço que o líder para aproveitar ao máximo o efeito do líder.
target: Add characters with the same Trait as the leader to make the most of the leader's effect.

source: Aeon cổ đại "Tham Ăn" đang dần thức tỉnh, sức mạnh đói khát của nó đang ăn mòn ra bên ngoài. Một bộ phận kẻ địch trong thế giới này đã bị lây nhiễm, nhận được sự cường hóa từ sức mạnh "Tham Ăn".
target: The ancient Aeon of Voracity is gradually awakening, THEIR ravenous power steadily encroaching outward. Infecting a portion of this world's enemies, THEY empower them with the might of Voracity.

source: Aeon kuno "Voracity" perlahan bangkit, kekuatannya yang rakus terus menggerogoti ke luar. Sebagian musuh di dunia ini terinfeksi olehnya, memperoleh penguatan dari kekuatan "Voracity".
target: The ancient Aeon of Voracity is gradually awakening, THEIR ravenous power steadily encroaching outward. Infecting a portion of this world's enemies, THEY empower them with the might of Voracity.

source: Aether Spirit terbagi menjadi 3 tipe, yang masing-masing memiliki kelebihan dan kelemahan terhadap satu sama lain, yaitu: tipe Mekanis, Humanoid, dan Anomali. Memanfaatkan kelebihan dan kekurangan masing-masing tipe adalah kunci kemenangan.
target: Aether Spirits can be sorted into the Mechanical, Humanoid, and Aberrant types that counteract each other. Utilizing their counteracting relationship is the key to victory.

source: Aether Spirit มีสามประเภทคือ จักรกล มนุษย์ และสิ่งประหลาด ซึ่งมีการยับยั้งซึ่งกันและกัน การใช้ประโยชน์จากความสัมพันธ์แบบยับยั้งกันอย่างเหมาะสม จะเป็นกุญแจสู่ชัยชนะ
target: Aether Spirits can be sorted into the Mechanical, Humanoid, and Aberrant types that counteract each other. Utilizing their counteracting relationship is the key to victory.

target: Assignments

source: Affrontez vos adversaires dans des matchs pour gagner des Jetons de pouvoir et de la Poussière de pouvoir. En combattant le gang Mogura, vous pouvez également obtenir des Jetons de pouvoir victorieux en bonus.
target: Defeat opponents in matches to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards. When fighting against the Mogura Gang, you can also obtain special "Victorious Power Tokens" as an extra bonus.

target: Discernment Tuning

target: Discernment Tuning

target: Accommodate Creations

target: Aurum Alley's Hustle and Bustle: Inventory Arrangement

target: Aurum Alley's Hustle and Bustle: Logistics Planning

source: Aglaea ha instalado Sastres en las zonas donde es probable que aparezcan las ninfas. Si aún quedan ninfas que no has encontrado en la zona, puedes entregar esquirlas de recuerdos al Sastre para que te ayude a localizarlas.
target: Aglaea has set up Garmentmakers beforehand at areas where nymphs can be found. If there are still nymphs to be found in the area, Memory Crystal Shard can be submitted to the Garmentmaker to help locate them.

source: Aglaea sudah menempatkan "Garmentmaker" di area tempat nimfa-nimfa muncul. Jika di area tersebut masih ada nimfa-nimfa yang belum ditemukan, serahkan "Serpihan Kristal Memori" agar "Garmentmaker" dapat membantu menunjukkan lokasi nimfa.
target: Aglaea has set up Garmentmakers beforehand at areas where nymphs can be found. If there are still nymphs to be found in the area, Memory Crystal Shard can be submitted to the Garmentmaker to help locate them.

source: Aglaea đã bố trí sẵn Thợ May ở các khu vực nhộng tiên xuất hiện.Nếu khu vực này vẫn còn nhộng chưa bị phát hiện, có thể giao nộp Mảnh Tinh Thể Ký Ức để Thợ May giúp chỉ ra vị trí.
target: Aglaea has set up Garmentmakers beforehand at areas where nymphs can be found. If there are still nymphs to be found in the area, Memory Crystal Shard can be submitted to the Garmentmaker to help locate them.

source: Aglaea ได้จัดวาง "หุ่นตัดชุด" ในพื้นที่ที่มีแมลงปรากฏตัวไว้ล่วงหน้าแล้ว หากพื้นที่ดังกล่าวยังมีแมลงที่ยังไม่ถูกค้นพบ สามารถมอบ "ผลึกความทรงจำ" เพื่อให้ "หุ่นตัดชุด" ช่วยระบุตำแหน่งได้
target: Aglaea has set up Garmentmakers beforehand at areas where nymphs can be found. If there are still nymphs to be found in the area, Memory Crystal Shard can be submitted to the Garmentmaker to help locate them.

source: Agora você sabe como usar o Truquelógio! Experimente alterar as emoções de alguém! Diferentes emoções trazem surpresas diferentes!
target: Now you know how to use Clockwork! Go try changing someone's emotions! Different emotions bring different surprises!

source: Aha aparece en la barra de acción cuando se tienen puntos de Chiste. Cuantos más personajes de la Vía de la Exultación haya, mayor es la VEL de Aha. Aha consume todos los puntos de Chiste tras actuar.
target: After gaining Punchline, Aha is added to the action bar. Aha's SPD increases based on the number of Elation characters present. After Aha's turn, all Punchline stacks are consumed.

source: Aha-Moment
target: Aha Instant

source: Aile du néant peut consommer ses propres PV pour déchaîner un souffle en continu sur tous les ennemis. Lorsque les PV d'Aile du néant sont inférieurs à 25 %, il peut continuer son souffle et déclencher son autodestruction.
target: Netherwing can consume its own HP to continuously blast all enemies. When Netherwing's HP is under 25%, it can continue blasting to trigger self-destruct.

source: Ajoutez des personnages avec la même caractéristique que le meneur pour maximiser l'effet du meneur.
target: Add characters with the same Trait as the leader to make the most of the leader's effect.

source: Akibatkan Break DMG pada musuh untuk memicu "Momen Puncak" dan memperoleh "Poin Atmosfer" dalam jumlah besar. Semakin tinggi jumlah lapisan Vulnerability yang dimiliki musuh, semakin banyak "Poin Atmosfer" yang akan diperoleh.
target: Deal Break DMG to enemies and trigger Highlights to get massive Vibes. The more Vulnerability stacks are inflicted on an enemy, the more Vibes will be gained.

source: Akibatkan Break pada Mass-Production Machine untuk memicu "Momen Puncak" dan memperoleh "Poin Atmosfer" dalam jumlah besar.
target: Break the Mass-Production Machine and trigger Highlights to gain massive Vibes.

source: Akibatkan Weakness Break pada Yanqing atau objek panggilan untuk memicu "Momen Puncak" dan memperoleh "Poin Atmosfer" dalam jumlah besar.
target: Break Yanqing or his summons' Weaknesses to trigger Highlights and obtain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Akibatkan Weakness Break pada musuh di medan pertempuran untuk memicu "Momen Puncak" dan memperoleh "Poin Atmosfer" dalam jumlah besar.
target: Break the Weaknesses of enemies on the field to trigger Highlights and gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Akibatkan Weakness Break pada musuh ini untuk menambahkan Buff bagi rekan tim.
target: Break this enemy's Weakness to apply buffs to allies.

source: Aksi Tak Terbatas: Panduan Bermain
target: Perpetual Exploit: Gameplay Details

source: Aktifkan "Mata Pemimpi" untuk beralih ke sudut pandang Pembangun Mimpi. Dalam sudut pandang tersebut, jalur yang semula terputus atau memiliki perbedaan ketinggian akan terhubung dengan cara yang luar biasa.
target: Activating the Dream's Eye allows you to switch to the Dreamweaver's View. In this mode, disconnected paths or those with height discrepancies will be connected in an incredible way.

source: Aktion ohne Ende: Spielweise
target: Perpetual Exploit: Gameplay Details

source: Aktionsreihenfolge
target: Action Order

source: Aktionsreihenfolge zeigt die Reihenfolge der Aktionen von Verbündeten und Gegnern an. Die Figur, die an der Spitze der Reihenfolge steht, wird als Nächstes handeln.
target: Action Order shows the order of action of both allies and enemies. The character at the top of the order will take action first.

source: Aktiviere Auto-Kampf, um automatisch zu kämpfen und Fähigkeiten einzusetzen. In manchen besonderen Kampfsituationen kann Auto-Kampf jedoch nicht verwendet werden.
target: Use auto-battle to cast abilities and fight automatically. However, auto-battle cannot be used in some special combat situations.

source: Aktiviere GES ×2, um Kämpfe schneller zu erleben. In manchen besonderen Kampfsituationen wird GES ×2 jedoch vorübergehend ausgeschaltet.
target: Use 2× speed to experience quicker battles. However, 2× speed will be temporarily turned off in some special combat situations.

source: Akumulasi "Nilai Ketangguhan" dalam pertempuran. Setelah terisi penuh akan memasuki tahap "Ketangguhan Bergolak", memperoleh Buff Stage yang kuat, dan meningkatkan efisiensi pertempuran secara signifikan.
target: Accumulate Grit Value during battle. Upon fully filling the gauge, enters the Surging Grit phase that grants powerful stage buffs and significantly improves combat efficiency.

source: Al apilar bloques puedes cambiar la forma del dispositivo. Cuando su forma coincida con las mostradas en los dos paneles laterales, se considera que completaste el acertijo.
target: Stack cubes to alter the device's shape. When its shape matches with those shown on the plates on the two sides, the puzzle is solved.

source: Al apuntar, la Mano de Zagreus puede detectar objetos destruibles brillantes. Al esprintar hacia un objeto destruible, lo destruirá. Al estrellarse, la Mano de Zagreus dejará de esprintar.
target: While in the aiming state, the Hand of Zagreus can detect destructible objects that glow. Sprint at the destructible object to destroy it. Upon collision, the Hand of Zagreus will stop sprinting.

source: Al atacar a este enemigo, puede cambiar entre Canal sorpresa y Canal aterrador.
target: Attacking this enemy can make it switch between Surprise Channel and Fright Channel.

source: Al atacar a un enemigo con Ruptura de Debilidad, se activarán los efectos de Ruptura de Debilidad de todos los tipos.
target: Attacking a Weakness Broken enemy target will trigger Weakness Break effects of all Types.

source: Al aumentar el pulido de la tarjeta de un personaje hasta la rareza máxima, la apariencia de la tarjeta obtendrá una textura holográfica.
target: After you Gild a Character Card to maximum Rarity, the card's appearance will gain a holographic texture.

source: Al borde de la muerte: modo de juego
target: Perilous Threshold: Gameplay Details

source: Al causar Ruptura de Debilidad a los enemigos, su ataque cargado se interrumpe.
target: Upon inflicting Weakness Break on an enemy, their Charged ATK will be interrupted.

source: Al causar Ruptura de Debilidad de Hielo o Imaginaria, se aplica el estado de Congelación o Prisión y se reduce el número de acciones del enemigo.
target: Causing Weakness Break with Ice and Imaginary DMG will inflict Frozen and Imprisonment effects respectively and reduce the enemy's actions.

source: Al comenzar el turno de un personaje afectado por el estado de Felicidad, las acumulaciones aumentan; al terminar el turno, si se alcanza un número determinado de acumulaciones, el personaje se convierte en Marioneta de la felicidad.
target: Characters afflicted with the "Happiness" state will gain stacks at the start of their turn. Once they reach a certain number of stacks at the end of their turn, they will be converted into a "Happiness Puppet."

source: Al comenzar la batalla, los enemigos se encuentran en estado de bloqueo de Debilidad.
target: At the start of the battle, enemies are in the Weaknessproof State.

source: Al comenzar la ronda, los jugadores heredan el campo de batalla final de la ronda anterior y todos obtienen los mismos efectos de campo nuevos.
target: When the turn starts, the players will inherit the final field from the previous round, and all players will receive the same additional field effect.

source: Al competir en el Torneo de Exhibición de Destrezas de Villarroca, los jugadores ya no reciben una bonificación fija en cada turno, sino que pueden seleccionarlas libremente.
target: While competing in the Boulder Town Martial Exhibition, players can now freely choose the buffs they receive each round, instead of having fixed ones.

source: Al completar el Salón olvidado y alcanzar ciertos requisitos, obtendrás Estrellas grabadas. Cuando consigas una cantidad específica de estrellas, podrás recoger Regalo grabado.
target: Clear Forgotten Hall and meeting specific conditions to obtain Marks of Starre. A Mark Gift can be obtained after collecting enough Marks of Starre.

source: Al comprar piezas idénticas, puedes aumentar su experiencia.
target: When you purchase identical pieces, it increases the piece's EXP

source: Al confirmar la ruta en la brújula, se activará un mecanismo que conseguirá que aparezca un carril arcoíris en el mapa según la indicación de la brújula.
target: After confirming a route on the compass, a mechanism will be triggered. A rainbow path will be added to the map according to the specified state of the compass.

source: Al controlar la Mano de Zagreus, interactúa con la runa dorada de Zagreus para realizar una acción de puente, lo que te permitirá formar un puente donde se encuentra la runa para que puedas cruzar.
target: While controlling the Hand of Zagreus, interact with the golden Zagreus rune to perform a Bridge Action, forming a bridge where the rune is located to provide passage to the Trailblazer.

source: Al controlar la bomba autómata camuflada, presiona el botón de ataque para activar la autodetonación, aturdir a todos los enemigos en el radio de ataque y completar el desafío.
target: When controlling the Automaton Stealth Bomb, press the attack button to trigger self-detonation and stun all enemies in the attack radius to complete the challenge

source: Al derrotar a los oponentes en una partida, obtienes Fichas poderosas y Polvo poderoso como recompensa. Además, en los combates contra la Banda Mogura también puedes obtener Fichas poderosas de victoria.
target: Defeat opponents in matches to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards. When fighting against the Mogura Gang, you can also obtain special "Victorious Power Tokens" as an extra bonus.

source: Al derrotar a los oponentes, obtienes Fichas poderosas que puedes canjear por cartas y Polvo poderoso para pulir cartas.
target: Defeat opponents to earn Power Tokens for redeeming cards and Power Dust for gilding cards.

source: Al derrotar a los oponentes, obtienes Fichas poderosas y Polvo poderoso como recompensa.
target: Defeat opponents to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards.

source: Al desarrollar una creación puedes activar eventos de mutación. Tras depositar los materiales, obtendrás rasgos mutantes. Al activar mutaciones especiales, la creación se puede convertir en una creación rara.
target: Nurturing can sometimes trigger Mutation Events. After depositing the materials needed, creations obtain Mutant Traits. When triggering Special Mutations, creations can become rare creations.

source: Al detenerte en una casilla, se activa el efecto correspondiente. Cuando hayas elegido una carta de acción, intenta caer en una casilla beneficiosa.
target: An effect will be triggered based on the tile you stop on. When selecting Action Cards, do your best to end up on advantageous tiles.

source: Al disponer el restaurante, puedes comprar mesas para que más clientes puedan comer al mismo tiempo.
target: When setting up your restaurant, you can serve more customers simultaneously by purchasing dining tables

source: Al elegir un don específico, puedes cambiar la proporción de día y noche y tal vez alcanzar un estado perpetuo.
target: After selecting specific Boons, you can change the ratio of Day and Night and may even be able to make one state permanent.

source: Al eliminar frutas con bonificación, el poder de combate aumenta 3 pts.
target: When Boost Fruits are eliminated, add 3 Combat Power.

source: Al encender la lámpara, esta creará un área térmica esférica que puede encender todas las lámparas apagadas dentro de su alcance.
target: When a lamp is ignited, it will create a a spherical thermal area that can ignite all other unlit lamps within its boundaries

source: Al entrar en combate en el Universo Diferenciado, el daño infligido aumenta y el daño que recibe se reduce. Los efectos se potencian al aumentar el nivel de máscara.
target: When battling in the Divergent Universe, you can gain increased DMG dealt and reduced DMG taken. These effects will be enhanced as the Mask level increases.

source: Al entrar en el modo de popularidad, el precio de venta de todos los platos aumentará. Cuantos más clientes sean atendidos consecutivamente, mayor será el aumento de precio.
target: After entering Streak Fever, prices of all dishes will increase. The more customers you serve consecutively, the more the price increases

source: Al entrar en un desafío de Conversión excesiva, todos los aliados activan sus habilidades definitivas y recuperan 5 pts. de habilidad básica.
target: When entering the Excessive Conversion challenge, all allies will activate their Ultimates and recover 5 Skill Points.

source: Al entrar en una zona nueva del plano, ganar una batalla o destruir objetos destruibles, obtienes una gran cantidad de fragmentos cósmicos.
target: Entering a new domain, achieving victory in battle, or destroying destructible objects will all get you a large number of Cosmic Fragments in this plane.

source: Al enviar informes del mismo miembro del equipo, puedes formar una combinación de informes y aumentar los puntos para conseguir una mejor valoración de Pom-Pom.
target: When submitting similar reports, you can create a report bundle, increase your score efficiency, and obtain higher scores from Pom-Pom.

source: Al final del combate obtendrás: Ingresos de monedas de oro del nodo = Monedas de oro base + Monedas de oro por racha de victorias + intereses.
target: At the end of combat, you will receive: Current Node's Gold Coins = Base Gold Coins + Winning Streak Gold Coins + Interest.

source: Al final del combate, por cada 10 monedas de oro que tengas, ganarás 1 moneda de oro de interés (hasta un máximo de 5 monedas de oro). Ahorrar monedas de oro con moderación es una forma efectiva de obtener más recursos económicos.
target: At the end of combat, for every 10 Gold Coins you own, you'll earn 1 Gold Coin as interest (up to 5 Gold Coins). Moderately saving up Gold Coins is an effective way to gain more economic advantage.

source: Al final se calculan los puntos totales del nodo 1 y nodo 2.
target: The final points will be calculated based on the sum of points scored in the Node 1 and Node 2 battles.

source: Al final se calculan los puntos totales del nodo 1 y nodo 2.
target: The final score will be calculated based on the total points scored in the Node 1 and Node 2 battles.

source: Al ganar en los nodos de combate, encuentro y jefe, los PV de escuadra se mantienen sin cambios. Si no logras la victoria, perderás cierta cantidad de PV de escuadra. Cuando los PV de escuadra llegan a 0, pierdes la partida.
target: When you achieve victory at Battle, Encounter, or Boss Nodes, the squad HP remains unchanged. If you do not achieve victory, you will lose a certain amount of squad HP. The match is lost if the squad HP drops to 0.

source: Al ganar una batalla, el contador de racha de victorias aumenta en 1. Cuanto más larga sea la racha de victorias, mayor será la recompensa de monedas de oro.
target: When you win a battle, your winning streak tally increases by 1. The longer your winning streak, the more Gold Coin Rewards you'll earn.

source: Al inicio de cada 2 turnos, comenzará la fase táctica, en la que podrás comprar cartas de tácticas.
target: At the start of every 2 turns, you'll enter the Tactics Segment, where you can purchase Tactics Cards.

source: Al inicio de cada cálculo, obtienes un mazo de cartas, el cual se divide en pila de reserva y pila de descarte.
target: At the start of each extrapolation, you'll receive a deck of cards, which is divided into a Draw Pile and a Discard Pile.

source: Al inicio de cada cálculo, puedes elegir una máscara. Una vez elegida, no se puede cambiar.
target: At the start of each extrapolation, you can select one Mask to wear. Once selected, it cannot be changed.

source: Al inicio de cada turno, obtiene 2 puntos tácticos.
target: Gains 2 Tactics Points at the start of each turn.

source: Al inicio del combate, obtiene cierta cantidad de puntos de Chiste en función del número de personajes de la Vía de la Exultación.
target: At the start of battle, gains a certain number of Punchlines based on the number of Elation characters present.

source: Al interactuar con las unidades de control, los módulos de sueño se pueden mover a lo largo del camino designado. Al mover módulos de sueño, las burbujas de ensueño dispersas en su superficie también se moverán con él.
target: By interacting with Control Panels, the Dream Module can be moved along the designated trajectory. When moving the Dream Module, the scattered dream bubbles on its surface will also move with it.

source: Al lanzar la técnica de Cirene, aumenta la velocidad de acción de todos los compañeros de equipo. Después de entrar en combate, se activará inmediatamente un campo que añade Daño verdadero a los ataques de los compañeros de equipo.
target: After using Cyrene's Technique, boosts all teammates' action speed. After entering combat, instantly deploys a Zone, allowing teammates' attacks to inflict additional True DMG.

source: Al lanzar su habilidad definitiva, Feixiao consume todos los puntos de Feihuang para causar daño varias veces a todos los enemigos.
target: When using Ultimate, Feixiao can consume all Flying Aureus to deal multiple instances of DMG to all enemies.

source: Al mejorar la máscara, se puede obtener un milagro. Cuando el nivel de máscara alcanza un múltiplo de 4, puedes elegir un milagro maravilloso con efectos más poderosos.
target: When the Mask levels up, you'll gain a miracle. When the Mask reaches a level that is a multiple of 4, you can select a more powerful Grand Miracle.

source: Al mismo tiempo, el aguante de las quimeras se reduce en una cantidad equivalente al consumo de tarea utilizado.
target: At the same time, the chimeras will reduce their stamina by an amount equal to their Task Consumption.

source: Al pasar por el anillo de aceleración con el Muérdago, obtendrás un potente efecto de aceleración durante el cual no podrás controlar la dirección.
target: Piloting the Mistletoe through an Acceleration Ring will grant a powerful speed boost effect, during which directional control is disabled.

source: Al recibir un golpe letal, el personaje no es derrotado y regenera el 100% de sus PV y el 50% de su energía.
target: When allies receive killing blows, they will not be downed, but instead restore 100% HP and regenerate 50% Energy.

source: Al reclutar personajes en Guerra de Divisas: Si ya tienes el personaje, heredarás los datos de desarrollo de tu personaje. Si no tienes el personaje, podrás reclutar su correspondiente personaje de prueba para jugar.
target: When recruiting characters in "Currency Wars": If you already own the character, you will inherit your character's build data. If you don't own the character, you can recruit a trial version of the character to play with.

source: Al reducir los PV de Conquistar o Ser Conquistado, se recuperan los PV máx. regenerables del personaje correspondiente, y el personaje puede infligir más daño al atacar al Conquistar o Ser Conquistado correspondiente.
target: Reducing the HP of "Conquer or Be Conquered" restores the corresponding character's Maximum Restorable HP, and the character can deal increased DMG when attacking their corresponding "Conquer or Be Conquered."

source: Al retroceder en el tiempo un objeto, este no se verá afectado por la zona de tiempo detenido.
target: While rewinding an object, that object will not be affected by the time-stopped zone.

source: Al romper la Debilidad de un enemigo, se adelanta la acción un 100% y se recupera 1 pt. de habilidad básica.
target: When Breaking an enemy's Weakness, Advances Action Forward by 100% and recovers 1 Skill Point.

source: Al romper la Debilidad del enemigo, inflige inmediatamente Daño de Ruptura una vez. El Daño de Ruptura aumenta conforme aumenta el efecto de Ruptura, y no puede infligir un Golpe CRIT.
target: When Breaking enemies' Weakness, immediately deals Break DMG once. Break DMG increases with Break Effect and cannot CRIT.

source: Al romper objetos en el Universo Simulado, podrás obtener fragmentos cósmicos, regenerar PV o recuperar puntos de técnica.
target: Break objects in the Simulated Universe to gain a random number of Cosmic Fragments, restore HP, or recover Technique Points.

source: Al superar el desafío de la dificultad del rango más alto actual, obtienes una evaluación de la partida según los PV de escuadra que te queden al finalizar, lo que te permite subir de rango.
target: Successfully challenging the current highest rank difficulty will earn you a battle rating based on your remaining squad HP, allowing you to rank up.

source: Al superar la dificultad 3 de Espejismo apocalíptico, se desbloquea el modo Despertar estelar. Para superar la dificultad 4 del modo Despertar estelar debes desafiar 3 nodos.
target: Clear Apocalyptic Shadow Difficulty 3 to unlock Starward Mode. Clearing Starward Mode Difficulty 4 requires challenging 3 Nodes.

source: Al superar la etapa 3 de Pura ficción, se desbloquea el modo Despertar estelar. Para superar la etapa 4 del modo Despertar estelar debes desafiar 3 nodos.
target: Clear Stage 3 of Pure Fiction to unlock Starward Mode. Clearing Stage 4 in Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes.

source: Al superar la etapa, si quedan 70 o más PV de escuadra, el rango se incrementa en 3. Si quedan 40 o menos PV de escuadra, el rango se incrementa en 2. Si quedan menos de 40 PV de escuadra, el rango se incrementa en 1.
target: If squad HP is 70 or above, rank increases by 3. When clearing the stage, if squad HP is 40 or above, rank increases by 2. When clearing the stage, if squad HP is below 40, rank increases by 1.

source: Al superar la etapa, si quedan 70 o más PV de escuadra, el rango se incrementa en 3. Si quedan 40 o menos PV de escuadra, el rango se incrementa en 2. Si quedan menos de 40 PV de escuadra, el rango se incrementa en 1.
target: When clearing the stage, if squad HP is 70 or above, rank increases by 3. When clearing the stage, if squad HP is 40 or above, rank increases by 2. When clearing the stage, if squad HP is below 40, rank increases by 1.

source: Al tener suficiente experiencia, la pieza subirá de nivel de estrellas, otorgándote efectos de combate más poderosos.
target: When pieces' EXP is full, their star rating increases, providing stronger combat effects

source: Al terminar de comer, los clientes pueden dejar la mesa sucia, lo que afecta al siguiente cliente cuando se sienta.
target: After dining, customers may leave the table messy, which can affect the next customer when they take a seat

source: Al terminar la prueba final, no se borrará el archivo de partida guardada. Puedes seleccionar planos guardados para volver a desafiar la prueba final.
target: After completing the Final Trial, the Save File for this challenge attempt will not be deleted. Planes with a Save File can be selected again to re-attempt the Final Trial.

source: Al terminar la ronda, el sistema calculará el daño según la diferencia de poder de combate. Si la vida del rival se reduce a 0, ganarás.
target: At the end of the turn, the system will calculate damage based on the Combat Power difference. If the opponent's HP is reduced to 0, you win.

source: Al usar ataques Cuánticos para causar Ruptura de Debilidad, se aplica el estado de Enredo.
target: Causing Weakness Break with Quantum DMG will inflict Entanglement.

source: Al usar esta habilidad, entra en un estado de invencibilidad y su VEL aumenta. Chocar con obstáculos o con otros esferoides aumenta la duración.
target: After using the ability, enters an invincible state and gains a speed boost. Colliding with other racers or obstacles extends the duration.

source: Al usar la habilidad definitiva, la acción se adelanta un 100%. Puedes usar la habilidad definitiva para que el mismo personaje actúe consecutivamente.
target: After characters cast their Ultimates, their actions are Advanced Forward by 100%. You can use Ultimates to make the same character act consecutively.

source: Alat Musik adalah fasilitas khas "Area Penacony", sebagian besar fasilitas ini memiliki efek yang sangat kuat, tetapi di setiap hari operasional hanya dapat dipicu dalam jumlah terbatas.
target: Musical instruments are special facilities unique to the Penacony Zone. Most of these facilities have incredibly powerful effects, but can only be triggered a limited number of times per business day.

source: Alat Pengendali Kristal Kuno yang ada di jalan akan mengubah status lantai yang warna energinya sama. Gunakan mereka untuk mencapai altar.
target: The Ancient Crystalline Controllers you find on the path can alter the state of the flooring that has the same energy color. Use them to help you reach the altar.

source: Algoritmo simulado inflige Daño Cuántico a todos los enemigos en cada turno durante la batalla. Ese daño reduce la Firmeza de todos los enemigos ignorando sus tipos de Debilidad.
target: Simulated Calculation will deal Quantum DMG to all enemies every turn. This DMG reduces Toughness of all enemies regardless of Weakness Type.

source: Algumas Runas de Titã exigem que outros mecanismos sejam utilizados de forma inteligente para ajustar seus padrões antes que possam ser totalmente montadas e continuar o download.
target: Some Titan runes require cleverly using other mechanisms to adjust their patterns before they can be fully assembled and continue downloading.

source: Algumas Runas de Titã precisam ser vistas de ângulos específicos antes que possam se alinhar corretamente e continuar o download.
target: Some Titan Runes need to be viewed from specific angles before they can align properly and continue downloading.

source: Algumas instalações podem aumentar a chance de ativação ou reduzir o intervalo de ativação de outras instalações. Planeje com sabedoria para garantir que os efeitos das instalações Culturais sejam ativados com frequência.
target: Some facilities can increase the trigger chance or reduce the trigger interval of other facilities. Plan wisely to ensure that the effects of cultural facilities are triggered frequently.

source: Algumas latas de lixo andarão de esquife estelar e algumas cairão do céu.
target: Some trashcans will ride starskiffs and some will fall from the sky.

source: Algumas peças do Quebra-Cabeça Onírico são instáveis e podem ir para outro local em cena durante a interação.
target: Some Dream Jigsaw pieces are unstable and may move to another location in the scene during interaction.

source: Algumas portas para a passagem secreta estão bastante complexas, apenas completando a imagem quando ambos os eixos horizontal e vertical estão alinhados, permitindo que você se mova rapidamente.
target: Some doors to the secret passages are rather complicated, only completing the image when both horizontal and vertical axes are aligned, allowing you to move quickly.

source: Algunas Pantallas cambiantes se pueden rotar y alinear con otras Pantallas cambiantes para que los personajes se teletransporten entre ellas.
target: Some Shifting Screens can be rotated and aligned to another Shifting Screen, allowing characters to teleport between them.

source: Algunas instalaciones pueden hacer que otras aumenten la probabilidad de activar sus efectos o reduzcan su intervalo de activación. Planifica todo bien para que los efectos de las instalaciones culturales se puedan activar con frecuencia.
target: Some facilities can increase the trigger chance or reduce the trigger interval of other facilities. Plan wisely to ensure that the effects of cultural facilities are triggered frequently.

source: Algunas paredes especiales se mueven según ciertos patrones. Aprovecha su movimiento para guiar la bola de piedra hacia la dirección correcta.
target: Some special wall panels will move in a set pattern. Use the right timing to take advantage of their traits to move the stone orb.

source: Algunas piezas del Rompecabezas de ensueño son inestables y pueden desplazarse a otra ubicación en la escena durante la interacción.
target: Some Dream Jigsaw pieces are unstable and may move to another location in the scene during interaction.

source: Algunas puertas de las sendas secretas son bastante complejas. Necesitas alinear los ejes horizontales y verticales para completar la imagen y poder moverte rápidamente.
target: Some doors to the secret passages are rather complicated, only completing the image when both horizontal and vertical axes are aligned, allowing you to move quickly.

source: Algunas runas de los Titanes requieren usar otros mecanismos hábilmente para ajustar el patrón y completarse antes de poder continuar con la descarga.
target: Some Titan runes require cleverly using other mechanisms to adjust their patterns before they can be fully assembled and continue downloading.

source: Algunas runas de los Titanes tienen que observarse desde un ángulo específico y completarse antes de poder continuar con la descarga.
target: Some Titan Runes need to be viewed from specific angles before they can align properly and continue downloading.

source: Algunos bloques especiales sirven para teletransportarse. Cuando pisas uno de ellos, te teletransportarás a otro parecido. Ten cuidado al utilizarlos.
target: You can use certain blocks to teleport. When you tread on one such block, you will be teleported to another one of the same color. Be careful how you use them.

source: Algunos consumibles tienen efectos especiales que se activan en el siguiente combate.
target: Some Consumables have special effects that will take effect in the next combat.

source: Algunos cubos de basura van subidos en astroesquifes, mientras que otros caen del cielo.
target: Some trashcans will ride starskiffs and some will fall from the sky.

source: Algunos cubos tienen unos patrones especiales. Tendrás que alinear los patrones en los paneles de los dos lados para resolver el Hexanexus.
target: Some cubes have special patterns on them, which need to match the patterns on the plates on the two sides to solve the Hexanexus.

source: Algunos cubos tienen unos patrones especiales. Tendrás que alinear los patrones en los paneles de los dos lados para resolver el Hexanexus.
target: Some cubes have special patterns on them, which need to match the patterns on the plates on the two sides to solve the puzzle of the Hexanexus.

source: Algunos efectos del dado pueden influir en el contenido de las zonas. Si seleccionas renunciar al efecto del dado, recibirás algunos fragmentos cósmicos como compensación.
target: Some Dice Effects can influence the content in the domains. If you select to give up the Dice Effect, you will receive some Cosmic Fragments as compensation.

source: Algunos enemigos hacen que los aliados entren en el estado de corrosión. Al atacar al enemigo, pueden regenerar sus PV corroídos. Cuantos más enemigos golpeen, más cantidad regeneran.
target: Certain enemies will inflict ally units with the "Corrosion" state. Attacking enemies will restore Corroded HP. The more targets hit, the more is restored.

source: Algunos enemigos utilizan un ataque cargado. Al recargar, lanzarán una poderosa habilidad definitiva en su siguiente acción.
target: Some enemies will unleash a powerful Charged ATK during their next action once they finish Charging.

source: Algunos lados del recipiente de icor están cubiertos por finas membranas. Estas se romperán al recibir un impacto y harán que el icor almacenado fluya.
target: Some sides of the ichor vessel are covered with a fragile membrane layer, which will break upon impact and cause ichor to flow out.

source: Algunos pajaritos especialmente traviesos no admiten su derrota y exigen que retires su disfraz poco a poco. Obsérvalos detenidamente y haz varios intentos para averiguar cómo capturarlos.
target: Some particularly playful birds won't directly admit their failure and require you to peel back their disguise little by little. Observe carefully and try many times to figure out the way to capture them.

source: Alguns Consumíveis têm efeitos especiais que serão ativados no próximo combate.
target: Some Consumables have special effects that will take effect in the next combat.

source: Alguns Dados Prismáticos possuem Faces especiais que ativam efeitos únicos quando são selecionadas!
target: Some Prismatic Dice have special Dice Faces that trigger unique effects when rolled and selected!

source: Alguns Efeitos de Dado podem influenciar o conteúdo dos domínios. Se você selecionar a opção de desistir do Efeito de Dado, você receberá alguns Fragmentos Cósmicos como compensação.
target: Some Dice Effects can influence the content in the domains. If you select to give up the Dice Effect, you will receive some Cosmic Fragments as compensation.

source: Alguns Painéis de Transporte podem ser girados e alinhados com outro Painel de Transporte para os personagens se teletransportarem entre eles.
target: Some Shifting Screens can be rotated and aligned to another Shifting Screen, allowing characters to teleport between them.

source: Alguns Traços de Personagem e efeitos climáticos podem aumentar temporariamente o número de vezes que você pode usar os Dados Prismáticos.
target: Some Character Traits and weather effects may temporarily increase the number of times you can use the Prismatic Dice.

source: Alguns cubos têm padrões especiais que precisam corresponder aos padrões das placas nos dois lados para solucionar o Hexanexus.
target: Some cubes have special patterns on them, which need to match the patterns on the plates on the two sides to solve the Hexanexus.

source: Alguns cubos têm padrões especiais que precisam corresponder aos padrões das placas nos dois lados para solucionar o quebra-cabeça do Hexanexus.
target: Some cubes have special patterns on them, which need to match the patterns on the plates on the two sides to solve the puzzle of the Hexanexus.

source: Alguns dos painéis especiais de parede se moverão em um padrão fixo. Aja no tempo correto para tirar proveito de suas características e mover o orbe de pedra.
target: Some special wall panels will move in a set pattern. Use the right timing to take advantage of their traits to move the stone orb.

source: Alguns inimigos realizarão um poderoso ATQ Carregado durante a próxima ação deles assim que terminarem de Carregar.
target: Some enemies will unleash a powerful Charged ATK during their next action once they finish Charging.

source: Alguns lados do receptáculo de ícor estão cobertos com uma camada de uma membrana fina, que quebrará com o impacto e fará com que o icor flua para fora.
target: Some sides of the ichor vessel are covered with a fragile membrane layer, which will break upon impact and cause ichor to flow out.

source: Alguns pássaros especialmente brincalhões não admitirão diretamente seu fracasso e exigirão que você desvende o disfarce pouco a pouco. Observe cuidadosamente e tente muitas vezes para entender como capturá-los.
target: Some particularly playful birds won't directly admit their failure and require you to peel back their disguise little by little. Observe carefully and try many times to figure out the way to capture them.

source: Aliados-alvo podem usar a Perícia Suprema para carregar "Heróis, Ardendo Eternamente" ou "Epopeias, Conforme Escrevemos", o que reduz consideravelmente o "Ódio Amphoreano"!
target: Ally targets can use Ultimate to charge "Heroes, Ever Ablaze" or "Epics, as We've Written," which greatly reduces "Amphorean Hatred"!

target: All domains in this plane are Domain — Occurrence (except Domain — Boss). Additional Blessing can be obtained after completing Occurrences.

target: The store within Domain — Respite can Enhance event-limited Blessings. In each store, all Blessings can be Enhanced 1 time.

target: All ally targets will battle on the prime-field and sub-field respectively. Outside of Aha Instants, ally and enemy targets on different fields cannot attack targets on the other field.

target: Mutare Magnus

target: As the boss of Dreamville, it is a basic requirement to adjust yourself to the situation. If needed, you can hide in the box to avoid Boss Stone's lackeys.
