target: Oneiric Memoir

source: Bayangan yang berhenti sementara di dalam Fragmentum, tidak berbahaya kalau tidak diganggu. Kamu dapat memperoleh Material Ascension Karakter dari Stagnant Shadow.
target: A shadow in the Fragmentum that temporarily stays stagnant. It is not dangerous if left alone. Stagnant Shadows can yield resources such as Character Ascension Materials.

source: Beachte die Bedürfnisse der Kunden und klicke auf die Menüpunkte, um Bestellungen an die Küche weiterzuleiten.
target: Observe the customers' needs and click on menu items to place orders to the kitchen

source: Beberapa "Gate of Babylon!" akan bertumpuk menjadi satu.
target: Multiple copies of "Gate of Babylon!" will stack together.

source: Beberapa Bahan Konsumsi memiliki efek spesial yang akan langsung aktif di pertempuran berikutnya.
target: Some Consumables have special effects that will take effect in the next combat.

source: Beberapa Efek Dadu dapat memengaruhi konten di dalam Zona. Jika kamu memilih untuk tidak mengambil Efek Dadu, maka kamu akan menerima Cosmic Fragment sebagai kompensasi.
target: Some Dice Effects can influence the content in the domains. If you select to give up the Dice Effect, you will receive some Cosmic Fragments as compensation.

source: Beberapa Kemampuan dari Karakter tertentu dapat mendahulukan atau menunda aksi target. Saat mengakibatkan Weakness Break pada target musuh, aksi target musuh tersebut juga akan tertunda.
target: Some characters' abilities can cause actions to be Advanced Forward or delayed. Triggering Weakness Break on enemies will also cause their action to be delayed.

source: Beberapa Kemampuan dari Karakter tertentu dapat menghapus efek Buff pada target musuh. Kemampuan seperti ini akan sangat berguna saat melawan musuh yang spesial.
target: Abilities from certain characters can dispel buffs applied to enemies. These can change the battlefield when fighting special enemies.

source: Beberapa Kemampuan dari Karakter tertentu dapat menghapus efek Debuff pada rekan tim. Kemampuan seperti ini dapat membalikkan keadaan dalam situasi tertentu.
target: Abilities from certain characters can dispel debuffs applied to allies. These can play a vital role at crucial moments.

source: Beberapa Shifting Screen dapat diputar dan disesuaikan ke Shifting Screen ruang yang berbeda.
target: Some Shifting Screens can be rotated and aligned to another Shifting Screen, allowing characters to teleport between them.

source: Beberapa Simbol Titan perlu bantuan mekanisme lain untuk menyesuaikan pola dan disusun sebelum bisa lanjut mengunduh.
target: Some Titan runes require cleverly using other mechanisms to adjust their patterns before they can be fully assembled and continue downloading.

source: Beberapa Simbol Titan perlu diamati dari sudut tertentu untuk disusun sebelum bisa lanjut mengunduh.
target: Some Titan Runes need to be viewed from specific angles before they can align properly and continue downloading.

source: Beberapa balok memiliki pola unik tertentu. Pola balok tersebut perlu disesuaikan dengan pola di dua sisi pelat tipis agar dapat memecahkan teka-teki Hexanexus.
target: Some cubes have special patterns on them, which need to match the patterns on the plates on the two sides to solve the Hexanexus.

source: Beberapa balok memiliki pola unik tertentu. Pola balok tersebut perlu disesuaikan dengan pola di dua sisi pelat tipis agar dapat memecahkan teka-teki Hexanexus.
target: Some cubes have special patterns on them, which need to match the patterns on the plates on the two sides to solve the puzzle of the Hexanexus.

source: Beberapa bentuk yang dijelaskan akan mengalami perubahan. Harap perhatikan sudut perbandingan pola matriks dan bentuk yang dijelaskan.
target: Part of the declared shape will change, so be sure to pay attention to the angle of the matrix pattern and the declared shape.

source: Beberapa burung yang suka bermain terkadang tidak akan langsung mengaku kalah, kamu perlu menguak penyamaran mereka selangkah demi selangkah. Perhatikan dengan teliti dan cobalah berkali-kali untuk menangkap mereka.
target: Some particularly playful birds won't directly admit their failure and require you to peel back their disguise little by little. Observe carefully and try many times to figure out the way to capture them.

source: Beberapa fasilitas dapat membuat fasilitas lain meningkatkan batas maksimal terpicunya efek harian. Harap rencanakan dengan baik agar jumlah terpicunya efek dari fasilitas alat musik dapat memenuhi kebutuhan pengunjung.
target: Certain facilities can increase the daily trigger count limit of other facilities' effects. Plan carefully to ensure musical facilities have adequate trigger counts to meet visitor demand.

source: Beberapa fasilitas dapat membuat fasilitas lain meningkatkan peluang terpicunya efek atau mengurangi interval terpicunya efek. Harap rencanakan dengan baik agar efek dari fasilitas jenis Barang Antik dapat sering terpicu.
target: Some facilities can increase the trigger chance or reduce the trigger interval of other facilities. Plan wisely to ensure that the effects of cultural facilities are triggered frequently.

source: Beberapa jenis barang hanya akan muat di posisi tertentu. Profit dari penataan dapat dimaksimalkan dengan cara menimpa dan memposisikan barang dengan cermat.
target: Specific types of goods only fit in specific types of Placement Spots. Profit from a single inventory arrangement can be increased by skillfully overlaying goods on top of each other

source: Beberapa karakter memiliki teknik yang dapat menghadapi petir. Contoh: Barrier milik Fu Xuan dapat menangkis petir, sementara status Stealth milik Seele dapat menghindari pelacakan petir.
target: Some characters' Techniques can deal with lightning. For example: Fu Xuan's Barrier can block lightning, and Seele's stealth state can prevent her from being tracked by lightning.

source: Beberapa kemampuan dari Karakter tertentu dapat mendahulukan atau menunda aksi target. Saat mengakibatkan Weakness Break pada target musuh, aksi target musuh tersebut juga akan tertunda.
target: Some characters' abilities can cause actions to be advanced forward or delayed. Inflicting Weakness Break on enemies will also cause their action to be delayed.

source: Beberapa kemampuan dari Karakter tertentu dapat menghapus efek Buff pada target musuh, yang dapat membalikkan keadaan saat melawan musuh yang memiliki efek Buff tertentu.
target: Certain characters have abilities that can dispel enemies' buffs. This can be very useful when fighting buffed enemies.

source: Beberapa kemampuan dari karakter tertentu dapat menghapus efek Debuff yang dimiliki rekan tim. Akan sangat berguna ketika musuh memberikan efek Debuff pada rekan tim.
target: Certain characters have abilities that can dispel allies' debuffs. This can play a vital role when allies are inflicted with debuffs.

source: Beberapa musuh akan membuat rekan tim memasuki status "Corrosion". Menyerang musuh dapat memulihkan HP yang terkena "Corrosion". Semakin banyak target yang terkena serangan, semakin banyak pemulihan HP-nya.
target: Certain enemies will inflict ally units with the "Corrosion" state. Attacking enemies will restore Corroded HP. The more targets hit, the more is restored.

source: Beberapa musuh dapat menggunakan Charged Attack. Setelah melakukan Charge, akan melancarkan kemampuan yang kuat pada aksi berikutnya.
target: Some enemies will unleash a powerful Charged ATK during their next action once they finish Charging.

source: Beberapa sisi "kotak cairan roh" ditutupi dengan sebuah lapisan tipis yang rapuh. Lapisan ini akan pecah saat terkena benturan, dan menyebabkan "cairan roh" menggelinding keluar.
target: Some sides of the ichor vessel are covered with a fragile membrane layer, which will break upon impact and cause ichor to flow out.

source: Beberapa tembok khusus akan bergerak sesuai dengan pola tertentu. Pergunakan situasi dengan baik dan memanfaatkan karakteristik mereka untuk memandu bola batu.
target: Some special wall panels will move in a set pattern. Use the right timing to take advantage of their traits to move the stone orb.

source: Beberapa tong sampah akan menaiki starskiff, dan ada juga yang akan jatuh dari langit.
target: Some trashcans will ride starskiffs and some will fall from the sky.

source: Befolge den angedeuteten Befehl, um sie nacheinander zu entzünden und alle Heizvorrichtungen zu aktivieren.
target: Follow the hinted order to sequentially light them and activate all heating facilities.

source: Behalte das markierte Gebiet auf der Karte im Auge ... Die formwandelnden Furbos verstecken sich irgendwo dort.
target: Keep an eye on the marked domain on the map... The mimicking furbos are hiding somewhere in this domain.

source: Bei Eintritt in Kampfgeistphase 4: Macht erwacht werden Fertigkeitspunkte wiederhergestellt. Die Ultimates aller Figuren werden aktiviert und sie führen sofort eine Aktion aus. Gleichzeitig wird der Effekt-WDS stark erhöht.
target: Recover Skill Points when entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken" and activate all characters' Ultimates, then all characters immediately take action while also greatly increasing their Effect RES.

source: Bei Wett-Szenen kannst du verschiedene Ergebnisse in Verträumte Slots erzielen und möglicherweise eine große Menge Publikumsemotionen erhalten.
target: Lucky Scene allows you to draw different results in Dreamy Slots, potentially granting a large amount of Audience Emotions

source: Bei aktiviertem Verfolgungsmodus erscheint das Gameplay-Hinweisfeld am oberen Bildschirmrand.
target: When Trailing Mode is active, the Gameplay Prompter will appear on top of the screen.

source: Bei deinen Abenteuern triffst du auf Gegner mit mehreren Schwächen. Wenn du im Kampf Angriffe einsetzt, die diesen Schwächen entsprechen, kann der Widerstand dieser Gegnern verringert werden.
target: During your adventures, you will encounter enemies with multiple Weaknesses. Entering combat using attacks that match these Weaknesses can reduce the Toughness of enemies who have these Weaknesses.

source: Bei deinen Abenteuern triffst du auf allerlei Gegner. Jeder hat Schwächen, die ausgenutzt werden können, um den Widerstand zu verringern, indem du Angriffe desselben Typs einsetzt.
target: You will encounter all kinds of enemies during your adventure. Each of them has Weaknesses that can be exploited to reduce their Toughness by using attacks of the same Type.

source: Bei deinen Erkundungen wirst du auf verschiedene Gameplays stoßen. Diese werden in den Konventionellen Memoiren aufgezeichnet, damit du schneller auf sie zugreifen kannst.
target: You will encounter different kinds of gameplay as you explore. These gameplays will be recorded in Conventional Memoir for faster review and access.

source: Bei den zusätzlichen Aufträgen kannst du mehr Awuuh-Kekse erhalten. Wenn du eine bestimmte Anzahl abgeschlossen hast, kannst du die Phasen-Ziele vorzeitig erreichen!
target: You can get more Awoo Cookies from extra assignments. After completing a certain number of extra assignments, you can achieve the stage target ahead of schedule!

source: Bei der Aktion „Endlose Ebene“ besteht jede Ebene aus der gewöhnlichen Ebene und der Letzten Prüfung.
target: In the Planar Infinity event, each plane comprises Ordinary Planes and the Final Trial.

source: Bei der Aktion „Endlose Ebene“ gibt es Segen oder Kuriositäten, die mit dem Endlosen Symbol gekennzeichnet sind. Sie sind aufgewertete Kuriositäten und begrenzte Segen, die mit Spezialeffekten belegt sind.
target: In the Planar Infinity event, Curios or Blessings marked with the infinite icon bear special effects and are plane-exclusive Transformed Curios and Exclusive Blessings.

source: Bei der Erkundung wirst du hier und da Goldenen Erinnerungsstaub entdecken, der dir zeigt, dass sich das Ziel in einer anderen Raumzeit hier befindet.
target: You may discover Golden Memory Dust when exploring, indicating that the target is located here in the other space-time.

source: Bei jedem Überschreiben wird zufällig 1 von 3 Gewichteten Kuriositäten ausgewählt. Die ausgewählte Gewichtete Kuriosität wird überschrieben.
target: Each overwrite will select 1 out of 3 random Weighted Curios and overwrite the selected Weighted Curio.

source: Bei jedem Überschreiben wird zufällig 1 von 3 Gleichungen ausgewählt, mit der die ausgewählte Gleichung überschrieben wird.
target: For each overwrite, you will select 1 out of 3 random Equations and overwrite the selected Equation.

source: Bei jedem Überschreiben wird zufällig 1 von 3 Segen ausgewählt, mit dem der ausgewählte Segen überschrieben wird.
target: For each overwrite, you will select 1 out of 3 random Blessings and overwrite the selected Blessing.

source: Bei jeder Erkundung gibt es eine bestimmte Anzahl von zusätzlichen Runden. Wenn diese aufgebraucht sind, treten die Gegner in den Status Raserei ein, der ihren ANG stark erhöht.
target: Every round of exploration has a certain number of extra Cycles. When all extra Cycles are used up, the enemy will enter a Berserk state and greatly increase their ATK.

source: Bei jeder Synthese erhältst du zufällig 1 von 3 Kuriositäten von höherer Qualität. Die höchste Qualität ist eine Kuriosität mit 3 Sternen.
target: Each synthesis allows you to select one out of three random Curios with higher quality. The highest-quality Curio that can be obtained is a 3-star one.

source: Bei späteren Herausforderungen kannst du Pfadresonanzeffekte auswählen, die durch Resonanz-Ableitung aus der Region – Boss in der Zweiten Ebene simuliert werden.
target: During later challenges, you can select Path Resonance effects as simulated by Resonance Extrapolation from the boss domain in the Second Plane.

source: Beide Teilnehmer müssen ihre Kampfkünste präsentieren, um die Unterstützung des Publikums zu erhalten! Beide Teilnehmer erhalten je nach der Unterstützung des Publikums eine unterschiedliche Zahl Atmosphärenpunkte.
target: The participants of the match will need to display their martial prowess to the utmost capacity and earn the support of the audience! The two sides will individually earn Vibes based on how much the audience supports either side.

source: Beim Besiegen von Gegnern erhältst du Kraftmünzen, die du gegen Karten und Kraftstaub einlösen kannst, um deine Karten funkeln zu lassen.
target: Defeat opponents to earn Power Tokens for redeeming cards and Power Dust for gilding cards.

source: Beim Besiegen von Gegnern erhältst du „Kraftmünzen“ und „Kraftstaub“ als Belohnung.
target: Defeat opponents to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards.

source: Beim Besiegen von Gegnern in einer Partie erhältst du „Kraftmünzen“ und „Kraftstaub“ als Belohnung. In Kämpfen gegen die Mogura-Bande kannst du zusätzlich spezielle „Sieges-Kraftmünzen“ erhalten.
target: Defeat opponents in matches to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards. When fighting against the Mogura Gang, you can also obtain special "Victorious Power Tokens" as an extra bonus.

source: Beim Einsatz des Ultimates kann Feixiao „Fliegender Aureus“ komplett verbrauchen, um allen Gegnern mehrfachen SCH zuzufügen.
target: When using Ultimate, Feixiao can consume all Flying Aureus to deal multiple instances of DMG to all enemies.

source: Beim Eintritt in die Herausforderung „Überschüssige Umwandlung“ werden die Ultimates aller Verbündeten aktiviert und 5 Fertigkeitspunkte wiederhergestellt.
target: When entering the Excessive Conversion challenge, all allies will activate their Ultimates and recover 5 Skill Points.

source: Beim Kampfbeginn befinden sich Gegner im Schwächeschutz.
target: At the start of the battle, enemies are in the Weaknessproof State.

source: Beim Kauf von identischen Spielfiguren werden die EP der Spielfigur erhöht.
target: When you purchase identical pieces, it increases the piece's EXP

source: Beim Kollidieren mit einem Schwimmring wird die GES des Seehündchens erhöht und es erhält 1 Pkt. ANG für die aktuelle Runde.
target: A baby seal that collides with a Floatie increases SPD, and gains 1 ATK for the current round.

source: Beim Kollidieren mit einem Schwimmring wird die GES des Seehündchens erhöht und es erhält 2 ANG für die aktuelle Runde.
target: Colliding with a Floatie increases the baby seal's SPD, and increases ATK by 2 for the current round.

source: Beim Kollidieren mit einer Stachelsäule erleidet das Seehündchen 3 Pkt. SCH.
target: Colliding with a Spiky Pillar deals 3 DMG to the baby seal.

source: Beim Kollidieren mit einer Stachelwand erleidet das Seehündchen 3 Pkt. SCH.
target: Colliding with a Spiky Wall deals 3 DMG to the baby seal.

source: Beim Rekrutieren von Figuren im Währungskrieg: Wenn du die Figur bereits besitzt, werden die Entwicklungsdaten deiner Figur übernommen. Wenn du die Figur nicht besitzt, kannst du die entsprechende Probefigur zum Spielen rekrutieren.
target: When recruiting characters in "Currency Wars": If you already own the character, you will inherit your character's build data. If you don't own the character, you can recruit a trial version of the character to play with.

source: Beim Talentturnier von Felsenstadt erhalten die Spieler nicht mehr jede Runde einen vorgegebenen Buff, sondern können ihn frei wählen.
target: While competing in the Boulder Town Martial Exhibition, players can now freely choose the buffs they receive each round, instead of having fixed ones.

source: Bekas luka yang disebabkan oleh Fragmentum ketika merusak realitas, mengarah ke tempat yang tidak diketahui. Kamu bisa mendapatkan Relic dari Cavern of Corrosion. Setelah diaktifkan, kamu bisa teleport ke lokasi melalui Navigasi.
target: A bite mark left by the Fragmentum when it corroded reality, leading to unknown places. Cavern of Corrosion can be used to acquire Relics. After activation, you can teleport to its location via Navigation.

source: Beli Bidak yang sama untuk meningkatkan EXP Bidak
target: When you purchase identical pieces, it increases the piece's EXP

source: Bencana Swarm: Beacon
target: Swarm Disaster: Beacons

source: Bencana Swarm: Hitung Mundur
target: Swarm Disaster: Countdown

source: Bencana Swarm: Jenis Zona
target: Swarm Disaster: Domain Types

source: Bencana Swarm: Perangkat Interelasi
target: Swarm Disaster: Communing Device

source: Bencana Swarm: Resonance Interplay
target: Swarm Disaster: Resonance Interplay

source: Bencana Swarm: Tahap Efek Dadu
target: Swarm Disaster: Dice Effect Phase

source: Bencana Swarm: Tahap Pergerakan
target: Swarm Disaster: Movement Phase

source: Bencana Swarm: Tujuan Permainan
target: Swarm Disaster: Gameplay Goal

source: Benda Langka
target: Curio

source: Benda Langka Negatif tidak dapat digunakan untuk Synthesis Benda Langka. Jumlah kesempatan untuk melakukan Synthesis Benda Langka di setiap Debugger Ciptaan terbatas.
target: Negative Curios cannot be used for Curio synthesis. There is a limit to the number of times each Workbench of Creation can synthesize Curios.

source: Bendiciones
target: Blessings

source: Bendición trazacaminos
target: Blessings of Trailblaze

source: Bentuk Tim
target: Form Team

source: Bentuk kipas merah mewakili rintangan yang akan menghalangi rute, dan rute tidak dapat melewati rintangan. Menghindarlah saat menghubungkan rute.
target: The red fan-shaped zone represents obstacles that block the path, and the route cannot pass through them. Be sure to avoid them when connecting the route.

source: Benutze das Energieleitungsgerät der Kunsthandwerkskommission, um damit alle verschränkten Wurzeln des Himmelsbaums gleichzeitig zu zerstören und die Äste des Himmelsbaums, die den Weg versperren, zu brechen.
target: Ambrosial Arbor's branches can be found blocking the path. Use the Artisanship Commission's energy conduction device to destroy all the entangled Ambrosial Arbor's coils at the same time.

source: Benutze den Auslöser um Heliobus-Energie abzugeben, und rotiere den Empfänger um die Leitungsrichtung der Heliobus-Energie anzupassen.
target: Rotate receiver nodes to adjust heliobus energy's conduction direction. Then activate the trigger node to release heliobus energy along the conduction direction.

source: Benutze den Demontageschlüssel, um die angelegte Ausrüstung der Figuren frei anzupassen und die Kampfkraft deines Teams zu maximieren.
target: Use the Disassembly Wrench to freely reassign equipped gears and maximize your team's combat power.

source: Benutze die Fähigkeit „Nitrogen-Explosion“, um die Geschwindigkeit stark zu erhöhen.
target: Use the Nitrous Burst ability to greatly increase your speed

source: Benutze die Kamera oder wechsle in den Graffiti-Modus, um zu sprühen.
target: Open the Camera or switch to Graffiti Mode to spray.

source: Benutze die Leiter, um nach oben und nach unten zu gelangen. Für eine Leiter von jeder Länge brauchst du nur einen Schritt.
target: Use the ladder to move up or down. You only need to take one step for each ladder, regardless of their length.

source: Berbagai kontainer ditempatkan di jalur perakitan. Sesuaikan posisi kontainer untuk menutup celah atau membuka jalan.
target: Various freight containers are placed on the assembly line. Adjust the position of the freight containers to fill gaps in the road or remove obstacles to open new passages.

source: Berdasarkan respons yang disampaikan lawan bicara, Tunjukkan Bukti yang tepat untuk mematahkan argumen lawan.
target: Present evidence in accordance with what the opposition is saying to refute their arguments

source: Berinteraksi dengan "Menara Gelembung Mimpi" yang belum pernah digunakan akan meningkatkan jumlah penggunaan "Energi Gelembung Mimpi". Jumlah maksimal "Energi Gelembung Mimpi" yang dapat dibawa adalah 5 kali.
target: Interacting with unused Bubble Tower will increase the number of Bubble Charges that can be used. The number of Bubble Charges that can be carried at any time cannot exceed 5.

source: Berinteraksi dengan "Perangkat Interelasi" di Zona untuk memperoleh Efek Dadu secara acak atau teleport menuju Zona berikutnya.
target: Interact with the Communing Device in the domain to obtain a random Dice Effect or move to the next domain.

source: Berinteraksilah dengan "Mata Pemimpi", untuk masuk atau keluar dari sudut pandang Pembangun Mimpi.
target: Interact with the Dream's Eye to enter or exit the Dreamweaver's View.

source: Berinteraksilah dengan landasan simbol untuk mendapatkan "Simbol Memori". Saat memiliki simbol, cakupan penyinaran "Mutiara Keajaiban" akan bergerak mengikuti karakter dan membalikkan ruang waktu di sekitar karakter.
target: Interact with the rune base to obtain the Rune of Recollection. With the rune in possession, the Miracle Orb's illumination radius moves with your character, and reverses the surrounding space-time.

source: Berinteraksilah dengan meja kendali batu untuk mulai mengontrol "Tangan Zagreus".
target: Interact with the stone control platform to start the control of the Hand of Zagreus.

source: Berjalan ke Perangkap
target: Walk Into The Trap

source: Bertempur bersama teman mungkin akan membuatmu mendapatkan lebih banyak hadiah.
target: Fighting alongside friends might just yield more rewards.

source: Bertemu dengan rekan-rekan dalam perjalanan perintisan, dapatkan equipment yang lebih kuat, dan kalahkan musuh kuat bersama-sama.
target: Meet companions on your Trailblaze journey, obtain powerful equipment, and defeat formidable foes together.

source: Beschworene Chimären werden vor dem Kampfbeitritt in der Warteschlange für Beschwörungen angezeigt.
target: The summoned chimera will be displayed in the summon queue before joining combat.

source: Besiege Gegner in Region – Elite oder Region – Boss und verbrauche Trailblaze-Kraft oder Immersatoren, um Immersionsbelohnungen zu erhalten, darunter Planarornamente.
target: After defeating enemies in Domain - Elite or Domain - Boss, you can consume Trailblaze Power or Immersifiers to obtain Immersion Rewards, including Planar Ornaments.

source: Besiege Gegner mit Verschanzfähigkeiten, um die Türkarte zu erhalten.
target: Defeat enemies with Garrison abilities to obtain Door Card.

source: Besiege Gegner, um Kampfgeist zu erhalten. Aktiviere Kampfgeistmechaniken, um Kampfgeist zu sammeln und schneller in die Phase Flut des Kampfes einzutreten, wodurch du zusätzlich mächtige Etappen-Buffs erhalten kannst.
target: Defeating enemies increases Grit Value. Activating the Grit Mechanics rapidly accumulates Grit Value, speeding up entry into the Surging Grit phase, granting additional powerful stage buffs.

source: Besiege Sparschweine, bevor sie fliehen können, um Highlights auszulösen und eine große Menge Atmosphärenpunkte zu erhalten.
target: Defeat the Trotter before it escapes and trigger Highlights to obtain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Besiege alle Gegner, bevor der Countdown abläuft, um den Kampf zu gewinnen und deine Siegesserie auszubauen. Je länger deine Siegesserie, desto mehr Goldmünzen erhältst du als Belohnung.
target: Defeat all enemies before the countdown hits zero to win the battle and add to your winning streak. The longer your winning streak, the more Gold Coins you'll earn as rewards.

source: Besiege alle Gegner, bevor der Countdown abläuft, um den Kampf zu gewinnen.
target: If you defeat all enemies before the countdown reaches zero, the combat is won.

source: Besiege die Seehündchen des Gegners, um Punkte zu sammeln. Erreiche die maximale Punktzahl, um zu gewinnen.
target: Defeat enemy seals to earn points — reach the maximum score to win.

source: Besiege die Sparschweine in dieser Etappe, um eine große Menge Kampfgeist anzusammeln. Du musst das Sparschwein besiegen, bevor es entkommt.
target: Defeat the Trotters in this stage to obtain a large amount of Grit Value. You need to defeat the Trotter before it escapes.

source: Besiege die Teufelsdiener, um die Schätze zu erhalten.
target: Defeat the Demon King's Minions to obtain the Demon King's Treasures.

source: Besiege in der Ultimativen Herausforderung so viele Gegner wie möglich, um eine hohe Punktzahl zu erreichen. Solltest du am Ende noch Runden übrig haben, erhältst du zusätzlich Punkte.
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: Besiege in der Ultimativen Herausforderung so viele Gegner wie möglich, um eine hohe Punktzahl zu erreichen. Solltest du am Ende noch überzählige Runden haben, erhältst du zusätzlich Punkte.
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: Besiege so viele Gegner wie möglich in der vorgegebenen Anzahl von Runden, um die Teamstufe so viel wie möglich zu erhöhen. Nach dem Hochstufen der Teamstufe kannst du eine der zufällig erscheinenden Waffen oder Accessoires auswählen.
target: Defeat as many enemies as possible to raise your team's level within the allotted Cycles. After your Team Level goes up, you'll be able to choose one of the randomly drawn weapons or Accessories.

source: Besondere Spielinhalte werden in Zyklische Berechnung wöchentlich aktualisiert.

source: Bestehe die Vergessene Halle und erfülle die speziellen Bedingungen zum Erhalt von „Markierung der Starre“. Du erhälst ein Markierungs-Geschenk, nachdem du ausreichend Markierungen der Starre gesammelt hast.

source: Bản Đồ Vận Mệnh hiển thị sự kiện quan trọng mà bạn có thể gặp trong hành trình "Khai Phá". Cùng với sự tiến triển không ngừng của hành trình "Khai Phá", bạn sẽ có cơ hội tham gia vào nhiều sự kiện quan trọng hơn.
target: Fate's Atlas presents the important events you may encounter in the Trailblazing expedition. As your Trailblazing expedition progresses, you will have the chance to be involved in more important events.

source: Bảo Tàng Lịch Sử Thành Everwinter: Nâng Cấp Khu Trưng Bày
target: Everwinter City Museum Ledger of Curiosities: Exhibition Area Level Up

source: Bảo Tàng Lịch Sử Thành Everwinter: Thu Thập Vật Trưng Bày
target: Everwinter City Museum Ledger of Curiosities: Exhibit Collection

source: Bảo Tàng Lịch Sử Thành Everwinter: Điểm Khôi Phục
target: Everwinter City Museum Ledger of Curiosities: RevitaScore

source: Bất cứ ai có ký hiệu Cậu Bé Đồng Hồ trên đầu, thì bạn đều có thể sử dụng Thủ Thuật Đồng Hồ lên người đó. Nếu tình cờ gặp thì cứ thử thoải mái nhé!
target: You can use Clockwork on anyone with a Clockie mark on their heads. When you get the chance, make sure to try it out as much as you need!

source: Bất cứ lúc nào, bạn đều có thể xác nhận tất cả các mốc thời gian đã trải qua trong ký ức tại đây.
target: You can check all the timestamps of your experiences in the memories here at any time.

source: Bất kể có online hay không, nhân vật đều sẽ chiến đấu và liên tục tạo ra tài nguyên.
target: Characters will engage in combat and continuously generate resources, whether you're online or not.

source: Bẫy Xoáy Nước
target: Whirlpool Trap

source: Bắn Quét
target: Barrage

source: Bắn trúng tiền vàng của Ông Chủ Đá có thể khiến tiền vàng bắn ngược trở về, cho Ông Chủ Đá nếm mùi gậy ông đập lưng ông
target: Firing at the Boss Stone's coins can deflect them back, thus giving him a taste of his own medicine

source: Bắn Đạn Hanu phá vỡ bia bắn sẽ nhận được điểm. Hãy cố gắng nhận điểm cao để đạt mục tiêu của đợt. Số lần đạt mục tiêu của đợt càng nhiều, phần thưởng cuối cùng càng phong phú.
target: Gain Points by launching Hanu Rocket to break targets. Gain more Points to reach the target for this wave. The more times you reach the wave target, the better the rewards you will receive at the end.

source: Bắn Đạn Hanu trúng Ông Chủ Đá có thể làm giảm Thể Lực của hắn ta. Sống sót tới khi hết thời gian sẽ được nhận thưởng, đánh bại Ông Chủ Đá sẽ nhận phần thưởng phong phú hơn.
target: Reduce Boss Stone's stamina by launching Hanu Rocket to hit him. Receive rewards by surviving till the end of the timer, and receive more rewards by defeating Boss Stone.

source: Bằng hệ thống Hành Trình của Đội Tàu Astral, Nhà Khai Phá có thể di chuyển giữa các khu vực và thế giới khác nhau.
target: Thanks to the Navigation System of the Astral Express, you can travel between different worlds and areas.

source: Bề mặt băng trơn trượt, có thể giúp Hải Cẩu di chuyển được xa hơn và lâu hơn.
target: Slippery ice makes baby seals move farther and for longer.

source: Bị Ông Chủ Đá đánh trúng sẽ tổn thất HP. Khi mất hết HP, khiêu chiến sẽ thất bại. Phá vỡ đạo cụ có biểu tượng HP, sẽ có thể hồi HP.
target: You will lose HP when hit by Boss Stone. The challenge fails if all your HP is lost. Break items that have the HP Symbol to restore HP.

source: Bố trí Vật Sưu Tập trong khu vực trưng bày Vật Sưu Tập sẽ có thể cung cấp Buff cho khiêu chiến trong Vũ Trụ Sai Phân.
target: Collections placed in the collection display areas can provide buffs for challenges in Divergent Universe.

source: Bộ Điều khiển Tinh Thạch Viễn Cổ trên đường sẽ thay đổi trạng thái sàn cùng màu với năng lượng, hãy tận dụng sự giúp đỡ của chúng để đi đến tế đàn.
target: The Ancient Crystalline Controllers you find on the path can alter the state of the flooring that has the same energy color. Use them to help you reach the altar.

source: Bụi Linh Vô Danh
target: Nameless Wispae

source: Bụi Linh Vô Danh - Chỉ Dẫn Của Người Hướng Dẫn
target: Nameless Wispae: Guide's Direction

source: C'est un panneau publicitaire. Entrer en collision avec l'un d'entre eux vous ralentira. N'offensez pas les sponsors !
target: This is a Billboard. You will be Slowed when you run into a Billboard. Please don't offend the advertisers!

source: Cada Bancada da Criação tem uma certa quantia de Calor inicial, que pode ser gasta para aprimorar Bênçãos.
target: Each Workbench of Creation has a certain amount of initial Heat, which can be expended to enhance Blessings.

source: Cada Banco de pruebas de la creación tiene una cantidad fija de Calor al principio. Gasta este Calor para potenciar bendiciones.
target: Each Workbench of Creation has a certain amount of initial Heat, which can be expended to enhance Blessings.

source: Cada Caminho tem um Traço correspondente, cujo efeito e condição de ativação podem ser visualizados no menu.
target: Every Path has 1 corresponding Trait, the effect and activation condition of which can be viewed in the menu.

source: Cada Cofrinho derrotado afetará todos os inimigos com Dano Contínuo aleatório. Faça bom uso das penalidades aplicadas ao derrotar os Cofrinhos para acabar com o chefe durante a "Fase de Bravura 4: Poder Desperto".
target: Every Trotter defeated will inflict all enemies with random DoTs. Make good use of the DoTs applied by defeating Trotters to quickly take down the boss during "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken".

source: Cada Cofrinho derrotado afetará todos os inimigos com a penalidade de Vulnerabilidade. Faça bom uso das penalidades aplicadas ao derrotar os Cofrinhos para acabar com o chefe durante a "Fase de Bravura 4: Poder Desperto".
target: Every Trotter defeated will inflict all enemies with the Vulnerability debuff. Make good use of the debuffs applied by defeating Trotters to quickly take down the boss during "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken".

source: Cada Engenho prosseguirá na direção determinada até o final, onde ele encontrará um obstáculo e aguardará o próximo comando.
target: Each ingenium will proceed along the determined direction until the very end where it encounters an obstacle and awaits the next command.

source: Cada Máscara tem uma forma única de obter Imaginouro e seus próprios efeitos passivos.
target: Each Mask has a unique way to obtain Wishpower and its own passive effects.

source: Cada Vía tiene 1 rasgo correspondiente. Puedes ver los efectos del rasgo y sus condiciones de activación en el menú.
target: Every Path has 1 corresponding Trait, the effect and activation condition of which can be viewed in the menu.

source: Cada acto tiene que superar una proyección de prueba antes de su estreno. Cada película tiene su propio objetivo de emociones.
target: Every chapter needs to pass Internal Screening before they are released, and different films have different Emotion Targets

source: Cada apresentação precisa coletar Inspiração do estilo musical correspondente. Complete o desafio musical no Modo Fácil para obter inspiração
target: Each performance needs to collect Inspiration of the corresponding music style. Pass the music challenge in Easy Mode to obtain inspiration

source: Cada capítulo precisa passar por uma Triagem Interna antes do lançamento, e filmes diferentes possuem diferentes Objetivos de Emoção
target: Every chapter needs to pass Internal Screening before they are released, and different films have different Emotion Targets

source: Cada carta jogada reduz a energia mágica necessária para a "Dispersão Arcana".
target: Each card played reduces the magical energy required for "Mana Burst."

source: Cada carta utilizada reduce la energía mágica necesaria para Energía mágica desatada.
target: Each card played reduces the magical energy required for "Mana Burst."

source: Cada cierto tiempo se celebrará una reunión de la cena en la que puedes obtener una gran cantidad de fondos del Expreso según los resultados del informe. ¡Ese es tu objetivo!
target: Dinner Meetings will be held periodically in the schedule, and you can gain a large amount of Express Funds based on your report results. Treat that as your main goal.

source: Cada convidado compartilhará uma história. A conclusão da Ocorrência concede muitas Recompensas de Exibição!
target: Each guest will share a story. Finishing the Occurrence grants lots of Exhibition rewards!

source: Cada creación de Ruan Mei en el Banco de pruebas de la creación se corresponde a una función de creación distinta.
target: Each of Ruan Mei's creations in the Workbench of Creation corresponds to a creation function.

source: Cada día habrá un número fijo de clientes que visitan el restaurante. Cuando el restaurante suba de nivel, atraerá a más clientes. Intenta atender a todos los clientes antes de la hora de cierre.
target: A fixed number of customers will visit each day. After the restaurant levels up, it will attract more customers. Try to serve all customers before closing time

source: Cada estande pertence a uma das três áreas da exibição: "Comemoração", "Mercado", e "Entretenimento".
target: Each booth belongs to one of three exhibition areas: "Souvenir," "Commercial," and "Fun."

source: Cada estágio fornecerá melhorias únicas e significativas para os aliados, assim como irá alterar a Tenacidade e a Fraqueza dos inimigos. Use estas melhorias para aumentar bastante as habilidades em batalhas e a eficiência no estágio.
target: Every stage will provide unique and significant buffs to allies, as well as changes to enemies' Toughness and Weakness. Utilize these buffs and enemy traits to greatly increase combat ability and efficiency in the stage.

source: Cada exploración tiene una cantidad determinada de ciclos adicionales. Cuando se agoten todos los ciclos adicionales, los enemigos entrarán en el estado de Furia y su ATQ aumentará significativamente.
target: Every round of exploration has a certain number of extra Cycles. When all extra Cycles are used up, the enemy will enter a Berserk state and greatly increase their ATK.

source: Cada foca pode agir 1 vez por rodada. No começo de uma nova rodada, o jogador que começa primeiro é trocado.
target: Each seal can take action 1 time per round. At the start of a new round, the player who goes first is swapped.

source: Cada foca tiene diferentes habilidades. Utilízalas para ganar.
target: Each baby seal has different abilities — using them wisely is key to victory.

source: Cada foquinha possui diferentes habilidades, usá-las com sabedoria é a chave para a vitória.
target: Each baby seal has different abilities — using them wisely is key to victory.

source: Cada ingenio avanzará en la dirección determinada hasta que encuentre un obstáculo y espere la siguiente orden.
target: Each ingenium will proceed along the determined direction until the very end where it encounters an obstacle and awaits the next command.

source: Cada lado do receptáculo de icor pode estar coberto com membranas diferentes. Destruir as membranas de lados diferentes pode gerar resultados diferentes.
target: Each side of the ichor vessel might be covered by different membranes. Destroying membranes on different sides might generate different results.

source: Cada líder de Esquadrão de Serviços terá um Traço de Liderança. Isso pode ser útil durante os serviços.
target: Every Duty Squad's leader will have a unique Leader Trait. This can be useful during duties.

source: Cada máscara tiene una forma única de obtener Imagiesencia y un efecto pasivo.
target: Each Mask has a unique way to obtain Wishpower and its own passive effects.

source: Cada objetivo absorbido activa Absorción enfurecida e inflige daño a todos los enemigos.
target: For each target absorbed, "Frenzied Absorption" will be triggered, dealing DMG to all enemies.

source: Cada plano consiste de diferentes tipos de domínios. Selecione o botão de "?" para visualizar todos os tipos de domínios.
target: Every plane consists of different types of domains. Select the "?" button to view all domain types.

source: Cada plano consta de diferentes tipos de zonas. En el botón "?" puedes ver todos los tipos de zonas.
target: Every plane consists of different types of domains. Select the "?" button to view all domain types.

source: Cada puesto pertenece a una de las tres zonas de exposición: zona conmemorativa, zona de compras y zona de entretenimiento.
target: Each booth belongs to one of three exhibition areas: "Souvenir," "Commercial," and "Fun."

source: Cada rodada de exploração tem uma certa quantidade de Ciclos extra. Quando todos os Ciclos extra forem utilizados, o inimigo irá entrar em um estado de Descontrole e seu ATQ será aumentado massivamente.
target: Every round of exploration has a certain number of extra Cycles. When all extra Cycles are used up, the enemy will enter a Berserk state and greatly increase their ATK.

source: Cada sobrescritura elegirá 1 de 3 bendiciones al azar y sobrescribirá la bendición elegida.
target: For each overwrite, you will select 1 out of 3 random Blessings and overwrite the selected Blessing.

source: Cada sobrescritura elegirá 1 de 3 ecuaciones al azar y sobrescribirá la ecuación elegida.
target: For each overwrite, you will select 1 out of 3 random Equations and overwrite the selected Equation.

source: Cada sobrescritura elegirá 1 de 3 objetos raros ponderados al azar y sobrescribirá el objeto raro ponderado elegido.
target: Each overwrite will select 1 out of 3 random Weighted Curios and overwrite the selected Weighted Curio.

source: Cada substituição selecionará 1 de 3 Curios Pesadas aleatórias e substituirá a Curio Pesada escolhida.
target: Each overwrite will select 1 out of 3 random Weighted Curios and overwrite the selected Weighted Curio.

source: Cada síntese permite selecionar um de três Curios aleatórias de maior qualidade. A Curio de maior qualidade que pode ser obtida é uma de 3 estrelas.
target: Each synthesis allows you to select one out of three random Curios with higher quality. The highest-quality Curio that can be obtained is a 3-star one.

source: Cada síntesis elige 1 de 3 objetos raros al azar de mayor calidad. Se puede obtener como máximo un objeto raro de 3 estrellas.
target: Each synthesis allows you to select one out of three random Curios with higher quality. The highest-quality Curio that can be obtained is a 3-star one.

source: Cada tarefa concluída pelas quimeras aumenta o Progresso da Tarefa com base na eficiência das quimeras.
target: Each task the chimeras complete increases the Task Progress based on the chimeras' efficiency.

source: Cada tipo de cubo de basura otorga una puntuación diferente. Fotografía la mayor cantidad posible de cubos de basura para alcanzar el objetivo de la etapa.
target: Different qualities of trashcans will give different scores. Take as many pictures of trashcans as possible and complete the stage objective.

source: Cada uma das criações de Ruan Mei na Bancada da Criação tem uma função de criação correspondente.
target: Each of Ruan Mei's creations in the Workbench of Creation corresponds to a creation function.

source: Cada vez que a história é concluída através de uma Aventura da Arte da Espada, 7 de Março ganhará Experiência Prática, que aprimorará seus atributos quando ela iniciar uma nova rodada de treinamento.
target: Each time the story is completed through a Swordart Escapade, March 7th will gain Trialed Insight, which will enhance her stats when she starts a new round of training.

source: Cada vez que completes la historia de un encuentro de práctica de espada, Siete de Marzo obtiene experiencia práctica, con la que puede aumentar atributos en la siguiente ronda de entrenamiento.
target: Each time the story is completed through a Swordart Escapade, March 7th will gain Trialed Insight, which will enhance her stats when she starts a new round of training.

source: Cada vez que destruyas cristaloides, los límites de la zona iluminada se contraerán. Usa esta característica para completar la prueba.
target: Each time you break a Crystal, the boundary of the lit area shrinks. Use this property to complete the trial.

source: Cada vez que elimines cierta cantidad de arándanos, transformas al azar cierta cantidad de frutas del tablero en superbombas. Intercambia una superbomba con una fruta adyacente para eliminar todas las frutas del mismo tipo del tablero.
target: Every time a certain amount of Blueberries are cleared, randomly transforms a certain amount of fruits on the board to Super Bomb(s). Swapping Super Bombs and adjacent fruits can clear all fruits of the same type on the board.

source: Cada vez que elimines cierta cantidad de duraznos, transformas al azar cierta cantidad de frutas del tablero en bombas de cuadro. Las bombas de cuadro pueden causar una detonación de área cuadrada de 3×3 casillas al ser eliminadas.
target: Every time a certain amount of Peaches are cleared, randomly transforms a certain amount of fruits on the board to Square Bombs. When cleared, Square Bombs can detonate a 3×3 square box area.

source: Cada vez que elimines cierta cantidad de fresas, transformas al azar cierta cantidad de frutas del tablero en bombas de línea. Las bombas de línea pueden detonar la fila o columna en la que estén al ser eliminadas.
target: Every time a certain amount of Strawberries are cleared, randomly transforms a certain amount of fruits on the board to Line Bombs. When cleared, Line Bombs can detonate a row or a column.

source: Cada vez que elimines cierta cantidad de kiwis, activas detonaciones de 2×2 casillas al azar en el tablero.
target: Every time a certain amount of Kiwifruits are cleared, randomly triggers 2×2 square detonation on the board.

source: Cada vez que elimines cierta cantidad de plátanos, activas una detonación en cruz al azar en el tablero.
target: Every time a certain amount of Bananas are cleared, randomly triggers cross-shaped detonation on the board.

source: Cada vez que la Mano de Zagreus se active por primera vez, se iniciará la Prueba del Capricho. Tendrás que controlar la mano y recoger las Monedas del Capricho que aparezcan cerca.
target: When each Hand of Zagreus is activated for the first time, the Trial of Whimsy will open for you, in which you need to control the hand and collect Coins of Whimsy generated nearby.

source: Cada vez que reconstruyas cristaloides, los límites de la zona iluminada se expandirán. Usa esta característica para completar la prueba.
target: Every time you reforge a Crystal, the boundaries of the lit area will expand. Use this property to complete the trial.

source: Cada vez que todos los aliados usen 3 veces en total la habilidad definitiva, se lanzan varios puñetazos de Puño bravo para atacar al enemigo.
target: Every time allies have used a total of 3 Ultimates, trigger multiple Brave Fists to attack enemies.

source: Cada vez que trabajan, las quimeras consiguen progreso de trabajo según su eficiencia.
target: Each task the chimeras complete increases the Task Progress based on the chimeras' efficiency.

source: Cada vez que un aliado actúa, la Caja regalo adelanta su acción y se obtiene la bonificación de la Caja regalo más rápidamente.
target: Every time allies take action, they will Advance the Giftbox's action Forward to receive the Giftbox buff more quickly.

source: Cada visitante compartirá una anécdota. ¡Completa las elecciones del evento para obtener una gran cantidad de recompensas de exposición!
target: Each guest will share a story. Finishing the Occurrence grants lots of Exhibition rewards!

source: Cada zona tiene una máquina recreativa de Conejo estelar. La pantalla de inicio de la máquina muestra el número, apodo del jugador y la mejor puntuación correspondientes a esa máquina.
target: There is a Star Rabbit Game Console in every area. The home page of the console will display its serial number, the player's nickname, and their best score.

target: The light from the Miracle Orb will invert the illuminated area into the other space-time.

target: Falling into a Whirlpool Trap deals 50% of current HP as DMG to the baby seal and returns it to its starting position.

target: Capture the same creation 3 times to unlock the Stack-a-Cake placement mode.

target: Leader Trait: March 7th

target: Leader Trait: Welt

target: Conduct Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and fulfill the designated number of goods as stated on the shipping targets on the left.

source: Carga la mercancía en el astroesquife de carga, completa el objetivo de envío y acumula fondos del gremio.
target: Complete Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and reach shipping targets to earn Merchant Guild's funds

source: Carga las mercancías de acuerdo a las solicitudes de los pedidos personalizados. Completa los pedidos para obtener el certificado de prosperidad.
target: Conduct Inventory Arrangement according to the Custom Orders' requests. Completing the orders to obtain Prosperity Certificate

target: Inventory Arrangement

source: Cari Grafiti Tersembunyi berdasarkan ikon dan berinteraksi dengannya, dengan begitu kamu bisa mendapatkan hadiah.
target: Follow the signs to find the hidden graffitis and interact with them to receive the corresponding rewards.

source: Cari Target Foto berdasarkan ikon dan berinteraksi dengannya, dengan begitu kamu bisa mendapatkan hadiah.
target: Follow the signs to find the photo subjects and interact with them to receive the corresponding rewards.

source: Cari belahan diri "Tong Pony" yang tersebar di berbagai tempat dan kalahkan musuh bersamanya!
target: Find the clones of Litter Pony scattered all over and join hands toward defeating the enemies!

source: Cari cara untuk mendekati "tiruanmu". Setelah menjalin kontak, reporter anjing rakun akan menampakkan wujud aslinya! Setelah itu, terserah padamu bagaimana mau "beri pelajaran" ke mereka.
target: Find a way to get close to your "fake self." Once you make contact, the furbo journalists will reveal their true form! After that, how you "educate" them is totally up to you.

target: Formidable Foe Card: Phainon

target: Formidable Foe Card: Sparxie

target: Formidable Foe Card: Sparxie

target: Formidable Foe Card: Phainon

source: Cartas de Ação diferentes implicam cargas de trabalho variadas. Após selecionar uma Carta de Ação, o cronograma avançará um número definido de passos até alcançar a peça correspondente.
target: Different Action Cards entail varying workloads. After selecting an Action Card, the schedule will advance by a set number of steps to reach the corresponding tile.

source: Cartas de Tática só podem ser usadas durante a Fase de Troca, sendo que Cartas de Tática de Ataque e de Defesa só podem ser usadas ao atacar ou defender, respectivamente.
target: Tactics Cards can only be used during the Swap Phase, with Attack-type and Defense-type Tactics Cards usable only when attacking or defending respectively.

source: Certaines capacités de personnages permettent d'avancer ou de retarder les actions. Infliger des Ruptures de faiblesse aux ennemis retarde également leur action.
target: Some characters' abilities can cause actions to be advanced forward or delayed. Inflicting Weakness Break on enemies will also cause their action to be delayed.

source: Certaines caractéristiques des personnages et effets météorologiques peuvent temporairement augmenter le nombre d'utilisations possibles des Dés prismatiques.
target: Some Character Traits and weather effects may temporarily increase the number of times you can use the Prismatic Dice.

source: Certaines faces du réceptacle d'ichor sont recouvertes d'une fine membrane, qui se brise au moindre impact, faisant ainsi s'écouler l'ichor.
target: Some sides of the ichor vessel are covered with a fragile membrane layer, which will break upon impact and cause ichor to flow out.

source: Certaines faveurs permettent de modifier la répartition jour/nuit jusqu'à atteindre un état perpétuel.
target: After selecting specific Boons, you can change the ratio of Day and Night and may even be able to make one state permanent.

source: Certaines pièces de puzzle onirique sont instables et peuvent se déplacer vers un autre endroit pendant l'interaction.
target: Some Dream Jigsaw pieces are unstable and may move to another location in the scene during interaction.

source: Certaines portes menant aux passages secrets sont plutôt complexes. Vous devez aligner les axes horizontaux et verticaux pour vous déplacer rapidement.
target: Some doors to the secret passages are rather complicated, only completing the image when both horizontal and vertical axes are aligned, allowing you to move quickly.

source: Certaines poubelles seront à bord d'astroskiffs et d'autres tomberont du ciel.
target: Some trashcans will ride starskiffs and some will fall from the sky.

source: Certaines runes des Titans doivent être observées sous des angles spécifiques avant de pouvoir s'aligner correctement et poursuivre le téléchargement.
target: Some Titan Runes need to be viewed from specific angles before they can align properly and continue downloading.

source: Certaines runes des Titans nécessitent d'utiliser intelligemment d'autres mécanismes avant de pouvoir s'aligner correctement et poursuivre le téléchargement.
target: Some Titan runes require cleverly using other mechanisms to adjust their patterns before they can be fully assembled and continue downloading.

source: Certaines techniques de personnages peuvent également figer le temps, comme celle du Pionnier de la Voie du Souvenir ou d'autres.
target: Hint: Some characters' Techniques can also trigger Time Stop, such as Trailblazer (Path of Remembrance) and others.

source: Certains Dés prismatiques sont dotés de faces spéciales dont les effets uniques s'activent lorsqu'ils se révèlent et que vous les sélectionnez !
target: Some Prismatic Dice have special Dice Faces that trigger unique effects when rolled and selected!

source: Certains Par-chemins peuvent pivoter et être alignés avec un autre Par-chemin, ce qui permet aux personnages de se téléporter entre les deux.
target: Some Shifting Screens can be rotated and aligned to another Shifting Screen, allowing characters to teleport between them.

source: Certains consommables ont des effets spéciaux qui prennent effet au cours du prochain combat.
target: Some Consumables have special effects that will take effect in the next combat.

source: Certains cubes comportent des motifs spéciaux, que vous devez faire correspondre à ceux des panneaux latéraux pour résoudre l'Hexanexus.
target: Some cubes have special patterns on them, which need to match the patterns on the plates on the two sides to solve the Hexanexus.

source: Certains cubes ont des motifs spéciaux, que vous devez faire correspondre à ceux des panneaux des deux côtés pour résoudre l'énigme de l'Hexanexus.
target: Some cubes have special patterns on them, which need to match the patterns on the plates on the two sides to solve the puzzle of the Hexanexus.

source: Certains effets de dé peuvent affecter le contenu des zones. Vous recevrez des fragments cosmiques en compensation si vous choisissez de renoncer à l'effet de dé.
target: Some Dice Effects can influence the content in the domains. If you select to give up the Dice Effect, you will receive some Cosmic Fragments as compensation.

source: Certains ennemis appliquent l'état Corrosion aux cibles alliées. Attaquer les ennemis permet de restaurer des PV corrodés. Plus le nombre de cibles touchées est élevé, plus le nombre de PV restaurés est important.
target: Certain enemies will inflict ally units with the "Corrosion" state. Attacking enemies will restore Corroded HP. The more targets hit, the more is restored.

source: Certains ennemis peuvent lancer une puissante ATQ chargée qui se déclenche lors de leur prochaine action après un tour de charge.
target: Some enemies will unleash a powerful Charged ATK during their next action once they finish Charging.

source: Certains murs spéciaux bougent en suivant un schéma spécifique. Maîtrisez le timing et servez-vous de leur particularité pour guider la boule de pierre.
target: Some special wall panels will move in a set pattern. Use the right timing to take advantage of their traits to move the stone orb.

source: Certains oiseaux particulièrement espiègles n'admettent pas directement leur échec et vous demandent de les trouver sous différentes formes. Observez attentivement et essayez plusieurs fois de trouver le moyen de les capturer.
target: Some particularly playful birds won't directly admit their failure and require you to peel back their disguise little by little. Observe carefully and try many times to figure out the way to capture them.

source: Certains personnages ont des capacités qui permettent de dissiper les bonus appliqués aux ennemis, ce qui peut renverser le cours de la bataille face à des ennemis qui se renforcent à l'aide de bonus.
target: Certain characters have abilities that can dispel enemies' buffs. This can be very useful when fighting buffed enemies.

source: Certains personnages ont des capacités qui permettent de dissiper les malus appliqués aux alliés, ce qui peut jouer un rôle crucial lorsque les alliés subissent des malus ennemis.
target: Certain characters have abilities that can dispel allies' debuffs. This can play a vital role when allies are inflicted with debuffs.

source: Certains types de marchandises ne peuvent être placés que dans des types d'emplacements précis. Optimisez le chargement en superposant habilement les marchandises les unes au-dessus des autres.
target: Specific types of goods only fit in specific types of Placement Spots. Profit from a single inventory arrangement can be increased by skillfully overlaying goods on top of each other

source: Certas instalações podem aumentar o limite diário de ativação dos efeitos de outras instalações. Planeje com cuidado para garantir que as instalações musicais tenham ativações adequadas para atender à demanda dos visitantes.
target: Certain facilities can increase the daily trigger count limit of other facilities' effects. Plan carefully to ensure musical facilities have adequate trigger counts to meet visitor demand.

source: Certos assistentes trabalhando juntos como uma combinação podem ativar o "Vínculo de Negócios", que aumenta a receita para todos os envolvidos.
target: Certain assistants working together as a combo can activate Business Bond that boosts revenue for both.

source: Certos inimigos infligirão unidades aliadas com o estado de "Corrosão". Atacar inimigos restaurará os PV com "Corrosão". Quanto mais alvos forem atingidos, mais PV serão restaurados.
target: Certain enemies will inflict ally units with the "Corrosion" state. Attacking enemies will restore Corroded HP. The more targets hit, the more is restored.

source: Certos personagens possuem habilidades que podem remover melhorias de inimigos. Isso pode ser vital ao enfrentar inimigos com melhorias.
target: Certain characters have abilities that can dispel enemies' buffs. This can be very useful when fighting buffed enemies.

source: Certos personagens possuem habilidades que podem remover penalidades de aliados. Isso pode ser vital quando aliados estiverem afligidos com penalidades.
target: Certain characters have abilities that can dispel allies' debuffs. This can play a vital role when allies are inflicted with debuffs.

source: Cerydras Überraschungsgeschenk kann das vorherige Überraschungsgeschenk erneut auslösen.
target: Cerydra's Surprise Gift can re-trigger the previous Surprise Gift.

source: Ces cartes comprennent : Fausse victoire (aucun effet), Victoire (invincibilité), Triplé (augmentation de vitesse) et Main divine (invincibilité et augmentation de vitesse)
target: Tiles include: False Win (No effect), Win (Invincible), Triplet (Speed Boost), and Heavenly Hand (Invincible and Speed Boost)

source: Ces ennemis puissants présentent de légères différences par rapport aux boss classiques. Vous pouvez consulter leurs caractéristiques avant le début du combat.
target: These formidable foe materializations will have slight differences between them and regular Enemy Bosses. Trailblazers can check out the details by reading about the enemies' traits when the battle begins.

source: Cette partie indique la valeur de base dont la robustesse de l'ennemi est réduite par cette attaque.
target: The Base Value of how much enemy Toughness is reduced by this attack.

target: Every Trotter defeated will inflict all enemies with the Vulnerability debuff. Make good use of the debuffs applied by defeating Trotters to quickly take down the boss during "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken".

source: Chaque Voie possède 1 caractéristique correspondante. Vous pouvez voir les effets de chaque caractéristique et ses conditions d'activation dans le menu.
target: Every Path has 1 corresponding Trait, the effect and activation condition of which can be viewed in the menu.

source: Chaque bébé phoque a des capacités différentes. Utilisez-les à bon escient pour remporter la victoire.
target: Each baby seal has different abilities — using them wisely is key to victory.

source: Chaque carte jouée réduit l'énergie magique requise pour lancer le Déluge de magie.
target: Each card played reduces the magical energy required for "Mana Burst."

source: Chaque case sur laquelle vous vous arrêtez déclenche un effet spécifique. Lors de la sélection des cartes d'action, faites en sorte de vous arrêter sur des cases avantageuses.
target: An effect will be triggered based on the tile you stop on. When selecting Action Cards, do your best to end up on advantageous tiles.

source: Chaque chapitre doit passer par une projection interne avant d'être diffusé. Chaque film a des objectifs émotionnels différents.
target: Every chapter needs to pass Internal Screening before they are released, and different films have different Emotion Targets

source: Chaque chef d'équipe a une caractéristique de leader unique qui peut s'avérer utile pendant les corvées.
target: Every Duty Squad's leader will have a unique Leader Trait. This can be useful during duties.

source: Chaque cristal assemblé élargit la frontière de la zone de lumière. Utilisez cette caractéristique pour terminer l'épreuve.
target: Every time you reforge a Crystal, the boundaries of the lit area will expand. Use this property to complete the trial.

source: Chaque cristal brisé rétrécit la frontière de la zone de lumière. Utilisez cette caractéristique pour terminer l'épreuve.
target: Each time you break a Crystal, the boundary of the lit area shrinks. Use this property to complete the trial.

source: Chaque face du réceptacle d'ichor est recouverte d'une membrane. Détruire les membranes des différentes faces peut produire des résultats différents.
target: Each side of the ichor vessel might be covered by different membranes. Destroying membranes on different sides might generate different results.

source: Chaque fois qu'une Main de Zagreus est activée pour la première fois, vous devrez passer une Épreuve de malice, dans laquelle vous devez contrôler la main et récupérer des Pièces de malice à proximité.
target: When each Hand of Zagreus is activated for the first time, the Trial of Whimsy will open for you, in which you need to control the hand and collect Coins of Whimsy generated nearby.

source: Chaque fois qu'une cible alliée perd des PV, l'unité accumule de la Bulle de désespoir. Lorsque la Bulle de désespoir atteint sa limite, avance l'action de Pollux et passe en état renforcé à son prochain tour.
target: When ally targets' HP is reduced, accumulates "Desperate Bubble." Upon reaching the limit, causes "Pollux" to advance its action and enter the "Enhanced" state in its next turn.

source: Chaque fois qu'une histoire se termine par une rencontre d'entraînement à l'épée, March 7th obtient de l'expérience pratique, laquelle renforce ses stats lors d'une nouvelle session d'entraînement.
target: Each time the story is completed through a Swordart Escapade, March 7th will gain Trialed Insight, which will enhance her stats when she starts a new round of training.

source: Chaque fois que Qingque bat un nouvel adversaire dans une partie d'arcade, elle accumule de la réputation. À mesure que le niveau de réputation augmente, de nouvelles fonctionnalités et de nouveaux objets se débloquent.
target: Whenever Qingque wins against a new opponent in an arcade game, she will accumulate reputation. More new functions and new battle items will become available with a higher Reputation Rank.

source: Chaque fois que Qingque bat un nouvel adversaire dans une partie d'arcade, elle accumule de la réputation. À mesure que le niveau de réputation augmente, de nouvelles fonctionnalités se débloquent.
target: Whenever Qingque wins against a new opponent in an arcade game, she will accumulate reputation. More new functions will become available with a higher Reputation Rank.

source: Chaque fois que vous éliminez un certain nombre de bananes, vous déclenchez une explosion en croix aléatoirement sur le plateau.
target: Every time a certain amount of Bananas are cleared, randomly triggers cross-shaped detonation on the board.

source: Chaque fois que vous éliminez un certain nombre de fraises, vous transformez des fruits sur le plateau en bombes brochettes. Les bombes brochettes détruisent une ligne ou une colonne après élimination.
target: Every time a certain amount of Strawberries are cleared, randomly transforms a certain amount of fruits on the board to Line Bombs. When cleared, Line Bombs can detonate a row or a column.

source: Chaque fois que vous éliminez un certain nombre de kiwis, vous déclenchez une explosion de 2×2 cases aléatoirement sur le plateau.
target: Every time a certain amount of Kiwifruits are cleared, randomly triggers 2×2 square detonation on the board.

source: Chaque fois que vous éliminez un certain nombre de pêches, vous transformez aléatoirement des fruits sur le plateau en bombes carrées. Les bombes carrées permettent de faire exploser une zone de 3×3 cases après élimination.
target: Every time a certain amount of Peaches are cleared, randomly transforms a certain amount of fruits on the board to Square Bombs. When cleared, Square Bombs can detonate a 3×3 square box area.

source: Chaque ingéniosité se déplace dans la direction indiquée jusqu'à ce qu'elle rencontre un obstacle. Auquel cas, elle attendra de nouvelles instructions.
target: Each ingenium will proceed along the determined direction until the very end where it encounters an obstacle and awaits the next command.

source: Chaque invité partage une anecdote. Terminez des événements pour obtenir des récompenses !
target: Each guest will share a story. Finishing the Occurrence grants lots of Exhibition rewards!

source: Chaque jour, avant l'ouverture du parc, vous devrez sélectionner des installations et les placer sur les cases appropriées.
target: Before the park opens each day, you'll need to select Attractions and place them on the appropriate tiles.
