source: Cuando el cubito evoluciona a oro ultra, el límite máximo de sus puntos cinéticos aumenta a 5. Cuando el Mago lanza su habilidad definitiva, el cubito también obtiene puntos cinéticos.
target: When minicans reach the Ultra Gold form, increases max Kinetic Points to 5. After the Magician uses their Ultimate, minicans will also gain Kinetic Points.

source: Cuando el disco esté activado, puedes cambiar su dirección de rotación.
target: When the plate is activated, you can set its rotation direction.

source: Cuando el esferoide tenga habilidades disponibles, podrás sacar una ficha de habilidad al azar.
target: When the racer has an available skill, an ability tile will be drawn at random.

source: Cuando el icor entre en contacto con el parterre, crecerá una flor del conocimiento. Al retroceder, ambos pueden regresar a su estado original.
target: When ichor comes into contact with the flower bed, it will grow Cognos Bloom. When Rewinding, you can Rewind both to their original states.

source: Cuando el ingenio pase por encima de un bloque hundido, este se transformará en un obstáculo.
target: After the ingenium passes by a pressure plate, the plate will be turned into an obstacle

source: Cuando el ingenio pase por encima de un bloque hundido, este se transformará en un obstáculo.
target: After the ingenium passes by a pressure plate, the plate will be turned into an obstacle.

source: Cuando el nivel total de mejora de los artefactos equipados de un personaje sea inferior al requerido en el nivel de Equilibrio actual, los artefactos se reemplazarán por artefactos temporales ajustados al nivel de Equilibrio actual.
target: When the total level of Relics equipped on a character is lower than that required in the current Equilibrium Level, the Relics will be replaced with temporary Relics that are compatible with the current Equilibrium Level.

source: Cuando el personaje en la primera posición de la formación de equipo usa la habilidad definitiva, acumula valor de Coraje.
target: When the ally positioned first in the Team Lineup uses their Ultimate, accumulates Grit Value.

source: Cuando el personaje golpea un globo, puede cambiar su color. Los globos alternan entre dos colores.
target: After characters hit the balloons, the balloons will change, alternating between two colors.

source: Cuando el progreso está al máximo, se obtiene 1 carta de Agigantamiento.
target: When the progress is full, gain 1 Gigantification

source: Cuando el progreso esté completo, obtendrás generosas recompensas.
target: Earn generous rewards when the progress bar is full

source: Cuando elimines frutas u obstáculos en una zona revitalizada, obtendrás el doble de poder de combate.
target: When fruits or obstacles in an enhanced region are eliminated, obtain double Combat Power.

source: Cuando encuentres muchos fragmentos de marcas de victoria en una escena, puedes juntar una marca de victoria completa moviendo su colocación y ángulo a la posición correcta.
target: When multiple fragments of a Victory Marking are found in a scene, Trailblazers can piece these fragments together into a complete Victory Marking by moving and changing the view to a specific angle and position.

source: Cuando hay varios objetivos que debes salvar, hay que salvarlos a todos para que se considere como prueba superada.
target: When there are multiple targets to be rescued on the field, all of them must be rescued to be considered a success.

source: Cuando haya más de 8 grafitis en el dominio, el primer grafiti será reemplazado. Cuando abandones el dominio actual, los grafitis desaparecerán.
target: When more than 8 graffitis are made in the domain, the earliest graffiti will be replaced. When you exit the current domain, existing graffitis will also disappear.

source: Cuando haya varias máquinas de pinball, puedes lanzar la bola a otras máquinas de pinball como una parada de intercambio y, finalmente, a la última máquina de pinball como parada final.
target: When multiple pinball machines exist, you can first fire the shot to another pinball machine as an interchange stop, then finally to the last pinball machine as the eventual destination.

source: Cuando hayas completado todos los requisitos de captura, puedes presionar el obturador para tomar la foto. Intenta cumplir todos los requisitos.
target: When all the photoshoot requirements are met, you can press the shutter to complete this shoot. Try to meet all the requirements if you can.

source: Cuando hayas reunido la cantidad requerida de adhesivos, podrás recoger las recompensas en Colección de adhesivos.
target: Once you have collected the required number of stickers, you may claim progress rewards on the "Collection" page.

source: Cuando la Firmeza del enemigo llegue a 0, se activarán los efectos de Ruptura de Debilidad del tipo correspondiente y sus acciones se retrasarán. Además, entrará en estado de Ruptura de Debilidad.
target: Reducing an enemy's Toughness to zero will trigger the corresponding Weakness Break effect of the attack Type, delay their action, and inflict them with Weakness Break.

source: Cuando la barra de progreso se llena, obtienes una carta de Despertar para mejorar a Espíritu formidable.
target: When the progress bar is full, obtain an Awakening Card to level up Towering Soul

source: Cuando la energía de un personaje está al máximo, puede activar su habilidad definitiva. Las habilidades definitivas se pueden usar en cualquier momento como una acción adicional.
target: Ultimates can be used when a character's Energy is fully charged. Ultimates can be unleashed at any time as an extra action.

source: Cuando la energía de un personaje está al máximo, puede activar su habilidad definitiva. Las habilidades definitivas se pueden usar en cualquier momento. ¡Úsalas estratégicamente para obtener más oportunidades de acción!
target: Ultimates can be used when a character's Energy is fully charged. Ultimates can be unleashed at any time. Use it at the right moment to give you more actions.

source: Cuando los Ojos de la sabiduría llegan al máximo, puedes aumentar tu división estelar. Cuando se apaguen los Ojos de la sabiduría, no se reducirá la división estelar, aunque fracases en el desafío.
target: When you have enough Cognoculi, you can raise your Astronomical Division. When the Cognoculi is completely extinguished, your Astronomical Division will not decrease after a failed challenge.

source: Cuando los PV de los aliados aumentan o disminuyen, se acumula valor de Coraje.
target: Grit Value accumulates when allies' HP increases or decreases.

source: Cuando los PV de los aliados se reducen, se acumula Burbuja agonizante. Cuando esta llega al máximo, la acción de Pólux se adelanta y entra en el estado potenciado en su siguiente acción.
target: When ally targets' HP is reduced, accumulates "Desperate Bubble." Upon reaching the limit, causes "Pollux" to advance its action and enter the "Enhanced" state in its next turn.

source: Cuando los PV de un enemigo llegan a 0, no muere. La siguiente vez que reciba daño, el daño recibido se transfiere a todos los enemigos.
target: When an enemy's HP reaches 0, it will not die. The next time it takes DMG, that DMG will be transmitted to all enemies.

source: Cuando los PV de un participante lleguen a cero, será eliminado y abandonará la competencia. Haz lo posible por sobrevivir.
target: When a contestant's HP reaches 0, they will be considered as defeated and leave the war. Please do your best to survive

source: Cuando los PV lleguen a cero, la simulación terminará y deberás retirarte. Haz todo lo posible por sobrevivir.
target: When HP reaches 0, the simulation test will end, and you will exit the test. Please do your best to survive.

source: Cuando los aliados obtienen Chiste, Silver Wolf Niv. 999 acumula MMR oculto, lo que hace que su ATQ básico potenciado "Etapa de recompensa: Momento Loba Insigne" inflija más daño.
target: When allies gain Punchline, "Hidden MMR" is accumulated for Silver Wolf LV.999, allowing her Enhanced Basic ATK "Bonus Stage: αWolf Instant" to deal higher DMG.

source: Cuando los fragmentos de marcas de victoria estén casi juntos, aparecerá un botón especial de cámara y se guardará la marca de victoria completa tras tomar una foto. Esto concluirá el desafío.
target: When the Victory Marking fragments are close to assembly, a special Camera button will appear and the complete Victory Marking will be saved after the picture is taken, thus concluding the challenge.

source: Cuando los objetos cargados de recuerdos entran en contacto entre sí, los recuerdos que contienen chocan temporalmente y se disipan, lo que hace que vuelvan a su estado estable habitual.
target: When memory-laden objects come into contact with each other, the memories they contain will temporarily collide and dissipate, causing them to revert to their usual stable states.

source: Cuando los personajes del equipo usan su habilidad básica, cargan la Caja de la risa y aumentan el número de golpes del Regalo sorpresa de Sparkle. El Regalo sorpresa de Sparkle inflige daño a enemigos al azar.
target: When characters in the team use their Skills, they can charge the Surprise Box and increase the number of damage instances from Sparkle's Surprise Gift. Sparkle's Surprise Gift deals damage to random enemy targets.

source: Cuando los personajes en los puestos 2, 3 y 4 atacan a enemigos, afectan con En el punto de mira al objetivo y la acción del personaje en el puesto 1 de la formación se adelanta.
target: When characters at positions 2, 3, or 4 in the team attack an enemy, the enemy enters the "Aimed" state, and advances the action of the character in position 1.

source: Cuando quedan pocos ciclos en las etapas de caballero, los aliados obtienen bonificaciones de combate al inicio de cada ciclo.
target: In Knight Stages, when there are only a few Cycles remaining, allies will receive Combat buffs at the start of each Cycle.

source: Cuando saca el número más alto, la Caja de la risa actúa inmediatamente.
target: When drawing the highest number, the Surprise Box will immediately take action.

source: Cuando se active el modo de rastreo, el indicador del modo de juego aparecerá en la parte superior de la pantalla.
target: When Trailing Mode is active, the Gameplay Prompter will appear on top of the screen.

source: Cuando se causa Ruptura de Debilidad usando los tipos Físico o Fuego, el Daño de Ruptura aumenta.
target: When Weaknesses are Broken by Physical or Fire attacks, the Break DMG will be higher.

source: Cuando se destruye Armadura de guerra, el enemigo recibe daño y su acción se retrasa. Además, el atacante recupera energía.
target: When "War Armor" is destroyed, deals DMG to enemies, delays their action, and regenerates Energy for the attacker.

source: Cuando se elimina un objetivo de fila trasera enemigo, el daño recibido por el jefe enemigo aumenta hasta un 2000%. Este efecto se disipa cuando el jefe enemigo cambia de fase.
target: When an enemy with "Back Row Target" is defeated, DMG dealt to the enemy boss increases up to 2000%. This effect will be removed when the enemy boss enters a new phase.

source: Cuando se gasten los pts. de Aguante, se consumirá un porcentaje determinado de los PV de todos los personajes en su lugar.
target: When Stamina is exhausted, every subsequent use of it will deduct a percentage of HP from all characters in the team.

source: Cuando se rompe la Debilidad de enemigos con una alta Firmeza máxima, el Daño de Ruptura que reciben aumenta.
target: When enemies with high max Toughness are Weakness Broken, the Break DMG they receive will be higher.

source: Cuando se rompe la Debilidad de un enemigo, se reduce la Firmeza a los otros enemigos.
target: When enemies are Weakness Broken, other enemy targets' Toughness will be reduced.

source: Cuando se rompe la Debilidad de un enemigo, sus Debilidades se implantan en una unidad adyacente.
target: When an enemy target is Broken, adds their Weaknesses to adjacent units.

source: Cuando subas de nivel trazacaminos, ve a ver a Pom-Pom, el revisor, para recoger las recompensas de nivel correspondientes.
target: As Trailblaze Level increases, you can claim corresponding rewards from Pom-Pom, the Express' conductor.

source: Cuando te encuentres sobre el puente inestable, no podrás activar la plegaria para que el puente retroceda en el tiempo.
target: When the Trailblazer themself is standing atop the unstable bridge, they will not be able to activate the prayer to rewind the bridge.

source: Cuando te encuentres un Cronorrecipiente roto podrás repararlo haciéndolo retroceder en el tiempo. Esto hará que el tiempo vuelva a fluir en los alrededores.
target: When facing a broken Chrono Vessel, rewinding it will fix the vessel and allow time to flow again in the surrounding area.

source: Cuando termina el Momento Aha, se otorga el efecto positivo ¡Bien hecho! a los personajes de la Vía de la Exultación. El efecto positivo concreto de ¡Bien hecho! varía en función de cada personaje de la Exultación.
target: When an Aha Instant ends, Elation Path characters are granted the "Certified Banger" buff. The "Certified Banger" buff has different effects for different Elation characters.

source: Cuando todos los efectos de Antibacteriano prolongado de Mecatrón de Aleación: Rey Pom-Pom se disipan, este recibe una gran cantidad de daño.
target: When all "Lasting Antibac" effects are removed from "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom," it takes massive DMG.

source: Cuando tu Bullicio alcance el límite máximo, entrarás en el estado de Motivación potenciada. En este estado, los enemigos se ven afectados por Ruptura de Debilidad y el daño que reciben aumenta en un 400%.
target: When your team's Vibes reach the maximum limit in the match, your team will enter the "Super Hype" state. In this state, your opponent will be Weakness Broken, and the DMG they take will increase by 400%.

source: Cuando tu Bullicio aumenta, el Bullicio del oponente disminuye. Cuando el oponente realiza una acción, aumentará su Bullicio mientras se reduce el tuyo.
target: When the team gains Vibes, the opponent side's Vibes get lowered. When the opponent acts, it will also raise their Vibes while lowering the team's Vibes.

source: Cuando tú o tus compañeros de equipo infligen 5/10/15 pts. de daño o más con un ataque, obtienes 1/2/3 puntos tácticos.
target: When you or a teammate deals DMG with a single attack that equals or exceeds 5/10/15 or more, gains 1/2/3 Tactics Point(s).

source: Cuando tú o tus compañeros de equipo se defienden, obtienen 3 puntos tácticos.
target: When you or a teammate successfully defends, gains 3 Tactics Points.

source: Cuando tú y tu compañero de equipo mueran al mismo tiempo, la partida termina.
target: It's game over when you and your teammates all fall in battle.

source: Cuando un aliado lanza la habilidad definitiva, carga Héroes que arden como estrellas o Epopeya tal y como escribimos. ¡Lanzar Héroes que arden como estrellas y Epopeya tal y como escribimos reducirá en gran medida el Odio de Amphoreus!
target: Ally targets can use Ultimate to charge "Heroes, Ever Ablaze" or "Epics, as We've Written," which greatly reduces "Amphorean Hatred"!

source: Cuando un aliado usa la habilidad definitiva, el cubito obtiene 1 punto cinético. Cuando los puntos cinéticos alcanzan el máximo, se invocan otros 4 cubitos que activan inmediatamente Impacto autodestructivo.
target: When allies use their Ultimates, grants 1 Kinetic Point to minicans. When Kinetic Points are at max, summons 4 additional minicans and immediately launches Self-Destructive Impacts.

source: Cuando un cubito aliado ataca a un enemigo, el enemigo realiza una acción inmediatamente y recibe Daño con el tiempo.
target: When allied minicans attack enemies, the enemy immediately takes action and suffers DoT.

source: Cuando un enemigo es afectado con estados de Daño con el tiempo, obtiene 1 acumulación de Emponzoñamiento. El Daño con el tiempo que reciben los enemigos con Emponzoñamiento inflige Golpe CRIT.
target: When enemy targets become afflicted with DoT, receive 1 stack of "Toxic." DoT taken by enemies in the "Toxic" state are guaranteed to CRIT.

source: Cuando un enemigo recibe Daño de Ruptura, obtiene 1 acumulación de Vulnerabilidad. Concentra tus ataques en los enemigos con más acumulaciones de Vulnerabilidad para infligir más Daño de Ruptura.
target: When enemies receive Break DMG, they are afflicted with 1 stack of Vulnerability. Focusing attacks on enemies with the highest Vulnerability stacks to deal higher Break DMG.

source: Cuando un enemigo recibe Daño de Ruptura, obtiene 1 acumulación de Vulnerabilidad. Concentra tus ataques en los enemigos con más acumulaciones de Vulnerabilidad para infligir más Daño de Ruptura.
target: When enemies receive Break DMG, they are inflicted with 1 stack of Vulnerability. Focus attacks on enemies with the most Vulnerability stacks to deal more Break DMG.

source: Cuando un objetivo aliado realiza acciones consecutivas, se puede activar momentos destacados y obtienes una gran cantidad de Bullicio.
target: After ally targets perform consecutive actions, triggers Highlights and gains a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Cuando un personaje aliado es afectado con el estado de Ilusión fantasmal, este se ausenta. Las unidades invocadas en el estado de Ilusión fantasmal toman su lugar y heredan algunos de los atributos de ese personaje.
target: When an ally character enters the "Phantom Illusion" state, they will be "Departed". Units summoned during the "Phantom Illusion" state will fight in their place and inherit some of that character's stats.

source: Cuando un personaje aliado lanza la habilidad definitiva, obtiene Resonancia y aumenta el daño de las invocaciones.
target: When an ally character uses Ultimate, gains "Resonance" that boosts summons' DMG dealt.

source: Cuando un personaje aliado recibe daño letal no es derrotado, sino que revive inmediatamente y su acción se adelanta.
target: When an ally character takes fatal damage, they will not be downed but will instead immediately revive and advance their action.

source: Cuando un personaje aliado recibe una curación, los PV regenerados se convierten en PV perdidos.
target: When an ally character receives healing, the HP restored is converted into HP lost instead.

source: Cuando un personaje está en la posición correcta, puede obtener una nueva habilidad exclusiva de Guerra de Divisas: el Empoderamiento de personaje. Esto brindará diferentes experiencias de combate para cada personaje.
target: When characters are in the correct position, you can gain the new ability exclusive to Currency Wars: Character Empowerment. This will bring different character combat experiences.

source: Cuando un personaje haya usado en total 3 veces la habilidad definitiva, activa de inmediato la habilidad definitiva una vez más.
target: After a single ally has used their Ultimate for a total of 3 times, they will immediately activate their Ultimate again.

source: Cuando un personaje recibe un golpe letal en combate, no es derrotado y regenera inmediatamente una parte de sus PV.
target: When a character receives a killing blow in combat, they will not be knocked down and will immediately recover some HP.

source: Cuando un personaje recibe un golpe letal en combate, se reduce la cuenta regresiva restante y el combate termina anticipadamente. Esto significa que es más difícil derrotar a todos los enemigos antes de que termine la cuenta regresiva.
target: When a character takes a killing blow in combat, the battle countdown timer will decrease, causing the combat to end early. This means it will be harder to defeat all enemies before the countdown expires.

source: Cuando una creación oscura se esconde, asoma su cola oscura. Cuando una creación clara se esconde, asoma su cola clara.
target: When a dark-colored creation hides, it'll leave a dark tail sticking out. When a light-colored creation hides, it'll leave a light tail sticking out.

source: Cuando una unidad muere, los Espíritus de Otro Mundo pueden aumentar el progreso del efecto de legión.
target: When a unit is defeated, Otherworldly Spirits can increase the Legion effect progress

source: Cuando varios personajes del frente tienen efectos de técnica que no pueden activarse simultáneamente, solo se activará la técnica del personaje más a la izquierda.
target: When multiple on-field characters have Technique Buffs that cannot be activated simultaneously, only the Technique of the leftmost character will take effect.

source: Cuantas más acumulaciones de Emponzoñamiento tenga, mayor es el Daño CRIT que recibe. Al atacar a un enemigo con 4 acumulaciones de Emponzoñamiento, se activa el Daño con el tiempo en el objetivo y en los objetivos adyacentes.
target: The higher the "Toxic" stacks are, the higher the CRIT DMG taken becomes. When attacking enemies with 4 stacks of "Toxic," you can also trigger DoT on the target and adjacent targets.

source: Cuanto mayor sea el Progreso de maestría de Siete de Marzo, más fácil será pasar la prueba. Tras superar la prueba, sus atributos aumentarán y su estado anímico se recuperará.
target: The higher March 7th's Swordart Ascension ranks, the easier it will be to pass the trial. Successfully completing the trial will enhance her stats and restore her Mood.

source: Cuanto mayor sea el nivel de tareas de los miembros, mejor será la valoración base del informe de trabajo correspondiente.
target: The higher your members' Duty Level, the higher the base score of their corresponding Duty Report will be as well.

source: Cuanto más alta es la calidad de la bendición, más Calor es necesario para potenciarla.
target: The rarer the Blessing, the more Heat is required to enhance it.

source: Cuanto más alto es el efecto de Ruptura del personaje, mayor es su Daño de Ruptura.
target: The higher the character's Break Effect, the greater the Break DMG dealt becomes.

source: Cuanto más daño inflijas en el tiempo límite, más generosas serán las recompensas.
target: The more DMG you deal within the time limit, the greater the rewards.

source: Cuantos más cubitos haya, mayor es el ATQ y la reducción de Firmeza. Cuando los cubitos atacan al enemigo, el Mago recupera una gran cantidad de energía.
target: The more minicans, the higher the ATK and Toughness Reduction. When minicans attack enemies, they will also regenerate a massive amount of energy for the Magician.

source: Cubo de Basura Señorial
target: Lordly Trashcan

source: Cuenta cuántas quimeras salen de la escena por el lado derecho para ir a trabajar.
target: Count the number of chimeras leaving the area via the right side to go to work.

source: Cuidado! Se você entrar em um Teletransportador quando outro você estiver pisando no interruptor, o Teletransportador permanecerá ativado, e o "seu eu" que entrou ficará perdido em um looping infinito de turbulência do espaço-temporal...
target: Watch out! If you step into a teleporter when the other you is stepping on the switch, the teleporter will remain activated, and the you who entered will be lost in an endless loop of space-time turbulence...

source: Cuidado! Todos os seus movimentos serão registrados pelas sombras no vazio. Quando os passos do destino voltarem a zero, uma Versão Ensombrada de Você se manifestará como um inimigo e seguirá o destino que você traçou...
target: Watch out! Your each and every move will be recorded by the shadows in the void. When fate's footsteps returns to zero, an enshadowed version of you will manifest as an enemy and process along the fate you have etched into being...

source: Cultivar ingredientes requer dinheiro
target: Growing crops requires money

source: Cultivos gigantes
target: Giant Crops

source: Cupones de combustible
target: Fuel Voucher Details

source: Curios Negativas não podem ser utilizadas na síntese de Curios. Há um limite de vezes que cada Bancada da Criação pode Sintetizar Curios.
target: Negative Curios cannot be used for Curio synthesis. There is a limit to the number of times each Workbench of Creation can synthesize Curios.

source: Curios Transformadas e Bênçãos Exclusivas
target: Transformed Curios and Exclusive Blessings

target: Aetherium Wars

target: Hanu's Adventure

target: Hanu's Adventure: Part I

source: Cuộc Phiêu Lưu Của Hanu 7

target: Cyrene

target: Sweep

source: Các Hải Cẩu Nhỏ có kỹ năng khác nhau, vận dụng kỹ năng là mấu chốt để giành chiến thắng
target: Each baby seal has different abilities — using them wisely is key to victory.

source: Các Phóng Viên Furbo của "Tuần Báo Furbobo" không chịu làm việc đàng hoàng khi được cử đi công tác ư? Thế này sao được! Mau bắt mấy nhóc hư đốn này lại và "giáo dục" tử tế một phen đi.
target: The furbo journalists from Furbobo Weekly are slacking off on the job? That won't do! Round up these little rascals and give them a good "talking-to"!

source: Các Phóng Viên Furbo của "Tuần Báo Furbobo" sẽ ẩn náu ở nhiều nơi khác nhau để lén lút theo dõi dấu vết của giám đốc! Muốn khiến chúng sử dụng khả năng này vào việc chính đáng, chúng ta phải chủ động xuất kích.
target: The furbo journalists from Furbobo Weekly lurk around all over the place, secretly tailing the president! If we want these guys to use their skills for good, we need to take the initiative.

source: Các Phóng Viên Furbo sẽ sử dụng "Furbo! Biến!" để biến thành bản sao của giám đốc, bắt chước từng hành động của bạn nhằm tìm cách chạy thoát.
target: The furbo journalists will use "Turbo furbo, transform!" to turn into the president's doppelgangers, mimicking your every move in reverse to make their escape.

source: Các Phóng Viên Furbo tinh nghịch sẽ biến hình mô phỏng các loại đồ vật... nhưng thẻ nhân viên sẽ bán đứng chúng! Hãy chú ý quan sát để tìm ra sơ hở và vạch trần lớp ngụy trang mà chúng tưởng là hoàn hảo.
target: These mischievous furbo journalists can shapeshift and mimic all sorts of objects... but their name cards will give them away! Keep an eye out for any flaws and expose their self-proclaimed flawless disguises.

source: Các hiện tượng ngưng tụ được gói gọn lại trong lát cắt ánh sáng. Sau khi dùng có thể tăng các loại năng lực. Khi Nón Ánh Sáng cùng Vận Mệnh với người dùng, sẽ đánh thức thêm sức mạnh...
target: Solidified phenomena sealed inside slices of pure light to upgrade various abilities. Additional powers are awakened when a Light Cone user follows the same Path as the Light Cone...

source: Các mảnh chìa khóa sẽ xoay liên tục theo một tần suất cố định, đồng thời tạo ra hình chiếu trên lỗ khóa. Sử dụng Lời Nguyện Oronyx có thể quay ngược mảnh chìa khóa, từ đó thay đổi hình chiếu.
target: Key fragments will continuously rotate at a fixed pace. At the same time, a projection will be generated over the keyhole. Use Oronyx's Prayer to Rewind the fragments and alter the projection.

source: Cầu Bong Bóng Giấc Mơ chia thành hai dạng "Góc Xoay Trong" và "Góc Xoay Ngoài".
target: Bubble Bridges have two forms: Concave Corner and Protruding Corner.

source: Cầu Không Ổn Định
target: Unstable Bridge

source: Cầu Đẩy
target: Repulsion Bridge

source: Cầu Đẩy chia thành 2 màu cam và xanh, sử dụng Thiết Bị Điều Phối để thay đổi đoạn đường sẽ đưa bạn đến những nơi không ngờ đến.
target: A repulsion bridge can either be orange or blue. Using the control device to change the active bridge will lead you to unexpected destinations.

source: Cẩn thận búp bê không rõ nguồn gốc trên đường đua! Đụng phải nó sẽ mất kiểm soát phương hướng và bị choáng!
target: Watch out for Unidentified Dolls on the racetrack! If you run into them, you'll lose control and become stunned!

source: Cẩn thận! Nhất cử nhất động của bạn sẽ bị chiếc bóng trong hư không ghi lại, khi bước chân vận mệnh trở về 0, phiên bản đen tối của bạn sẽ xuất hiện như kẻ địch, hãy men theo vận mệnh của bạn, từng bước tiến về phía trước...
target: Watch out! Your each and every move will be recorded by the shadows in the void. When fate's footsteps returns to zero, an enshadowed version of you will manifest as an enemy and process along the fate you have etched into being...

source: Cẩn thận! Nếu lúc bước vào cổng dịch chuyển mà một "bạn" khác vừa hay đạp lên công tắc, thì cổng dịch chuyển sẽ duy trì trạng thái kích hoạt, và bạn - người đã bước vào cổng sẽ lạc lối trong dòng thời không nhiễu loạn vô tận...
target: Watch out! If you step into a teleporter when the other you is stepping on the switch, the teleporter will remain activated, and the you who entered will be lost in an endless loop of space-time turbulence...

source: Cậu Bé Đồng Hồ Ngoại Truyện - Bí Kíp Họa Sĩ Hoạt Hình Cao Cấp
target: Clockie's Extras: Senior Animator's Secret Volume

source: Cậu Bé Đồng Hồ Ngoại Truyện - Chế Độ Nhiều Tập
target: Clockie's Extras: Sequel Mode

source: Cậu Bé Đồng Hồ Ngoại Truyện - Chế Độ Điện Ảnh
target: Clockie's Extras: Movie Mode

source: Cậu Bé Đồng Hồ Ngoại Truyện - Kỵ Sĩ Bóng Hamster: Tốc Độ Và Quả Hạch
target: Clockie's Extras: Hamster Ball Knight: Fast & Furynuts

source: Cậu Bé Đồng Hồ Ngoại Truyện - Người Anh Em Hanu: Con Đường Của Sói
target: Clockie's Extras: Brother Hanu: Way of the Wolf

source: Cậu Bé Đồng Hồ Ngoại Truyện - Trải Nghiệm Quay Phim
target: Clockie's Extras: Filming Experience

source: Cổ vũ cần tiêu hao Bánh Nhảy Nhót nhưng khi kết thúc mỗi chặng, nếu tuyển thủ mà bản thân cổ vũ đạt Top 3, sẽ được hoàn trả lượng lớn Bánh tùy theo lợi ích thắng lợi của tuyển thủ đó.
target: Cheering requires Bounce-Bounce Snacks, but at the end of each round, if the contestant you cheered for ranks in the top three, you'll receive massive snack rewards based on their winning profits.

source: Cổng Thông Tin Vũ Trụ Mô Phỏng
target: Simulated Universe Index

source: Cổng Thông Tin liệt kê ra các loại Chúc Phúc, Vật Thể Lạ, Aeon trong Vũ Trụ Mô Phỏng.
target: Blessings, Curios, and Aeons in the Simulated Universe are collected in the Index

source: Cỗ Máy Nổ Ngầm
target: Automaton Stealth Bomb

source: Cỗ máy cổ đại do Đấng Kiến Tạo Belobog chế tạo, phục tùng ý chí của Bảo Hộ. Trong một số trận chiến nhất định, có thể nạp năng lượng cho cỗ máy này thông qua hành động của nhân vật phe ta, từ đó kích hoạt kỹ năng.
target: An ancient machine made by the Architects of Belobog that obeys the will of Preservation. In certain combat scenarios, you and your allies can Charge the machine to activate its ability.

source: Cột Gai Nhọn
target: Spiky Pillar

source: Cột Phao Bơi
target: Floatie

source: Cột Áp Lực bị khóa có thể nâng lên sau khi đi qua 2 lần.
target: Locked pressure pillars can be raised after ingenia pass over them two times.

source: Cờ Tỷ Phú Vũ Trụ
target: Cosmodyssey

source: Cứ cách một khoảng thời gian trong lịch trình sẽ tổ chức Cuộc Họp Bữa Tối, dựa trên kết quả báo cáo sẽ nhận được lượng lớn Quỹ Đội Tàu, cứ thế tiến thẳng đến mục tiêu.
target: Dinner Meetings will be held periodically in the schedule, and you can gain a large amount of Express Funds based on your report results. Treat that as your main goal.

source: Cứ mỗi 2 hiệp, khi bắt đầu hiệp sẽ bước vào giai đoạn chiến thuật, có thể mua Thẻ Chiến Thuật.
target: At the start of every 2 turns, you'll enter the Tactics Segment, where you can purchase Tactics Cards.

source: Cứ sử dụng 8 lá bài, Saber nhận được 1 điểm Ma Lực. Điểm số được kế thừa qua các hiệp.
target: For every 8 cards used, Saber gains 1 point of magical energy. The tally carries over between turns.

source: Cứ sử dụng một lá bài, sẽ làm giảm Ma Lực cần thiết cho "Ma Lực Phóng Thích".
target: Each card played reduces the magical energy required for "Mana Burst."

target: Store

target: World Shop

source: Cửa Hàng Đặc Biệt "Vị Diện Vô Tận"
target: "Planar Infinity" Special Store

source: Cửa hàng trong Khu Vực - Giải Lao có thể cường hóa Chúc Phúc Giới Hạn Sự Kiện. Trong mỗi Cửa Hàng, mỗi một Chúc Phúc có thể được cường hóa 1 lần.
target: The store within Domain — Respite can Enhance event-limited Blessings. In each store, all Blessings can be Enhanced 1 time.

source: D'autre part, durant la phase de débrief de chaque période de service, vous pouvez choisir de remettre des rapports de service pour obtenir des fonds de l'Express supplémentaires en fonction du score attribué par Pom-Pom.
target: At the same time, during the Dinner Meeting phase of every duty period, you can choose to submit the Duty Reports and additionally obtain Express Funds based on the score from Pom-Pom.

source: D'autre part, l'Endurance des chimères est réduite d'un montant équivalent à celui dépensé dans les tâches.
target: At the same time, the chimeras will reduce their stamina by an amount equal to their Task Consumption.

source: D'habitude, synthétiser des gemmes rouges ou bleues avec une pièce d'équipement commun permet d'obtenir des emblèmes de différentes synergies.
target: Usually, synthesizing Red Gems/Blue Gems with a piece of basic equipment results in Emblems of various Bonds.

target: Break DMG: Break Effect

target: Break DMG: Types and Toughness

source: DGT de rupture extrême
target: Super Break DMG

target: DMG dealt by Bleed, Burn, Shock, and Wind Shear is considered DoT. This DMG cannot deal CRIT Hit.

target: DMG dealt by Bleed, Burn, Shock, and Wind Shear is considered DoT. This DMG cannot deal CRIT Hit.

target: Break DMG: Break Effect

target: Super Break DMG

source: Da teilweise verschwommene Erinnerungen vorhanden sind, werden während der Erkundung der Erinnerungen manche Dialoginhalte als ■■■ angezeigt.
target: Due to the presence of certain hazy memories, some content will appear as ■■■ in conversations as you explore your memories.

source: Dados Prismáticos podem ser rolados novamente assim como os outros dados.
target: Prismatic Dice can be rerolled just like other dice.

source: Dalam "Apocalyptic Shadow", Trailblazer harus menghadapi proyeksi dari "Finality" dan mengalahkan Boss Musuh Kuat yang pernah dihadapi sebelumnya.
target: In Apocalyptic Shadow, Trailblazers must face projections of Finality and defeat bosses they have faced before.

source: Dalam "Kejuaraan Pusat Bisnis" Kota Seafeld kali ini, "Kekuatan Galaksi" akan berlangsung dengan format 2 lawan 1. Ayo kerja sama dengan Silver Wolf untuk mengalahkan musuh kuat!
target: In this Seafeld City "Commerce Street Showdown," the "Cosmicon Collective" will fight in a 2v1 format. Work together with Silver Wolf to defeat formidable foes!

source: Dalam "Perang Mata Uang", rekrut tim milikmu secara bertahap, bentuk tim 8-10 orang untuk bertempur, dan kalahkan lawanmu!
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8-10 members, and defeat your opponents!

source: Dalam "Perang Mata Uang", rekrut tim milikmu secara bertahap, bentuk tim 8-10 orang untuk bertempur, dan kalahkan lawanmu.
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8–10 members, and defeat your competitors.

source: Dalam "Perang Mata Uang", setiap karakter dapat mengenakan maksimal 3 equipment. Mengenakan equipment yang sesuai untuk karakter akan meningkatkan kemampuan bertempurnya secara drastis.
target: In Currency Wars, you can equip up to 3 pieces of Equipment on each Character. Equipping suitable gears on a character can significantly boost that character's combat ability.

source: Dalam "Permainan Overclock", saat setiap Node dimulai, kamu otomatis akan memperoleh lebih banyak EXP dan Koin Emas, tetapi tidak lagi memperoleh Bunga.
target: In Overclock Gambit mode, at the start of each Node, you'll automatically gain more Experience and Gold Coins, but no longer receive Interest.

source: Dalam "Rapat Makan Malam", kamu dapat memilih untuk menyerahkan laporan piket dan memperoleh "Dana Express" dengan berdasarkan Skor Pom-Pom.
target: During the Dinner Meeting phase, you can select and submit Duty Reports to obtain Express Funds based on the score received from Pom-Pom.

source: Dalam Battle Royale pada Mode Multipemain, semua item tempur akan diperkuat ke 3★ secara default.
target: In the multiplayer Battle Royale mode, all battle items are enhanced to their 3-star effects by default.

source: Dalam Battle Royale, setelah setiap ronde selesai, pemain yang kekuatan tempurnya lebih rendah akan menerima DMG tetap. Saat HP pemain mencapai 0, pemain akan memasuki status Sekarat, dan akan tereliminasi jika menerima DMG lagi.
target: In Battle Royale, the player with the lower combat power after a round will take a set amount of DMG. When a player's HP becomes 0, they will enter the Near-Death state. Taking DMG again will result in defeat.

source: Dalam Duel Duo pada Mode Multipemain, semua item tempur akan diperkuat ke 3★ secara default.
target: In the multiplayer Duo Duel mode, all battle items are enhanced to their 3-star effects by default.

source: Dalam Duel Duo, kedua pihak beraksi bergantian di papan yang sama. Setiap giliran, kedua pihak dapat beraksi 2 langkah, dan pihak dengan Kekuatan Tempur yang lebih tinggi setelah 4 giliran akan menang.
target: In a Duo Duel, the two sides take turns acting on the same field. Each side can act 2 moves per turn. After 4 turns, the side with more combat power will win.

source: Dalam Duel Duo, memicu penghancuran kombo dengan menukar 2 Bom Super akan memberikan langkah tambahan.
target: In a Duo Duel, you can also obtain extra moves when triggering a combo elimination via Swapping 2 Super Bombs.

source: Dalam Duel Duo, pemain dan lawan akan bertempur di papan yang sama.
target: In a Duo Duel, the player and their opponent fights on the same field.

source: Dalam Duel Duo, saat 4 atau lebih butir buah yang sama terhubung dan menciptakan bom, kamu akan memperoleh langkah tambahan.
target: In a Duo Duel, when 4 or more identical fruits are connected to generate a bomb, you will gain extra moves.

source: Dalam Mode Film, durasi film adalah terbatas. Bar Progres di bawah menunjukkan kemajuan proses syuting.
target: The film's length is limited in Movie Mode. The progress bar below indicates the filming progress.

source: Dalam Mode Kooperatif, setelah kamu dan rekanmu memilih dadu di tahap lempar dadu, aksi tidak akan langsung berakhir, melainkan memasuki tahap penukaran.
target: In Co-Op Mode, after you and your teammate select dice during the Rolling Phase, your action doesn't end immediately. Instead, you'll enter the Swap Phase.

source: Dalam Mode Lanjutan, trek akan diperpanjang secaraterus-menerus. Tantang dirimu dan ciptakan rekor skor tertinggi!
target: In Sequel Mode, the tracks will continue endlessly. Challenge yourself and achieve your highest all-time score!

source: Dalam Mode Latihan, kamu dapat menantang dalam Level Protokol mana saja, tapi tidak akan memengaruhi poin
target: In Retrace Mode, you can start a challenge under any protocol level, but your points will not be affected

source: Dalam Mode Lembur, tim kamu perlu menyelesaikan beberapa ronde pekerjaan.
target: In Overtime Mode, your squad needs to complete multiple rounds of tasks.

source: Dalam Perang Aetherium, kamu dan lawan akan terlibat dalam duel menggunakan Aether Spirit.
target: In Aetherium Wars, you and your opponent will engage in battle using Aether Spirits

source: Dalam Perang Mata Uang, Koin Emas adalah sumber daya ekonomi utama untuk membeli karakter, menaikkan level untuk memperbesar ukuran tim dan refresh toko. Dapatkan lebih banyak Koin Emas untuk meningkatkan kekuatan tempur tim.
target: In "Currency Wars", Gold Coins are the core economic resource used for recruiting characters, upgrading team size, and refreshing Store offerings. Gain more Gold Coins to enhance your team's combat power.

source: Dalam Perang Mata Uang, Koin Emas adalah sumber daya ekonomi yang paling utama. Dapatkan lebih banyak Koin Emas untuk meningkatkan kekuatan tempur tim.
target: In "Currency Wars", Gold Coins are the core economic resource. Gain more Gold Coins to enhance your team's combat power.

source: Dalam Perang Mata Uang, kamu memiliki 100 poin HP Tim di awal. Pada akhir pertandingan, sisa HP Tim akan menentukan rating pertandingan.
target: In Currency Wars, you start with 100 Squad HP. At the end of the match, the remaining squad HP determines the rating for that match.

source: Dalam Perang Mata Uang, karakter on-field akan otomatis menggunakan Technique saat memasuki pertempuran.
target: In "Currency Wars", on-field characters will automatically use Techniques in combat.

source: Dalam Perang Mata Uang, setiap karakter memiliki "Biaya" masing-masing, yaitu harga Koin Emas untuk membeli karakter. Dibagi menjadi 1 Biaya, 2 Biaya, 3 Biaya, 4 Biaya, 5 Biaya.
target: In Currency Wars, each character has their own "Cost", which is the number of Gold Coins required to recruit them. The costs are 1-cost, 2-cost, 3-cost, 4-cost, or 5-cost.

source: Dalam Permainan Standar, kamu dapat memilih kesulitan Rank yang ingin kamu tantang dengan bebas. Semakin tinggi Rank, semakin sulit tantangannya, dan semakin besar hadiah yang akan kamu dapatkan.
target: In Standard Gambit, you can freely select the rank difficulty you wish to challenge. The higher the rank, the greater the challenge and the more luxurious the rewards.

source: Dalam Simulated Universe: Zona Rahasia, setiap pertempuran memiliki sejumlah Putaran Standar. Setelah durasi pertempuran melebihi Putaran Standar, akan mengonsumsi Putaran Tambahan.
target: In Simulated Universe: Unknowable Domain, every battle has a standard number of Cycles. When the battle exceeds the standard Cycles, it will consume extra Cycles.

source: Dalam Stage Kuda, saat putaran tersisa sedikit, rekan tim akan memperoleh Buff pertempuran setiap saat putaran dimulai.
target: In Knight Stages, when there are only a few Cycles remaining, allies will receive Combat buffs at the start of each Cycle.

source: Dalam event "Pagi dan Senja Tersembunyi" total terdapat 5 gulungan. Temukan gulungannya, masuk ke pertempuran, dan kalahkan musuh untuk membuka masa lalu yang tersegel.
target: In the Enscrolled Crepusculum event, there are a total of 5 scrolls. Locate the scrolls, enter combat, and defeat the enemies to unlock memories that are sealed away.

source: Dalam event "Perintisan: Sihir Persahabatan!", karakter-karakter yang kamu kenal akan muncul sebagai "Penyihir" dan bertarung bersama "Tong Pony".
target: In the "Trailblaze: Friendship Is Magic!" event, familiar characters will appear as the Magician, fighting side by side with Litter Pony.

source: Dalam event "Stasiun Televisi Kejutan Mimpi" total terdapat 5 layar TV yang sinyalnya dibajak. Temukan layar bersangkutan, masuk ke pertempuran, dan kalahkan pelaku di balik semua ini.
target: In the Dreamjolt TV event, a total of 5 TV screens have been hacked. Locate the screens and fight the culprits to foil the mastermind's plan.

source: Dalam event kali ini, kamu dapat mengontrol karakter yang dipilih sebagai "Penyihir" dan bertempur bersama "Tong Pony". Perhatian: Di setiap stage, kamu hanya dapat menggunakan rekan tim sihir yang ditentukan untuk bertempur.
target: In this event, you can control the designated character as a Magician and fight alongside Litter Pony. Attention: You can only use the designated magical teammates to fight in each stage.

source: Dalam gameplay ini, musuh akan terus muncul. Mengakibatkan DMG atau mengalahkan musuh akan memberikan poin.
target: In this game mode, enemies will continuously appear. You can earn points by dealing damage to enemies or defeating them.

source: Dalam jumlah Putaran yang terbatas, kalahkan musuh sebanyak-banyaknya dan tingkatkan Level Tim. Setelah Level Tim meningkat, kamu dapat memilih 1 kali dari senjata atau aksesori yang muncul secara acak.
target: Defeat as many enemies as possible to raise your team's level within the allotted Cycles. After your Team Level goes up, you'll be able to choose one of the randomly drawn weapons or Accessories.

source: Dalam kisah "Petualangan Hanu", perangkat aneh milik Bos Stone membuat Bro Hanu menjadi kecil. Dia harus menggunakan tubuhnya yang kecil untuk bertualang dan mengambil kembali harta karun yang diambil oleh Bos Stone dari kota.
target: In the story of Hanu's Adventure, he was made smaller by Boss Stone's strange device. He then had to experience a grand adventure with his small body and take back the treasure Boss Stone took from the town.

source: Dalam medan tempur ganda, medan tempur tempat musuh Boss berada disebut medan tempur utama, sedangkan yang satunya lagi disebut medan tempur sekunder.
target: In both the battlefields, the battlefield where the Boss Enemy is located is called the prime-field, while the other battlefield is called the sub-field.

source: Dalam mimpi Penacony, terkadang kamu akan menemukan Jam Dunia Mimpi yang bermasalah, berinteraksilah dengannya untuk memasuki ruang pikiran Jam Dunia Mimpi dan memperbaiki makhluk-makhluk kasihan ini.
target: Occasionally, you may find malfunctioning Dream Tickers in Penacony. Interacting with them allows you to enter their Emoscape and repair these poor guys.

source: Dalam mode Battle Royale, 6 pemain akan bergabung dalam pertempuran. Setiap saat giliran dimulai, pemain akan dicocokkan dengan salah satu dari sisa lawan yang masih bertahan untuk bertempur.
target: In Battle Royale mode, every battle will have 6 participating players. Players will draw one from remaining opponents in each turn to battle against.

source: Dalam mode Pertarungan Multipemain, setiap pertandingan terdiri dari 6 pemain yang akan berduel. Di setiap giliran, pemain akan memilih 1 dari lawan yang tersisa untuk berduel.
target: In Multiplayer Bonanza mode, every match will have 6 participating players. Players will draw one from remaining opponents in each turn to battle against.

source: Dalam mode kesulitan sulit, garis pembantu akan menghilang. Ikuti musik dan ritme untuk merespons dengan tepat!
target: On Hard difficulty, the judgment line will disappear. Follow the music and rhythm to respond accordingly!

source: Dalam penjelajahan, ada banyak cara untuk memperoleh "Arcadian Token" yang biasa disebut orang-orang sebagai Wishbae. Misalnya, dengan menyelesaikan Misi Trailblaze, Misi Petualangan, Misi Dunia, membuka Peti Harta di dunia, dan sebagainya.
target: While exploring, you can obtain Arcadian Tokens (or as folks like to call them, Wishbae) in multiple ways, like completing Trailblaze Missions, Adventure Missions, world missions, opening treasures around the world, and more.

source: Dalam pertempuran, gelombang pertempuran saat ini dan progres mengalahkan musuh akan ditampilkan secara riil.
target: The current wave of enemies and the number of enemies defeated in the current wave will be displayed during battle.

source: Dalam pertempuran, mengalahkan Trotter akan memperoleh poin lebih tinggi.
target: Defeating a Trotter during battle will award even higher points.

source: Dalam pertempuran, musuh akan terus bermunculan. Kalahkan musuh atau akibatkan DMG pada musuh Boss untuk memperoleh poin. Masuki tahap "Ketangguhan Bergolak" secepat mungkin dan kalahkan musuh untuk memperoleh poin yang lebih tinggi!
target: In battle, enemies will continuously appear. You can earn points by defeating enemies or dealing DMG to the Boss enemy. Prioritize entering the Surging Grit phase and defeat enemies to obtain even higher points!

source: Dalam pertempuran, musuh non-Boss akan terus bermunculan setelah dikalahkan. Saat musuh non-Boss yang memiliki tanda ini dikalahkan, akan mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh Boss. Saat musuh Boss dikalahkan, gelombang akan dianggap selesai.
target: During battle, non-Boss enemies will continuously replenish after being defeated. When non-Boss enemies with this mark are defeated, it will deal DMG to the Boss enemy. When Boss enemies are defeated, the wave is considered complete.

source: Dalam setiap pertandingan, "Aha" secara acak membawa 3 equipment dasar, yang akan terbuka secara berurutan saat Ikatan "Elation" 3/4/5 karakter diaktifkan.
target: In each match, Aha randomly carries 3 pieces of basic equipment, which are unlocked sequentially as the Elation Bond activates at 3/4/5 characters.

source: Dalam status "Enhanced", saat "Pollux" atau "The Long Arms of Sorrow" terkena serangan, akan mengurangi "Desperate Bubble" dan memulihkan HP rekan tim. Saat "Desperate Bubble" terkonsumsi habis, status "Enhanced" akan dihapus.
target: In the "Enhanced" state, attacks against "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" can reduce "Desperate Bubble" and restore allies' HP. When "Desperate Bubble" depletes, dispels the "Enhanced" state.

source: Dalam sudut pandang Pembangun Mimpi, area aktivitas karakter akan dibatasi. Karakter dapat bergerak keluar dari batasan di layar setelah keluar dari "Mata Pemimpi".
target: In the Dreamweaver's View, your character's movement is limited within the screen boundaries. To move beyond these boundaries, you need to deactivate the Dream's Eye.

source: Dalam tahap Tantangan Final, kalahkan banyak musuh untuk mendapatkan skor tinggi. Jika ada Putaran yang tersisa, kamu dapat memperoleh skor tambahan.
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: Dalam tahap Tantangan Final, kalahkan musuh sebanyak-banyaknya untuk mendapatkan skor tinggi. Jika ada Putaran yang tersisa, kamu dapat memperoleh skor tambahan.
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: Dalam tahap penukaran, dadu yang tidak dipilih oleh kamu dan rekanmu akan diletakkan di Zona Penukaran. Kamu dapat menggeser dadu milikmu untuk ditukar dengan dadu yang ada di Zona Penukaran.
target: During the Swap Phase, dice not selected by you and your teammates will be placed in the Swap Pool. You can drag your own dice to swap them with dice in the Swap Pool.

source: Dalam tantangan gelombang ketiga, mengurangi HP musuh akan memberikan poin. Setelah pertempuran berakhir, semakin banyak poin yang dimiliki, maka semakin banyak Cosmic Fragment yang dapat diperoleh.
target: In the third wave, reducing enemies' HP will grant you points. After the battle ends, the more points you obtained, the more Cosmic Fragments you can claim.

source: Dalam tantangan multipemain, kamu dapat menantang musuh kuat bersama Trailblazer lain. Kartu yang digunakan oleh musuh kuat akan lebih kuat dibandingkan di duel alur cerita.
target: In Co-Op Challenges, you can team up with other Trailblazers to take on formidable foes. These enemies use more powerful cards compared to story battles.

source: Dalam tantangan teman, pemain dapat menantang lineup pertahanan lawan. Lineup pertahanan dapat diatur di antarmuka utama event.
target: In Friendly Challenges, players can challenge their opponent's Defense Lineup. The Defense Lineup can be set up in the main event interface.

source: Dalam tantangan, pemain dapat bertarung melawan pelatih Chimera yang sudah dikenal atau teman lainnya.
target: In the Challenge Match, players can battle against familiar chimera trainers or other friends.

source: Dalam tantangan, pemain perlu menggunakan File Penyimpanan untuk bertarung. Saat menyelesaikan satu ronde kejuaraan, lineup yang digunakan dalam ronde tersebut bisa disimpan.
target: In the Challenge Match, players need to use Saved Files to battle. After completing a tournament, you can save the Lineup used in that match.

source: Dana Pembangunan juga dapat digunakan untuk meningkatkan Nilai Dasar setiap tingkat pengelolaan, yang dapat membantu kamu mencapai Nilai yang Diperlukan
target: Development Fund can also be used to improve the Base Value on all parameters to help you reach the Required Values.

source: Danh Vọng Quyết Đấu Game Thùng
target: Arcade Duel Reputation

source: Dank des Navigationssystems des Astralexpresses kannst du zwischen Welten und Bereichen hin- und herreisen.
target: Thanks to the Navigation System of the Astral Express, you can travel between different worlds and areas.

source: Dano Contínuo
target: DoT

source: Dano de Quebra: Efeito de Quebra
target: Break DMG: Break Effect

source: Dano de Quebra: Tipos e Tenacidade
target: Break DMG: Types and Toughness

source: Dans Cosmopoly, vous devez lancer des dés pour vous déplacer. Vous pouvez obtenir des billets pionniers grâce à différents modes de jeu.
target: In Cosmodyssey, you need to roll dice to advance on the map. Trailblazers can obtain Trailblaze Funds through a variety of game modes.

source: Dans Fantômes de l'apocalypse, vous devez affronter des projections de la Finalité et vaincre des boss que vous avez déjà combattus.
target: In Apocalyptic Shadow, Trailblazers must face projections of Finality and defeat bosses they have faced before.

source: Dans Guerres des monnaies, chaque personnage possède un coût en pièces d'or qui lui est propre. Il peut être de 1, 2, 3, 4 ou 5.
target: In Currency Wars, each character has their own "Cost", which is the number of Gold Coins required to recruit them. The costs are 1-cost, 2-cost, 3-cost, 4-cost, or 5-cost.

source: Dans Guerres des monnaies, les personnages en première ligne utilisent automatiquement des techniques au combat.
target: In "Currency Wars", on-field characters will automatically use Techniques in combat.

source: Dans Guerres des monnaies, les pièces d'or sont la ressource économique principale. Gagnez des pièces d'or pour renforcer la puissance de combat de votre équipe.
target: In "Currency Wars", Gold Coins are the core economic resource. Gain more Gold Coins to enhance your team's combat power.

source: Dans Guerres des monnaies, recrutez progressivement votre équipe, formez un groupe de 8 à 10 membres et partez au combat pour vaincre vos adversaires !
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8-10 members, and defeat your opponents!

source: Dans Guerres des monnaies, recrutez progressivement votre équipe, formez un groupe de 8 à 10 membres et partez au combat pour vaincre vos rivaux.
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8–10 members, and defeat your competitors.

source: Dans Guerres des monnaies, vous commencez avec 100 PV de l'escouade. À la fin du match, les PV de l'escouade restants déterminent le classement pour ce match.
target: In Currency Wars, you start with 100 Squad HP. At the end of the match, the remaining squad HP determines the rating for that match.

source: Dans Guerres des monnaies, vous pouvez équiper au maximum 3 pièces d'équipement sur chaque personnage. Équiper un personnage avec des équipements adaptés peut considérablement améliorer ses capacités au combat.
target: In Currency Wars, you can equip up to 3 pieces of Equipment on each Character. Equipping suitable gears on a character can significantly boost that character's combat ability.

source: Dans Saut interdimensionnel !, vous pouvez vous transformer en différents Explorae et profiter de tout un tas de contenus amusants. Bien sûr, il existe d'autres récompenses qui ne demandent qu'à être réclamées.
target: In "Interplanar Jump!," you can transform into different forms of Trailblazemon and experience all kinds of fun content. Of course, there are also various rewards in "Interplanar Jump!" just waiting to be claimed.

source: Dans ce jeu, l'objectif est de générer des profits et d'augmenter le niveau d'exposition pour faire prospérer l'exposition.
target: In this game, your objective is to get rich and raise the Venue Level to make the exhibition more prosperous.

source: Dans ce mode de jeu, les ennemis apparaîssent en continu. Vous pouvez obtenir des points en leur infligeant des dégâts ou en les éliminant.
target: In this game mode, enemies will continuously appear. You can earn points by dealing damage to enemies or defeating them.

source: Dans ce plan, vous obtiendrez un grand nombre de fragments cosmiques en entrant dans une nouvelle zone, en sortant victorieux des combats et en détruisant des objets destructibles.
target: Entering a new domain, achieving victory in battle, or destroying destructible objects will all get you a large number of Cosmic Fragments in this plane.

source: Dans ce plan, vous rencontrerez la nouvelle Tranche de monde de Ruan Mei.
target: In this plane, you are guaranteed to encounter Ruan Mei's new "World Slice."

source: Dans chaque niveau, Salestia a un ensemble différent de mécaniques de combat, ce qui permet d'offrir une nouvelle expérience de jeu au travers de la coopération avec le sorcier et les autres alliés magiques.
target: In each stage, Litter Pony has a different set of combat mechanics. Coordinate with the Magician and the magical teammates to bring a completely new combat gameplay.

source: Dans chaque phase, si le concurrent que vous soutenez se classe dans les trois premiers, les snacks seront restitués en fonction de la quantité de snacks dépensée pour le soutenir et du bonus de victoire du coureur.
target: In each race segment, if the player's supported contestant wins the segment, snacks will be returned based on the amount of snacks spent on the support and the racer's victory bonus.

source: Dans l'Univers parallèle, vous pouvez améliorer votre efficacité en combat en choisissant des Faveurs de sang doré.
target: In the Divergent Universe, you can enhance your combat effectiveness by selecting Golden Blood's Boons.

source: Dans l'Univers simulé, vous pouvez choisir des Bénédictions après avoir vaincu des ennemis. Elles seront actives uniquement durant l'exploration en cours.
target: In Simulated Universe, Blessings can be chosen after defeating enemies, which are effective only in the current exploration.

source: Dans l'état Fièvre de la Marée noire, les cibles subissent des dégâts sur la durée de Faille du vent, Brûlure, Stupéfaction et Saignement au début de chaque tour.
target: While in "Black Tide Fever," targets receive Wind Shear, Burn, Shock, and Bleed DoT at the start of every turn.

source: Dans l'état ciblage, la Main de Zagreus peut détecter les objets destructibles qui brillent. Sprintez vers l'objet destructible pour le détruire. Pendant la collision, la Main de Zagreus arrêtera de sprinter.
target: While in the aiming state, the Hand of Zagreus can detect destructible objects that glow. Sprint at the destructible object to destroy it. Upon collision, the Hand of Zagreus will stop sprinting.

source: Dans l'état renforcé, lorsque Pollux ou le « Long bras de la miséricorde » subit une attaque, la Bulle de désespoir diminue et les alliés récupèrent des PV. Lorsque la Bulle de désespoir est complètement épuisée, l'état renforcé se dissipe.
target: In the "Enhanced" state, attacks against "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" can reduce "Desperate Bubble" and restore allies' HP. When "Desperate Bubble" depletes, dispels the "Enhanced" state.

source: Dans l'événement Chocmar TV, 5 écrans de télévision ont été piratés. Localisez-les et combattez les coupables pour déjouer les plans du cerveau de cette affaire.
target: In the Dreamjolt TV event, a total of 5 TV screens have been hacked. Locate the screens and fight the culprits to foil the mastermind's plan.

source: Dans l'événement « Le Cœur pionnier et la Magie de l'amitié ! », des personnages bien connus feront leur retour sous les traits d'un sorcier, et se battront aux côtés de Salestia.
target: In the "Trailblaze: Friendship Is Magic!" event, familiar characters will appear as the Magician, fighting side by side with Litter Pony.

source: Dans la Confrontation de la rue commerçante de Merchamps, les parties d'Atout cosmique se joueront en 2 contre 1. Faites équipe avec Louve d'argent pour vaincre des ennemis puissants !
target: In this Seafeld City "Commerce Street Showdown," the "Cosmicon Collective" will fight in a 2v1 format. Work together with Silver Wolf to defeat formidable foes!

source: Dans la Super ligue de la Ville de Boulder, vous pouvez participer à différents tournois pour gagner les récompenses correspondantes.
target: In the Boulder Town Super League, Trailblazers can challenge different tournaments to win the corresponding tournament rewards.

source: Dans la deuxième phase, si vos coéquipiers et vous sélectionnez des dés de même valeur, l'ATQ de Sparxie augmente considérablement. Changez vos dés de manière stratégique pour contrer cela.
target: In the second phase, if you and your teammate select dice with the same value, Sparxie's ATK will increase significantly. Swap dice strategically to counter this.

source: Dans la gueule du loup
target: Walk Into The Trap

source: Dans la troisième vague, vous pouvez gagner des points en réduisant les PV des ennemis. À la fin de la bataille, vous pourrez recevoir des fragments cosmiques proportionnels au nombre de points que vous avez obtenus.
target: In the third wave, reducing enemies' HP will grant you points. After the battle ends, the more points you obtained, the more Cosmic Fragments you can claim.

source: Dans le Domaine de l'inconnu, chaque combat a un nombre de cycles défini. Lorsque le combat dépasse le nombre de cycles standard, il consomme des cycles supplémentaires.
target: In Simulated Universe: Unknowable Domain, every battle has a standard number of Cycles. When the battle exceeds the standard Cycles, it will consume extra Cycles.

source: Dans le Jeu standard, vous pouvez sélectionner librement la difficulté du rang que vous souhaitez défier. Plus le rang est élevé, plus le défi sera difficile et les récompenses intéressantes.
target: In Standard Gambit, you can freely select the rank difficulty you wish to challenge. The higher the rank, the greater the challenge and the more luxurious the rewards.

source: Dans le Jeu surcadencé, au début de chaque Nœud, vous gagnez automatiquement plus d'EXP et de pièces d'or, mais vous ne recevez plus d'intérêts.
target: In Overclock Gambit mode, at the start of each Node, you'll automatically gain more Experience and Gold Coins, but no longer receive Interest.

source: Dans le Jeu surcadencé, chaque plan a moins de nœuds de progression.
target: In Overclock Gambit, each plane has fewer progression nodes.

source: Dans le Plan de l'infini, chaque plan comprend des plans ordinaires et une épreuve finale.
target: In the Planar Infinity event, each plane comprises Ordinary Planes and the Final Trial.

source: Dans le champ de bataille double : celui où se trouve le boss est appelé le terrain principal, tandis que l'autre est appelé le terrain secondaire.
target: In both the battlefields, the battlefield where the Boss Enemy is located is called the prime-field, while the other battlefield is called the sub-field.

source: Dans le combat final, votre équipe devra relever la tâche la plus difficile !
target: In the final battle, your squad will challenge the most difficult task!

source: Dans le mode Combat éclair, vous pouvez combattre contre des dresseurs chryséens ou vos amis.
target: In the Challenge Match, players can battle against familiar chimera trainers or other friends.

source: Dans le mode Combat éclair, vous utiliserez des fichiers de sauvegarde pour combattre. Après avoir terminé un tournoi, vous pourrez sauvegarder la formation utilisée lors de ce match.
target: In the Challenge Match, players need to use Saved Files to battle. After completing a tournament, you can save the Lineup used in that match.

source: Dans le mode Pionnier des étoiles, vous ne pouvez accéder qu'aux niveaux qui correspondent à votre Division astronomique. Vous illuminez les Yeux de la connaissance si le défi est réussi, et les éteignez en cas d'échec.
target: In Star-Pioneer Mode, you can only enter the protocol level matching your Astronomical Division. You will light Cognoculi after passing stages and will extinguish Cognoculi if you do not successfully finalize.

source: Dans le mode Répétition, vous pouvez relever un défi de n'importe quel niveau sans toutefois que cela ait une influence sur votre score.
target: In Retrace Mode, you can start a challenge under any protocol level, but your points will not be affected

source: Dans le mode Suite, la piste continue à l'infini. Mettez vos talents à l'épreuve, et atteignez le meilleur score de tous les temps !
target: In Sequel Mode, the tracks will continue endlessly. Challenge yourself and achieve your highest all-time score!

source: Dans le mode battle royale, chaque partie nécessite 6 joueurs. À chaque tour, les joueurs tirent au sort un adversaire parmi ceux qui restent.
target: In Battle Royale mode, every battle will have 6 participating players. Players will draw one from remaining opponents in each turn to battle against.

source: Dans le mode duel en bec-à-bec, tous les objets de combat sont automatiquement améliorés pour avoir leurs effets 3 étoiles.
target: In the multiplayer Duo Duel mode, all battle items are enhanced to their 3-star effects by default.

source: Dans le mode multijoueur, chaque partie nécessite 6 joueurs. À chaque tour, les joueurs tirent au sort un adversaire parmi ceux qui restent.
target: In Multiplayer Bonanza mode, every match will have 6 participating players. Players will draw one from remaining opponents in each turn to battle against.

source: Dans les Aventures de Hanu, le personnage principal a été rapetissé par l'étrange appareil de Boss Stone. Il va alors devoir vivre une grande aventure dans son tout petit corps pour récupérer le trésor que Boss Stone a dérobé à la ville.
target: In the story of Hanu's Adventure, he was made smaller by Boss Stone's strange device. He then had to experience a grand adventure with his small body and take back the treasure Boss Stone took from the town.

source: Dans les Embranchements du destin, vous pouvez également consulter les missions de la Finalité.
target: The experience you gained during the Finality Mission can also be viewed in Fate's Atlas.

source: Dans les Guerres de l'étherium, vous combattez vos adversaires en utilisant des esprits d'éther.
target: In Aetherium Wars, you and your opponent will engage in battle using Aether Spirits

source: Dans les Zones de repos, vous pouvez obtenir autant de bénédictions que vous possédez de bizarreries pour vous préparer pour l'épreuve finale que vous devrez passer après avoir terminé tous les niveaux ordinaires du plan.
target: While in a "Domain — Respite," you can gain Blessings equal in number to the number of Curios you already possess to handle the Final Trial that you must face after clearing all Ordinary Plane stages.

source: Dans les duels en bec-à-bec, connecter 4 fruits identiques ou plus pour créer une bombe accorde des coups supplémentaires.
target: In a Duo Duel, when 4 or more identical fruits are connected to generate a bomb, you will gain extra moves.

source: Dans les duels en bec-à-bec, les deux joueurs agissent à tour de rôle sur le même terrain. Chaque joueur peut effectuer 2 coups par tour, et après 4 tours, le joueur avec la puissance de combat la plus élevée remporte la victoire.
target: In a Duo Duel, the two sides take turns acting on the same field. Each side can act 2 moves per turn. After 4 turns, the side with more combat power will win.

source: Dans les défis amicaux, vous pouvez défier la formation défensive de votre adversaire. La formation défensive peut être configurée dans l'interface principale de l'événement.
target: In Friendly Challenges, players can challenge their opponent's Defense Lineup. The Defense Lineup can be set up in the main event interface.

source: Dans les défis coopératifs, vous pouvez faire équipe avec d'autres Pionnières et Pionniers pour affronter des ennemis puissants. Ces ennemis utilisent des cartes plus puissantes que lors des combats de l'histoire.
target: In Co-Op Challenges, you can team up with other Trailblazers to take on formidable foes. These enemies use more powerful cards compared to story battles.

source: Dans les niveaux Cavalier, lorsqu'il ne reste que quelques cycles, les alliés gagnent des bonus de combat au début de chaque cycle.
target: In Knight Stages, when there are only a few Cycles remaining, allies will receive Combat buffs at the start of each Cycle.

source: Dans les plans ordinaires, tous les magasins des Zones de repos sont des magasins spéciaux, qui proposent des fonctionnalités différentes.
target: During exploration of Ordinary Planes, stores in "Domain — Respite" are all Special Stores that provide different store functions.

source: Dans « Fate/stay night », les niveaux des personnages, des cônes de lumière, les Traces et les reliques sont améliorés lorsque les conditions nécessaires sont remplies dans l'Univers parallèle : La Comédie humaine.
target: In "Fate/stay night," character levels, Light Cone levels, Traces, and Relics can be enhanced if requirements are met.

target: Wardance: Boothill Showdown
