source: Dapat Synthesis 2 Berlian Merah/Berlian Biru untuk memperoleh Berlian Kekayaan.
target: Perform synthesis using any 2 Red Gems/Blue Gems to obtain a Wealth Gem.

source: Dapat beralih kembali ke Mode Reguler kapan saja untuk menantang Apocalyptic Shadow Tingkat Kesulitan 4 biasa, dan memperoleh konten hadiah yang sudah ada sebelumnya.
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Difficulty 4 of the regular Apocalyptic Shadow and obtain the original rewards.

source: Dapat beralih kembali ke Mode Reguler kapan saja untuk menantang Forgotten Hall Stage 12 reguler, dan memperoleh konten hadiah yang sudah ada sebelumnya.
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 12 of the regular Forgotten Hall and obtain the original rewards.

source: Dapat beralih kembali ke Mode Reguler kapan saja untuk menantang Pure Fiction biasa stage 4, dan memperoleh konten hadiah yang sudah ada sebelumnya.
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 4 of the regular Pure Fiction and obtain the original rewards.

source: Dapat membuka Paspor Dunia Mimpi melalui tombol pintasan. Juga dapat dibuka melalui item "Paspor Dunia Mimpi" di dalam Tas
target: You can open the Dreamscape Pass via the shortcut button, or by using the "Dreamscape Pass" item in the Inventory.

source: Dapatkan Blessing atau Persamaan apa pun yang mengandung "kata kunci" untuk mengaktifkan Karakteristik yang sesuai.
target: Obtain any Blessings or Equations that have the "keyword" to activate the corresponding Trait.

source: Dapatkan Blessing event waktu terbatas yang sama secara berulang untuk memperkuat Blessing, maksimal hingga 9 kali. Perkuat Blessing event waktu terbatas hingga level maksimal untuk mempersiapkan diri menghadapi "Ujian Terakhir".
target: Repeatedly obtain the same event-limited Blessings to enhance them for up to 9 times. Enhance event-limited Blessings to higher levels to prepare for the Final Trial.

source: Dapatkan Koleksi setelah menyelesaikan tantangan-tantangan tertentu di "Divergent Universe", "Simulated Universe: Bencana Swarm", dan "Simulated Universe: Emas dan Mesin".
target: Receive collections after completing special challenges in Divergent Universe, Simulated Universe: Swarm Disaster, and Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.

source: Dapatkan Lukisan setelah menyelesaikan tantangan-tantangan tertentu di "Divergent Universe", "Simulated Universe: Bencana Swarm", dan "Simulated Universe: Emas dan Mesin".
target: Receive artworks after completing special challenges in Divergent Universe, Simulated Universe: Swarm Disaster, and Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.

source: Dapatkan karakteristik baru atau ciptaan langka dengan mengembangkan ciptaan untuk meningkatkan Level Penelitian.
target: By nurturing creations and obtaining new traits or rare creations, you can increase your Research Level.

source: Dapatkan lebih banyak "Gate of Babylon!", dan lancarkan serangan pembelah langit dan bumi!
target: Get more "Gate of Babylon!" and unleash an earth-shattering strike!

source: Das Abfeuern von Bubbles verbraucht Bubble-Energie. Sammle schwebende Bubble-Kugeln in der Umgebung, um deine Bubble-Energie aufzuladen. Greife kontinuierlich das Bubble-Haus an, um es zu zerstören und Bubble-Kugeln zu erhalten.
target: Releasing bubble attacks consumes bubble energy. Collect floating bubble orbs in the environment to replenish bubble energy. Continuously attack the Bubble House to break it and obtain bubble orbs.

source: Das Abschließen weiterer Etappen oder das Erreichen höherer Stufen in Instanzen erhöht deine Leerlauf-Effizienz.
target: Complete more stages or reach higher levels in Raids to boost your idle efficiency.

source: Das Auslösen des Schwächebruchs eines Gegners verursacht bei allen Gegnern WDS-Reduktion. In „Kampfgeistphase 4: Macht erwacht“ hat der Bossgegner keinen Schwächeschutz. Wenn du Gegner mit Schwächebruch angreifst, erhältst du massive Buffs.
target: Breaking an enemy's Weakness can inflict Toughness reduction on all enemies. During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," the enemy Boss will not have Weakness Protection. Attacking enemies in the Weakness Broken state will provide immense buffs.

source: Das Besiegen eines Sparschweins im Kampf bringt noch höhere Punkte.
target: Defeating a Trotter during battle will award even higher points.

source: Das Chronogefäß ist ein von den Priestern von Oronyx hergestelltes Zeremoniegerät, das in verschiedenen Größen und Ausführungen existiert. Wenn das Chronogefäß zerbricht, wird die Zeit in seiner Umgebung angehalten.
target: The Chrono Vessel is a temporal ritual tool crafted by Oronyx's priests, with various sizes and styles. Breaking the Chrono Vessel will pause time in the area around it.

source: Das Darstellermodell hat verschiedene Positionen. Für jede Position können unterschiedliche Requisiten ausgewählt werden.
target: There are different slots in the Protagonist Model. The Plot Armor that can be selected for each slot is different.

source: Das Dekorieren des Zimmers verbraucht Expressgelder. Diese können durch geplante Aktionen während der Schichtarbeit erhalten werden.
target: Renovating the room requires Express Funds. These can be obtained through scheduled actions during duties.

source: Das Einzige, was ihn bestrafen kann, ist die Kraft von Oronyx: Benutze in der Nähe der Wankelmütigen Münze die Rückspulfähigkeit von Oronyx’ Gebet an dem Riss, aus dem er entkommen ist, und du kannst den Diebgeist wieder einfangen.
target: The only thing that can punish them is Oronyx's power. When near a Coin of Whimsy, use the rewinding powers provided by Oronyx's Prayer upon the fissures the thief escapes through to get the Spirithief to come back.

source: Das Ingenium bewegt sich in die angewiesene Richtung, bis es auf ein Hindernis stößt, und führt dann den nächsten Richtungsbefehl aus.
target: Each ingenium will proceed along the determined direction until the very end where it encounters an obstacle and awaits the next command.

source: Das Kaufen und Aktualisieren von Taktikkarten verbraucht Taktikpunkte. Im 2-gegen-1-Modus erhältst du Taktikpunkte, indem du Schaden verursachst, dich erfolgreich verteidigst, Konter ausführst und mehr.
target: Purchasing and refreshing Tactics Cards consumes Tactics Points. In Co-Op Mode, players can earn Tactics Points by dealing DMG, successfully defending, launching Counters, and more.

source: Das Licht einer Wundersphäre versetzt den Ort, auf den sie scheint, in eine andere Raumzeit.
target: The light from the Miracle Orb will invert the illuminated area into the other space-time.

source: Das Monument der Prophezeiung wurde von Oronyx erschaffen. Löse das Rätsel, um die Prophezeiung in Erfüllung zu bringen.
target: The Prophecy Tablet is a creation of Oronyx. Solving the puzzle will make the prophecy come true

source: Das Spiel ist vorbei, wenn du und all deine Teammitglieder im Kampf fallt.
target: It's game over when you and your teammates all fall in battle.

source: Das Team teilt sich alle Fertigkeitspunkte. Die Anwendung einer Fertigkeit verbraucht Fertigkeitspunkte. Die Anwendung eines Standardangriffs stellt Fertigkeitspunkte wieder her.
target: Skill Points are shared among the team. Using a Skill will consume Skill Points, while using Basic ATK can recover Skill Points.

source: Das Terminal bietet auch noch andere Funktionen. Zum Beispiel kannst du nachschauen, wie du deine Äthergeister ausrüsten kannst.
target: The terminal has other functions as well. You can check how to build your Aether Spirits

source: Das Training verbraucht Stimmung, und wenn die Stimmung niedrig ist, sinkt auch die Trainings-Effizienz. Stimmung kann durch Ausflüge wiederhergestellt werden.
target: Training consumes Mood, and when Mood is low, training efficiency will also decrease. Mood can be restored through Excursions.

source: Das Unirdische Wunder besteht aus speziellen optischen Materialien. Wenn Lebensformen es berühren, leuchten die berührten Blöcke auf. Bringe alle Blöcke zum Leuchten, damit sie zu einem Pfad werden.
target: Unearthly Marvel is made from special optical materials. When put in direct contact with life forms, the touched blocks will be illuminated. Light up all the blocks to turn them into a physical path.

source: Das Verursachen von Schwächebruch bei diesem Gegner verleiht Verbündeten Buffs.
target: Break this enemy's Weakness to apply buffs to allies.

source: Das Verursachen von Schwächebruch mit Quanten-SCH führt zu Verschränkung.
target: Causing Weakness Break with Quantum DMG will inflict Entanglement.

source: Das Ziel ist es, die leeren Minenwagen zu den blauen Prellböcken zu bewegen und die beladenen zu den gelben. Du kannst Minenwagen neben den Erzhaufen be- oder entladen.
target: The goal is to move the empty mine carts to the blue blockers, and move the loaded ones to the yellow blockers. You can load or empty mine carts at the ore piles.

source: Das finstere Du ist dein Gegner: Es bewegt sich Schritt für Schritt, genau wie du es vorher getan hast, bis die aufgezeichneten Schritte enden. Denk daran, es nicht zu berühren.
target: The enshadowed version of you is a foe that will strictly follow your previous actions and advance accordingly until the recorded steps have ended. Remember: Do not make contact with them.

source: Das geübte Auge eines Barkeepers erkennt drei Attribute in deinem Getränk. Jede davon hat zwei Zweige.
target: A drinksmith's trained eye allows you to see the three attributes in a beverage. Each has 2 types of inclinations.

source: Das ist eine Werbetafel. Wenn du gegen diese Werbetafel fährst, wirst du verlangsamt. Bitte verärgere die Werbenden nicht!
target: This is a Billboard. You will be Slowed when you run into a Billboard. Please don't offend the advertisers!

source: Das verzerrte Echo der Ordnung verursacht nur noch Chaos. Und als Harmonisierer kann Sonntag leicht erkennen, wo die Harmonie der Traumlandschaft gestört wurde.
target: The Afterechoes of Order, once distorted, only add to the chaos. As a tuner, Sunday can easily discern where the harmony of Dreamscapes has been disrupted.

source: Das Überschreiben von Gewichteten Kuriositäten verbraucht keine Kosmischen Fragmente. Es gibt eine Obergrenze für die Anzahl der Gewichteten Kuriositäten, die an jeder Werkbank der Schöpfung überschrieben werden können.
target: Overwriting Weighted Curios does not expend Cosmic Fragments. There is a limit to the number of times each Workbench of Creation can overwrite Weighted Curios.

source: Das Übertaktungsspiel ist ein schneller Spielmodus, der weniger Zeit in Anspruch nimmt und mit dem du wöchentliche Punktemissionen für Belohnungen abschließen kannst.
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, and can be used to complete Weekly Points mission rewards.

source: Das Übertaktungsspiel ist ein schneller Spielmodus, der weniger Zeit in Anspruch nimmt und weniger Knoten in jeder Ebene aufweist.
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, with fewer progression nodes in each plane.

source: Daño con el tiempo
target: DoT

source: Daño de Ruptura: efecto de Ruptura
target: Break DMG: Break Effect

source: Daño de Ruptura: tipo y Firmeza
target: Break DMG: Types and Toughness

source: Daño de Ultrarruptura
target: Super Break DMG

source: De ambos campos de batalla, donde se encuentra el jefe enemigo se denomina campo principal, y el otro se denomina campo secundario.
target: In both the battlefields, the battlefield where the Boss Enemy is located is called the prime-field, while the other battlefield is called the sub-field.

source: De nouveaux personnages peuvent être ajoutés à l'exploration en cours grâce au téléchargeur. Un téléchargeur ne peut ajouter qu'un personnage, choisissez judicieusement.
target: New characters can be added to the current exploration by using the Downloader. One Downloader can only add one character, so please make it count.

source: De plus : le fait d'effectuer des contres, d'appliquer Poison et Épines ou d'autres actions similaires peut également accorder des points tactiques.
target: Additionally, performing Counters, inflicting Poison and Thorns, and other such actions may also grant Tactics Points.

source: De plus, les compositions d'équipe des différents points de vue sont indépendantes, mais elles partagent les effets de statut, les PV, les points de technique, etc...
target: Moreover, team lineups across different POVs are independent of each other but share their Status Effects, HP, Technique Points, etc.

source: De vez en cuando descubrirás algunas burbujas de ensueño dispersas en la escena. Debido a que no están conectadas a plataformas transitables, estas burbujas de ensueño no pueden formar puentes de burbujas de ensueño.
target: You will occasionally discover some scattered dream bubbles in the map. Due to them being unconnected to passable platforms, these dream bubbles cannot form Bubble Bridges.

source: Debates acalorados
target: Debate

source: Debatte
target: Debate

source: Debido a que algunos recuerdos son borrosos, algunas partes de la conversación aparecerán como ■■■ al explorar los recuerdos.
target: Due to the presence of certain hazy memories, some content will appear as ■■■ in conversations as you explore your memories.

source: Debilidad
target: Weakness

source: Debilidad
target: Weakness Combat Trigger

source: Debugger Ciptaan dapat melakukan Synthesis 4 Komponen dengan level bintang yang sama menjadi komponen dengan level bintang yang lebih tinggi.
target: Workbench of Creation can synthesize 4 Components of the same star rating to become higher-rated Components.

source: Debugger Ciptaan dapat menimpa 1 Komponen menjadi Komponen acak dengan level bintang yang sama.
target: Workbench of Creation can Overwrite 1 Component to a random Component of the same star rating.

source: Decorações Culturais são instalações únicas encontradas na Zona do Luofu do Xianzhou. A maioria dessas instalações funciona com base na ativação baseada em chance ou na ativação a cada poucos segundos.
target: Cultural facilities are unique installations found in the Xianzhou Luofu Zone. Most of these facilities take effect either through chance-based triggers or triggering every few seconds.

source: Dein Erlebnis in der Endgültigkeitsmission wird auch in der Schicksalskreuzung angezeigt.
target: The experience you gained during the Finality Mission can also be viewed in Fate's Atlas.

source: Dein Etappen-Buff wird in der Ultimativen Herausforderung nicht hochgestuft.
target: Your Stage Buff rank will not be upgraded during the Final Showdown phase.

source: Deine Seite hat 3 geteilte LP. Wenn die LP einer beliebigen Karte auf 0 fallen, wird 1 geteilter LP verbraucht, dann wird diese Karte mit 1 LP wiederhergestellt und kämpft weiter.
target: Allies have 3 Shared HP. When any card's HP drops to 0, 1 Shared HP will be consumed, then that card will be restored to 1 HP and continue battling.

source: Deine eigene Verteidigungsaufstellung wird auf dem Hauptbildschirm der Aktion angezeigt.
target: Ally Defense Lineup will be displayed on the event main screen.

source: Dekati "Menara Gelembung Mimpi" dan berinteraksilah dengannya untuk mendapatkan "Energi Gelembung Mimpi".
target: Approach Bubble Tower and interact with it to obtain Bubble Charges.

source: Demi keamanan, Pengoperasian secara manual hanya dapat melakukan sedikit penyesuaian pada kontainer di jalur perakitan. Lampu pada panel kontrol menunjukkan rentang perubahan yang bisa dilakukan.
target: Manual operation can only make minor adjustments to the freight containers on the assembly line. The lights on the control panel indicate the range of the adjustments that can be performed.

source: Demônio de Fogo Heliobus
target: Heliobus Fiendfire

source: Den Sockel drehen
target: Turn the Base

source: Dengan "Memori Tanpa Nama", kamu bisa menuliskan kisah para pahlawan di "Seperti yang Kutulis"
target: Using "Nameless Recollection," heroes' stories can be written down in "As I've Written."

source: Dengan Renovasi Kamar dan Kustomisasi Dekorasi, kamu bisa memperindah kamarmu secara bertahap.
target: You can gradually liven up your room by renovating and customizing it.

source: Dengan Renovasi dan Kustomisasi Dekorasi, kamu bisa memperindah kamarmu secara bertahap.
target: You can gradually liven up your room by renovating and customizing it.

source: Dengan berinteraksi dengan Perangkat Kontrol, Modul Mimpi dapat digerakkan sesuai dengan jalur yang ditentukan. Saat Modul Mimpi bergerak, gelembung mimpi yang tersebar di permukaannya juga akan bergerak bersamanya.
target: By interacting with Control Panels, the Dream Module can be moved along the designated trajectory. When moving the Dream Module, the scattered dream bubbles on its surface will also move with it.

source: Dengan mempraktikkan "Jalan Pathstrider", kamu dapat meningkatkan poin "Jejak Interelasi" dan mengumpulkan seluruh chapter "Bencana Swarm".
target: Carry out the Trails of Pathstrider, increase Communing Trail points, and collect all chapters of the Swarm Disaster.

source: Dengan mengajukan laporan yang sama, Kombinasi Laporan dapat terbentuk dan dapat meningkatkan Efisiensi Skor untuk memperoleh Skor Pom-Pom yang lebih tinggi.
target: When submitting similar reports, you can create a report bundle, increase your score efficiency, and obtain higher scores from Pom-Pom.

source: Dengan menggunakan fitur Auto-Battle, kamu dapat melancarkan Kemampuan secara otomatis dalam pertempuran. Namun, fitur Auto-Battle tidak dapat digunakan dalam beberapa pertempuran khusus.
target: Use auto-battle to cast abilities and fight automatically. However, auto-battle cannot be used in some special combat situations.

source: Dengan menggunakan fitur kecepatan 2×, kamu dapat menikmati ritme pertempuran yang lebih cepat. Namun, fitur kecepatan 2× akan dihentikan sementara dalam beberapa pertempuran khusus.
target: Use 2× speed to experience quicker battles. However, 2× speed will be temporarily turned off in some special combat situations.

source: Dengan menggunakan kekuatan-kekuatan ini, kamu bisa mendapatkan Poin dan hadiah dalam "Perjalanan Seorang Pahlawan", lalu Adegan "Legenda Trailblazer" pun akan terbuka secara bertahap.
target: Using these abilities can earn you points and rewards in Legends Past and Present, and will also gradually unlock Legend of the Trailblazer sections.

source: Dengan menggunakan titik persimpangan tempat bertemunya beberapa arah lampu pemandu, kamu bisa menemukan lokasi yang kamu cari. Di lokasi tersebut, gunakan Home-Use Object Finder lagi untuk menemukan target.
target: By using the intersection points where multiple guiding light beams meet, you can deduce the target's location. At that location, use the Home-Use Object Finder again to locate the target.

source: Dengan mengombinasikan senjata dan aksesori secara masuk akal, kamu dapat memperoleh efek hasil kombinasi yang lebih kuat.
target: Make reasonable Weapon-Accessory combinations to obtain stronger combo effects.

source: Dengan menyelesaikan "Tantangan Waktu Terbatas" selama periode event, kamu bisa mendapatkan hadiah tambahan yang terbatas.
target: If you complete the "Limited Time Challenge" during the event period, you can also get bonus rewards.

source: Dengan menyelesaikan renovasi untuk meningkatkan tingkat penyelesaian renovasi kamar, kamu dapat meningkatkan Rating Dekorasi dan mendapatkan tunjangan renovasi.
target: Completing renovations to increase the renovation progress of the room and raise your Décor Rating. This will earn you Renovation Subsidy.

source: Dengan metode Terus Tanya, gali informasi yang bisa didapatkan dari pernyataan yang diberikan.
target: Use questions to discover possible details hiding behind given statements.

source: Dentro del plano hay una gran cantidad de objetos destruibles. Al romperlos, podrás obtener una gran cantidad de objetos raros.
target: Many destructible objects exist within the planes. Destroy them to obtain a large number of Curios.

source: Depois de aplicar a Estratégia, você pode acompanhar o equipamento do personagem recomendado na estratégia a qualquer momento.
target: After applying Strategy, you can track the recommended character's equipment in the strategy anytime.

source: Depois de capturar a mesma criação 6 vezes, você pode desbloquear o modo de colocação da Torre Miau Miau.
target: After capturing the same creation 6 times, you can unlock the Meow Meow Tower placement mode.

source: Depois de coletar todas as Moedas do Capricho próximas, você pode obter os tesouros da Mão de Zagreus específica.
target: After collecting all the Coins of Whimsy nearby, you can obtain the treasures of the specific Hand of Zagreus.

source: Depois de coletar todas as ninfas de uma área, a Confeccionadora começará a decifrar a profecia e poderá fornecer informações inesperadas para surpresas desconhecidas.
target: After collecting all the nymphs of an area, the Garmentmaker will begin deciphering the prophecy and may provide unexpected information to unknown surprises.

source: Depois de concluir a "Pura Ficção" e ganhar pontos suficientes, você receberá Estrelas de Contos e Recompensas de Contos.
target: Once you have cleared Pure Fiction and earned enough points, you will receive Story Stars and Story Rewards.

source: Depois de concluir pelo menos um Domínio no Universo Simulado no último Ciclo, é possível selecionar uma Bênção de Desbravamento para aprimorar sua própria equipe ao voltar ao Universo Simulado.
target: After completing at least one domain in the Simulated Universe in the last Cycle, you can select one Blessing of Trailblaze to enhance your own team upon re-entry into the Simulated Universe.

source: Depois de concluir todos os desafios, você também desbloqueará partidas de exibição, que lhe permitirão desafiar novamente oponentes de elite que você já enfrentou antes.
target: After you complete all challenges, you will also unlock exhibition matches, which will allow you to re-challenge elite opponents that were encountered before.

source: Depois de conseguir uma Mão Vitoriosa, Qingque pode continuar pegando peças. Cada vez que ela obtém uma Mão Vitoriosa, isso fornece uma Carga massiva para a "Caixa Surpresa".
target: After winning a hand, Qingque can continue to draw tiles. Each time she gains a winning hand, it provides massive Charge to the Surprise Box.

source: Depois de interagir com o Painel de Controle, os Módulos Oníricos correspondentes e suas trajetórias serão destacados.
target: After interacting with the Control Panel, the corresponding Dream Modules and their trajectory will be highlighted.

source: Depois de interagir com o poleiro ou com a própria MechAve, você pode começar a controlar a MechAve remotamente.
target: After interacting with the roost or the cycrane itself, you can start remotely controlling the cycrane.

source: Depois de mudar todos os balões do campo para a mesma cor, um Ciclo de Desafio será concluído. Quanto mais Ciclos de Desafios você concluir dentro do limite de tempo, maiores serão as recompensas recebidas.
target: After changing all balloons on the field to the same color, a Challenge Cycle will be completed. The more Cycles of challenges you complete within the time limit, the greater the rewards you receive.

source: Depois de obter o "Certificado de Analista de Poder" e comprar novos "Dados Prismáticos", você pode equipar "Dados Prismáticos" diferentes em suas cartas de personagens.
target: After obtaining the "Power Analyst Certificate" and purchasing new Prismatic Dice, you can equip different Prismatic Dice for your character cards

source: Depois de obter os Papéis de Parede do Telefone, eles podem ser alterados nas funções do Telefone.
target: After obtaining Phone Wallpapers, they can be changed in the Phone function.

source: Depois que Aha agir, ganha uma certa quantidade de pontos de "Piada" com base no número de personagens de Euforia presentes.
target: After Aha takes action, gains a certain amount of Punchline based on the number of Elation characters present.

source: Depois que Feixiao usa sua Técnica ela ganha um bônus de velocidade de movimento e puxa os inimigos com ela conforme se movimenta. Quanto mais inimigos são puxados, maior é o Dano ao entrar em batalha.
target: After Feixiao uses her Technique, she grants herself a movement speed boost and will pull enemies along her as she travels. The more enemies are pulled, the higher the DMG upon entering battle.

source: Depois que alvos-aliados realizam ações consecutivas, ativa Destaques e ganha uma quantidade massiva de Vibrações.
target: After ally targets perform consecutive actions, triggers Highlights and gains a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Depois que o "Mechatron de Liga: Rei Pom-Pom" usa "Modo de Esterilização de Alta Temperatura", ele ganha várias cargas de "Bactericida Duradouro", reduzindo muito o Dano sofrido por ele.
target: After "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom" uses "High-Temp Sterilization Mode," it gains several stacks of "Lasting Antibac," greatly reducing the DMG taken by it.

source: Depois que o Engenho passa pela placa no chão, ela se transformará em um obstáculo
target: After the ingenium passes by a pressure plate, the plate will be turned into an obstacle

source: Depois que o Engenho passa pela placa no chão, ela se transformará em um obstáculo.
target: After the ingenium passes by a pressure plate, the plate will be turned into an obstacle.

source: Depois que o Mago usa sua Perícia Suprema, as Minilatas evoluirão, evoluindo no máximo para a forma Ultra Dourada. Após a evolução, aumenta bastante o ATQ das Minilatas e aumenta o Dano de Ataque Extra de todos os aliados.
target: After the Magician uses their Ultimate, the minicans will evolve, up to the Ultra Gold form at max. After evolution, greatly increases minicans' ATK and increases all allies' Follow-Up ATK DMG.

source: Depois que o Mago usa sua Perícia, se houver um espaço vazio do lado inimigo, invoca 1 Lixo Perigoso no lado inimigo. Ao mesmo tempo, faz com que todos os Lixos Perigosos no lado inimigo ajam imediatamente.
target: After the Magician uses their Skill, if there is an empty slot on the enemy's side, summons 1 Hazardous Waste on the enemy's side. At the same time, causes all Hazardous Wastes in the enemy's side to immediately take action.

source: Depois que o parque abrir para o público, Poeirinhas visitantes vão entrar uma por uma e pagar Moedas Arca ao passar pelas atrações.
target: Once the park is open for business, wispae visitors will enter one by one and pay Arca Coins as they pass by the attractions.

source: Depois que os personagens atingirem os balões, os balões mudarão, alternando entre duas cores.
target: After characters hit the balloons, the balloons will change, alternating between two colors.

source: Depois que os personagens utilizarem suas Perícias Supremas, suas ações são Avançadas Adiante em 100%. É possível utilizar Perícias Supremas para que o mesmo personagem aja consecutivamente.
target: After characters cast their Ultimates, their actions are Advanced Forward by 100%. You can use Ultimates to make the same character act consecutively.

source: Depois que todas as quatro estátuas no espaço-tempo da Noite forem ativadas, você pode quebrar os grilhões da divindade de Nikador e avançar na história.
target: After all four statues in the Night space-time are activated, you can break the shackles on Nikador's divinity and advance the story.

source: Depois que um personagem aliado usa uma Perícia, ele recupera Pontos de Perícia, aumenta o Máximo de Pontos de Perícia e aumenta o Dano.
target: After an ally character uses a Skill, they recover Skill Points, increase Max Skill Points, and increase DMG.

source: Depois que você e seu companheiro de equipe terminarem de agir, os dados escolhidos serão usados para causar Dano ao oponente formidável.
target: After you and your teammates have both finished taking actions, the dice in your pool will be used to deal DMG to the formidable foe.

source: Der ANG der Gegner wird stark erhöht. Ihre Angriffe fügen Verbündeten Todesstöße zu.
target: Enemy ATK is greatly increased. When they attack, they will deal killing blows to allies.

source: Der Anbau von Pflanzen kostet Geld.
target: Growing crops requires money

source: Der Ausbeuterbetrieb besitzt spezielle Kapseln, die Wispae-Schätze genannt werden. Wispae-Schätze erhöhen den Fortschritt des Legionseffekts zu Beginn jeder Runde basierend auf der Platzierung der Wispaes auf dem Feld.
target: The Sweatshop Company possesses special capsules called Wispae Treasure. Wispae Treasures increase the Legion effect progress at the start of each Cycle based on the placement of wispae on the field.

source: Der Ausstellungsort verfügt über einzigartige Stände aus dem ganzen Universum. Man kann bekannte Figuren als Assistenten einladen, um die Ausstellung gemeinsam durchzuführen.
target: The venue has unique booths from all over the cosmos. You can invite familiar characters as assistants to run the exhibition together.

source: Der Basiswert des gegnerischen Widerstands wird durch diesen Angriff reduziert.
target: The Base Value of how much enemy Toughness is reduced by this attack.

source: Der Bestienseelenklan kann den Fortschritt des Legionseffekts erhöhen, wenn Wispae- oder Kapsel-Einheiten Stufe 3 erreichen.
target: The Beastsoul Clan can increase the Legion effect progress when wispae or capsule units reach Level 3

source: Der Bossgegner beschwört aktiv Seelensteine. Besiege die Seelensteine, um Highlights auszulösen und eine große Menge Atmosphärenpunkte zu erhalten.
target: The Boss Enemy will actively summon Soulstones. Defeating the Soulstones will trigger Highlight and grant a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Der Bossgegner wird mit Seelenfaust belegt und löst bei seiner Aktion vorrangig Blitz-DoT gegen andere Gegner aus. Durch Auslösen von Seelenfaust können die Seelensteine schneller zerstört werden.
target: Applies Spiritual Caning on the boss enemy. When they act, prioritize triggering Lightning DoT on other enemies. Triggering Spiritual Caning will allow the Soulstone to be defeated faster.

source: Der Diebgeist Bartholos kann Schätze verschlingen. Nähere dich einem Schatz und drücke die Verschlingen-Taste, um die Belohnung sofort zu erhalten.
target: Spirithief Bartholos can devour treasures. Get close to a treasure and press the Devour button to instantly receive rewards.

source: Der Geheimpfad-Mechanismus verbindet alle von Janus’ Verborgenen Wegen in Amphoreus. Sobald er aktiviert ist, werden alle offenen Wege in einen sofortigen Aktivierungsstatus versetzt.
target: The Secret Path Mechanism connects to all Janus's Hidden Passages across Amphoreus. Once activated, all unlocked passages will enter an Instant Activation state.

source: Der Medaillenbereich präsentiert Beweise des in Herausforderungen errungenen Ruhms und verzeichnet deine freigeschalteten Pfade.
target: The medal zone showcases proof of glory earned from Challenges and records your unlocked Paths.

source: Der Modus Sternenrang ist in Sternenpionier-Modus und Rückverfolgungsmodus unterteilt.
target: Astronomical Division Mode is split into Star-Pioneer and Retrace Modes

source: Der Pfad des Schicksals ist nicht eben ... Wenn du fällst, wirst du nie wieder zurückkehren können.
target: The path of destiny is not a smooth one... Should you fall, you will experience eternal damnation.

source: Der Schild absorbiert Schaden und verringert den Verlust von LP. Die Schildmenge entspricht der aktuellen Menge an Schaden, die der Schild absorbieren kann.
target: Shield can take DMG in place of HP, Shield Effect refers to the maximum DMG value that can be absorbed by the current Shield.

source: Der Schild für alle absorbiert SCH für alle Verbündete. Die Schildmenge entspricht der aktuellen Menge an SCH, die der Schild absorbieren kann.
target: Collective Shield can take DMG on behalf of all ally characters, and the Shield Effect represents the amount of DMG the Shield can currently endure.

source: Der Schlüssel zur Wiederbelebung des Museums liegt darin, die verlorenen Ausstellungstücke zu finden. Setze den Betrieb fort, um weiterhin Hinweise zu finden!
target: The key to revitalizing the museum lies in finding the lost exhibits. Continue operations to keep finding clues!

source: Der Schwertkampf-Test muss von 7. März allein abgeschlossen werden. Der gesamte Kampf läuft automatisch ab und sie kann keine Hilfe von anderen Teammitgliedern erhalten.
target: The Sword Trial must be completed by March 7th alone. The entire battle will proceed automatically, and no assistance from teammates is allowed.

source: Der Snack-Sprint ist eine von den Schöpfungen spontan organisierte Aktion, an der 8 Spieler als Zuschauer teilnehmen und die Teilnehmer anfeuern können.
target: Snack Dash is an obstacle race event spontaneously organized by the creations, where 8 players can participate as spectators and cheer for the contestants.

source: Der Sockel der Kugel kann durch Angriffe zerstört werden, wodurch die Kugel in die Richtung rollt, in die der Sockel zeigt, Hindernisse auf ihrem Weg zerstört und angelehnte Türen aufstößt.
target: The Ball-Holder Statue's base can be destroyed by attacks, causing the ball to roll in the direction the statue faces, breaking obstacles along its path, and pushing open slightly ajar doors.

source: Der Status „Antinomie“ aktiviert Ultimates. Allerdings kostet der Einsatz eines Ultimates während dieses Status massive LP.
target: The "Antinomy" state will activate Ultimates. However, using an Ultimate during this effect will cost massive HP.

source: Der Sturz in eine Strudelfalle fügt dem Seehündchen SCH in Höhe von 50 % seiner aktuellen LP zu und bringt es in seine Ausgangsposition zurück.
target: Falling into a Whirlpool Trap deals 50% of current HP as DMG to the baby seal and returns it to its starting position.

source: Der Teamleiter verfügt über einen einzigartigen Teamleitereffekt, der die Kampfleistung des gesamten Teams beeinflussen kann.
target: The Team Leader possesses a unique Leader Effect capable of influencing the entire team's combat performance.

source: Der Tisch kann schmutzig werden, nachdem ein Kunde mit dem Essen fertig ist. Das wird sich auf den nächsten Kunden auswirken, wenn er sich setzt.
target: After dining, customers may leave the table messy, which can affect the next customer when they take a seat

source: Der Traumpass kann über den Schnellzugriffsbutton oder über den Gegenstand „Traumpass“ im Inventar geöffnet werden.
target: You can open the Dreamscape Pass via the shortcut button, or by using the "Dreamscape Pass" item in the Inventory.

source: Der Unterwerfung des Zwists widerstehen
target: Resist Strife's Domination

source: Der Wechselbildschirm ist ein Gerät der Kunsthandwerkskommission zur Kurzstrecken-Teleportation. Damit können Figuren zwischen zwei räumlichen Koordinaten teleportieren.
target: Shifting Screen is a short-distance teleportation device of the Artisanship Commission that allows characters to teleport between two spatial coordinates.

source: Der Währungskrieg besteht aus 3 Ebenen. Jede Ebene enthält mehrere verschiedene Arten von Knotenpunkten.
target: The Currency Wars match consists of 3 Planes. Each Plane contains several Nodes of different types.

source: Der anfängliche Widerstand der Gegner beträgt 50 % ihres max. Widerstands.
target: Enemies' initial Toughness is 50% of their Max Toughness.

source: Der erste Verbündete im Team erhält Aufladung, wenn andere Verbündeten ihren Ultimate einsetzen. Außerdem besteht die Chance, dass der SCH des eigenen nächsten Angriffs erhöht wird.
target: The ally positioned first in the Team Lineup gains Energy when other allies use their Ultimates, and there is a chance that the ally positioned first will have their next attack's DMG increased.

source: Der gefaltete Raum verzerrte sich während der Ausbreitung des Infernos. Der Versuch, ihn zu durchschreiten, könnte eine Verschiebung der Raumkoordinaten nach sich ziehen und dich an einen unbekannten Ort schicken.
target: The folded space results from the spatial distortion during the spread of the infernal fire. Trying to pass through it may result in a drift in the spatial coordinates, with you transported to somewhere unexpected

source: Der gefaltete Raum, den die Raumstation benutzt, um entkommenen Kuriositäten entgegenzuwirken. Er kann effektiv den Raum versperren und so gewöhnliche Durchreisen stoppen.
target: The folded space that the space station uses to counter escaped Curios. It can effectively cut off space to hinder standard travel

source: Der gesamte Kampf wird sich zwischen Tag und Nacht abwechseln.
target: The entire battle will cycle between Day and Night.

source: Der vergangene Äon „Gier“ erwacht allmählich und seine unstillbare Macht greift um sich. Einige Gegner in dieser Welt sind davon befallen und werden durch die Kraft der Gier verstärkt.
target: The ancient Aeon of Voracity is gradually awakening, THEIR ravenous power steadily encroaching outward. Infecting a portion of this world's enemies, THEY empower them with the might of Voracity.

source: Derrota a las focas rivales para obtener puntos. Alcanza la puntuación máxima y ganarás.
target: Defeat enemy seals to earn points — reach the maximum score to win.

source: Derrota a los enemigos con poder de vigilancia para obtener la tarjeta de entrada.
target: Defeat enemies with Garrison abilities to obtain Door Card.

source: Derrota a los enemigos en los ciclos especificados para completar el desafío de Refriega estelar. Antes del comienzo de cada batalla, tus PV, puntos de habilidad básica y energía se restablecerán a la cantidad indicada.
target: Defeat enemies within specified number of Cycles to complete the Stellar Flare challenge. Before the start of each battle, your HP, Skill Points, and Energy will be restored to a specified amount.

source: Derrota a más enemigos durante la fase de desafío final para obtener más pts. Si te sobran rondas, conseguirás pts. adicionales.
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: Derrota a más enemigos durante la fase de desafío final para obtener más puntos. Si te sobran rondas, conseguirás puntos adicionales.
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: Derrota a tantos enemigos como puedas dentro de un número limitado de ciclos para aumentar el nivel de tu equipo todo lo posible. Después de incrementar tu nivel de equipo, podrás elegir una de las armas o accesorios que aparecen al azar.
target: Defeat as many enemies as possible to raise your team's level within the allotted Cycles. After your Team Level goes up, you'll be able to choose one of the randomly drawn weapons or Accessories.

source: Derrota al Chanchito en esta etapa para acumular una gran cantidad de valor de Coraje. Debes derrotarlo antes de que escape.
target: Defeat the Trotters in this stage to obtain a large amount of Grit Value. You need to defeat the Trotter before it escapes.

source: Derrota al Esbirro del Rey Demonio y obtén sus tesoros.
target: Defeat the Demon King's Minions to obtain the Demon King's Treasures.

source: Derrotar enemigos aumenta el valor de Coraje. Activar el mecanismo de Coraje acumula una gran cantidad de valor de Coraje para entrar rápidamente en la fase de Coraje tumultuoso y obtener una poderosa bonificación de etapa adicional.
target: Defeating enemies increases Grit Value. Activating the Grit Mechanics rapidly accumulates Grit Value, speeding up entry into the Surging Grit phase, granting additional powerful stage buffs.

source: Derrotar inimigos aumenta o "Valor de Bravura". Ativar as Mecânicas de Bravura acumula rapidamente "Valor de Bravura", acelerando a entrada na fase de "Surto de Bravura", concedendo melhorias poderosas de estágio adicionais.
target: Defeating enemies increases Grit Value. Activating the Grit Mechanics rapidly accumulates Grit Value, speeding up entry into the Surging Grit phase, granting additional powerful stage buffs.

source: Derrotar um Cofrinho durante a batalha garante uma pontuação ainda mais alta.
target: Defeating a Trotter during battle will award even higher points.

source: Derrote focas inimigas para ganhar pontos. Atinja a pontuação máxima para vencer.
target: Defeat enemy seals to earn points — reach the maximum score to win.

source: Derrote inimigos com Habilidades de Guarnição para obter o Cartão de Porta.
target: Defeat enemies with Garrison abilities to obtain Door Card.

source: Derrote inimigos dentro de um certo número de Ciclos para concluir o desafio da Chama Estelar. Antes do início de cada batalha, seus PV, Pontos de Perícia e Energia serão restaurados a um valor especificado.
target: Defeat enemies within specified number of Cycles to complete the Stellar Flare challenge. Before the start of each battle, your HP, Skill Points, and Energy will be restored to a specified amount.

source: Derrote mais inimigos durante a fase do Combate Final para ganhar mais pontos. Você ganhará pontos adicionais se possuir algum ciclo restante.
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: Derrote o Cofrinho antes que ele escape e ative Destaques para uma obter quantidade massiva de Vibrações.
target: Defeat the Trotter before it escapes and trigger Highlights to obtain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Derrote oponentes em partidas para ganhar "Fichas de Poder" e "Pó de Poder" como recompensa. Ao lutar contra a Gangue Mogura, você também pode obter "Fichas de Poder Vitoriosas" especiais como um bônus extra.
target: Defeat opponents in matches to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards. When fighting against the Mogura Gang, you can also obtain special "Victorious Power Tokens" as an extra bonus.

source: Derrote oponentes para ganhar "Fichas de Poder" e "Pó de Poder" como recompensa.
target: Defeat opponents to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards.

source: Derrote oponentes para ganhar Fichas de Poder e resgatar cartas, e Pó de Poder para Dourar as cartas.
target: Defeat opponents to earn Power Tokens for redeeming cards and Power Dust for gilding cards.

source: Derrote os Cofrinhos neste estágio para obter uma grande quantidade de "Valor de Bravura". Você precisa derrotar o Cofrinho antes que ele fuja.
target: Defeat the Trotters in this stage to obtain a large amount of Grit Value. You need to defeat the Trotter before it escapes.

source: Derrote os Lacaios do Demônio Rei para obter os Tesouros do Demônio Rei.
target: Defeat the Demon King's Minions to obtain the Demon King's Treasures.

source: Derrote quantos inimigos forem possíveis para aumentar o nível da sua equipe dentro dos Ciclos atribuídos. Depois que seu Nível da Equipe subir, você será capaz de escolher uma das armas ou dos Acessórios sorteados aleatoriamente.
target: Defeat as many enemies as possible to raise your team's level within the allotted Cycles. After your Team Level goes up, you'll be able to choose one of the randomly drawn weapons or Accessories.

source: Derrote quantos inimigos forem possíveis para aumentar o nível da sua equipe dentro dos Ciclos atribuídos. Depois que seu Nível de Equipe subir, você será capaz de escolher uma das armas ou dos Acessórios sorteados aleatoriamente.
target: Defeat as many enemies as possible to raise your team's level within the allotted Cycles. After your Team Level goes up, you'll be able to choose one of the randomly drawn weapons or Accessories.

source: Derrote todos os inimigos antes que o contador chegue a zero para vencer a batalha e aumentar sua sequência de vitórias. Quanto maior for sua sequência de vitórias, mais Moedas de Ouro você receberá como recompensa.
target: Defeat all enemies before the countdown hits zero to win the battle and add to your winning streak. The longer your winning streak, the more Gold Coins you'll earn as rewards.

source: Derrote todos os inimigos antes que os Ciclos de Ação terminem para alcançar a vitória na batalha. Alcançar a vitória na batalha causará Dano aos oponentes.
target: Defeat all enemies before the Action Cycles end to achieve victory in battle. Achieving victory in battle will deal DMG to opponents.

source: Des Weiteren sind Teamaufstellungen in verschiedenen Perspektiven unabhängig voneinander, haben aber die gleichen Statuseffekte, LP, Technikpunkte usw.
target: Moreover, team lineups across different POVs are independent of each other but share their Status Effects, HP, Technique Points, etc.

source: Des bizarreries aux effets divers parsèment l'Univers simulé. Récupérez-les pour renforcer votre équipe.
target: Curios with various effects can be encountered in the Simulated Universe. Collect Curios to Enhance your team.

source: Des coffres au trésor sont disséminés partout dans le monde. Partez en exploration, venez à bout de vos ennemis, et vous trouverez peut-être des objets de grande valeur.
target: Treasures are scattered across the world. You may find things of great value by exploring the world and defeating your enemies.

source: Des feux d'artifice Chocmar apparaîtront dans cet épisode. Si vous les attaquez, vous provoquerez des explosions qui blesseront tous les ennemis sur le champ de bataille.
target: Dreamjolt Fireworks will appear in this episode. Attacking them will trigger explosions that will attack all enemies on the battlefield.

source: Des fils narratifs de différentes couleurs changeront les émotions du public qui les visionnent, ce qui produira des effets variés.
target: Different colored Story Snippets will cause different Audience Emotions to change, resulting in varied effects

source: Des gentlemen qui tiennent des puzzles oniriques peuvent apparaître n'importe où à Penacony. Terminez le puzzle et l'objet qu'il représente apparaîtra dans le Pays des rêves.
target: Puzzle Gentleman holding Dream Jigsaws may appear anywhere in Penacony. Completing the jigsaw puzzle will make the object within it appear in the Dreamscape.

source: Des indications d'aide apparaissent au cours de certains modes de jeu. Suivez les indications d'aide et terminez les opérations correspondantes afin d'atteindre les objectifs de la mission en cours.
target: Support Guide will appear in certain specific overworld gameplay. Follow Support Guide and finish the corresponding operations to arrive at the destination for the current mission.

source: Des oiseaux en origami innocents pourraient apparaître dans cet épisode. Blesser les innocents vous retirera un bon nombre de points, en revanche, si vous permettez aux oiseaux en origami de s'échapper, vous gagnerez beaucoup de points.
target: Innocent Origami Birds might appear in this episode. Hurting the innocent will deduct a large amount of points from you, and allowing the Origami Birds to escape will earn you a large amount of points.

source: Des événements d'invité apparaissent à intervalles réguliers une fois la journée d'exposition lancée. Terminez les événements d'invité pour faire progresser la journée d'exposition.
target: After the Exhibition Day starts, Guest Occurrences will appear periodically. Completing Guest Occurrences will advance the Exhibition Day.

source: Des événements livraison de Pom-Pom apparaissent à intervalles réguliers une fois la journée d'exposition lancée. Terminez les livraisons de Pom-Pom pour faire progresser la journée d'exposition.
target: After the Exhibition Day starts, the Pom-Pom Delivery event will appear periodically. Completing Pom-Pom Delivery will advance the Exhibition Day progress.

source: Desafiar o Eco da Guerra, experienciar o Universo Simulado ou o Salão Esquecido são ótimas maneiras de aumentar seu Nível de Desbravamento.
target: Challenging Echo of War or experiencing the Simulated Universe or the Forgotten Hall are all great ways to increase Trailblaze Level.

target: Arcade Challenge: Access Screening

source: Desafio Arcade: Códigos Secretos
target: Arcade Challenge: Hidden Codes

target: Co-op Challenge

target: Sword Trial

source: Desafía las pruebas de cuatro zonas de victoria sucesivamente y derrota a los aspirantes al título del campeonato para ganar insignias de maestría. Reúne 4 insignias de maestría para poder participar en el torneo.
target: Successively challenge four Victory Zone trials and defeat the championship contenders to win Mastery Marks. Collect 4 Mastery Marks to qualify for the tournament

source: Desafío de la máquina recreativa: Control de acceso
target: Arcade Challenge: Access Screening

source: Desafío de la máquina recreativa: Códigos ocultos
target: Arcade Challenge: Hidden Codes

source: Desafío multijugador
target: Co-op Challenge

source: Desarrollar creaciones y obtener nuevos rasgos o creaciones especiales incrementa tu nivel de investigación.
target: By nurturing creations and obtaining new traits or rare creations, you can increase your Research Level.

target: Nurture Creation

target: Character: Leveling and Trial

target: Swarm Disaster: Resonance Interplay

source: Desbloqueie a habilidade "Automatizar" para mais funcionárias para reduzir a pressão operacional!
target: Unlock the Automate skill for more staff members to reduce operational pressure!

target: Quick Unlock

target: Quick Unlock

target: Worksite Dispatch

source: Despliega más personajes del mismo vínculo para aumentar el nivel del vínculo. Cuanto más alto sea el nivel del vínculo, más potentes serán los efectos.
target: Deploying more characters with the same Bond will increase the Bond Level. The higher the Bond Level, the stronger the effect.

source: Después de activar las cuatro estatuas en el espacio-tiempo de la noche, podrás liberar la divinidad de Nikador de sus grilletes y avanzar en la historia.
target: After all four statues in the Night space-time are activated, you can break the shackles on Nikador's divinity and advance the story.

source: Después de cada partida obtienes puntos de espectador. Cuanto más alto sea el nivel del circuito, más puntos ganas. ¡Acumula puntos y reclama las recompensas de espectador!
target: After each match, you'll earn Spectator Points. Higher-tier matches award more points, and you can claim Spectator Rewards by accumulating points.

source: Después de cada ronda, el jugador con menos poder de combate recibirá daño fijo. Cuando sus PV desciendan a 0, entrará en el estado Agonizante y será eliminado tras recibir daño una vez más.
target: Player with the lower combat power after a round will take a set amount of DMG. When a player's HP becomes 0, they will enter the Near-Death state. Taking DMG again will result in defeat.

source: Después de completar al menos una zona en el último ciclo, puedes seleccionar una bendición trazacaminos para mejorar tu equipo al volver a entrar en el Universo Simulado.
target: After completing at least one domain in the Simulated Universe in the last Cycle, you can select one Blessing of Trailblaze to enhance your own team upon re-entry into the Simulated Universe.

source: Después de derrotar a los enemigos en el Universo Simulado, puedes gastar fragmentos cósmicos para restablecer la bendición por solo 1 vez durante el proceso de selección de la bendición.
target: After defeating enemies in the Simulated Universe, you can consume Cosmic Fragments to reset the Blessing for just one time during the Blessing selection process.

source: Después de derrotar a una Unidad de Producción en Masa, la Firmeza actual de todos los enemigos se reduce en un 30%. De esta forma, es más fácil romper la Debilidad de los enemigos.
target: After defeating Mass-Production Machine, all enemies will have their current Toughness reduced by 30%, making it easier to Break other enemies.

source: Después de hacer el pedido, la cocina preparará los platos en orden. Puedes hacer el pedido con anticipación y se pueden guardar hasta 3 raciones de cada plato.
target: After ordering, the kitchen will prepare meals in sequential order. You can order in advance, and up to 3 portions of each dish can be stored

source: Después de interactuar con el resucitador, puedes usar fragmentos cósmicos para restablecer la RAM, revivir a los personajes derrotados y restaurar una cantidad determinada de sus PV.
target: After interacting with the Reviver, you can use Cosmic Fragments to reset RAM, revive downed characters, and restore a certain amount of HP to them.

source: Después de obtener el Certificado de analista de poder y comprar nuevos dados iridiscentes, puedes cambiar el dado iridiscente de las cartas de personaje.
target: After obtaining the "Power Analyst Certificate" and purchasing new Prismatic Dice, you can equip different Prismatic Dice for your character cards

source: Después de que Castorice use la técnica, puede infligir Mareo continuamente a los enemigos que se encuentren en el camino. Usa la técnica una vez más para atacar a los enemigos en el área e invocar al Dragón Caído y que entre en combate.
target: After Castorice uses her Technique, she can continually Daze enemies in her path. Using the Technique again will attack enemies in a radius and summon Netherwing to enter combat.

source: Después de que comience el día de exposición, de vez en cuando aparecerán eventos de visitante. Tras completarlos, avanzará el progreso del día de exposición.
target: After the Exhibition Day starts, Guest Occurrences will appear periodically. Completing Guest Occurrences will advance the Exhibition Day.

source: Después de que cualquier aliado realice acciones consecutivas, obtendrá una gran cantidad de valor de Coraje. Derrotar enemigos o bloquear las acciones de los enemigos sirve para que el personaje aliado continúe actuando.
target: After any ally performs consecutive actions, a large amount of Grit Value can be obtained. Defeating enemies or stopping enemy actions are all viable means to have allies continue to take action.

source: Después de que el enemigo actúe, los aliados lanzan inmediatamente sus habilidades definitivas contra él. El enemigo entonces realiza una acción adicional inmediatamente y recibe efectos de Daño con el tiempo.
target: After an enemy takes action, allies instantly use Ultimates to attack the enemy. The enemy then immediately takes action and receives a DoT effect.

source: Después de que el personaje en la segunda posición de tu equipo use la habilidad definitiva, el personaje en la primera posición carga energía y aumenta el daño que inflige en su siguiente ataque.
target: After the ally positioned second in the Team Lineup uses their Ultimate, regenerates Energy for the ally positioned first, and increases their next attack's DMG.

source: Después de que un aliado lance la habilidad definitiva o un ataque adicional, obtiene tantas acumulaciones de Luz estelar como número de enemigos golpeados, con lo que se incrementa el efecto de aumento de daño de todos los aliados.
target: After an ally character uses an Ultimate or launches a Follow-Up ATK, they gain corresponding "Starlight" stacks based on the number of targets hit, increasing the team's DMG boosting effect.

source: Después de que un aliado reciba un ataque, se reduce la cantidad y el límite máximo de pts. de habilidad básica.
target: After any ally unit is attacked, reduce the number of Skill Points and Max Skill Points.

source: Después de que un aliado rompa la Debilidad de este enemigo, su acción se adelanta un 50% y su efecto de Ruptura aumenta.
target: After an ally Breaks this enemy, the ally's action advances by 50% and Break Effect increases by 50%.

source: Después de que un aliado sea afectado con Miedo pertinaz, es posible disiparlo atacando una vez al lanzador de Miedo pertinaz.
target: When an ally is inflicted with Terror Grip, attacking the caster of Terror Grip once can dispel Terror Grip.

source: Después de que un aliado use la habilidad definitiva para atacar a un enemigo, este adelanta su acción un 100% y su ATQ se reduce. Además, le aplica diversos efectos de Daño con el tiempo.
target: After allies attack enemies with their Ultimates, enemy actions will be Advanced Forward by 100%, and they will deal less DMG and be inflicted with various DoT effects.

source: Después de que un personaje aliado lance la habilidad básica, recupera pts. de habilidad básica y aumenta el límite de pts. de habilidad básica. Además, aumenta el daño infligido.
target: After an ally character uses a Skill, they recover Skill Points, increase Max Skill Points, and increase DMG.

source: Después de que un personaje aliado sea liberado de una Piedra Espiritual, todos los aliados obtienen una acumulación de Tortura espiritual. Cada acumulación de Tortura espiritual puede aumentar las veces que inflige daño Azote espiritual.
target: After an ally is freed from the Soulstone, all allies obtain 1 stack of Spiritual Torture. Every stack of Spiritual Torture can apply more instances of DMG for Spiritual Caning.

source: Después de que una invocación ataque, consume Resonancia y realiza una acción inmediatamente.
target: After any summon attacked, consume "Resonance" and immediately take action.

source: Después de recolectar las ninfas de una zona, el Sastre comenzará a interpretar la profecía, lo cual podría revelar información desconocida y conducir a sorpresas inesperadas.
target: After collecting all the nymphs of an area, the Garmentmaker will begin deciphering the prophecy and may provide unexpected information to unknown surprises.

source: Después de superar todas las etapas de caballero, el rey quedará debilitado al perder sus guardias.
target: After clearing all Knight Stages, the King will be weakened without its guards.

source: Después de usar la guía, puedes rastrear en cualquier momento el equipamiento recomendado para los personajes sugeridos.
target: After applying Strategy, you can track the recommended character's equipment in the strategy anytime.

source: Después de ver por primera vez una carrera en el circuito avanzado, se desbloquea el canje de saltipastis. Allí podrás canjear tus saltipastis sobrantes por recompensas como aperitivo con truco y lágrima de los espíritus.
target: After watching your first match in the advanced arena, Snack Exchange will be unlocked, allowing you to exchange excess "Bounce-Bounce Snacks" for rewards such as Trick Snacks and Tears of Souls.

source: Destino entrelazado
target: Fate's Convergence

source: Destrua objetos destrutíveis e use Consumíveis especiais para recuperar Pontos de Técnica. Aumentar seu Nível de Equilíbrio aumentará o número de Pontos de Técnica disponíveis para você, até um máximo de 5.
target: Destroy destructible objects and use special Consumables to recover Technique Points. Increasing your Equilibrium Level will increase the number of Technique Points available to you, up to a maximum of 5.

source: Destruye objetos con la insignia de FelizAlma para cargar la barra de habilidad de Relotiempo.
target: Break items with the SoulGlad insignia to charge up the Clock Time ability bar.
