source: Du contenu de gameplay spécial est mis à jour chaque semaine dans le mode Calcul cyclique.
target: Special gameplay content will be updated weekly in Cyclical Extrapolations.

source: Du erhältst bei vollem Fortschritt 1 Gigantifizierung.
target: When the progress is full, gain 1 Gigantification

source: Du erhältst ein eigenes Zimmer im zweiten Stock des Partywagens des Astralexpresses, in dem du die Vitrine nutzen kannst.
target: The Trailblazer has their own room on the second floor of the Astral Express's Party Car, where they can use the Collection Showcase feature.

source: Du erhältst großzügige Belohnungen, wenn die Fortschrittsleiste voll ist.
target: Earn generous rewards when the progress bar is full

source: Du kannst Aideen-Marken verbrauchen, um alle möglichen Unterhaltungseinrichtungen auszuprobieren, mit geringer Chance auf wertvolle Belohnungen.
target: You can use Aideen Tokens to play various amusement facilities and have a small chance of winning valuable rewards.

source: Du kannst Uhrwerk bei jedem mit einer Clockie-Markierung anwenden. Probiere es aus so viel du willst, wenn du die Gelegenheit bekommst!
target: You can use Clockwork on anyone with a Clockie mark on their heads. When you get the chance, make sure to try it out as much as you need!

source: Du kannst all deine Kosmische Fragmente in der Region – Rast verbrauchen, um eine große Anzahl von Segen zu kaufen.
target: You can consume all your Cosmic Fragments within Domain — Respite to buy a great number of Blessings.

source: Du kannst auf deiner Reise viele lesbare Elemente erhalten. Lies sie dir durch, um mehr über das Leben der Leute und die Geschichte der verschiedenen Welten zu erfahren.
target: You may find lots of readable items on your journey. Do spend some time reading them to learn about people's lives and the lore in different worlds.

source: Du kannst bei jeder Synthese 1 von 3 Komponenten auswählen.
target: You can select 1 Component from 3 with every synthesis.

source: Du kannst bestimmte Blöcke zum Teleportieren benutzen. Wenn du auf einen solchen Block trittst, wirst du auf einen anderen derselben Farbe teleportiert. Sei vorsichtig, wenn du sie benutzt.
target: You can use certain blocks to teleport. When you tread on one such block, you will be teleported to another one of the same color. Be careful how you use them.

source: Du kannst dein Zimmer nach und nach ausschmücken, indem du es renovierst und individuell gestaltest.
target: You can gradually liven up your room by renovating and customizing it.

source: Du kannst den Laden für 2 Goldmünzen aktualisieren, um die darin erscheinenden Figuren zu ersetzen. Du kannst auch die Sperrfunktion nutzen, damit der Laden ab dem nächsten Knotenpunkt nicht mehr automatisch aktualisiert wird.
target: You can use 2 Gold Coins to refresh the Store and reset the Characters appearing within it. You can also use the Lock feature, which will prevent the Store from automatically refreshing at the start of the next Node.

source: Du kannst dich an die Momente erinnern, die du mit Dan Heng in Amphoreus verbracht hast, und sie in eine feste Anzahl von Erinnerungskristallsplittern verwandeln. Es wird zu Beginn jeder Woche aktualisiert.
target: You can recall the life you led with Dan Heng in Amphoreus and convert them into a fixed amount of Memory Crystal Shards. Refreshes at the beginning of each week.

source: Du kannst die Drehrichtung der Scheibe einstellen, wenn sie aktiviert ist.
target: When the plate is activated, you can set its rotation direction.

source: Du kannst die Freischaltbedingungen des aktuellen Ereignisses auf der Detailseite der gesperrten Ereignisse einsehen.
target: You can review the current event's unlock criteria on the locked event details page.

source: Du kannst die Schneeglanz-Lampen auf den Munitionskisten innerhalb des Spielbereichs anstoßen, um Lampen zu entzünden, die sich außerhalb des Wirkungsbereichs befinden, und das Herausforderungsziel abzuschließen.
target: You can push the Snowshine Lamps and place them atop the armory boxes within the gameplay area to ignite the other lamps that remain out of reach and complete the challenge goal

source: Du kannst die Stapelanzahl verringern, indem du Gegner angreifst und besiegst, um die Umwandlung zu vermeiden und den Effekt „Glück“ zu überwinden.
target: Attacking and defeating enemy targets can reduce stacks to avoid being converted and overcome the "Happiness" effect.

source: Du kannst die empfohlenen Sets, Hauptattribute und Nebenattribute für die aktuelle Figur einsehen. Die Daten zu Sets und Hauptattributen stammen aus den Statistiken kürzlich aktiver Spieler.
target: You can view the recommended Set, Main Stat, and Subsidiary Stats for the current character. The Set and Main Stat data are based on statistics from recently active players.

source: Du kannst die erfolgreichen Aufstellungen von Freunden bei Lichtwärts einsehen.
target: You can view your Friend Clearance Lineup in Treasures Lightward

source: Du kannst dir die aktuelle Punktzahl für jeden Pfad der Audienz im Audienzsaal ansehen. Jeder Pfad bringt unterschiedliche Buffs mit sich.
target: You can view the current Communing Trail points for each Path in the Audience Chamber. Every Path will bring different buffs

source: Du kannst dir hier jederzeit alle Zeitstempel deiner Erlebnisse in den Erinnerungen ansehen.
target: You can check all the timestamps of your experiences in the memories here at any time.

source: Du kannst dir in der Figurenkarte die empfohlene Ausrüstung für die Figur ansehen.
target: You can view the recommended equipment suitable for a character on the Character Card.

source: Du kannst direkt einen Bossgegner auswählen und herausfordern, um mit einem Sieg entsprechende Planarornamente zu erhalten.
target: You can select the boss enemy to challenge it directly and earn corresponding Planar Ornaments upon victory.

source: Du kannst in deinem eigenen Partywagen suchen oder mehr Schöpfungen fangen, indem du den Partywagen von Freunden oder Fremden besuchst.
target: You can search in your own Party Car, or catch more creations by visiting Friends' or Strangers' Party Cars.

source: Du kannst jede beliebige Gewichtete Kuriosität in einen Platz einsetzen. Nur eingesetzte Gewichtete Kuriositäten entfalten ihre Wirkung. Mit steigender Stufe der Region – Schmiede erhöht sich auch die Anzahl der verfügbaren Plätze.
target: You can select any Weighted Curio to equip in a slot. Only equipped Weighted Curios will take effect. As the Forge Domain level increases, the number of slots available will also increase.

source: Du kannst jederzeit zurück in den Standardmodus wechseln, um den regulären Schwierigkeitsgrad 4 von Phantom der Apokalypse herauszufordern und die ursprünglichen Belohnungen zu erhalten.
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Difficulty 4 of the regular Apocalyptic Shadow and obtain the original rewards.

source: Du kannst jederzeit zurück in den Standardmodus wechseln, um die reguläre Etappe 12 der Vergessenen Halle herauszufordern und die ursprünglichen Belohnungen zu erhalten.
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 12 of the regular Forgotten Hall and obtain the original rewards.

source: Du kannst jederzeit zurück in den Standardmodus wechseln, um die reguläre Etappe 4 von Reine Fiktion herauszufordern und die ursprünglichen Belohnungen zu erhalten.
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 4 of the regular Pure Fiction and obtain the original rewards.

source: Du kannst nach je 4 betretenen Regionen 1-mal einen Segen des goldenen Blutes auswählen.
target: You can select Golden Blood's Boons once for every 4 domains entered.

source: Du kannst nun die Dreharbeiten am brandneuen explosiven Actionfilm „Hanukrieg“ erleben. Du musst den supercoolen Hanu spielen und mit seiner unbesiegbaren Hanu-Rakete alle seine Gegner in die Luft jagen!
target: The brand-new gun-blazing action flick Hanu Wars is now available for visitors to experience. You need to play the ultra-cool Brother Hanu and use his invincible Hanu Rocket to blow all the enemies in your way to bits!

source: Du kannst während der Abendmeetings Baupläne und Dekorationen erhalten. Mit Bauplänen kannst du Dekoraufgaben in verschiedenen Bereichen freischalten. Dekorationen können in verschiedenen Bereichen im Zimmer platziert werden.
target: You can obtain Construction Blueprints and Decorations during Dinner Meeting. Construction Blueprints can unlock renovation projects in the area, and Decorations can be placed in different areas across the room based on your choice.

source: Du kannst zerbrochene Chronogefäße reparieren, indem du sie zurückspulst, und somit den Fluss der Zeit in der Umgebung wiederherstellen.
target: When facing a broken Chrono Vessel, rewinding it will fix the vessel and allow time to flow again in the surrounding area.

source: Du kannst zur nächsten Region neben der aktuellen Region bewegen. Die Regionen links von der aktuellen Region werden zusammenbrechen und können nicht betreten werden.
target: You can move to a domain adjacent to the current domain. At the same time, the domains to the left of the targeted domain will collapse and cannot be entered.

source: Du musst für jede Aufführung Inspiration des entsprechenden Musikstils sammeln. Bestehe die Musikherausforderung auf dem Schwierigkeitsgrad Leicht, um Inspiration zu erhalten.
target: Each performance needs to collect Inspiration of the corresponding music style. Pass the music challenge in Easy Mode to obtain inspiration

source: Du nouveau contenu pour le film La voie du loup a été ajouté. Vous allez directement affronter Boss Stone dans l'histoire.
target: The content for the Way of the Wolf film has been fully upgraded. You will directly face Boss Stone in the story

source: Du wirst gelegentlich verstreute Traumblasen in der Szene finden. Da sie nicht mit zugänglichen Plattformen verbunden sind, können diese Traumblasen keine Traumblasen-Brücken formen.
target: You will occasionally discover some scattered dream bubbles in the map. Due to them being unconnected to passable platforms, these dream bubbles cannot form Bubble Bridges.

source: Dua equipment dasar dapat di-synthesis menjadi satu equipment lanjutan. Tekan equipment dasar untuk melihat tabel synthesis.
target: Two basic equipment can be synthesized into one advanced equipment. Click on the basic equipment to view the synthesis chart.

source: Dua equipment dasar mana pun dapat di-Synthesis menjadi satu equipment lanjutan. Tekan equipment dasar untuk melihat tabel Synthesis.
target: Any two basic equipment can be synthesized into a piece of advanced equipment. Click on the basic equipment to view the synthesis chart.

source: Duel Hyperlink
target: Hyperlink Match

source: Durant l'entraînement, March peut avoir un éclair de génie, ce qui double le gain de stats lors de cette session.
target: During training, Epiphany Flare may be triggered, doubling the stats gain for that session.

source: Durant l'exploration d'Amphoreus, vous remarquerez des passages secrets avec deux apparences différentes. Interagissez avec pour entrer dans le passage secret de Janus et vous déplacer rapidement entre les deux passages.
target: During exploration in Amphoreus, Trailblazers will notice Hidden Passages with two different appearances. Interact with them to enter Janus' Hidden Passage and quickly traverse between different doors.

source: Durant l'épreuve avancée, toutes les indications seront désactivées. Agissez selon le rythme.
target: During the Advanced Trial, all hints will be disabled. Respond based on the rhythm.

source: Durant la Surconversion, vous devez réduire les PV des ennemis pour obtenir des données de conversion.
target: During Excessive Conversion, reduce the enemy's HP to obtain Conversion Data.

source: Durant la deuxième phase, Phaénon marque la cible ayant la DÉF la plus élevée. Coopérez avec Louve d'argent pour encaisser les dégâts à tour de rôle.
target: In the second phase, Phainon will mark the target with the highest DEF. Work with Silver Wolf to take turns soaking up the DMG.

source: Durant la phase d'échange, les dés que vous et votre coéquipier n'aurez pas sélectionnés seront placés dans la réserve d'échange. Vous pouvez faire glisser vos propres dés pour les échanger avec les dés de la réserve d'échange.
target: During the Swap Phase, dice not selected by you and your teammates will be placed in the Swap Pool. You can drag your own dice to swap them with dice in the Swap Pool.

source: Durant la phase de débrief, vous soumettrez des rapports de service et obtiendrez des fonds de l'Express en fonction du score attribué par Pom-Pom.
target: During the Dinner Meeting phase, you can select and submit Duty Reports to obtain Express Funds based on the score received from Pom-Pom.

source: Durant les défis, des objectifs de récompenses spéciaux peuvent apparaître. Frappez-les 2 fois pour les détruire et remporter des bizarreries, des fragments cosmiques, des bénédictions et d'autres récompenses bonus.
target: During challenges, there is a chance for special reward targets to appear. Striking them 2 times will break and grant Curios, Cosmic Fragments, Blessings, and other bonus rewards.

source: Durant un combat dans l'Univers simulé, consommer de l'énergie peut déclencher Résonance de la Voie, qui vous accordera un bonus en combat.
target: During combat in the Simulated Universe, actively consuming Energy might lead to Path Resonance, which will earn you a buff in combat.

source: Durante "Instantes Aha", Perícias da Euforia só podem atacar inimigos-alvo no subcampo.
target: During Aha Instants, Elation Skills can only attack enemy targets on the sub-field.

source: Durante Coraje fase 4: El despertar del poder, cada vez que los PV aumenten o disminuyan en 1500, puedes obtener 1 acumulación de bonificaciones, hasta un máximo de 99.
target: During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," every 1500 of HP increase or decrease grants 1 stack of buffs, up to 99 stacks.

source: Durante a "Fase de Bravura 4: Poder Desperto", a cada 1.500 de PV, concede ou diminui 1 acúmulo de melhorias, com um máximo de 99 acúmulos.
target: During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," every 1500 of HP increase or decrease grants 1 stack of buffs, up to 99 stacks.

source: Durante a Conversão Excessiva, reduz os PV do inimigo para obter Dados de Conversão.
target: During Excessive Conversion, reduce the enemy's HP to obtain Conversion Data.

source: Durante a Fase de Troca, os dados não selecionados por você e seu companheiro de equipe serão colocados na Reserva de Troca. Você pode arrastar seus próprios dados para trocá-los com os dados na Reserva de Troca.
target: During the Swap Phase, dice not selected by you and your teammates will be placed in the Swap Pool. You can drag your own dice to swap them with dice in the Swap Pool.

source: Durante a exploração dos Planos Ordinários, lojas nos "Domínio - Trégua" serão todas Lojas Especiais que providenciam diferentes funções de loja.
target: During exploration of Ordinary Planes, stores in "Domain — Respite" are all Special Stores that provide different store functions.

source: Durante a exploração em Amphoreus, os Desbravadores notarão Passagens Ocultas com duas aparências diferentes. Interaja com elas para entrar na Passagem Oculta de Janus e viajar rapidamente entre diferentes portas.
target: During exploration in Amphoreus, Trailblazers will notice Hidden Passages with two different appearances. Interact with them to enter Janus' Hidden Passage and quickly traverse between different doors.

source: Durante a exploração, usar a Técnica de Acheron para atacar inimigos normais irá derrotá-los instantaneamente sem entrar em combate. Caso nenhum inimigo seja atingido, nenhum Ponto de Técnica será consumido.
target: During exploration, using Acheron's Technique to hit normal enemies will instantly defeat them without entering combat. When the Technique does not hit an enemy, no Technique Points are consumed.

source: Durante a fase Reunião do Jantar, você pode selecionar e enviar Relatórios de Serviço para obter Fundos do Expresso com base na pontuação recebida por Pom-Pom.
target: During the Dinner Meeting phase, you can select and submit Duty Reports to obtain Express Funds based on the score received from Pom-Pom.

source: Durante a luta contra o Chefe no Terceiro Plano, ocorrerá Extrapolação de Ressonância. As Extrapolações de Ressonância simularão tipos diferentes de Ressonância do Caminho e terão um impacto sério em todos os aliados.
target: During the boss fight in the Third Plane, Resonance Extrapolation will occur. Resonance Extrapolations will simulate different types of Path Resonance and have a serious impact on all allies.

source: Durante a partida, os jogadores podem usar itens da arena para influenciar o jogo. Após usar qualquer item, todos os itens entrarão em tempo de recarga.
target: During the match, players can use arena items to influence the game. After using any item, all items will enter cooldown.

source: Durante desafios posteriores, você pode selecionar efeitos de Ressonância do Caminho simulados pela Extrapolação de Ressonância do domínio de Chefe no Segundo Plano.
target: During later challenges, you can select Path Resonance effects as simulated by Resonance Extrapolation from the boss domain in the Second Plane.

source: Durante el Momento Aha, las habilidades de Exultación solo pueden atacar a los enemigos del campo secundario.
target: During Aha Instants, Elation Skills can only attack enemy targets on the sub-field.

source: Durante el Torneo de la Calle Comercial de Manamar, el formato de Fuerza Cósmica será de 2 contra 1. ¡Colabora con Silver Wolf para derrotar al enemigo poderoso!
target: In this Seafeld City "Commerce Street Showdown," the "Cosmicon Collective" will fight in a 2v1 format. Work together with Silver Wolf to defeat formidable foes!

source: Durante el combate en el Universo Simulado, el consumo activo de energía puede activar la Resonancia de Vía, lo que te hará ganar bonificaciones de combate.
target: During combat in the Simulated Universe, actively consuming Energy might lead to Path Resonance, which will earn you a buff in combat.

source: Durante el combate te encontrarás con enemigos de distintos niveles. Cuanto mayor sea el nivel, más poderosos serán.
target: In combat, you'll encounter enemies of different levels. The higher the level, the tougher they are.

source: Durante el combate, algunos personajes que cumplan los requisitos lanzarán automáticamente 1 ataque extra denominado ataque adicional. El contraataque también pertenece a la categoría de ataque adicional.
target: During combat, some characters will automatically trigger an additional attack, known as Follow-Up ATK, when certain conditions are met. Counters are also considered a type of Follow-Up ATK.

source: Durante el combate, algunos personajes que cumplan los requisitos obtendrán un turno adicional que no se resta de la cantidad de turnos. Durante este turno adicional no se puede usar la habilidad definitiva.
target: During combat, some characters will receive an extra turn when certain conditions are met. This extra turn does not consume any turn counts, and Ultimates cannot be used during this extra turn.

source: Durante el combate, se mostrará la oleada actual y la cantidad de enemigos derrotados en la oleada actual.
target: The current wave of enemies and the number of enemies defeated in the current wave will be displayed during battle.

source: Durante el desafío de Conversión excesiva, reduce los PV del enemigo para obtener datos de conversión.
target: During Excessive Conversion, reduce the enemy's HP to obtain Conversion Data.

source: Durante el desafío, hay una posibilidad de que aparezcan dianas con recompensas especiales. Tras golpearlas 2 veces, se romperán y podrás obtener objetos raros, fragmentos cósmicos, bendiciones y otras recompensas adicionales.
target: During challenges, there is a chance for special reward targets to appear. Striking them 2 times will break and grant Curios, Cosmic Fragments, Blessings, and other bonus rewards.

source: Durante el entrenamiento onírico, no puedes obtener Bullicio al actuar. Solo puedes obtener Bullicio al lograr momentos destacados y entrar en el estado de Motivación potenciada.
target: While in Dreamscape Training, you are unable to obtain Vibes through actions. Only by performing Highlights can you gain Vibes and enter the "Super Hype" state.

source: Durante el entrenamiento, Siete de Marzo puede obtener la ayuda de sus compañeros, lo que aumenta la eficiencia del entrenamiento y los Recorridos.
target: During sword training, March 7th can receive assistance from companions, enhancing the efficiency of her Training and Excursions.

source: Durante el entrenamiento, puede ocurrir una chispa de inspiración, que duplica el efecto de aumento de atributos de este entrenamiento.
target: During training, Epiphany Flare may be triggered, doubling the stats gain for that session.

source: Durante el evento Juego cazaestrellas, completa Sector cerrado en los niveles de dificultad designados para obtener recompensas adicionales.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete Sealed Sectors at designated difficulties to receive extra rewards.

source: Durante el evento Juego cazaestrellas, completa el Desafío de la máquina recreativa para obtener Siempre sonriente y canjearlo por materiales de superposición y otras recompensas en la tienda del evento.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete the Arcade Challenge to receive Always Smiling, which is used to exchange for rewards such as Superimposition materials in the event shop.

source: Durante el evento Juego cazaestrellas, completa la misión de acompañante «Mentalidad de Punklorde» en Modo de historia y podrás obtener grafitis y activar las marcas de grafitis.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete the Companion Mission Punklorde Mentality in Story Mode to receive graffitis, and activate graffiti markers.

source: Durante el evento «Canal Susto», 5 pantallas de televisión han sido hackeadas. Encuentra las pantallas y entra en combate para derrotar al responsable.
target: In the Dreamjolt TV event, a total of 5 TV screens have been hacked. Locate the screens and fight the culprits to foil the mastermind's plan.

source: Durante el vuelo, la robogrulla puede ascender y descender.
target: While flying a cycrane, you can control it to ascend or descend.

source: Durante el vuelo, la robogrulla puede ascender y descender.
target: While in control of a cycrane, you can control it to ascend or descend.

source: Durante el vuelo, la robogrulla puede ascender y descender.
target: While in control of a cycrane, you have the option to either ascend or descend as desired.

source: Durante el vuelo, puedes abrir el mapa para ver los puntos de navegación.
target: During flight, you can open the map to check your waypoints.

source: Durante essa missão, mais condições precisam ser preenchidas para concluir a tarefa de fotografia.
target: During this mission, more conditions need to be met to complete the photoshoot.

source: Durante esta fase no dejará de perseguirnos. ¡Concéntrate y derrótalo!
target: He will constantly chase after us in the current phase. Focus on defeating him first!

source: Durante esta misión, necesitarás cumplir con más requisitos para completar la misión de fotografía.
target: During this mission, more conditions need to be met to complete the photoshoot.

source: Durante este evento, puedes controlar a un personaje específico para que sea el Mago y luche junto a Poni de basura. Atención: en cada etapa solo puedes usar compañeros mágicos preconfigurados para luchar.
target: In this event, you can control the designated character as a Magician and fight alongside Litter Pony. Attention: You can only use the designated magical teammates to fight in each stage.

source: Durante la batalla, derrota al Chanchito para obtener una puntuación más alta.
target: Defeating a Trotter during battle will award even higher points.

source: Durante la capacitación del personal, puedes contratar más hadas empleadas.
target: During staff training, you can recruit more fairy staff members

source: Durante la carrera, puedes usar objetos del circuito para influir en la competencia. Después de usar cualquier objeto, todos los objetos comienzan un tiempo de espera.
target: During the match, players can use arena items to influence the game. After using any item, all items will enter cooldown.

source: Durante la clasificación de recuerdos, los fragmentos borrosos de información que recuerdes serán grabados y actualizados al instante para ayudarte a reconstruir todos los hechos.
target: Memory Sorting will record and update in real-time the vague information you recall as you explore your memories, helping you to reconstruct events.

source: Durante la exploración de los planos normales, las tiendas de las zonas de reposo serán tiendas especiales que ofrecen distintas funciones.
target: During exploration of Ordinary Planes, stores in "Domain — Respite" are all Special Stores that provide different store functions.

source: Durante la exploración, a veces podrás descubrir polvo dorado de memoria, que indica que el objetivo está en este lugar pero en otro espacio-tiempo.
target: You may discover Golden Memory Dust when exploring, indicating that the target is located here in the other space-time.

source: Durante la exploración, encontrarás todo tipo de modos de juego. Estos modos se registrarán en Memorias convencionales para que puedas acceder a ellos y revisarlos rápidamente.
target: You will encounter different kinds of gameplay as you explore. These gameplays will be recorded in Conventional Memoir for faster review and access.

source: Durante la exploración, la técnica de Acheron derrotará instantáneamente a los enemigos normales al golpearlos, sin necesidad de entrar en combate. Si no se acierta a un enemigo, no se consume el punto de técnica.
target: During exploration, using Acheron's Technique to hit normal enemies will instantly defeat them without entering combat. When the Technique does not hit an enemy, no Technique Points are consumed.

source: Durante la fase de intercambio, los dados que no hayan sido seleccionados por ti y tu compañero de equipo se colocarán en la zona de intercambio. Puedes arrastrar tus dados para intercambiarlos por los dados de la zona de intercambio.
target: During the Swap Phase, dice not selected by you and your teammates will be placed in the Swap Pool. You can drag your own dice to swap them with dice in the Swap Pool.

source: Durante la partida, el sistema de guías recomendará automáticamente las estrategias adecuadas según la formación de personajes que tengas. Utiliza la función de Usar guía para encontrar rápidamente los personajes recomendados en la tienda.
target: During the match, the strategy system will automatically recommend suitable strategies based on the character lineups you have unlocked. Use the Apply Strategy feature to quickly find the characters recommended by the strategy in the Store!

source: Durante o Teste Avançado, todas as dicas serão desabilitadas. Responda apenas com base no ritmo.
target: During the Advanced Trial, all hints will be disabled. Respond based on the rhythm.

source: Durante o Treinamento da Espada, 7 de Março pode receber ajuda de seus companheiros, aprimorando a eficiência de seu Treinamento e Excursões.
target: During sword training, March 7th can receive assistance from companions, enhancing the efficiency of her Training and Excursions.

source: Durante o combate no Universo Simulado, consumir Energia ativamente pode levar à Ressonância do Caminho, que concederá uma melhoria na batalha.
target: During combat in the Simulated Universe, actively consuming Energy might lead to Path Resonance, which will earn you a buff in combat.

source: Durante o combate, alguns personagens ativarão automaticamente um ataque adicional, conhecido como Ataque Extra, quando certas condições forem atendidas. Contra-Ataques também são considerados um tipo de Ataque Extra.
target: During combat, some characters will automatically trigger an additional attack, known as Follow-Up ATK, when certain conditions are met. Counters are also considered a type of Follow-Up ATK.

source: Durante o combate, alguns personagens receberão uma rodada extra quando certas condições forem atendidas. Essa rodada extra não consome nenhuma contagem de rodadas, e Perícias Supremas não podem ser utilizadas durante essa rodada extra.
target: During combat, some characters will receive an extra turn when certain conditions are met. This extra turn does not consume any turn counts, and Ultimates cannot be used during this extra turn.

source: Durante o combate, os Cofrinhos podem se perder e, acidentalmente, entrar na batalha. Derrote o Cofrinho perdido antes que ele fuja para obter recompensas bônus dos outros inimigos.
target: During battle, Trotters might accidentally enter the battle as a result of being lost. Defeat the Trotter before they run away to obtain bonus rewards dropped from other enemies.

source: Durante o evento Jogo Caça-Estelar, conclua Setores Trancados nas dificuldades designadas para receber recompensas extras.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete Sealed Sectors at designated difficulties to receive extra rewards.

source: Durante o evento Jogo Caça-Estelar, conclua a Missão de Companheiro Mentalidade de Punklorde no Modo História para receber grafites e ativar os marcadores de grafite.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete the Companion Mission Punklorde Mentality in Story Mode to receive graffitis, and activate graffiti markers.

source: Durante o evento Jogo Caça-Estelar, conclua o Desafio Arcade para receber Sempre Sorrindo, item usado na Loja do evento para trocar por recompensas, como materiais de Sobreposição.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete the Arcade Challenge to receive Always Smiling, which is used to exchange for rewards such as Superimposition materials in the event shop.

source: Durante o processo de negociação, se a moral de qualquer equipe chegar a 0, a negociação será imediatamente encerrada.
target: During the negotiation process, if either party's morale drops to zero, the negotiation immediately ends.

source: Durante o retrocesso de um objeto, esse objeto não será afetado pelo campo de tempo parado.
target: While rewinding an object, that object will not be affected by the time-stopped zone.

source: Durante o treinamento da equipe, você pode recrutar mais fadas para serem membros da equipe
target: During staff training, you can recruit more fairy staff members

source: Durante o treinamento, uma Fagulha de Inspiração pode ser ativada, dobrando o ganho de atributos para aquela sessão.
target: During training, Epiphany Flare may be triggered, doubling the stats gain for that session.

source: Durante o voo, você pode abrir o mapa para verificar seus pontos de rota.
target: During flight, you can open the map to check your waypoints.

source: Durante os desafios, há uma chance de alvos com recompensas especiais aparecerem. Atacá-los 2 vezes fará com que eles quebrem e concederá Curios, Fragmentos Cósmicos, Bênçãos e outras recompensas bônus.
target: During challenges, there is a chance for special reward targets to appear. Striking them 2 times will break and grant Curios, Cosmic Fragments, Blessings, and other bonus rewards.

source: Durante suas aventuras, você encontrará inimigos com múltiplas Fraquezas. Entrar na batalha usando ataques que combinem com essas Fraquezas pode reduzir a Tenacidade de inimigos que possuam essas Fraquezas.
target: During your adventures, you will encounter enemies with multiple Weaknesses. Entering combat using attacks that match these Weaknesses can reduce the Toughness of enemies who have these Weaknesses.

source: Durante tu exploración te encontrarás con enemigos muy poderosos. ¡Derrótalos para obtener valiosas recompensas!
target: While exploring, you may encounter powerful enemies. Defeat them to win bountiful rewards.

source: Durante tu turno de negociación, puedes usar estrategias de negociación para desplegar diferentes tácticas de negociación que te ayuden a tener éxito.
target: During your negotiation turn, you can use "Negotiation Strategies" to apply various negotiation techniques to help you succeed.

source: Durante tu viaje encontrarás muchos materiales de lectura. Léelos detenidamente para entender el modo de vida de la gente y las muchas historias que han ocurrido aquí...
target: You may find lots of readable items on your journey. Do spend some time reading them to learn about people's lives and the lore in different worlds.

source: Durante tus aventuras encontrarás enemigos que normalmente poseen varios tipos de Debilidad. Entra en combate usando ataques del mismo tipo que la Debilidad del enemigo para reducir la Firmeza de los objetivos enemigos a esa Debilidad.
target: During your adventures, you will encounter enemies with multiple Weaknesses. Entering combat using attacks that match these Weaknesses can reduce the Toughness of enemies who have these Weaknesses.

source: Durante tus aventuras encontrarás toda clase de enemigos. Cada uno de ellos tiene una Debilidad de la que puedes aprovecharte utilizando un ataque de ese mismo tipo para reducir su Firmeza.
target: You will encounter all kinds of enemies during your adventure. Each of them has Weaknesses that can be exploited to reduce their Toughness by using attacks of the same Type.

source: Durante tus aventuras, conocerás a nuevos compañeros. Completa ciertas misiones y podrás invitarlos a subir al Expreso Astral.
target: Completing certain missions allows you to invite companions that you meet in your journey onto the Astral Express.

source: Durch Ansammeln von Kampfgeist kannst du die Kampfgeistphase hochstufen. Wenn du in Kampfgeistphase 4: Macht erwacht eintrittst, erhältst du mächtige Etappen-Buffs, sodass deine Kampfeffizienz deutlich gesteigert wird.
target: Accumulating Grit Value during battle can elevate your Grit Phase. When entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken", you can obtain powerful stage buffs and significantly improve your combat effectiveness.

source: Durch Befragung, um mögliche verborgene Details hinter den gegebenen Aussagen zu entdecken.
target: Use questions to discover possible details hiding behind given statements.

source: Durch Bremszonen wird deine Geschwindigkeit verringert.
target: Hitting the Deceleration Zones decreases your Speed.

source: Durch Namenlose Rückerinnerung können die Geschichten der Helden in „Wie ich es schrieb“ festgehalten werden.
target: Using "Nameless Recollection," heroes' stories can be written down in "As I've Written."

source: Durch Training können die Attribute von 7. März verbessert werden. Nach einer bestimmten Menge Training wird dessen Effektivität erhöht.
target: Through training, March 7th can improve her stats. With each type of training, its effectiveness increases after a certain level of progress.

source: Durch Verbrauch von Ausdauer kannst du die erleuchteten Bereiche erkunden.
target: By consuming Stamina, you can explore the illuminated areas.

source: Durch das Auslösen von Extremüberholung und das Einsammeln von Versorgungsgegenständen kann Energie aufgeladen werden. Wenn die Energie voll ist, trittst du in den Status Nuss-Sprint ein und bist für eine lange Zeit unbesiegbar.
target: Energy can be accumulated by triggering Turbo Dash and picking up supplies. When energy is full, you will enter Nutty Blitz and experience a long period of invulnerability.

source: Durch das Beseitigen von Erinnerungslücken können relevante verschwommene Erinnerungen geweckt werden.
target: Using Cognition Chasm has a chance of restoring relevant hazy memories.

source: Durch das Dekorieren erhöhst du den Dekorfortschritt des Zimmers und steigerst deine Dekor-Bewertung. Dadurch erhältst du einen Dekorzuschuss.
target: Completing renovations to increase the renovation progress of the room and raise your Décor Rating. This will earn you Renovation Subsidy.

source: Durch das Verwenden von Umdenken kannst du ausgewählte Berichte verwerfen und die gleiche Anzahl neuer Berichte ziehen. Bitte beachte dabei, dass die Anzahl der Berichte jedes Teammitglieds begrenzt ist.
target: Using "Mental Reset", you can discard selected reports and draw the same number of new ones. Please note that each team member has a limit on the total number of reports.

source: Durch die Funktion „Dekor-Anpassung“ im Zimmer kannst du verschiedene Möbel, die du während des Abenteuers erhältst, platzieren.
target: Use the "Décor Customization" feature in your room to place various furniture items obtained during your adventures.

source: Durch die Interaktion mit dem Steuergerät kann das Traummodul auf der vorgesehenen Spur bewegt werden. Beim Bewegen von Traummodulen bewegen sich auch die verstreuten Traumblasen auf ihren Oberflächen.
target: By interacting with Control Panels, the Dream Module can be moved along the designated trajectory. When moving the Dream Module, the scattered dream bubbles on its surface will also move with it.

source: Durch die Tasten auf beiden Seiten kann die momentane Stimmung harmonisiert werden!
target: The current Emotion can be tuned via the buttons on the two sides!

source: Durch die Verwendung des Trugbild-Echos können Gegner im Tarnmodus früher entdeckt werden. Diese Fähigkeit hat eine Abklingzeit.
target: Using Mirage Echolocation can detect enemies in stealth mode in advance. There is a cooldown time after the ability is used.

source: Durch manuelle Bedienung können nur geringfügige Änderungen an der Position der Frachtcontainer auf dem Montageband vorgenommen werden. Die Leuchten auf dem Bedienfeld zeigen an, welche Änderungen möglich sind.
target: Manual operation can only make minor adjustments to the freight containers on the assembly line. The lights on the control panel indicate the range of the adjustments that can be performed.

source: Durch verschiedene Kombinationen von Graffitis kannst du interessante Bilder sprühen. Mit Rückgängig und Alle löschen kannst du noch einfacher sprühen.
target: Switch graffiti combos to spray interesting images — Use Undo and Erase All to spray with more convenience.

source: Dádiva da Pressa Divina de Prome
target: Gift of the Godspeed Prome

source: Déblocage rapide
target: Quick Unlock

source: Débloquez la compétence Autonomie pour plus de membres du personnel afin de réduire la pression d'exécution du service !
target: Unlock the Automate skill for more staff members to reduce operational pressure!

source: Déclencher l'effet Départ résolu augmente le rang du bonus de niveau. À mesure que le rang du bonus de niveau augmente, sa note s'améliore.
target: After triggering "Solved Departure," you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: Déclencher l'effet Folle absorption augmente le rang du bonus de niveau. À mesure que le rang du bonus de niveau augmente, sa note s'améliore.
target: After triggering "Frenzied Absorption," you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: Déclenchez des Scènes d'action et récupérez des ravitaillements pour accumuler de l'énergie. Une fois la jauge pleine, vous activez le Moment de Hanu et bénéficiez d'une longue période d'invulnérabilité.
target: Energy can be accumulated by conducting Action Scenes and picking up supplies. When energy is full, you will trigger Hanu Time and enter a long period of invulnerability.

source: Déclenchez des Turbo accélérations et récupérez des ravitaillements pour accumuler de l'énergie. Une fois la jauge pleine, vous entrez en Dragster hamster et bénéficiez d'une longue période d'invulnérabilité.
target: Energy can be accumulated by triggering Turbo Dash and picking up supplies. When energy is full, you will enter Nutty Blitz and experience a long period of invulnerability.

target: Arcade Challenge: Hidden Codes

target: Challenging Echo of War or experiencing the Simulated Universe or the Forgotten Hall are all great ways to increase Trailblaze Level.

target: DoT

target: Overflowing Wounds: Gameplay Details

target: Spend Clock Credits to raise the Statue's level and gain rewards.

source: Déplacez les terminaux de base au sol et alignez les motifs en forme d'étoile de la matrice avec le motif affiché pour résoudre l'énigme.
target: Move the base terminals on the ground and align the matrix's star patterns with the displayed pattern to complete the puzzle.

source: Déployer plus de personnages avec la même synergie augmentera le niveau de synergie. Plus le niveau de synergie est élevé, plus l'effet est puissant.
target: Deploying more characters with the same Bond will increase the Bond Level. The higher the Bond Level, the stronger the effect.

target: Swarm Disaster: Beacons

target: Home-Use Object Finder

source: Détruisez des objets dans l'Univers simulé pour obtenir un nombre aléatoire de fragments cosmiques, restaurer des PV, ou récupérer des points de technique.
target: Break objects in the Simulated Universe to gain a random number of Cosmic Fragments, restore HP, or recover Technique Points.

source: Détruisez des objets floqués de l'insigne Félicitâme pour charger la barre du Moment Chrono.
target: Break items with the SoulGlad insignia to charge up the Clock Time ability bar.

source: Dù hiện tại đang ở thời không nào, ánh sáng của viên ngọc cũng sẽ duy trì đảo ngược ra một thời không khác.
target: No matter which space-time you're currently in, the orb's light will continuously reveal the other space-time.

source: Dùng "Hồi Ức Vô Danh", có thể viết nên câu chuyện của các anh hùng trong "Như Tôi Đã Viết"
target: Using "Nameless Recollection," heroes' stories can be written down in "As I've Written."

source: Dùng Hỏa Tiễn Thần Kỳ được tạo ra bởi những chú Chim Giấy, Người Anh Em Hanu có thể di chuyển nhanh đến hai đầu hỏa tiễn khác nhau, đi đến những nơi không thể đến.
target: Using the fantastic rockets built by the Origami Bird, Hanu can quickly shift between the ends of different rockets to reach places otherwise inaccessible.

source: Dùng Máy Hát có thể thay đổi âm nhạc trong toa tàu. Khám phá thế giới để nhận Đĩa Hát mới, và mở khóa thêm nhiều ca khúc.
target: Use the Phonograph to change the music when on the Express. By exploring various worlds, you can obtain new records to unlock new tracks.

source: Dùng Nhãn Dán trang trí trang sổ tay để tăng độ hoàn thành của trang tương ứng
target: Use your stickers collection to decorate your scrapbook and boost its completion progress.

source: Dùng Phiếu Nhiên Liệu có thể thu thập nhanh nguyên liệu bồi dưỡng rơi từ Đài Hoa Nhân Tạo/Hư Ảnh Ngưng Đọng.
target: Using a Fuel Voucher lets you quickly farm upgrade materials from Calyx / Stagnant Shadows.

source: Dùng Thiết Bị Bắn bắn năng lượng Tuế Dương, xoay Thiết Bị Tiếp Nối để thay đổi hướng truyền dẫn của năng lượng Tuế Dương.
target: Rotate receiver nodes to adjust heliobus energy's conduction direction. Then activate the trigger node to release heliobus energy along the conduction direction.

source: Dùng Thiết Bị Tải có thể tăng thêm nhân vật mới trong lần khám phá này. Mỗi Thiết Bị Tải chỉ được thêm 1 nhân vật, nhớ chọn cẩn thận nhé!
target: New characters can be added to the current exploration by using the Downloader. One Downloader can only add one character, so please make it count.

source: Dùng Tiếng Vọng Thần Ảnh có thể phát hiện kẻ địch ở trạng thái Tàng Hình, sau khi dùng sức mạnh sẽ có thời gian chờ.
target: Using Mirage Echolocation can detect enemies in stealth mode in advance. There is a cooldown time after the ability is used.

source: Dùng Tiền Đồng Hồ Vàng tăng cấp tượng, và nhận thưởng.
target: Spend Clock Credits to raise the Statue's level and gain rewards.

source: Dùng Vật Tiêu Hao để giúp Nhà Khai Phá đối phó các mối nguy gặp phải trong khi khám phá một cách dễ dàng hơn.
target: Use Consumables can help the Trailblazer better deal with all kinds of danger they might come across in the journey.

source: Dùng Xu Vàng mua EXP tăng cấp, có thể tăng quy mô đội, ra trận thêm nhiều nhân vật! Cấp càng cao, Cửa Hàng càng dễ làm mới ra nhân vật COST cao.
target: Spend Gold Coins to buy Experience and level up, increasing your team size to deploy more characters! The higher your level, the more likely you are to find high-cost characters in the Store.

source: Dùng cần điều khiển bên phải có thể xoay góc nhìn để quan sát. Dùng cần điều khiển bên trái có thể di chuyển khung cảnh và quan sát. Nhấn nút đặt lại ở góc dưới bên phải có thể đặt lại góc nhìn.
target: Use the right joystick to rotate the camera. Use the left joystick to move the screen. Press the reset button in the bottom right corner to reset your camera.

source: Dùng cần điều khiển bên trái khống chế di chuyển, dùng nút bên phải để di chuyển lên xuống. Nhấn nút thoát có thể kết thúc điều khiển. Tay Của Zagreus sẽ ở yên tại chỗ.
target: Use the left joystick to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Dùng cầu thang để di chuyển lên xuống, tất cả độ dài đều chỉ cần một bước.
target: Use the ladder to move up or down. You only need to take one step for each ladder, regardless of their length.

source: Dùng kỹ năng Bùng Nổ Khí Nitơ có thể tăng cao tốc độ
target: Use the Nitrous Burst ability to greatly increase your speed

source: Dùng kỹ năng sát thương nhóm tấn công kẻ địch. Sau khi tiêu diệt kẻ địch không phải Thủ Lĩnh sẽ dựa theo Sát Thương Vượt Mức gây ra ở lần tấn công này, để gây sát thương bội số cao lên Thủ Lĩnh Phe Địch.
target: Use AoE abilities to attack enemies. After defeating a non-boss enemy, deals DMG with huge multipliers to the boss based on the Overflow DMG dealt in this attack.

source: Dùng những năng lực này có thể nhận điểm và phần thưởng tương ứng trong Truyền Kỳ Kim Cổ, phân đoạn của Câu Chuyện Hiệp Khách Khai Phá cũng được mở khóa dần.
target: Using these abilities can earn you points and rewards in Legends Past and Present, and will also gradually unlock Legend of the Trailblazer sections.

source: Dùng nút "Chọn" để chọn vòng và nút "Xoay" để xoay các vòng. Khi tuyến đường được kết nối, la bàn sẽ hiển thị nhắc nhở, lúc này có thể nhấn nút "Xác Nhận Tuyến Đường" để xác định tuyến đường.
target: Use the Select button to choose a specific ring, and use the Rotate button to turn it. When a route has been connected, a hint will appear on the compass. Tap the Confirm Route button to finalize your route.

source: Dùng nút điều hướng khống chế di chuyển, dùng nút bên phải để di chuyển lên xuống. Nhấn nút thoát có thể kết thúc điều khiển. Tay Của Zagreus sẽ ở yên tại chỗ.
target: Use the directional keys to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Dùng thiết bị truyền dẫn Năng Lượng của Sở Công Nghiệp, khiến tất cả Gốc Rễ Cây Kiến Tạo bị phá hủy, sẽ có thể diệt trừ nhánh Cây Kiến Tạo cản lối.
target: Ambrosial Arbor's branches can be found blocking the path. Use the Artisanship Commission's energy conduction device to destroy all the entangled Ambrosial Arbor's coils at the same time.

source: Dùng thánh hỏa trong tay thắp sáng tế đàn, để thế giới có được ánh sáng!
target: Use the holy flame in hand to light up the altar and bring light to this world!

source: Dùng tính năng Tăng Tốc x2 có thể trải nghiệm trận đấu với nhịp điệu nhanh hơn, nhưng trong một số trận đặc biệt sẽ tạm tắt tính năng Tăng Tốc x2.
target: Use 2× speed to experience quicker battles. However, 2× speed will be temporarily turned off in some special combat situations.

source: Dùng tính năng tự động chiến đấu có thể tự động thi triển kỹ năng để chiến đấu, nhưng trong một số trận đặc biệt sẽ không thể dùng tính năng tự động chiến đấu.
target: Use auto-battle to cast abilities and fight automatically. However, auto-battle cannot be used in some special combat situations.

source: Dư Âm Chiến Đấu
target: Echo of War

source: Dư âm của "Trật Tự" sau khi bị bóp méo sẽ chỉ gây thêm hỗn loạn. Và với tư cách là một thầy chỉnh âm, Sunday có thể dễ dàng phân biệt được nơi nào đã làm nhiễu loạn sự hài hòa của Cõi Mộng.
target: The Afterechoes of Order, once distorted, only add to the chaos. As a tuner, Sunday can easily discern where the harmony of Dreamscapes has been disrupted.

source: Dưới góc nhìn của Kiến Trúc Sư Xây Mộng, khu vực hoạt động của nhân vật sẽ bị hạn chế. Chỉ sau khi thoát khỏi Đôi Mắt Xây Mộng, nhân vật mới có thể di chuyển ra khỏi ranh giới màn hình.
target: In the Dreamweaver's View, your character's movement is limited within the screen boundaries. To move beyond these boundaries, you need to deactivate the Dream's Eye.

target: Optical Marking

source: Dấu tích quang học là ký hiệu mà Hội Trí Thức dùng để trao đổi tri thức ngầm. Ghép các ký hiệu lại cho hoàn chỉnh ở góc độ nhất định, sẽ có thể nhận bản khắc quang học hoàn chỉnh.
target: Optical markings are used by the Intelligentsia Guild to discreetly exchange knowledge. At a certain angle, the markings will be pieced together to show the complete optical rubbing.

source: Dốc: Tạo Vật rơi trên dốc sẽ trượt xuống dọc theo chiều dốc
target: Slope: Creations that land on the Slope will slide down the decline.

source: Dừng lại trên ô nào sẽ kích hoạt hiệu ứng của ô đó, khi chọn Thẻ Hành Động hãy cố gắng dừng lại ở ô có lợi.
target: An effect will be triggered based on the tile you stop on. When selecting Action Cards, do your best to end up on advantageous tiles.

source: Dựa theo chỉ dẫn tìm lại các mảnh ghép phân tán trong cảnh sẽ có thể hoàn thành tranh ghép.
target: Follow the instructions to retrieve the scattered pieces and complete the puzzle.

source: Dựa theo lời nói tương ứng, đưa ra bằng chứng chính xác để đánh bại đối phương
target: Present evidence in accordance with what the opposition is saying to refute their arguments

source: Dựa theo yêu cầu tính năng khác nhau, phun vẽ Graffiti trong khu vực chỉ định.
target: Please spray graffiti in the target area in accordance with the different requirements.

source: Dựa vào điểm giao nhau giữa các hướng của chùm sáng hướng dẫn, sẽ có thể tìm thấy vị trí thăm dò, đến vị trí này dùng lại Máy Tìm Đồ Gia Dụng lần nữa sẽ có thể tìm thấy mục tiêu.
target: By using the intersection points where multiple guiding light beams meet, you can deduce the target's location. At that location, use the Home-Use Object Finder again to locate the target.

target: The assist effects provided by Silver Wolf are only valid once the specified conditions are met. Please arrange your training schedule accordingly.

target: Increased stats can take effect in both Surface Exploration and Deep Exploration of the ruins.

source: Efek yang dapat diaktifkan ke Zona. Zona dengan Beacon akan memberikan hadiah yang melimpah.
target: An effect applied to a domain. Domains with beacons will net you great rewards.

source: Effectuez une synthèse en utilisant 2 gemmes rouges ou bleues pour obtenir une gemme de prospérité.
target: Perform synthesis using any 2 Red Gems/Blue Gems to obtain a Wealth Gem.

source: Effekt entfernen
target: Effect Dispel

source: Effekt entfernen: Buff
target: Buff Dispel

source: Effekt entfernen: Debuff
target: Debuff Dispel

source: Effet de soutien
target: Assist Effect

source: Effets cachés de la Recette de cocktail spécial
target: "Special Mix Recipe" Hidden Effects

source: Effizienz des Fähigkeitseffekts
target: Ability Effect Efficiency

source: Eficiência do Efeito da Habilidade
target: Ability Effect Efficiency

source: Egal in welcher Raumzeit du dich befindest, das Licht der Sphäre zeigt stets die jeweils andere Raumzeit an.
target: No matter which space-time you're currently in, the orb's light will continuously reveal the other space-time.

source: Ehre
target: Glory

source: Ein Bergarbeiter und sein Lehrling haben einige Probleme in der Großen Mine ... Hilf ihnen, die Minenwagen zu den vorgesehenen Prellböcken zu schieben, dann findest du vielleicht etwas, das dich interessieren könnte.
target: A mine cart operator and his apprentice seem to be having a bit of trouble in the Great Mine... Help them push the mine carts to the designated blockers, and you may find something of interest.

source: Ein Effekt auf Regionen. Regionen mit Leuchtfeuer werden dir tolle Belohnungen bringen.
target: An effect applied to a domain. Domains with beacons will net you great rewards.

source: Ein Objektfinder der Interastralen Friedenskorporation, der liebevoll „Findie“ genannt wird. Folge der Richtung, die Findie anzeigt, um Schätze zu finden. Er kann jedoch keine Objekte anzeigen, die zu weit weg sind.
target: An object finder produced by the Interastral Peace Corporation, lovingly known as Findie. You can find treasures by following the direction indicated by Findie. However, it won't find things that are too far away.

source: Ein Schatten im Fragmentum, der sich vorerst inaktiv zeigt. Wird er nicht gestört, ist er nicht gefährlich. Ruhender Schatten kann Ressourcen wie etwa Materialien zum Figurenaufstieg gewähren.
target: A shadow in the Fragmentum that temporarily stays stagnant. It is not dangerous if left alone. Stagnant Shadows can yield resources such as Character Ascension Materials.

source: Ein Teil der angezeigten Form wird sich dabei verändern. Pass daher unbedingt auf den Winkel zwischen dem Matrixmuster und der angezeigten Form auf.
target: Part of the declared shape will change, so be sure to pay attention to the angle of the matrix pattern and the declared shape.

source: Ein Ziel mit einer Ringmarkierung wurde erkannt. Halte still, bis die Erkennung abgeschlossen wurde.
target: A target with a ring mark is detected. Hold still until the recognition is complete.

source: Ein Ziel mit einer gelben Markierung wurde erkannt. Dies muss manuell fotografiert werden.
target: A target with a yellow mark is detected, which needs to be manually photographed.

source: Ein gelbes Lichtmuster an der Tür bedeutet, dass sie in der aktuellen Raumzeit geöffnet werden kann. Ein weißes Lichtmuster an der Tür bedeutet, dass sie in der aktuellen Raumzeit nicht geöffnet werden kann.
target: Yellow light patterns on the door means the door can be opened in the current space-time. White light patterns on the door means the door cannot be opened in the current space-time.

source: Ein mechanischer Hund, der von der Kunsthandwerkskommission hergestellt wurde. Setze seine Lokalitätssonde ein, um verdächtigen Gerüchen und Spuren nachzugehen.
target: An ingenium dog crafted by the Artisanship Commission. Use its Locality Probe feature to find suspicious odors and traces.

source: Ein mysteriöser, von Janus gesegneter Gegenstand. Nachdem er zerbrochen wurde, wird die Bewegungs-GES für eine bestimmte Dauer erhöht.
target: A mysterious object blessed by Janus. After breaking it, movement speed will increase for a certain duration.

source: Ein seltsames Gebilde in Form einer Knospe mit Staubgefäßen und Blütenstempeln in einem kräftigen Rot sowie tintenschwarzen Blütenblättern. Besiege Gegner, um Spurenmaterialien zu erhalten.
target: A strange creation in the shape of a flower's sepal, with crimson stamens and pistils and ink-black petals. Defeat enemies to gain Trace Materials.

source: Ein seltsames Gebilde in Form einer Knospe mit goldenen Staubgefäßen und Blütenstempeln sowie tintenschwarzen Blütenblättern. Besiege Gegner, um Materialien zu Figur-EP, Materialien zu Lichtkegel-EP und Credits zu erhalten.
target: A strange creation in the shape of a flower's sepal, with golden stamens and pistils and ink-black petals. Defeat enemies to gain Character EXP Materials, Light Cone EXP Materials, and credits.

source: Eine Abstoßbrücke kann orange oder blau sein. Mit dem Steuergerät kannst du die aktive Brücke ändern und so an ungeahnte Orte gelangen.
target: A repulsion bridge can either be orange or blue. Using the control device to change the active bridge will lead you to unexpected destinations.

source: Eine Art getarntes Alarmgerät. Wird der Alarm im Sperrgebiet ausgelöst, werden die sich in der Nähe befindenden Wachen alarmiert. Setze Diting ein, um seine genaue Form zu bestimmen.
target: A type of optically concealed alarm device. If the alarm is triggered in the guard zone, nearby guards will be alerted. Use Diting to probe its exact shape.

source: Eine Technik ist eine besondere Art von Fähigkeit, die bei Erkundungen eingesetzt wird und Technikpunkte kostet. Unterschiedliche Figuren haben unterschiedliche Technikbuffs.
target: Technique is a special type of ability used in Exploration, which costs Technique Points. Different characters have different Technique Buffs.

source: Eine Unterhaltungseinrichtung, die überall in Aideen-Park zu finden ist. Ihre Regeln sind einfach, aber faszinierend. Unzählige Gäste sind davon gefesselt und haben die Realität völlig vergessen.
target: An amusement facility that can be seen anywhere in Aideen Park. Its rules are simple but charming. Countless guests are immersed in it and become completely oblivious to reality.

source: Eine Vergrößerung des Ausstellungsbereichs wird den Gewinn aus dem Betrieb des Museums erhöhen, aber auch die Ziele höher setzen.
target: Increase the level of exhibition area will improve benefits from operating the museum, but will also set the objectives higher

source: Eine bestimmte Zahl von Angriffen kann die Kriegsrüstung eines Gegners zerstören.
target: Attacking enemies a certain number of times can destroy their "War Armor."

source: Eine der Funktionen an der Werkbank der Schöpfung: Verbrauche Hitze an der Werkbank der Schöpfung, um Segen zu verstärken.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends the Workbench of Creation's Heat to enhance Blessings.

source: Eine der Funktionen an der Werkbank der Schöpfung: Verbrauche Kosmische Fragmente, um aktuelle Gleichungen zu tauschen.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Equations.

source: Eine der Funktionen an der Werkbank der Schöpfung: Verbrauche Kosmische Fragmente, um vorhandene Segen zu tauschen.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Blessings.

source: Eine der Funktionen an der Werkbank der Schöpfung: Vorhandene Gewichtete Kuriositäten können ersetzt werden.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can replace existing Weighted Curios.

source: Eine der Funktionen an der Werkbank der Schöpfung: Zur Synthese brauchst du 2 Kuriositäten gleicher Qualität.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can synthesize a new Curio using 2 Curios of the same quality.

source: Eine große Anzahl von Sparschweinen ist in der Ebene aufgetaucht. Fange sie, um mehr Segen zu erhalten.
target: A large number of Trotters have appeared in the plane. Capture them and obtain more Blessings.

source: Eine sehr seltene und wertvolle Ausrüstung, die bei Erhalt die maximale Teamgröße um 1 erweitert. Während sie ausgerüstet ist, erhältst du zusätzlich einige Goldmünzen.
target: A very rare and valuable piece of equipment. When acquired, it increases the team size limit by 1. While continuously equipped, it also grants some Gold Coins.

source: Eine uralte Maschine der Architekten von Belobog, die dem Willen der Bewahrung gehorcht. In einigen Kampfszenarien können Verbündete die Maschine aufladen, um ihre Fähigkeit zu aktivieren.
target: An ancient machine made by the Architects of Belobog that obeys the will of Preservation. In certain combat scenarios, you and your allies can Charge the machine to activate its ability.

source: Eine zeremonielle Vidyadhara-Lampe, die die versiegelnde Kraft dieser Rasse enthält.
target: A ceremonial lamp left by the Vidyadhara that contains the Vidyadhara's power of sealing.

source: Einfache Ausrüstung ist der grundlegendste Ausrüstungstyp und bietet verschiedene Grundattributsboni für die Figur.
target: Basic equipment is the most fundamental type of equipment, providing different Base Stat bonuses for the Character.

source: Einführung
target: How to Play

source: Einheiten im Status „Überladbar“ wandeln jeden Schaden, der ihre aktuellen LP übersteigt, in LP-Überladung um und werden dadurch nicht handlungsunfähig.
target: Units in the "Overloadable" state will convert any damage exceeding their current HP into "HP Overload" and won't be knocked down as a result.

source: Einheiten mit einer LP-Zahl verlieren bei einem Angriff keine LP, aber ihr LP-Zähler sinkt. Wenn die LP-Zahl 0 erreicht, wird die Einheit handlungsunfähig. Heilungs- und Schildeffekte können nicht verhindern, dass die LP-Zahl sinkt.
target: Units with "HP Count" will not lose HP when attacked, but their "HP Count" will decrease instead. When the "HP Count" reaches zero, the unit will be knocked down. Healing and Shield effects cannot prevent "HP Count" reduction.

source: Einige Einrichtungen können bei anderen die Chance auf die Auslösung des Effekts erhöhen oder das Intervall zwischen den Auslösungen verkürzen. Plane vorausschauend, damit die Effekte von Kultur-Einrichtungen häufiger ausgelöst werden.
target: Some facilities can increase the trigger chance or reduce the trigger interval of other facilities. Plan wisely to ensure that the effects of cultural facilities are triggered frequently.

source: Einige Einrichtungen können die tägliche Obergrenze für Effektauslösungen anderer Einrichtungen erhöhen. Plane vorausschauend, damit die Häufigkeit der Effektauslösungen bei Musik-Einrichtungen den Bedürfnissen der Besucher entspricht.
target: Certain facilities can increase the daily trigger count limit of other facilities' effects. Plan carefully to ensure musical facilities have adequate trigger counts to meet visitor demand.

source: Einige Fähigkeiten der Figuren können dazu führen, dass Aktionen vorgezogen oder verzögert werden. Das Auslösen von Schwächebruch bei Gegnern führt ebenfalls dazu, dass ihre Aktionen verzögert werden.
target: Some characters' abilities can cause actions to be Advanced Forward or delayed. Triggering Weakness Break on enemies will also cause their action to be delayed.

source: Einige Fähigkeiten der Figuren können dazu führen, dass Aktionen vorgezogen oder verzögert werden. Das Auslösen von Schwächebruch bei Gegnern führt ebenfalls dazu, dass ihre Aktionen verzögert werden.
target: Some characters' abilities can cause actions to be advanced forward or delayed. Inflicting Weakness Break on enemies will also cause their action to be delayed.

source: Einige Gegner können aufgeladene Angriffe einsetzen. Durch Aufladung entfesseln sie bei ihrer nächsten Aktion eine mächtige Fähigkeit.
target: Some enemies will unleash a powerful Charged ATK during their next action once they finish Charging.

source: Einige Glanzfarbenwürfel haben besondere Würfelseiten, die bei der Auswahl nach dem Würfeln einzigartige Effekte auslösen!
target: Some Prismatic Dice have special Dice Faces that trigger unique effects when rolled and selected!

source: Einige Seiten des Geo-Gefäßes sind mit einer dünnen, brüchigen Membran überzogen, die bei einem Aufprall zerbricht und die Geo-Tropfen freisetzt.
target: Some sides of the ichor vessel are covered with a fragile membrane layer, which will break upon impact and cause ichor to flow out.

source: Einige Titanen-Runen erfordern eine Anpassung des Musters mithilfe anderer Mechanismen. Nachdem sie vollständig zusammengesetzt sind, wird der Download fortgesetzt.
target: Some Titan runes require cleverly using other mechanisms to adjust their patterns before they can be fully assembled and continue downloading.

source: Einige Titanen-Runen müssen aus einem bestimmten Winkel betrachtet werden. Nachdem sie vollständig zusammengesetzt sind, wird der Download fortgesetzt.
target: Some Titan Runes need to be viewed from specific angles before they can align properly and continue downloading.

source: Einige Traumpuzzleteile sind instabil. Sie können bei Interaktionen vom Puzzle verschwinden und sich an andere Stellen verteilen.
target: Some Dream Jigsaw pieces are unstable and may move to another location in the scene during interaction.

source: Einige Verbrauchsgegenstände haben besondere Effekte, die im nächsten Kampf wirksam werden.
target: Some Consumables have special effects that will take effect in the next combat.

source: Einige Würfeleffekte können den Inhalt der Regionen beeinflussen. Wenn du den Würfeleffekt aufgibst, erhältst du als Entschädigung einige Kosmische Fragmente.
target: Some Dice Effects can influence the content in the domains. If you select to give up the Dice Effect, you will receive some Cosmic Fragments as compensation.

source: Einige besonders ungezogene Vögel geben nicht sofort ihre Niederlage zu. Du musst ihre Tarnung nach und nach enthüllen. Beobachte sie und versuche es ein paar Mal, um herauszufinden, wie du sie fangen kannst.
target: Some particularly playful birds won't directly admit their failure and require you to peel back their disguise little by little. Observe carefully and try many times to figure out the way to capture them.

source: Einige spezielle Wandplatten bewegen sich nach bestimmten Mustern. Nutze den richtigen Moment und ihre Eigenschaften, um die Kugel gezielt zu lenken.
target: Some special wall panels will move in a set pattern. Use the right timing to take advantage of their traits to move the stone orb.

source: Einkaufsstraßen-Showdown von Seafeld City
target: Seafeld City Commerce Street Showdown

source: Einrichtung der Vitrine
target: Display Area Setup

source: Eisoberfläche
target: Ice

source: El ATQ del enemigo aumenta en gran medida y los ataques del enemigo infligen golpes letales a los aliados.
target: Enemy ATK is greatly increased. When they attack, they will deal killing blows to allies.

source: El Banco de pruebas de la creación puede sintetizar 4 componentes del mismo nivel de estrellas en un componente de nivel superior.
target: Workbench of Creation can synthesize 4 Components of the same star rating to become higher-rated Components.

source: El Banco de pruebas de la creación puede sobrescribir un componente por otro al azar del mismo nivel de estrellas.
target: Workbench of Creation can Overwrite 1 Component to a random Component of the same star rating.

source: El Calor de la marea oscura es un estado negativo de tipo Daño con el tiempo. El Daño con el tiempo proviene de una parte del daño recibido por el objetivo. Al acumularse, se actualiza la duración en turnos del Calor de la marea oscura.
target: "Black Tide Fever" is a type of DoT debuff. The DoT originates from a part of the DMG that the target takes. When stacking, it resets the duration of "Black Tide Fever."

source: El Clan Bestialma puede aumentar el progreso del efecto de legión cuando las unidades eterae o cápsulas alcanzan el nivel 3.
target: The Beastsoul Clan can increase the Legion effect progress when wispae or capsule units reach Level 3

source: El Cronorrecipiente es una herramienta ritual creada por los sacerdotes de Oronix que adopta varios tamaños y estilos. Romper un Cronorrecipiente detendrá el tiempo en sus alrededores.
target: The Chrono Vessel is a temporal ritual tool crafted by Oronyx's priests, with various sizes and styles. Breaking the Chrono Vessel will pause time in the area around it.

source: El Cubo de Basura Señorial aparecerá en este episodio. Es necesario golpearlo 2 veces para romperlo.
target: The Lordly Trashcan will appear in this stage. The Lordly Trashcan needs to be hit 2 times to be broken.

source: El Dragón Caído consume sus propios PV y dispara continuamente contra todos los enemigos. Cuando los PV del Dragón Caído están por debajo del 25%, sigue disparando y activa su autodestrucción.
target: Netherwing can consume its own HP to continuously blast all enemies. When Netherwing's HP is under 25%, it can continue blasting to trigger self-destruct.

source: El Escudo colectivo puede recibir daño en lugar de todos los aliados. El efecto de escudo es la cantidad de daño que puede absorber el escudo.
target: Collective Shield can take DMG on behalf of all ally characters, and the Shield Effect represents the amount of DMG the Shield can currently endure.

source: El Mago solo puede usar la habilidad básica en el cubito, con lo que obtiene 3 puntos cinéticos. Cuando un aliado contraataca, el cubito consume 1 punto cinético, lanza un ataque adicional y recupera energía para el Mago.
target: The Magician can only use their Skill on minicans, which grants 3 Kinetic Points to them. When allies launch Counters, minicans consume 1 Kinetic Point to launch Follow-Up ATKs and regenerate Energy for the Magician.

source: El Regalo sorpresa de Céridra vuelve a activar el Regalo sorpresa anterior.
target: Cerydra's Surprise Gift can re-trigger the previous Surprise Gift.

source: El Regalo sorpresa de Feixiao le otorga una gran cantidad de puntos de Feihuang.
target: Feixiao's Surprise Gift will grant Feixiao massive Flying Aureus points.

source: El Regalo sorpresa de Qingque aplica estados negativos a los enemigos para potenciar el daño de los siguientes ataques de Regalo sorpresa.
target: Qingque's Surprise Gift applies a debuff to enemy units, which enhances the DMG dealt by subsequent Surprise Gifts.

source: El Sr. Pantallarredonda aparecerá en este episodio. Presta atención a sus expresiones. Cuando esté sonriendo, dale un golpe para obtener más puntos.
target: Mr. Domescreen will appear in this episode. Pay close attention to his expressions. Break him when he's smiling to get more points.

source: El Trucorreloj también puede traer muchas sorpresas inimaginables. ¡Ve a explorar, tic-tac!
target: Clockwork can also bring lots of unexpected surprises. Go and explore, tick tock!

source: El antiguo Eón, la Voracidad, despierta poco a poco y su poder insaciable devora todo a su paso. Algunos enemigos de este mundo se ven afectados por esta corrupción y se potencian con el poder de la Voracidad.
target: The ancient Aeon of Voracity is gradually awakening, THEIR ravenous power steadily encroaching outward. Infecting a portion of this world's enemies, THEY empower them with the might of Voracity.

source: El bullicio del Callejón Aurum: carga de mercancía
target: Aurum Alley's Hustle and Bustle: Inventory Arrangement

source: El bullicio del Callejón Aurum: planificación logística
target: Aurum Alley's Hustle and Bustle: Logistics Planning

source: El camino del destino es irregular... Si te caes, recibirás la condena eterna.
target: The path of destiny is not a smooth one... Should you fall, you will experience eternal damnation.

source: El canto de los insectos
target: Chirping Secret

source: El canto de los insectos: ayuda del Sastre
target: Chirping Secret: Garmentmaker's Help

source: El cofre miau miau de creaciones liberará aleatoriamente 3 creaciones cada semana. Las creaciones que salgan del cofre se esconderán en el vagón de fiestas. La hora de reinicio es cada lunes a las 04:00 (hora del servidor).
target: The Creation Meow Box will randomly release 3 creations each week. Once they've escaped the box, these creations will hide somewhere in the Party Car. Resets every Monday at 04:00 (server time).

source: El color de la luz guía del buscador doméstico de objetos indica la distancia a la que se encuentra el objetivo. La luz roja indica que el objetivo está muy lejos, mientras que la luz verde avisa de que está cerca.
target: Home-Use Object Finder's guidance light color can show the distance to the target. Red light indicates a longer distance, while green light indicates a close distance.

source: El color rojo representa los obstáculos que bloquean el camino. El camino no puede pasar a través de ellos. Asegúrate de evitarlos al conectar la ruta.
target: The red fan-shaped zone represents obstacles that block the path, and the route cannot pass through them. Be sure to avoid them when connecting the route.

source: El combate irá alternando entre el día y la noche.
target: The entire battle will cycle between Day and Night.

source: El comediante puede obtener puntos de risa contenida para cargar la Caja de la risa. Cuantos más puntos de risa contenida haya, más potente será el efecto de la Caja de la risa.
target: The Comedian can charge the Surprise Box by gaining Giggle Gauge. The higher the Giggle Gauge, the stronger the effect of the Surprise Box.

source: El contenido especial de juego se actualizará todas las semanas en Cálculo periódico.
target: Special gameplay content will be updated weekly in Cyclical Extrapolations.

source: El dado iridiscente se puede volver a tirar como cualquier otro dado.
target: Prismatic Dice can be rerolled just like other dice.

source: El dado iridiscente se puede volver a tirar como cualquier otro dado.
target: The Prismatic Dice can be rerolled like other dice.

source: El dado iridiscente tiene un límite de usos y normalmente solo se puede usar dos veces por partida.
target: The Prismatic Dice has limited uses. You can typically only use it twice per match.

source: El daño que infligen Sangrado, Quemadura, Electrocución e Intemperie pertenece a la categoría de Daño con el tiempo. Este tipo de daño no puede infligir Golpe CRIT.
target: DMG dealt by Bleed, Burn, Shock, and Wind Shear is considered DoT. This DMG cannot deal CRIT Hit.

source: El desafío se completa si se termina el trabajo antes de que todas las quimeras estén agotadas.
target: The challenge is successful if the task is completed before all the chimeras are exhausted.

source: El día y la noche tienen sus propios efectos básicos. Selecciona dones de la sangre dorada para obtener bonificaciones adicionales.
target: Day and Night each have their own basic effects. Selecting Golden Blood's Boons can grant you additional buffs.

source: El efecto Chanchito: modo de juego
target: Trotter Effect: Gameplay Details

source: El efecto de escudo se muestra con una barra blanca con una longitud de escudo proporcional a los PV máx. del personaje.
target: The displayed Shield length corresponds to the percentage of the character's Max HP that the remaining Shield Effect represents.

source: El entrenamiento consume estado anímico. Cuando el estado anímico está bajo, la eficiencia del próximo entrenamiento también disminuye. El estado anímico se puede recuperar realizando Recorridos.
target: Training consumes Mood, and when Mood is low, training efficiency will also decrease. Mood can be restored through Excursions.

source: El entrenamiento permite mejorar los atributos de Siete de Marzo. Los efectos de cada entrenamiento aumentan tras avanzar en él hasta cierto punto.
target: Through training, March 7th can improve her stats. With each type of training, its effectiveness increases after a certain level of progress.

source: El equipamiento básico es el tipo más elemental de equipamiento que proporciona diferentes bonificaciones de atributos base al personaje.
target: Basic equipment is the most fundamental type of equipment, providing different Base Stat bonuses for the Character.

source: El escudo recibe daño y la cantidad de PV se mantiene igual. El efecto de escudo es la cantidad de daño que puede absorber el escudo.
target: Shield can take DMG in place of HP, Shield Effect refers to the maximum DMG value that can be absorbed by the current Shield.

source: El espacio plegado que la Estación Espacial utiliza para lidiar con los objetos raros que han escapado. Puede bloquear el espacio de manera efectiva e impedir los movimientos normales.
target: The folded space that the space station uses to counter escaped Curios. It can effectively cut off space to hinder standard travel

source: El espacio plegado se distorsiona durante la propagación del fuego del infierno. Intentar atravesarlo puede generar un desplazamiento en las coordenadas espaciales, lo que te llevará a lugares inesperados.
target: The folded space results from the spatial distortion during the spread of the infernal fire. Trying to pass through it may result in a drift in the spatial coordinates, with you transported to somewhere unexpected

source: El espirizuelo Bartholos puede devorar tesoros. Acércate al tesoro y presiona el botón de devorar para obtener la recompensa directamente.
target: Spirithief Bartholos can devour treasures. Get close to a treasure and press the Devour button to instantly receive rewards.

source: El estado de Antinomia activa la habilidad definitiva. Pero lanzar la habilidad definitiva durante este efecto causará una gran pérdida de PV.
target: The "Antinomy" state will activate Ultimates. However, using an Ultimate during this effect will cost massive HP.

source: El estado de Enredo inflige Daño Cuántico adicional al comenzar el turno del objetivo. Además, cuando recibe un ataque bajo el efecto de Enredo, ese daño adicional aumenta.
target: Entanglement will deal Additional Quantum DMG at the start of the enemy target's turn. If the target is attacked while under Entanglement, the Additional DMG taken will increase.

source: El hielo resbaladizo permite que las focas se desplacen más lejos y durante más tiempo.
target: Slippery ice makes baby seals move farther and for longer.

source: El impulsor de la senda secreta está conectado a las Sendas secretas de Jano de todo Amphoreus. Al activarlo, todas las sendas desbloqueadas entrarán en estado de activación instantánea.
target: The Secret Path Mechanism connects to all Janus's Hidden Passages across Amphoreus. Once activated, all unlocked passages will enter an Instant Activation state.

source: El jefe enemigo ahora tiene Azote espiritual. Cuando realice una acción, se activa primero Daño de Rayo con el tiempo contra otros enemigos. Activar Azote espiritual puede hacer que se eliminen las Piedras Espirituales más rápidamente.
target: Applies Spiritual Caning on the boss enemy. When they act, prioritize triggering Lightning DoT on other enemies. Triggering Spiritual Caning will allow the Soulstone to be defeated faster.

source: El jefe invocará Piedras Espirituales. Elimina las Piedras Espirituales para activar momentos destacados y obtener una gran cantidad de Bullicio.
target: The Boss Enemy will actively summon Soulstones. Defeating the Soulstones will trigger Highlight and grant a massive amount of Vibes.

source: El jugador entrará en estado de Agonizante cuando su vida sea 0, y será eliminado si vuelve a recibir daño.
target: When the player's HP is at 0, they will enter the Near-Death state. Taking DMG again will result in defeat.

source: El líder del equipo del turno de trabajo tiene su rasgo de líder único que puede resultar de ayuda durante el trabajo.
target: Every Duty Squad's leader will have a unique Leader Trait. This can be useful during duties.

source: El líder posee un efecto de líder único que puede influir en el rendimiento en combate de todo el equipo.
target: The Team Leader possesses a unique Leader Effect capable of influencing the entire team's combat performance.

source: El objetivo del juego es ganar mucho dinero y aumentar el nivel de recinto para que la exposición sea más próspera.
