target: War memories of past formidable foes are still fresh. Use Echo of War to relive past battles. Upon victory, there is a chance that you will gain rewards such as Trace Materials, Rare Light Cones, and Relics.

source: Kẻ địch có Năng Lực Hỗ Trợ sẽ cường hóa kẻ địch xuất hiện ở khu vực xung quanh, tăng Tấn Công cho những kẻ địch khác. Kẻ địch này sẽ xuất hiện trực tiếp, nhưng không phong tỏa khu vực xung quanh.
target: Enemies with Support Abilities will strengthen enemies in the surrounding areas and increase their ATK. This enemy will immediately appear, but will not lock down the surrounding area.

source: Kẻ địch có Năng Lực Phong Tỏa sẽ phong tỏa khu vực xung quanh, có thể chiến đấu đánh bại chúng.
target: Enemies with Lockdown Abilities can lock down nearby areas, and can be defeated through combat.

source: Kẻ địch có Năng Lực Trưởng Thành sẽ phong tỏa khu vực xung quanh.
target: Enemies with Growth abilities can put the surrounding areas on lock down.

source: Kẻ địch có Năng Lực Trưởng Thành sẽ đếm ngược theo Hành Động của bạn. Khi kết thúc đếm ngược sẽ nhận Cường Hóa, tăng Tấn Công bản thân.
target: Enemies with Growth Abilities will start a countdown based on your actions. When the timer reaches zero, they will be strengthened, increasing their ATK.

source: Kẻ địch có Năng Lực Trấn Thủ sẽ căn cứ số lượng khu vực chưa tìm kiếm xung quanh, tăng Tấn Công bản thân. Kẻ địch này sẽ xuất hiện trực tiếp, nhưng không phong tỏa khu vực xung quanh.
target: Enemies with Garrison Abilities will strengthen themselves according to the number of unexplored areas surrounding them, increasing their own ATK. These enemies will immediately appear, but will not lock down the surrounding area.

source: Kẻ địch có Sức Bền. Sức Bền sẽ khác nhau tùy theo độ mạnh khác nhau của kẻ địch.
target: Enemy targets have Toughness. Depending on the strength of the enemy, their Toughness will also be different.

source: Kẻ địch có hai loại ký hiệu trong hình là Thủ Lĩnh Phe Địch.
target: Enemies marked with both the icons shown are Boss enemies.

source: Kẻ địch có ký hiệu này có thể vào trạng thái Trăng Cuồng. Sau khi kẻ địch tấn công sẽ kèm thêm 1 tầng Khát Máu cho đơn vị địch có thể kích hoạt trạng thái Trăng Cuồng.
target: Enemies with this mark can enter the Moon Rage state. After enemies use attacks, apply 1 stack of Bloodlust to enemy units that can trigger Moon Rage.

source: Kẻ địch có ký hiệu này sẽ chia sẻ HP.
target: Enemies tagged with this mark will share HP.

source: Kẻ địch có ký hiệu trong hình là kẻ địch Thường.
target: Enemies marked with the icon shown are normal enemies.

source: Kẻ địch có ký hiệu trong hình là kẻ địch Tinh Anh.
target: Enemies marked with the icon shown are elite enemies.

source: Kẻ địch có nhiều tầng Sức Bền, mỗi tầng Sức Bền khi bị giảm còn 0 sẽ kích hoạt 1 lần Sát Thương Phá Vỡ, khi Sức Bền tầng cuối cùng giảm còn 0, sẽ kích hoạt Phá Vỡ Điểm Yếu.
target: Enemies with multiple layers of Toughness will suffer an instance of Break DMG each time a layer of Toughness is reduced. When the last layer is reduced to 0, the Weakness Break effect will trigger.

source: Kẻ địch có điểm yếu và sức bền. Tấn công điểm yếu tương ứng của kẻ địch có thể làm giảm sức bền của kẻ địch.
target: Enemies have Weaknesses and Toughness. Use attacks of the same Type as their Weaknesses to reduce their Toughness.

source: Kẻ địch gặp phải trong lúc thám hiểm thường sẽ có điểm yếu với nhiều loại thuộc tính. Dùng tấn công có thuộc tính giống với điểm yếu để vào chiến đấu, sẽ có thể giảm sức bền của kẻ địch mang điểm yếu này.
target: During your adventures, you will encounter enemies with multiple Weaknesses. Entering combat using attacks that match these Weaknesses can reduce the Toughness of enemies who have these Weaknesses.

source: Kẻ địch thuộc phạm vi Vùng Nhiệt Năng sẽ mất đi buff Sát Thương Băng của môi trường bão tuyết, và bị thêm Điểm Yếu Hỏa, Sát Thương Hỏa mà kẻ địch này phải chịu cũng tăng mạnh, giúp nhân vật phe ta chiếm ưu thế trong chiến đấu.
target: Enemies within the range of the thermal energy field will lose the Ice DMG boost available in snowstorms, and additionally receive Fire Weakness. It will also take extra Fire DMG, giving allies an advantage in combat.

source: Kẻ địch trong cách chơi này sẽ xuất hiện liên tục, gây sát thương cho kẻ địch hoặc đánh bại kẻ địch đều có thể nhận điểm.
target: In this game mode, enemies will continuously appear. You can earn points by dealing damage to enemies or defeating them.

source: Kẻ địch trong trận này sẽ có Điểm Thành Tích, phá vỡ hoặc tiêu diệt kẻ địch, có thể đoạt lấy Điểm Thành Tích của kẻ đó. Đoạt lấy Điểm Thành Tích sẽ kích hoạt Khoảnh Khắc Nổi Bật, nhận lượng lớn Điểm Khí Thế.
target: Enemies will have Performance Points in this match. Breaking or defeating enemies will allow you to seize their Performance Points. Seizing Performance Points will trigger Highlights and grant a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Kỹ năng của một số nhân vật có thể giải trừ Hiệu Ứng Xấu của mục tiêu phe ta, khi phe ta bị kẻ địch thêm Hiệu Ứng Xấu sẽ có thể phát huy tác dụng then chốt.
target: Certain characters have abilities that can dispel allies' debuffs. This can play a vital role when allies are inflicted with debuffs.

source: Kỹ năng của một số nhân vật có thể loại bỏ Hiệu Ứng Buff mà kẻ địch có, có thể phát huy hiệu quả kỳ diệu khi giao chiến với kẻ địch đặc biệt.
target: Abilities from certain characters can dispel buffs applied to enemies. These can change the battlefield when fighting special enemies.

source: Kỹ năng của một số nhân vật có thể loại bỏ Hiệu Ứng Buff mà kẻ địch có, khi chiến đấu với một số kẻ địch có Hiệu Ứng Buff sẽ có thể phát huy hiệu quả không ngờ.
target: Certain characters have abilities that can dispel enemies' buffs. This can be very useful when fighting buffed enemies.

source: Kỹ năng của một số nhân vật có thể loại bỏ Hiệu Ứng Xấu mà mục tiêu phe ta rơi vào, khi cần có thể phát huy tác dụng quan trọng.
target: Abilities from certain characters can dispel debuffs applied to allies. These can play a vital role at crucial moments.

source: Kỹ năng của một số nhân vật có thể ưu tiên hoặc trì hoãn hành động của mục tiêu. Khi gây Phá Vỡ Điểm Yếu cho kẻ địch, cũng sẽ khiến hành động của mục tiêu bị trì hoãn.
target: Some characters' abilities can cause actions to be Advanced Forward or delayed. Triggering Weakness Break on enemies will also cause their action to be delayed.

source: Kỹ năng của một số nhân vật có thể ưu tiên hoặc trì hoãn hành động của mục tiêu. Khi gây Phá Vỡ Điểm Yếu cho kẻ địch, cũng sẽ khiến hành động của mục tiêu bị trì hoãn.
target: Some characters' abilities can cause actions to be advanced forward or delayed. Inflicting Weakness Break on enemies will also cause their action to be delayed.

source: Kỹ năng loại chia sẻ của kẻ địch sẽ tấn công nhiều mục tiêu trong phe phái, mục tiêu bị tấn công sẽ phân chia đồng đều hệ số sát thương của kỹ năng này hoặc hệ số hiệu ứng mà kỹ năng này kèm theo.
target: Enemy distribution-type abilities will attack multiple targets within the team, and the attacked targets will evenly distribute either the DMG coefficient of the ability or any additional effect coefficient attached to that ability.

source: Kỹ năng loại càn quét của kẻ địch sẽ cố định phát động từ một bên nào đó của phe, lần lượt tấn công số lượng mục tiêu nhất định theo thứ tự, sẽ không bị ảnh hưởng bởi bất kỳ hiệu ứng thay đổi mục tiêu tấn công nào.
target: Enemy sweep-type abilities will always initiate from a fixed side of the team, sequentially attacking a set number of targets without being influenced by any effects that alter target selection.

source: Kỹ năng tự động hóa cho phép nhân viên tự động giao đồ ăn, tự động dọn dẹp và tự động đặt món với bếp
target: The Automate skill allows staff to automatically deliver meals, clean, and place orders with the kitchen

source: L'ATQ des ennemis est considérablement augmentée. Lorsqu'ils attaquent, ils infligent des coups fatals aux alliés.
target: Enemy ATK is greatly increased. When they attack, they will deal killing blows to allies.

source: L'ATQ et la réduction de robustesse augmentent en fonction du nombre de lilipoubelles. Lorsqu'une lilipoubelle attaque un ennemi, elle restaure également une quantité massive de points d'énergie au sorcier.
target: The more minicans, the higher the ATK and Toughness Reduction. When minicans attack enemies, they will also regenerate a massive amount of energy for the Magician.

source: L'Atelier clandestin possède des capsules spéciales appelées Trésors Ætherae. Les Trésors Ætherae augmentent la progression de l'effet de légion au début de chaque round en fonction du placement des Ætherae sur le champ de bataille.
target: The Sweatshop Company possesses special capsules called Wispae Treasure. Wispae Treasures increase the Legion effect progress at the start of each Cycle based on the placement of wispae on the field.

source: L'Efficacité et l'Endurance d'une chimère augmentent avec sa capacité de travail.
target: The higher a chimera's efficiency and stamina, the greater its work capacity.

source: L'Extrapolation de résonance se déclenche pendant le combat de boss du troisième plan. Les Extrapolations de résonance simulent différents types de Résonance de la Voie et peuvent lourdement impacter tous les alliés.
target: During the boss fight in the Third Plane, Resonance Extrapolation will occur. Resonance Extrapolations will simulate different types of Path Resonance and have a serious impact on all allies.

source: L'Hexanexus V2 est une version remaniée de l'Hexanexus. Sélectionnez la construction au centre de l'écran et placez des blocs aux endroits nécessaires. Chaque fois que vous placez un bloc, vous utilisez une ressource.
target: "Hexanexus: Remake" is the complete remake version of the Hexanexus. Select the device in the middle of the screen, and you can stack cubes along the indicated direction. Every time you stack a cube, a resource cube is consumed.

source: L'Omni-synthétiseur produit des consommables essentiels à votre voyage de pionnier et qui octroient toutes sortes d'améliorations inattendues.
target: The Omni-Synthesizer can produce Consumables that are essential in your Trailblazing journey and bring all kinds of unexpected buffs.

source: L'Omni-synthétiseur sert également à améliorer des objets de faible niveau en objets de niveau élevé du même type.
target: The Omni-Synthesizer can also turn low-level items into high-level items of the same category.

source: L'allié placé en première position dans la composition d'équipe régénère des points d'énergie lorsque les autres alliés lancent un ultime, et il a des chances de voir les DGT de sa prochaine attaque augmenter.
target: The ally positioned first in the Team Lineup gains Energy when other allies use their Ultimates, and there is a chance that the ally positioned first will have their next attack's DMG increased.

source: L'antique Aiôn de la Voracité s'éveille peu à peu, et son pouvoir insatiable frappe tout sur son passage. Ouroboros infecte plusieurs ennemis de ce monde et leur accorde la puissance de la Voracité.
target: The ancient Aeon of Voracity is gradually awakening, THEIR ravenous power steadily encroaching outward. Infecting a portion of this world's enemies, THEY empower them with the might of Voracity.

source: L'appât universel peut être déplacé et utilisé n'importe où sur le terrain pour attirer continuellement les créations environnantes. Placez-le près des mécanismes ou des cases spéciales du terrain pour créer des effets inattendus.
target: Universal Bait can be dragged and used anywhere on the field, continuously attracting nearby creations. It's perfect for placing near a field mechanism or special tiles to create unexpected effects.

source: L'effet Magoret : Détails
target: Trotter Effect: Gameplay Details

source: L'effet de Folle absorption se déclenche pour chaque cible absorbée, ce qui inflige des DGT à tous les ennemis.
target: For each target absorbed, "Frenzied Absorption" will be triggered, dealing DMG to all enemies.

source: L'endurance de Boss Stone est affichée dans le coin supérieur droit de l'écran. Battez-le en lui renvoyant ses pièces d'or !
target: Boss Stone's stamina is displayed in the upper right of the screen. Defeat him by firing at his gold coins to deflect them back!

source: L'ennemi bascule entre le mode compétence et le mode ultime lorsqu'il subit une ATQ normale ou des DGT provenant d'unités de son équipe.
target: When attacking the enemy with Basic ATK or causing this enemy to be damaged by other enemies, the enemy will switch between Skill and Ultimate modes.

source: L'entraînement consomme du moral, et lorsque le moral est faible, l'efficacité de l'entraînement diminue. Vous pouvez retrouver du moral en participant à des excursions.
target: Training consumes Mood, and when Mood is low, training efficiency will also decrease. Mood can be restored through Excursions.

source: L'objectif ? Devenir riche ! Améliorez le niveau d'exposition pour rendre votre événement plus vivant et attirer les foules.
target: The goal is to get rich! Raise the Venue Level and make the exhibition even more lively.

source: L'objectif est de déplacer les chariots de mine vides vers les bloqueurs bleus et de déplacer les chariots pleins vers les bloqueurs jaunes. Vous pouvez charger ou décharger les chariots de mine au niveau des tas de minerai.
target: The goal is to move the empty mine carts to the blue blockers, and move the loaded ones to the yellow blockers. You can load or empty mine carts at the ore piles.

source: L'ordre d'action indique l'ordre dans lequel alliés et ennemis agissent. Le personnage en haut de la liste agit en premier.
target: Action Order shows the order in which allies and enemies take action. The character at the top of the order will take action first.

source: L'ordre d'action indique l'ordre dans lequel alliés et ennemis agissent. Le personnage en haut de la liste agit en premier.
target: Action Order shows the order of action of both allies and enemies. The character at the top of the order will take action first.

source: L'ultime de Yao Guang déclenche immédiatement 1 Moment d'Aha supplémentaire. Lorsque Yao Guang bénéficie de Banger absolu, toute l'équipe inflige des comidégâts supplémentaires.
target: Yao Guang's Ultimate immediately triggers 1 additional Aha Instant. When Yao Guang possesses "Certified Banger," the entire team deals additional Elation DMG.

source: L'une des fonctionnalités de l'Établi de la création consiste à pouvoir remplacer les bizarreries pondérées existantes.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can replace existing Weighted Curios.

source: L'une des fonctionnalités de l'Établi de la création consiste à synthétiser une nouvelle bizarrerie en fusionnant 2 bizarreries de qualité identique.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can synthesize a new Curio using 2 Curios of the same quality.

source: L'une des fonctionnalités de l'Établi de la création consiste à utiliser des fragments cosmiques pour remplacer les bénédictions actuelles.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Blessings.

source: L'une des fonctionnalités de l'Établi de la création consiste à utiliser des fragments cosmiques pour remplacer les équations actuelles.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Equations.

source: L'univers regorge de joueurs des Guerres de l'étherium. Participez à des combats et remportez la victoire pour débloquer de nouveaux adversaires.
target: There are other Aetherium Wars players in the world. Heading into matches and claiming victory will continuously unlock new opponents for you.

source: L'Équipe de pros a accès à une boutique premium exclusive, disponible à tout moment.
target: Professional teams have access to an exclusive Premium Store, available anytime

source: L'Établi de la création permet entre autres de dépenser les points de cuisson de la machine pour renforcer les bénédictions.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends the Workbench of Creation's Heat to enhance Blessings.

source: L'Établi de la création peut synthétiser 4 composants du même niveau d'étoiles pour en faire des composants de niveau supérieur.
target: Workbench of Creation can synthesize 4 Components of the same star rating to become higher-rated Components.

source: L'Établi de la création peut écraser 1 composant contre un composant aléatoire du même niveau d'étoiles.
target: Workbench of Creation can Overwrite 1 Component to a random Component of the same star rating.

source: L'âme de Nikador a été divisée en 4 parties par les Acrokopiens ; elle est scellée dans les 4 statues de la Zone Forge-âmes. Insérez les énormes épées des statues dans leur socle pour libérer un fragment de la divinité de Nikador.
target: Nikador's soul has been severed into 4 parts by the Kremnoans and is sealed into the 4 statues in the Soul-Forging Zone. Insert the giant swords in these statues' hands into the base to release one fragment of Nikador's divinity.

source: L'émotion actuelle peut être ajustée grâce aux boutons sur les côtés !
target: The current Emotion can be tuned via the buttons on the two sides!

source: L'énergie se régénère en combat en utilisant des capacités, en éliminant des ennemis et en subissant des attaques.
target: Regenerate Energy in battle when using abilities, defeating enemies, or receiving attacks.

source: L'énergie se régénère en combat en utilisant des capacités, éliminant des ennemis et subissant des attaques. Le taux de régénération d'énergie peut augmenter la quantité d'énergie que le personnage régénère.
target: Energy is regenerated in battle when using abilities, defeating enemies, or receiving attacks. Energy Regeneration Rate can boost the amount of energy a character gains.

source: L'énergie stockée dans les ancres spatiales peut être utilisée pour redonner des PV aux personnages.
target: Energy stored in the Space Anchor can be used to restore HP to characters.

source: L'épreuve finale est un combat en continu avec un compte à rebours de six cycles. Durant l'épreuve, des règles spéciales régissent les combats contre les boss.
target: The Final Trial is a continuous battle with a countdown timer of 6 Cycles. Boss enemies in the trial will have their special battle mechanics.

source: L'équipement commun est le type d'équipement le plus fondamental, il fournit différents bonus de base pour le personnage.
target: Basic equipment is the most fundamental type of equipment, providing different Base Stat bonuses for the Character.

source: L'état Antinomie active les ultimes. Cependant, utiliser un ultime alors qu'Antinomie est actif coûte une quantité considérable de PV.
target: The "Antinomy" state will activate Ultimates. However, using an Ultimate during this effect will cost massive HP.

source: L'événement Mystères du crépuscule comporte 5 parchemins. Trouvez les parchemins pour lancer le combat et éliminez les ennemis pour débloquer les souvenirs scellés.
target: In the Enscrolled Crepusculum event, there are a total of 5 scrolls. Locate the scrolls, enter combat, and defeat the enemies to unlock memories that are sealed away.

source: L'événement de tournage des séries dérivées de Chronou propose désormais de nouvelles activités. Venez les découvrir !
target: The Clockie's Extras filming experience event now has more available activities. Guests are welcome to try them out!

source: L'œil averti d'un maître des breuvages vous permet de distinguer les trois attributs d'une boisson. Chaque attribut possède 2 types d'inclinations.
target: A drinksmith's trained eye allows you to see the three attributes in a beverage. Each has 2 types of inclinations.

target: HP Count

source: LP-Überladung
target: HP Overload

target: The Fool's Box

target: The Creation Meow Box will randomly release 3 creations each week. Once they've escaped the box, these creations will hide somewhere in the Party Car. Resets every Monday at 04:00 (server time).

target: Navigation Compass

target: The Surprise Box will assist in combat. When it takes action, it triggers special effects that help during battles.

source: La Fiche de personnage comporte plusieurs emplacements. Chaque emplacement peut accueillir un accessoire en scénarium différent.
target: There are different slots in the Protagonist Model. The Plot Armor that can be selected for each slot is different.

source: La Firmeza inicial de los enemigos es el 50% de su Firmeza máxima.
target: Enemies' initial Toughness is 50% of their Max Toughness.

source: La Gyrostatue qui retient la boule en pierre peut être détruite en l'attaquant, la boule roulera alors dans la direction dans laquelle la statue est orientée, détruisant les obstacles sur son passage et ouvrant les portes entrouvertes.
target: The Ball-Holder Statue's base can be destroyed by attacks, causing the ball to roll in the direction the statue faces, breaking obstacles along its path, and pushing open slightly ajar doors.

source: La Lámpara iluminanieve es un dispositivo de apoyo bélico creado por la División de Tecnología de la Guardia Crinargenta. Consta de dos partes: la base de la lámpara y el núcleo térmico.
target: Snowshine Lamp is a combat support device invented by the Silvermane Guard Technology Division. It consists of two parts: The base of the lamp and the thermic core.

source: La Main de Zagreus est un vestige divin laissé par le Titan de la Ruse, Zagreus. Après la chute du Titan, les habitants d'Amphoreus ont appris à la modifier pour l'utiliser à leur compte.
target: Hand of Zagreus is the divine body left behind by Zagreus, the Trickery Titan. After the Titan had fallen, the people of Amphoreus learned to modify and utilize them.

source: La Main de Zagreus peut se charger et foncer en ligne droite. Elle peut alors détruire certains objets.
target: The Hand of Zagreus can charge up, and then sprint in a straight line, during which it will gain a certain degree of destructive power.

source: La Main de Zagreus peut être utilisée pour le transport.
target: The Hand of Zagreus can be used for transportation.

source: La Mano de Zagreus es un cuerpo divino que Zagreus, el Titán del Engaño, dejó atrás. Tras la caída del Titán, los habitantes de Amphoreus aprendieron a modificarlo para utilizarlo.
target: Hand of Zagreus is the divine body left behind by Zagreus, the Trickery Titan. After the Titan had fallen, the people of Amphoreus learned to modify and utilize them.

source: La Mano de Zagreus puede cargar y esprintar en línea recta, lo cual le otorga cierto poder destructivo.
target: The Hand of Zagreus can charge up, and then sprint in a straight line, during which it will gain a certain degree of destructive power.

source: La Mano de Zagreus puede usarse como medio de transporte.
target: The Hand of Zagreus can be used for transportation.

source: La Pantalla cambiante es un dispositivo de teletransportación de corta distancia de la Comisión de Artesanía. Permite a los personajes teletransportarse entre dos coordenadas espaciales.
target: Shifting Screen is a short-distance teleportation device of the Artisanship Commission that allows characters to teleport between two spatial coordinates.

target: Swarm Disaster: Communing Device

target: Swarm Disaster: Resonance Interplay

source: La Poubelle vénérable apparaît dans ce niveau. Il faut la frapper deux fois pour la détruire.
target: The Lordly Trashcan will appear in this stage. The Lordly Trashcan needs to be hit 2 times to be broken.

source: La Tabla de la profecía es una creación de Oronix. Al resolver el acertijo, la profecía se hará realidad.
target: The Prophecy Tablet is a creation of Oronyx. Solving the puzzle will make the prophecy come true

source: La VEL afecta al intervalo entre dos acciones de los objetivos. Cuanto mayor sea la VEL, más corto será el intervalo. Además, la VEL también afecta al orden de acción al entrar en combate.
target: SPD will affect the interval between a target's actions. The faster their speed, the shorter the interval. At the same time, SPD also affects the Action Order when entering battle.

source: La VIT influence l'intervalle entre les actions de la cible. Plus leur VIT est élevée, plus l'intervalle est court. La VIT influence également l'ordre d'action au début des combats.
target: SPD will affect the interval between a target's actions. The faster their speed, the shorter the interval. At the same time, SPD also affects the Action Order when entering battle.

source: La ayuda que aparecerá en la parte inferior de la pantalla saltará con el ritmo de la música.
target: The hint prompts at the bottom of the screen will move with the rhythm.

source: La barrera algebraica de catorce líneas ha sido disipada. Tornillum ha desplegado múltiples anillos de aceleración en el espacio de datos δme-13 para mejorar la eficiencia de hackeo del Muérdago.
target: The quatorzain algebraic expressions barrier has been deactivated. Screwllum has deployed multiple Acceleration Rings in the δme-13 dataspace to enhance Mistletoe's hacking efficiency.

source: La barrière d'expressions algébriques en quatorzain a été désactivée. Screwllum a déployé plusieurs Anneaux de vitesse dans l'espace de données δme-13 pour renforcer l'efficacité du piratage du Gui.
target: The quatorzain algebraic expressions barrier has been deactivated. Screwllum has deployed multiple Acceleration Rings in the δme-13 dataspace to enhance Mistletoe's hacking efficiency.

source: La base sobre la que reposa la bola esculpida puede ser destruida con ataques. La bola rodará en la dirección hacia la que mira la estatua, romperá obstáculos a su paso y abrirá puertas ligeramente entreabiertas.
target: The Ball-Holder Statue's base can be destroyed by attacks, causing the ball to roll in the direction the statue faces, breaking obstacles along its path, and pushing open slightly ajar doors.

source: La bataille alterne entre jour et nuit par cycle.
target: The entire battle will cycle between Day and Night.

source: La bolsa de basura se puede arrastrar y utilizar en cualquier posición de la pista. Tras un momento, aturde a las creaciones dentro del área. Es ideal para usar contra las creaciones que van en las primeras posiciones y frenar su avance.
target: Trash Bag can be dragged and used anywhere on the field. After a brief delay, it stuns creations within its range. Best used against creations at the front of the pack to halt their momentum.

source: La boutique s'actualise automatiquement 1 fois au début de la phase de préparation pour chaque Nœud. Vous pouvez utiliser des pièces d'or pour recruter les personnages voulus dans la boutique.
target: The Store automatically refreshes 1 time at the start of the preparation phase for each Node. You can use Gold Coins to recruit desired Characters from the Store.

source: La boîte surprise vous assistera au combat. Lorsqu'elle agit, elle déclenche des effets spéciaux qui vous aident pendant les combats.
target: The Surprise Box will assist in combat. When it takes action, it triggers special effects that help during battles.

source: La caja de Yesca es un recipiente que se utiliza para almacenar objetos importantes. Cuando se activa, aparecerán cerraduras en su exterior correspondientes a varios fragmentos de llaves.
target: The Coreflame Casket is used to contain important items. When activated, keyholes will appear on the exterior of the Coreflame Casket and activate the corresponding number of key fragments.

source: La cantidad de fragmentos cósmicos necesaria para sobrescribir una bendición aumenta con el número de sobrescrituras.
target: Cosmic Fragments required to overwrite Blessings increase with each overwriting attempt.

source: La cantidad de fragmentos cósmicos necesaria para sobrescribir una ecuación aumenta con el número de sobrescrituras. El número de veces que pueden sobrescribirse ecuaciones en cada Banco de pruebas de la creación tiene un límite.
target: The number of Cosmic Fragments required to overwrite an Equation increases with each overwriting attempt. There is a limit to the number of times each Workbench of Creation can overwrite Equations.

source: La capacidad de combate del personaje recibe diferentes niveles de potenciación inicial según su costo. En general, costo 5 > costo 4 > costo 3 > costo 2 > costo 1. Los personajes del mismo costo tienen una capacidad de combate similar.
target: Characters receive different levels of initial boost to their combat abilities based on their cost. Generally, 5-cost > 4-cost > 3-cost > 2-cost > 1-cost, with characters of the same cost having similar combat capabilities.

source: La carte Modèle à suivre permet d'augmenter le Niv. de service de tous les passagers jusqu'à atteindre celui du membre de l'équipe avec le Niv. de service le plus élevé.
target: The Passenger Paragons card can elevate all members' Duty Level to match the highest Duty Level within the team.

source: La chambre est divisée en 6 zones, chacune ayant son propre Niv. d'aménagement. Dépensez des fonds de l'Express pour terminer l'aménagement de la chambre et augmentez son niveau pour obtenir des subventions de rénovation.
target: There are 6 areas in the room, and each area has its independent renovations to complete. Consume Express Funds to complete room renovations, increase Décor Rating and obtain Renovation Subsidy.

source: La charge de travail varie selon les cartes d'action. Après avoir sélectionné une carte d'action, l'emploi du temps avancera du nombre de cases correspondantes pour atteindre une certaine case.
target: Different Action Cards entail varying workloads. After selecting an Action Card, the schedule will advance by a set number of steps to reach the corresponding tile.

source: La chimère invoquée est affichée dans la file d'invocation avant de rejoindre le combat.
target: The summoned chimera will be displayed in the summon queue before joining combat.

source: La clave para revitalizar el museo es encontrar los objetos perdidos. ¡Sigue gestionando el museo para encontrar pistas!
target: The key to revitalizing the museum lies in finding the lost exhibits. Continue operations to keep finding clues!

source: La clé pour restaurer le musée est de retrouver les pièces d'exposition perdues. Poursuivez les opérations pour continuer à trouver des indices !
target: The key to revitalizing the museum lies in finding the lost exhibits. Continue operations to keep finding clues!

source: La compétence Autonomie permet au personnel d'automatiquement apporter les repas, nettoyer et prendre les commandes en cuisine.
target: The Automate skill allows staff to automatically deliver meals, clean, and place orders with the kitchen

source: La confusion de vos souvenirs est telle que certaines informations sont masquées par des ■■■ lorsque vous vous remémorez vos conversations passées.
target: Due to the presence of certain hazy memories, some content will appear as ■■■ in conversations as you explore your memories.

source: La construcción existente cuando superas el Universo Diferenciado puede guardarse para desafiar rápidamente contenido futuro con la misma construcción.
target: When you clear Divergent Universe, the build content can be saved, allowing for quick challenges with the same build content.

source: La distorsion spatiale a été déformée suite au passage du feu infernal. Si vous tentez de passer à travers, vos coordonnées peuvent se trouver affectées, ce qui vous enverra dans un endroit inattendu.
target: The folded space results from the spatial distortion during the spread of the infernal fire. Trying to pass through it may result in a drift in the spatial coordinates, with you transported to somewhere unexpected

source: La duración de la película está limitada en el modo película. La barra de progreso que aparece abajo indica el progreso de la filmación.
target: The film's length is limited in Movie Mode. The progress bar below indicates the filming progress.

source: La eficiencia y el aguante de las quimeras son proporcionales a su capacidad de trabajo. Es decir, cuanto más altos sean estos valores, más puede trabajar una quimera.
target: The higher a chimera's efficiency and stamina, the greater its work capacity.

source: La energía de Pedrusco aparecerá en la esquina superior derecha de la pantalla. ¡Derrótalo haciendo que reboten sus monedas de oro!
target: Boss Stone's stamina is displayed in the upper right of the screen. Defeat him by firing at his gold coins to deflect them back!

source: La energía que almacenan las anclas del espacio sirve para regenerar los PV de los personajes.
target: Energy stored in the Space Anchor can be used to restore HP to characters.

source: La energía se acumula al activar Adelanto extremo y recoger suministros. Cuando la energía esté llena, entrarás en Turboaceleración y en un largo periodo de invencibilidad.
target: Energy can be accumulated by triggering Turbo Dash and picking up supplies. When energy is full, you will enter Nutty Blitz and experience a long period of invulnerability.

source: La energía se puede recuperar usando habilidades, derrotando enemigos o recibiendo ataques en los combates.
target: Regenerate Energy in battle when using abilities, defeating enemies, or receiving attacks.

source: La energía se puede recuperar usando habilidades, derrotando enemigos o recibiendo ataques en los combates. La recuperación de energía puede aumentar la energía que obtienen los personajes.
target: Energy is regenerated in battle when using abilities, defeating enemies, or receiving attacks. Energy Regeneration Rate can boost the amount of energy a character gains.

source: La experiencia cinematográfica de las historias derivadas de Relojito ya cuenta con más actividades disponibles. ¡Los visitantes pueden ir a probarlas!
target: The Clockie's Extras filming experience event now has more available activities. Guests are welcome to try them out!

source: La formación defensiva aliada se muestra en la interfaz principal del evento.
target: Ally Defense Lineup will be displayed on the event main screen.

source: La foudre frappe à intervalles aléatoires. Repérez le signal lumineux juste avant l'impact et esquivez à temps.
target: Lightning will strike at random intervals. Watch for the flashing signal right before a strike and dodge in time.

source: La glace glissante permet aux bébés phoques de se déplacer plus loin et plus longtemps.
target: Slippery ice makes baby seals move farther and for longer.

source: La gravité de la réalité vous pèse ? Pas de panique ! À Astropolis, il vous suffit de suivre les chemins lumineux pour défier la gravité et marcher sur les murs, sans aucun gadget spécial.
target: Is the gravity of reality weighing you down? Don't worry! In Astropolis, just follow the glowing paths to defy gravity and walk right up the wall surfaces, no special gadgets required.

source: La guía de apoyo aparecerá en ciertos modos de juego específicos. Sigue la guía de apoyo y completa las operaciones correspondientes para llegar al destino de la misión actual.
target: Support Guide will appear in certain specific overworld gameplay. Follow Support Guide and finish the corresponding operations to arrive at the destination for the current mission.

source: La habilidad básica y la habilidad definitiva del personaje que haga de Mago obtendrán nuevos efectos de combate, y podrá comandar a Poni de basura en combate.
target: Characters acting as the Magician will see their Skill and Ultimate gain new combat effects, letting them command Litter Pony in battle.

source: La habilidad de automatización permite a los empleados entregar comidas, limpiar y hacer pedidos a la cocina automáticamente.
target: The Automate skill allows staff to automatically deliver meals, clean, and place orders with the kitchen

source: La habilidad definitiva de Yao Guang activa de inmediato un Momento Aha adicional. Cuando Yao Guang tiene ¡Bien hecho!, todo el equipo inflige Daño de Exultación adicional.
target: Yao Guang's Ultimate immediately triggers 1 additional Aha Instant. When Yao Guang possesses "Certified Banger," the entire team deals additional Elation DMG.

source: La imagen proporcionada es solo como ejemplo. Puedes completar la misión encontrando cualquier otro objetivo del mismo tipo en la zona de mando principal.
target: The provided images are only examples. Find any other target of the same type in the master control zone will also complete the mission.

source: La lampe brûle-neige est un dispositif d'aide au combat inventé par la Division technologique de la Garde de la crinière d'argent. Elle se décompose en deux parties : la base de la lampe et le noyau thermique.
target: Snowshine Lamp is a combat support device invented by the Silvermane Guard Technology Division. It consists of two parts: The base of the lamp and the thermic core.

source: La ligne d'assemblage comprend plusieurs conteneurs de fret. Ajustez la position des conteneurs de fret pour combler les trous sur la route et retirer les obstacles afin de vous frayer un passage.
target: Various freight containers are placed on the assembly line. Adjust the position of the freight containers to fill gaps in the road or remove obstacles to open new passages.

source: La longueur du bouclier affichée sur la barre de vie du personnage correspond au pourcentage de PV max du personnage auquel la valeur de bouclier restante s'applique.
target: The displayed Shield length corresponds to the percentage of the character's Max HP that the remaining Shield Effect represents.

source: La lumière des orbes miracles permet de changer l'espace-temps de la zone illuminée.
target: The light from the Miracle Orb will invert the illuminated area into the other space-time.

source: La luz del orbe milagroso cambia el área iluminada a un espacio-tiempo diferente.
target: The light from the Miracle Orb will invert the illuminated area into the other space-time.

source: La mayoría de las zonas se pueden mejorar. Tras mejorar una zona, su contenido será potenciado.
target: Most Domains can be leveled up. After leveling up a Domain, its contents will be enhanced.

source: La mecánica tiene una cantidad de ciclos limitada. Los enemigos aparecerán continuamente hasta el final. Elimina a más enemigos para conseguir una puntuación más alta y obtener más recompensas.
target: This mechanic has a Cycle limit. Before the Cycles run out, enemies will continue to appear. Defeating more enemies will earn you higher scores and greater rewards.

source: La mejora y ascensión pueden potenciar masivamente todo tipo de atributos para los conos de luz, haciendo que el portador sea aún más poderoso.
target: Level-up and Ascension can both massively boost all stats for the Light Cone, making the wearer even more powerful.

source: La máquina sintetizadora multiusos sirve para sintetizar consumibles que necesitarás en tu aventura y que te otorgarán ventajas esenciales.
target: The Omni-Synthesizer can produce Consumables that are essential in your Trailblazing journey and bring all kinds of unexpected buffs.

source: La máquina sintetizadora multiusos también puede convertir objetos de nivel bajo en otros de nivel alto de la misma categoría.
target: The Omni-Synthesizer can also turn low-level items into high-level items of the same category.

source: La mécagrue fait automatiquement demi-tour quand vous rencontrez des ennemis.
target: When encountering enemies, the cycrane will automatically return.

source: La partie se termine quand vous et vos coéquipiers tombez tous au combat.
target: It's game over when you and your teammates all fall in battle.

source: La percepción actual y el intervalo de percepción objetivo se mostrará en la barra de percepción. Puedes verla en la parte superior de la tabla. La percepción requerida para desbloquear cada secreto se muestra por encima del secreto.
target: Current Cognition Value and Cognition Value Target Range are both displayed in the Cognition Bar. Check it at the top of the board. The Cognition Value required to unlock each Secret is displayed above the Secret.

source: La phase de gestion et les Revitapoints du musée sont affichés ici.
target: The museum's Revitalization Stage and obtained RevitaScore are shown here

source: La plupart des Zones peuvent gagner des niveaux. Après la montée de niveau d'une Zone, son contenu sera renforcé.
target: Most Domains can be leveled up. After leveling up a Domain, its contents will be enhanced.

source: La prueba final es una serie de batallas consecutivas con una cuenta regresiva de 6 rondas. Los jefes tienen mecánicas especiales.
target: The Final Trial is a continuous battle with a countdown timer of 6 Cycles. Boss enemies in the trial will have their special battle mechanics.

source: La puntuación final de la etapa dependerá de dos factores: el porcentaje de PV que le queda al jefe y el valor de acción restante tras derrotar el jefe. Si no lo derrotas, solo se tendrá en cuenta el porcentaje de PV restante.
target: Stage finalization and score data are affected by 2 factors: The boss' remaining HP percentage and remaining action value after defeating the boss. If the boss is undefeated, only its remaining HP percentage is calculated.

source: La robogrulla volverá automáticamente al encontrarse con un enemigo.
target: When encountering enemies, the cycrane will automatically return.

source: La robustesse initiale des ennemis est équivalente à 50 % de leur robustesse max.
target: Enemies' initial Toughness is 50% of their Max Toughness.

source: La ronda termina cuando todos los globos que haya en el campo sean del mismo color. Cuantos más rondas completes dentro del tiempo límite, más abundantes serán las recompensas.
target: After changing all balloons on the field to the same color, a Challenge Cycle will be completed. The more Cycles of challenges you complete within the time limit, the greater the rewards you receive.

source: La réserve de points kinétiques augmente de 5 lorsqu'une lilipoubelle passe en forme Or dur. Aussi, les lilipoubelles obtiennent des points kinétiques après que le sorcier utilise son ultime.
target: When minicans reach the Ultra Gold form, increases max Kinetic Points to 5. After the Magician uses their Ultimate, minicans will also gain Kinetic Points.

source: La sobrescritura de objetos raros ponderados no gasta fragmentos cósmicos. El número de veces que pueden sobrescribirse objetos raros ponderados en cada Banco de pruebas de la creación tiene un límite.
target: Overwriting Weighted Curios does not expend Cosmic Fragments. There is a limit to the number of times each Workbench of Creation can overwrite Weighted Curios.

source: La station spatiale utilise la distorsion spatiale pour empêcher les bizarreries de s'échapper. Cela permet de bloquer efficacement l'espace.
target: The folded space that the space station uses to counter escaped Curios. It can effectively cut off space to hinder standard travel

source: La terminal también tiene otras funciones. Puedes ver cómo construir tus espíritus etéreos.
target: The terminal has other functions as well. You can check how to build your Aether Spirits

source: La tienda de la zona de reposo puede potenciar las bendiciones exclusivas del evento. En cada tienda, cada bendición solo puede potenciarse 1 vez.
target: The store within Domain — Respite can Enhance event-limited Blessings. In each store, all Blessings can be Enhanced 1 time.

source: La tienda se actualiza automáticamente cuando comienza la fase de preparación de cada nodo. Usa monedas de oro para comprar los personajes que necesitas.
target: The Store automatically refreshes 1 time at the start of the preparation phase for each Node. You can use Gold Coins to recruit desired Characters from the Store.

source: La túnica de la Belleza (infinita) se ha modificado. Todos los fragmentos cósmicos obtenidos en el plano aumentan el daño de los aliados en la batalla. Consigue más fragmentos cósmicos para prepararte para la prueba final.
target: The Robe of The Beauty (Infinite) has been modified. All Cosmic Fragments that have been obtained within the plane can now increase the DMG Boost effect for allies in battle. Obtain more Cosmic Fragments to prepare for the Final Trial.

source: La vague d'ennemis actuelle et le nombre d'ennemis vaincus durant la vague actuelle seront affichés durant le combat.
target: The current wave of enemies and the number of enemies defeated in the current wave will be displayed during battle.

source: La valeur de combat s'accumule lorsque les PV des alliés augmentent ou diminuent.
target: Grit Value accumulates when allies' HP increases or decreases.

source: La version renforcée d'un équipement avancé avec le même nom. En plus d'avoir des stats plus puissantes, ses effets de combat uniques seront aussi renforcés.
target: The enhanced version of advanced equipment with the same name. In addition to having more powerful stats, its unique combat effects will also be strengthened.

source: La vitrina de exposición te permite exhibir figuras conmemorativas, medallas de honor y fotos que hayas conseguido a lo largo de tu viaje trazacaminos. La vitrina de exposición se mostrará en el Perfil trazacaminos.
target: Through the "Collection Showcase" feature, you can set up various commemorative figures, honor badges, and travel photos obtained during your Trailblaze journey. Your "Collection Showcase" will be shown in your Trailblazer Profile.

source: La zone de figurines sert à exposer les souvenirs que vous avez ramenés de vos voyages. Vous pouvez aussi placer des objets spéciaux au centre !
target: The figure zone is for displaying mementos you've picked up on your travels, and you can place special items in the center spot too!

source: La zone de médailles présente vos moments de gloire obtenus lors des défis, ainsi que les Voies débloquées.
target: The medal zone showcases proof of glory earned from Challenges and records your unlocked Paths.

source: La zone rouge représente les obstacles qui bloquent le passage, et la route ne peut pas les traverser. Assurez-vous de les éviter lorsque vous tracez le parcours.
target: The red fan-shaped zone represents obstacles that block the path, and the route cannot pass through them. Be sure to avoid them when connecting the route.

target: Slope: Creations that land on the Slope will slide down the decline.
