source: Se 7 de Março não conseguir superar o Desafio da Espada, você pode escolher Retroceder para o início do estágio correspondente e reiniciar o Treinamento da Espada.
target: If March 7th couldn't pass the Sword Trial, you can choose to rewind to the start of the corresponding stage and restart the sword training.

source: Se aproxime da Torre de Bolhas e interaja com ela para obter Cargas de Bolha.
target: Approach Bubble Tower and interact with it to obtain Bubble Charges.

source: Se ha actualizado el contenido de la película «El camino del lobo: Final». Puedes ir a desafiar directamente a Pedrusco en la historia.
target: The content for the Way of the Wolf film has been fully upgraded. You will directly face Boss Stone in the story

source: Se han desbloqueado los encuentros de exhibición. Los oponentes de élite que enfrentaste en batallas anteriores aparecerán al azar en encuentros de exhibición y podrás enfrentarlos nuevamente.
target: Exhibition matches have been unlocked. The elite opponents you faced in previous battles will randomly appear in exhibition matches, and you can challenge them again.

source: Se nenhuma unidade for capaz de conjurar uma Perícia da Euforia quando Aha agir, Aha conjurará a Perícia da Euforia: "Que Haja Riso". Quanto mais acúmulos de "Piada", mais forte o efeito dessa perícia.
target: If no units are capable of casting an Elation Skill when Aha takes action, Aha will instead cast the Elation Skill: "Let There Be Laughter." The more Punchline stacks, the stronger the effect of this skill.

source: Se o Irmão Hanu não tiver mais munição sobrando, você pode devolver o Lançador Hanu a sua posição para desbloquear o Foguete Hanu novamente e repor 1 munição.
target: If Brother Hanu has no more ammo left, you can return to Hanu Launcher's position to unlock the Hanu Rocket again and replenish 1 ammo.

source: Se o participante por quem você torceu em ficou em 2º ou 3º lugar, a quantidade de petiscos devolvidos será reduzida respectivamente. Se o participante pelo qual você torceu não ficar entre os três primeiros, nenhum petisco será devolvido.
target: If your supported contestant wins 2nd or 3rd place, the amount of snacks returned would be reduced respectively. If the contestant you supported doesn't place in the top three, no snacks will be returned.

source: Se os carrinhos de mineração empacarem, você terá que usar o aparelho de mudança de via para alterar a direção dos trilhos antes de prosseguir.
target: If the mine carts won't move, you'll need to use the turnout to change the direction of the track to continue moving.

source: Se puede cargar energía en las escenas de acción y recogiendo suministros. Cuando la energía esté llena, se activará el Momento de Hanu y entrarás en un largo periodo de invencibilidad.
target: Energy can be accumulated by conducting Action Scenes and picking up supplies. When energy is full, you will trigger Hanu Time and enter a long period of invulnerability.

source: Se pueden añadir balizas en la mayoría de las zonas para generar efectos interesantes. En cada zona, se pueden añadir hasta 3 balizas.
target: Most Domains can have beacons attached to them, creating all kinds of interesting effects. Each Domain can have up to 3 beacons attached.

source: Se pueden añadir nuevos personajes durante tu exploración utilizando un descargador. Cada descargador solo puede añadir un personaje, así que elige con cuidado.
target: New characters can be added to the current exploration by using the Downloader. One Downloader can only add one character, so please make it count.

source: Se uma foquinha parar em um Campo de Ação Extra após agir, ela recebe uma Ação Extra. Isso só pode ser ativado 1 vez por rodada.
target: If a baby seal stops in an Extra Action Zone after taking action, it gets an extra action. This can only be triggered 1 time per round.

source: Se você concluir o "Desafio por tempo limitado" durante o período do evento, é possível obter recompensas extras.
target: If you complete the "Limited Time Challenge" during the event period, you can also get bonus rewards.

source: Se você derrotar todos os inimigos antes que a contagem regressiva chegue a zero, você vencerá o combate.
target: If you defeat all enemies before the countdown reaches zero, the combat is won.

source: Se você deseja congelar um objeto em movimento em um momento específico, você pode criar um Campo de Parada no Tempo antecipadamente, então iniciar o Retrocesso e interromper manualmente o Retrocesso no momento desejado.
target: If you wish to freeze a moving object at a specific time, you can pre-emptively deploy a Time Stop Zone, then initiate Rewind, and manually interrupt the Rewind at the desired moment.

source: Se você desvendar a imitação do pássaro, então vá e interaja com eles, por gentileza. Os pássaros amigáveis prepararão um presente para os aventureiros que os descobrirem.
target: If you see through the bird's mimicry, then please go up and interact with them. The friendly birds will prepare a gift for adventurers who discover them.

source: Se você encontrar quaisquer indivíduos com uma bolha sobre suas cabeças no Mundonírico, você pode extrair emoções dela, tique!
target: If you encounter any individuals with a bubble over their heads in the Dreamscape, you can extract emotions from them, tick!

source: Se você entrar em uma batalha quando os Ciclos extra estiverem em 0, então o inimigo irá entrar em um estado de Descontrole no fim da quantidade de Ciclos padrão desta batalha.
target: If you enter a battle when extra Cycles are at 0, then the enemy will enter a Berserk state at the end of the standard Cycle for this battle.

source: Se você não conseguir encontrar as marcações restantes na área, use o sistema de detecção da Câmera para obter as informações de localização do restante das marcações.
target: If you are unable to find the remaining markings in the area, use the Camera's detection system to obtain the remaining markings' location information.

source: Se você não deseja que seus dados de conclusão sejam visualizados pelos seus amigos, você pode escolher não exibir suas equipes do Caminho da Fortuna na página de Configurações
target: If you do not wish for your clearance data to be viewed by your friends, you can select not to display your Treasures Lightward lineups in the Settings page

source: Se você não eliminar todos os inimigos antes que a contagem regressiva chegue a zero, o combate será perdido e seu esquadrão sofrerá Dano.
target: If you fail to eliminate all enemies before the countdown reaches zero, combat will be lost and your squad will take damage.

source: Se você precisar alterar seu ponto de vista para continuar a história, você pode selecionar aqui para entrar no "Elenco do Destino".
target: If you need to change your POV to continue the story, you can select here to enter "Fate's Ensemble."

source: Se você precisar alterar seu ponto de vista para continuar a história, você pode selecionar aqui para entrar no "Elenco do Destino". Para mais detalhes, por favor veja os Tutoriais.
target: If you need to change your POV to continue the story, you can select here to enter "Fate's Ensemble." For more details, please see Tutorials.

source: Se você quer sair temporariamente do jogo ou encerrar a transformação, você pode interagir com a máquina de encolhimento novamente ou se teletransportar usando o Mapa.
target: If you want to temporarily exit the game or end the transformation, you can interact with the shrinking machine again or teleport using the Map.

source: Se você tiver personagens que estão abaixo do padrão de desenvolvimento, eles serão automaticamente aprimorados pelo sistema. Personagens que foram automaticamente aprimorados terão esta Marca de Mapeamento.
target: If you have characters that are below the build standard, they will be automatically enhanced by the system. Characters that have been automatically enhanced will have this Mapping Tag.

source: Se você usar o Foguete Hanu para acender os fogos de artifício, isso acionará uma explosão maior que derrota os inimigos, e é até capaz de derrubar paredes.
target: If you use the Hanu Rocket to ignite the fireworks, it will trigger an explosion that defeats enemies, and is even capable of destroying walls.

source: Sebagai bos di Dreamville, bisa meregangkan tubuh adalah kemampuan dasar. Kalau perlu, kamu bisa masuk ke dalam peti untuk menghindari anak buah Bos Stone.
target: As the boss of Dreamville, it is a basic requirement to adjust yourself to the situation. If needed, you can hide in the box to avoid Boss Stone's lackeys.

source: Sebagai presdir "Mingguan Rakun", masukkan "Arcadian Token" ke dalam celenganmu. Seiring dengan naiknya level, para rakun akan kirim hadiah untukmu.
target: As the president of Furbobo Weekly, drop your Arcadian Tokens into the Piggy Bank. As it levels up, the furbos will deliver rewards to you.

source: Sebagian "Dadu Prismatik" memiliki sisi khusus, yang ketika dilempar dan dipilih akan memicu efek unik!
target: Some Prismatic Dice have special Dice Faces that trigger unique effects when rolled and selected!

source: Sebagian besar Ikatan Bisnis terdiri dari ikatan dua asisten, seperti March 7th dan Himeko, tetapi akan ada kombinasi ikatan tiga asisten yang lebih kuat di waktu mendatang.
target: Business Bonds usually take the form of Duo Bond. For example, March 7th and Himeko can form a bond. Later, you'll see more powerful Trio Bond combos.

source: Sebagian besar Zona dapat dinaikkan levelnya. Setelah level naik, konten dalam Zona akan diperkuat.
target: Most Domains can be leveled up. After leveling up a Domain, its contents will be enhanced.

source: Sebagian besar Zona dapat ditambahkan Beacon, yang dapat menghasilkan berbagai efek menarik. Kamu dapat menambahkan hingga 3 Beacon di setiap Zona.
target: Most Domains can have beacons attached to them, creating all kinds of interesting effects. Each Domain can have up to 3 beacons attached.

source: Sebelum Boss Mirage terkena Weakness Break, DMG yang diterimanya akan berkurang drastis.
target: When the Boss Mirage's Weakness is not Broken, greatly reduces its DMG taken.

source: Sebelum melancarkan Kemampuan, jumlah pengurangan Toughness akan ditampilkan terlebih dahulu di atas bar HP target.
target: Before using abilities, the expected Toughness reduction will be displayed above the target's HP bar.

source: Sebelum pertempuran dimulai, kamu dapat memilih item tempur untuk dibawa. Menggunakan item tidak akan mengonsumsi jumlah langkah aksi.
target: You can select the battle items you wish to bring before the battle starts. Using an item will not consume a move.

source: Sebuah lampu penerangan ritual peninggalan Vidyadhara yang berisi kekuatan penyegelan ras Vidyadhara.
target: A ceremonial lamp left by the Vidyadhara that contains the Vidyadhara's power of sealing.

source: Sebuah mesin kuno yang dibuat oleh Architect Belobog, yang tunduk pada kehendak Preservation. Dalam pertempuran tertentu, kamu dapat mengisi Energy mesin tersebut dan mengaktifkan Kemampuan-nya melalui aksi rekan tim.
target: An ancient machine made by the Architects of Belobog that obeys the will of Preservation. In certain combat scenarios, you and your allies can Charge the machine to activate its ability.

source: Secara umum, Trailblazer dapat memperoleh Emblem dari setiap Ikatan dengan Synthesis Berlian Merah/Berlian Biru + equipment dasar.
target: Usually, synthesizing Red Gems/Blue Gems with a piece of basic equipment results in Emblems of various Bonds.

target: Different colored Story Snippets will cause different Audience Emotions to change, resulting in varied effects

source: Seiring dengan peningkatan level, karakter dengan biaya yang lebih tinggi akan lebih mudah muncul saat refresh di toko.
target: As your level increases, higher cost characters will appear more frequently in the Store.

source: Seiring meningkatnya progres penyelesaian renovasi, dekorasi kamar secara keseluruhan juga akan semakin bagus dan lengkap.
target: As your renovation progress increases, your room's overall décor will also be refined.

source: Sejenis alarm yang tersembunyi. Kalau alarm terpicu di Zona Waspada, penjaga sekitar akan datang. Gunakan Diting untuk mengungkap wujudnya.
target: A type of optically concealed alarm device. If the alarm is triggered in the guard zone, nearby guards will be alerted. Use Diting to probe its exact shape.

source: Sekarang kamu sudah tahu cara menggunakan "Clockwork"! Ayo coba ubah emosi orang lain! Setiap emosi yang berbeda memiliki kejutan yang berbeda!
target: Now you know how to use Clockwork! Go try changing someone's emotions! Different emotions bring different surprises!

source: Selain itu, dalam sesi "Rapat Makan Malam" saat piket, kamu dapat memilih untuk menyerahkan laporan piket dan memperoleh tambahan "Dana Express" berdasarkan perolehan Skor Pom-Pom.
target: At the same time, during the Dinner Meeting phase of every duty period, you can choose to submit the Duty Reports and additionally obtain Express Funds based on the score from Pom-Pom.

source: Selain itu, edit tim yang dilakukan dengan sudut pandang yang berbeda adalah bersifat independen/terpisah. Tapi tetap berbagi efek status, HP, Poin Technique, dll. yang sama.
target: Moreover, team lineups across different POVs are independent of each other but share their Status Effects, HP, Technique Points, etc.

source: Selain itu, kamu juga bisa menyelesaikan Misi Harian untuk mendapatkan hadiah yang sesuai.
target: Aside from that, you can also complete Daily Missions to obtain corresponding rewards.

source: Selain itu, masih ada sebuah Cermin Mimpi yang bisa bergeser dan bisa menyalin jalur di hadapan cermin. Setelah jalur menuju Gir terbentuk, Clockie akan secara otomatis mengumpulkan Gir. Kumpulkan semua Gir untuk menyelesaikan perbaikan.
target: In addition, there is a movable Dream Mirror that replicates existing paths. Once a pathway to a gear is complete, Clockie will automatically collect the gear. Collect all the gears to complete the repair.

source: Selain itu, melancarkan Serangan Balasan, memberikan efek Keracunan atau Duri, dan tindakan lainnya juga dapat memberikan Poin Taktik.
target: Additionally, performing Counters, inflicting Poison and Thorns, and other such actions may also grant Tactics Points.

source: Selain mengundang teman, kamu juga bisa mengundang karakter lain untuk menantang musuh kuat bersama.
target: Besides inviting Friends, you can also invite other characters to take on formidable foes.

source: Selain menyelesaikan Misi Trailblaze untuk melanjutkan cerita, misi lain juga dapat ditemukan selama eksplorasi.
target: Aside from completing Trailblaze Missions to progress the storyline, other missions can also be encountered in the exploration.

source: Selama "Tahap Ketangguhan 4: Power Awoken", kamu akan memperoleh 1 lapis Buff setiap kali HP bertambah atau berkurang 1.500 poin. Maksimal 99 lapis.
target: During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," every 1500 of HP increase or decrease grants 1 stack of buffs, up to 99 stacks.

source: Selama Aha Instant, Elation Skill selalu hanya dapat melancarkan serangan pada target musuh di medan tempur sekunder.
target: During Aha Instants, Elation Skills can only attack enemy targets on the sub-field.

source: Selama Rapat Makan Malam, kamu dapat memperoleh "Blueprint Pembangunan" dan "Dekorasi". "Blueprint Pembangunan" dapat membuka proyek renovasi di dalam area, dan "Dekorasi" dapat ditempatkan di berbagai lokasi dalam Kustomisasi Dekorasi.
target: You can obtain Construction Blueprints and Decorations during Dinner Meeting. Construction Blueprints can unlock renovation projects in the area, and Decorations can be placed in different areas across the room based on your choice.

source: Selama bertualang, kamu akan bertemu dengan berbagai macam musuh, mereka semua memiliki Weakness yang beragam. Manfaatkan Tipe serangan yang serupa dengan Weakness musuh untuk menyerang dan mengurangi Toughness musuh.
target: You will encounter all kinds of enemies during your adventure. Each of them has Weaknesses that can be exploited to reduce their Toughness by using attacks of the same Type.

source: Selama event Permainan Berburu Bintang berlangsung, kamu bisa mendapatkan Grafiti dan mengaktifkan Simbol Grafiti setelah menyelesaikan misi bersama Punklorde Mentality pada Mode Cerita.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete the Companion Mission Punklorde Mentality in Story Mode to receive graffitis, and activate graffiti markers.

source: Selama event Permainan Berburu Bintang berlangsung, kamu bisa mendapatkan hadiah tambahan dengan cara menyelesaikan Sektor Tersegel pada tingkat kesulitan yang ditentukan.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete Sealed Sectors at designated difficulties to receive extra rewards.

source: Selama event Permainan Berburu Bintang berlangsung, selesaikan Tantangan Arkade untuk mendapatkan Always Smiling yang bisa ditukarkan dengan hadiah material Superimpose di toko event.
target: During the Starhunt Game event, complete the Arcade Challenge to receive Always Smiling, which is used to exchange for rewards such as Superimposition materials in the event shop.

source: Selama latihan pedang, March 7th dapat memperoleh bantuan dari rekan-rekan, yang bisa meningkatkan efisiensi latihan dan Melancong.
target: During sword training, March 7th can receive assistance from companions, enhancing the efficiency of her Training and Excursions.

source: Selama latihan, ada kemungkinan akan terpicu inspirasi dadakan, yang menggandakan efek peningkatan stats dari latihan kali ini.
target: During training, Epiphany Flare may be triggered, doubling the stats gain for that session.

source: Selama menjelajahi Permukaan Biasa, toko di "Zona — Istirahat" adalah Toko Khusus, yang akan menyediakan fitur toko yang berbeda-beda.
target: During exploration of Ordinary Planes, stores in "Domain — Respite" are all Special Stores that provide different store functions.

source: Selama pelatihan staf, kamu dapat merekrut lebih banyak staf peri.
target: During staff training, you can recruit more fairy staff members

source: Selama penjelajahan, terkadang kamu bisa menemukan Debu Memori Emas, yang menandakan bahwa target berada di tempat tersebut, tapi di ruang-waktu yang berbeda.
target: You may discover Golden Memory Dust when exploring, indicating that the target is located here in the other space-time.

source: Selama pertandingan, pemain dapat menggunakan item arena untuk memengaruhi pertandingan. Setelah menggunakan item apa pun, semua item akan memasuki cooldown.
target: During the match, players can use arena items to influence the game. After using any item, all items will enter cooldown.

source: Selama pertandingan, selesaikan aksi pertempuran yang ditentukan dan picu "Momen Puncak" untuk membuat "Poin Atmosfer" rekan tim meningkat dalam jumlah besar.
target: Complete designated combat actions and achieve Highlights during the matches to gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Selama pertempuran di Simulated Universe, aktif mengonsumsi Energy mungkin akan memicu Path Resonance yang akan memberikan buff dalam pertempuran.
target: During combat in the Simulated Universe, actively consuming Energy might lead to Path Resonance, which will earn you a buff in combat.

source: Selama pertempuran, Trotter mungkin akan salah masuk ke pertempuran karena tersesat. Kalahkan Trotter sebelum Trotter melarikan diri, agar kamu bisa mendapatkan material tambahan yang dijatuhkan oleh musuh lain.
target: During battle, Trotters might accidentally enter the battle as a result of being lost. Defeat the Trotter before they run away to obtain bonus rewards dropped from other enemies.

source: Selama progres piket, kamu akan menemui tiga jenis Kartu Aksi: Biasa, Langka, dan Khusus. "Kartu Aksi Langka" dapat memberikan lebih banyak EXP Piket dan Dana Express; "Kartu Aksi Khusus" dapat memberikan berbagai efek spesial.
target: During the duty periods, you will encounter three types of Action Cards: "Normal," "Rare," and "Special." Rare Action Cards grant more Duty Experience and Express Funds, while Special Action Cards provide various special effects.

source: Selama proses penjelajahan, kamu akan menemukan berbagai macam gameplay, semua gameplay itu akan dicatat di Pojok Nostalgia supaya kamu bisa melihat dan mengakses dengan lebih cepat.
target: You will encounter different kinds of gameplay as you explore. These gameplays will be recorded in Conventional Memoir for faster review and access.

source: Selama tantangan "Konversi Luapan", kamu dapat memperoleh Data Konversi dengan mengurangi HP musuh.
target: During Excessive Conversion, reduce the enemy's HP to obtain Conversion Data.

source: Selama tong sampah melakukan Gerakan Khusus, ambil foto untuk memperoleh ekstra Skor Potret.
target: Take the picture during the Special Action to obtain extra Capture Scores.

source: Selecciona hasta 4 encargos, las recompensas se acumularán automáticamente cada hora según los encargos elegidos.
target: After assignments (up to 4) are added, the rewards based on the selected assignments will be automatically accumulated per hour.

source: Selecciona la comida correspondiente según las indicaciones del cliente para completar el pedido.
target: Select food items according to customers' requirements to complete the order

source: Selecciona los capítulos bloqueados para ver los requisitos para desbloquearlos.
target: Select the locked chapters to view the requirements to unlock them

source: Selecionar Alvo
target: Select Target

source: Selecione a arena do desafio 1
target: Select the challenge arena 1

source: Selecione a arena do desafio 2
target: Select the challenge arena 2

source: Selecione amigos designados para presentear ou solicitar fragmentos específicos de Cartão de Memória. Participe disso todos os dias para obter Moedas de Nova Jogada.
target: Select designated friends to gift or request specific Memory Card fragments. Participate in this every day to obtain reroll coins.

source: Selecione mercadorias para fazer uma organização rápida. Arraste e rotacione as mercadorias para mudar suas posições
target: Select goods to perform rapid arrangement. Drag or rotate the goods to change their positions

source: Selecione mercadorias para fazer uma organização rápida. Segure ou gire as mercadorias para mudar de posição.
target: Select goods to perform rapid arrangement. Drag or rotate the goods to change their positions.

source: Selecione o botão de Abrir Fogo e Hanu irá atirar para o outro canto das pistas. Se o ataque atingir um oponente ou obstáculo, ele acionará uma Cena de Ação e você entrará em um curto período de invencibilidade.
target: Select the Fire button and Hanu will fire toward the other side of the tracks. If the attack hits an opponent or an obstacle, it will trigger an Action Scene and you will enter a short period of invulnerability.

source: Selecione o ícone de ponto de referência e clique em Iniciar Navegação, e o Visco voará automaticamente até o ponto de referência selecionado e pousará.
target: Select the waypoint icon and click Start Cruise, and the Mistletoe will automatically fly to and land at the selected waypoint.

source: Selecione os alimentos de acordo com as exigências dos clientes para concluir o pedido
target: Select food items according to customers' requirements to complete the order

source: Selecione os capítulos bloqueados para visualizar os requisitos de desbloqueio
target: Select the locked chapters to view the requirements to unlock them

source: Selecione os marcadores de grafite para iniciar uma análise de Cone de Luz. Conclua a análise para obter o Cone de Luz Antes do Início da Missão do Tutorial.
target: Select the graffiti markers to perform Light Cone analysis. Complete the analysis to obtain the Light Cone Before the Tutorial Mission Starts.

source: Selecione um inimigo comum com PV baixos e use a habilidade de Dano de alvo único nele. Após derrotar o inimigo, causa um Dano de alvo único com altos multiplicadores ao chefe com base no Dano Sobressalente causado à unidade derrotada.
target: Select a non-boss enemy with low HP and use single-target DMG ability on it. After defeating the enemy, deals single-target DMG with huge multipliers to the boss based on the Overflow DMG dealt to the defeated unit.

source: Selecione uma Carta de Ação para avançar sua agenda de serviços, aumente o Nível de Serviços dos membros correspondentes, e obtenha Fundos do Expresso.
target: Select an Action Card to progress your duty schedule, raise the corresponding member's Duty Level, and obtain Express Funds.

source: Selecione uma Carta de Ação, progrida em sua agenda de serviços, aumente o Nível de Serviços dos seus membros, e apresente seus Relatórios de Serviço na Reunião do Jantar para ganhar Fundos do Expresso ao final do dia!
target: Select an Action Card, progress your duty schedule, raise your members' Duty Level, and submit your Duty Reports at the Dinner Meeting to gain Express Funds when the day ends!

source: Selesaikan "Perjalanan Seorang Pahlawan" bersama dengan Tuan Xiyan untuk memperbanyak kemampuan Templat Protagonis.
target: Follow Mr. Xiyan and complete the Hero's Journey to unlock new abilities for the Protagonist Model.

source: Selesaikan Apocalyptic Shadow Tingkat Kesulitan 3 untuk membuka Mode Nyala Bintang. Untuk menyelesaikan Tingkat Kesulitan 4 di Mode Nyala Bintang, kamu perlu menantang 3 node.
target: Clear Apocalyptic Shadow Difficulty 3 to unlock Starward Mode. Clearing Starward Mode Difficulty 4 requires challenging 3 Nodes.

source: Selesaikan Event Jalanan yang ditentukan untuk menciptakan Keuntungan Rute baru di jaringan logistik agar dapat memperoleh Skor Logistik yang lebih tinggi.
target: Complete specific Streetside Events to generate new route advantages in the courier network and obtain higher logistic score

source: Selesaikan Forgotten Hall dan capai persyaratan yang ditentukan untuk mendapatkan bintang. Setelah mengumpulkan jumlah bintang yang ditentukan, kamu dapat mengambil "Hadiah Bintang".
target: Clear Forgotten Hall and meeting specific conditions to obtain Marks of Starre. A Mark Gift can be obtained after collecting enough Marks of Starre.

source: Selesaikan Jalan Pathstrider di "Path Space" untuk meningkatkan poin "Jejak Interelasi".
target: Complete the Trail of Pathstrider in the Path Space to increase Communing Trail points

source: Selesaikan Penataan Barang di kargo Starskiff dan selesaikan Target Pesanan untuk memperoleh dana Serikat Dagang.
target: Complete Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and reach shipping targets to earn Merchant Guild's funds

source: Selesaikan Pure Fiction dan capai skor yang ditentukan untuk memperoleh "Bintang Cerita" dan mengambil "Hadiah Cerita".
target: Once you have cleared Pure Fiction and earned enough points, you will receive Story Stars and Story Rewards.

source: Selesaikan Stage 11 Forgotten Hall untuk membuka Mode Nyala Bintang. Untuk menyelesaikan Stage 12 di Mode Nyala Bintang, kamu perlu menantang 3 node.
target: Clear Stage 11 of Forgotten Hall to unlock Starward Mode. Clearing Stage 12 in Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes.

source: Selesaikan Stage 3 Pure Fiction untuk membuka Mode Nyala Bintang. Untuk menyelesaikan Stage 4 di Mode Nyala Bintang, kamu perlu menantang 3 node.
target: Clear Stage 3 of Pure Fiction to unlock Starward Mode. Clearing Stage 4 in Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes.

source: Selesaikan berbagai misi di Perang Aetherium untuk meningkatkan Victory Rating dan memperoleh hadiah.
target: Complete various missions in Aetherium Wars to raise your Victory Rating and unlock rewards

source: Selesaikan lebih banyak stage atau capai level yang lebih tinggi di Raid untuk meningkatkan efisiensi AFK.
target: Complete more stages or reach higher levels in Raids to boost your idle efficiency.

source: Selesaikan misi, stage Calyx, dan Simulated Universe untuk meningkatkan Level Trailblaze.
target: Completing missions, clearing Calyxes, and trying out Simulated Universe are all great ways to increase your Trailblaze Level.

source: Selesaikan tantangan Suara Genderang Perang dengan mengalahkan target musuh dalam jumlah putaran tertentu. Sebelum pertempuran dimulai, HP, Poin Skill, dan Energy penantang akan dipulihkan hingga jumlah tertentu.
target: Defeat enemies within specified number of Cycles to complete the Stellar Flare challenge. Before the start of each battle, your HP, Skill Points, and Energy will be restored to a specified amount.

source: Selesaikan target tantangan atau tingkatkan level reputasi untuk memperoleh "Kotak Peralatan Cuit-Cuit" yang diperlukan untuk memperkuat item tempur.
target: Complete the challenge goal or increase Reputation Rank to obtain the "Tweet-Tweet Toolbox" needed to enhance battle items.

source: Selesaikan target tantangan dari 2 gelombang pertama dalam tantangan "Konversi Luapan" untuk memperoleh Peti Harta. Semakin banyak target tantangan yang tercapai, semakin melimpah hadiahnya.
target: In Excessive Conversion Challenge, complete the challenge goals of the first two waves to obtain treasure chests. The more challenge goals you complete, the better the rewards.

source: Selesaikan target tantangan untuk memperoleh Peti Harta. Semakin banyak target tantangan yang tercapai, semakin melimpah hadiahnya.
target: Complete the challenge goals to obtain treasure chests. The more challenge goals you complete, the better the rewards.

source: Seltene Ausrüstung: Edelstein des Wohlstands
target: Rare Equipment: Wealth Gem

source: Seltene Ausrüstung: Emblem
target: Rare Equipment: Emblem

source: Seltene Ausrüstung: Exquisite Ausrüstung
target: Rare Equipment: Privileged Equipment

source: Seltene Ausrüstung: Roter und Blauer Edelstein
target: Rare Equipment: Red Gem and Blue Gem

source: Seltenes Synthesematerial, verwendbar für: Synthese verschiedener Bindungsembleme zur Erhöhung der Anzahl der Bindungsmitglieder. Synthese von Reichtumsjuwelen zur Erweiterung der maximalen Teamgröße.
target: Rare synthesis material, usable for: Synthesizing various Bond Emblems to increase the number of members in a Bond. Synthesizing Wealth Gems to increase the team size limit.

source: Seltsamer Kristall
target: Strange Crystal

source: Seluruh pertempuran akan bergilir antara Siang dan Malam.
target: The entire battle will cycle between Day and Night.

source: Seluruh rekan tim akan dipisahkan untuk bertarung di dua medan pertempuran. Rekan tim dan target musuh di medan pertempuran yang berbeda tidak dapat menyerang target di medan pertempuran lain.
target: All ally targets are split between two battlefields. Ally and enemy targets cannot attack targets on a different battlefield.

source: Seluruh rekan tim akan dipisahkan untuk bertarung di medan tempur utama dan medan tempur sekunder. Di luar Aha Instant, rekan tim dan target musuh di medan tempur yang berbeda tidak dapat menyerang target di medan tempur lain.
target: All ally targets will battle on the prime-field and sub-field respectively. Outside of Aha Instants, ally and enemy targets on different fields cannot attack targets on the other field.

source: Semakin banyak DMG yang diakibatkan dalam waktu terbatas, semakin berlimpah juga hadiah yang diperoleh.
target: The more DMG you deal within the time limit, the greater the rewards.

source: Semakin banyak lapisan "Toxic", semakin tinggi CRIT DMG yang diterima. Saat menyerang musuh yang memiliki 4 lapis "Toxic", juga akan memicu DoT pada musuh tersebut dan target di sekitarnya.
target: The higher the "Toxic" stacks are, the higher the CRIT DMG taken becomes. When attacking enemies with 4 stacks of "Toxic," you can also trigger DoT on the target and adjacent targets.

source: Semakin banyak stage yang terbuka, semakin banyak "Komedian" akan ikut tampil dalam pertunjukan. Komedian di tim akan memasukkan "Hadiah Kejutan" yang berbeda ke dalam "Kotak Kejutan" untuk memberikan berbagai bantuan dalam pertempuran.
target: As you unlock more stages, more Comedians will join the show. The Comedian in your team will put different Surprise Gifts into the Surprise Box, providing various benefits in combat.

source: Semakin banyak tong sampah kecil, ATK dan Pengurangan Toughness akan semakin tinggi. Saat tong sampah kecil menyerang musuh, ia akan memulihkan Energy dalam jumlah besar untuk penyihir.
target: The more minicans, the higher the ATK and Toughness Reduction. When minicans attack enemies, they will also regenerate a massive amount of energy for the Magician.

source: Semakin tinggi Break Effect karakter, maka semakin tinggi juga Break DMG yang diakibatkannya.
target: The higher the character's Break Effect, the greater the Break DMG dealt becomes.

source: Semakin tinggi Efisiensi dan Stamina Chimera, maka kemampuan kerjanya juga lebih tinggi.
target: The higher a chimera's efficiency and stamina, the greater its work capacity.

source: Semakin tinggi Level Piket anggota, semakin tinggi pula Skor Dasar laporan piket mereka.
target: The higher your members' Duty Level, the higher the base score of their corresponding Duty Report will be as well.

source: Semakin tinggi Peningkatan Ilmu Pedang March 7th, maka akan semakin mudah baginya untuk melewati Ujian Pedang. Setelah lulus Ujian Pedang, stats akan meningkat dan emosi akan pulih.
target: The higher March 7th's Swordart Ascension ranks, the easier it will be to pass the trial. Successfully completing the trial will enhance her stats and restore her Mood.

source: Semakin tinggi kualitas Blessing, semakin banyak Heat yang dibutuhkan untuk peningkatan.
target: The rarer the Blessing, the more Heat is required to enhance it.

source: Sempre que 3 Bombas Bombásticas forem eliminadas, recupera aleatoriamente 1 contagem de uso de item em 1.
target: Every time 3 Super Bombs are eliminated, randomly recover 1 item's usage count by 1.

source: Sempre que Qingque vence um novo oponente em um jogo de fliperama, ela acumula reputação. Novas funções e novos itens de combate serão desbloqueados à medida que seu Nível de Reputação aumenta.
target: Whenever Qingque wins against a new opponent in an arcade game, she will accumulate reputation. More new functions and new battle items will become available with a higher Reputation Rank.

source: Sempre que Qingque vence um novo oponente em um jogo de fliperama, ela acumula reputação. Novas funções serão desbloqueadas à medida que seu Nível de Reputação aumenta.
target: Whenever Qingque wins against a new opponent in an arcade game, she will accumulate reputation. More new functions will become available with a higher Reputation Rank.

source: Sempre que uma certa quantidade de Bananas for eliminada, ativa aleatoriamente uma detonação em forma de cruz no tabuleiro.
target: Every time a certain amount of Bananas are cleared, randomly triggers cross-shaped detonation on the board.

source: Sempre que uma certa quantidade de Kiwis for eliminada, desencadeia aleatoriamente uma detonação em quadrados 2x2 no tabuleiro.
target: Every time a certain amount of Kiwifruits are cleared, randomly triggers 2×2 square detonation on the board.

source: Sempre que uma certa quantidade de Morangos for eliminada, transforma aleatoriamente uma certa quantidade de frutas no tabuleiro em Bombas de Linha. Ao serem eliminadas, Bombas de Linha podem detonar uma linha ou uma coluna.
target: Every time a certain amount of Strawberries are cleared, randomly transforms a certain amount of fruits on the board to Line Bombs. When cleared, Line Bombs can detonate a row or a column.

source: Sempre que uma certa quantidade de Pêssegos for eliminada, transforma aleatoriamente uma certa quantidade de frutas no tabuleiro em Bombas Quadradas. Ao serem eliminadas, Bombas Quadradas podem detonar uma área quadrada de 3×3.
target: Every time a certain amount of Peaches are cleared, randomly transforms a certain amount of fruits on the board to Square Bombs. When cleared, Square Bombs can detonate a 3×3 square box area.

source: Sempre que você quebrar um Cristal, a divisa da área iluminada diminui. Use essa propriedade para concluir o teste.
target: Each time you break a Crystal, the boundary of the lit area shrinks. Use this property to complete the trial.

source: Sempre que você reforjar um Cristal, os limites da área iluminada se expandem. Use essa propriedade para concluir o teste.
target: Every time you reforge a Crystal, the boundaries of the lit area will expand. Use this property to complete the trial.

source: Semua
target: All

source: Semua Zona di dalam permukaan ini adalah "Zona — Event" (selain "Zona — Boss"). Kamu dapat memperoleh Blessing tambahan setelah menyelesaikan Event.
target: All domains in this plane are Domain — Occurrence (except Domain — Boss). Additional Blessing can be obtained after completing Occurrences.

source: Semua jenis Blessing event waktu terbatas untuk setiap Path yang bersangkutan bisa diperoleh di permukaan ini.
target: All kinds of event-limited Blessings corresponding to each Path can be obtained in this plane.

source: Semua memori akan disimpan di sini berdasarkan urutan titik waktu masing-masing. Sudut pandang yang berbeda tetap mengikuti pengurutan yang sama.
target: All memories are stored here in chronological order based on their own timestamps. Even different points of view follow the same sequential order.

source: Semua musuh di setiap gelombang akan berbagi HP.
target: All enemies in each wave have Shared HP.

source: Senda secreta de Jano I
target: Janus's Hidden Passage (I)

source: Senda secreta de Jano II
target: Janus's Hidden Passage (II)

source: Senda secreta de Jano III
target: Janus's Hidden Passage (III)

source: Seorang "pemandu" wispae tanpa nama akan berjaga di dekat konsol game "Kelinci Rel Bintang". Jika masih ada wispae tanpa nama yang belum ditemukan di area ini, kamu bisa menyerahkan Koin Piksel agar si pemandu bantu menunjukkan lokasinya.
target: A Nameless Wispae Guide is stationed near the Star Rabbit Game Console. If there are still undiscovered nameless wispae in the area, you can submit "Pixcoin" to have the Guide point out their locations.

source: Separación inversa
target: Inverted Severance

source: Seperti yang Kutulis
target: As I've Written

source: Sepertinya ada sepasang operator kereta tambang yang kesulitan di Great Mine. Ayo bantu mereka dorong kereta tambang agar bisa tiba di penghenti kereta yang ditentukan. Mungkin saja kamu akan memperoleh kejutan tidak terduga.
target: A mine cart operator and his apprentice seem to be having a bit of trouble in the Great Mine... Help them push the mine carts to the designated blockers, and you may find something of interest.

source: Serang musuh beberapa kali dan hapus "Barrier" untuk memicu "Momen Puncak" dan memperoleh "Poin Atmosfer" dalam jumlah besar.
target: Attack enemies multiple times, dispel the Barriers, and trigger Highlights to gain massive Vibes.

source: Serangan Beruntun pada musuh ini akan menghancurkan "War Armor" miliknya dan mengalahkannya.
target: Consecutive attacks on this enemy will destroy their "War Armor" and defeat them.

source: Serangan Kelemahan: Panduan Bermain
target: Weakness Assault: Gameplay Details

source: Serangan Lanjutan
target: Follow-Up ATK

source: Serangan Support yang dipanggil karakter "Rekan Perintisan" memiliki efek spesial
target: Support attacks beckoned by "Trailblaze Companions" characters have special effects

source: Serangan dengan Tipe apa pun dapat menambahkan Weakness dengan Tipe yang sesuai pada musuh ini.
target: Attacks of any Type can implant a Weakness of the corresponding Type on this enemy.

source: Serangan kali ini mengurangi Nilai Dasar Toughness musuh.
target: The Base Value of how much enemy Toughness is reduced by this attack.

source: Seret anjing laut kecil untuk melancarkan tembakan. Saat menabrak, ia akan mengakibatkan DMG pada musuh sesuai dengan ATK.
target: Drag a baby seal to launch it. Colliding with enemies deals damage based on ATK.

source: Seret barang untuk mengantarnya kepada asisten yang sesuai, dan kamu akan menerima hadiah Pesan Antar. Hadiah termasuk: Koin Emas dalam jumlah besar, Berlian, serta Tiket Masuk dan item langka lainnya.
target: Drag cargo and hand them off to the corresponding assistant to claim Express Rewards. Rewards include rare items such as lots of gold coins, diamonds, and Entry Tickets.

source: Seret ke equipment lanjutan untuk menaikkan level equipment tersebut, memperoleh equipment keistimewaan dengan nama yang sama, dan meningkatkan stats serta efek spesial secara signifikan.
target: Drag onto a piece of advanced equipment to upgrade it, obtaining the privileged equipment of the same name, which greatly enhances the equipment's stat values and special effects.

source: Seret ke equipment untuk mendapatkan equipment lain dengan kualitas yang sama secara acak.
target: Drag onto the equipment to randomly re-obtain another piece of equipment of the same quality.

source: Seret ke karakter untuk memilih 1 dari 4 equipment lanjutan yang direkomendasikan untuk karakter tersebut.
target: Drag onto the character to choose and obtain 1 of the 4 pieces of advanced equipment from that character's recommended equipment list.

source: Seret ke karakter untuk memperoleh satu salinan 1★ dari karakter tersebut.
target: Drag onto the character to obtain a 1-star duplicate of that character.

source: Seret ke karakter untuk mengatur ulang semua equipment yang dikenakan oleh karakter tersebut.
target: Drag onto the character to randomly reroll all pieces of equipment on that character.

source: Seret ke karakter, pilih 1 equipment lanjutan yang telah dikenakan untuk ditingkatkan menjadi equipment keistimewaan.
target: Drag onto the character to select and upgrade 1 piece of advanced equipment that the character is already wearing to privileged equipment.

source: Seret layar untuk memutar sudut pandang. Seret joystick di sudut kiri bawah untuk menggeser tampilan layar. Tekan tombol reset di pojok kanan bawah untuk mereset sudut pandang.
target: Drag the screen to rotate the camera. Drag the joystick at the button left to move the image. Press the reset button in the bottom right corner to reset your camera.

source: Seria difícil alcançar a Bailu com ela fugindo no Labirinto Ilusório. Nós só podemos fazê-la correr para a matriz da Cabaça de Lunaumbra.
target: It would be difficult to catch up to Bailu as she flees in the Illusory Maze. We can only drive Bailu to run into the Lunaumbra Gourd's matrix.

source: Sering-sering perhatikan orang-orang yang seperti ini! Setelah kamu memperbaiki mereka, kamu bisa memperoleh kejutan tambahan loh!
target: Pay lots of attention to these people! You'll receive additional surprises once you've fixed all of them, tick tock!

source: Serpihan Kristal Memori
target: Memory Crystal Shard

source: Sessão de Fotos de Várias Condições
target: Multi-Conditional Photoshoot

source: Sessões de Arte da Espada
target: Swordplay Sessions

source: Sesuaikan emosi saat ini menggunakan 2 tombol di kedua sisi!
target: The current Emotion can be tuned via the buttons on the two sides!

source: Setelah Aha beraksi, memperoleh sejumlah Punchline berdasarkan jumlah karakter Path "Elation".
target: After Aha takes action, gains a certain amount of Punchline based on the number of Elation characters present.

source: Setelah Bro Hanu memperoleh Bazoka Hanu, kaki tangan Bos Stone akan berada dalam masalah besar! Setelah membidik musuh, tekan tombol serang untuk menggunakan "Misil Hanu" dan konsumsi amunisi untuk mengalahkan musuh.
target: Boss Stone's minions will experience true calamity when Hanu gets his Hanu Launcher! After taking aim at an enemy, hitting the fire button will unleash the Hanu Rocket and consume ammunition.

source: Setelah EXP Bidak penuh, level bintang akan meningkat dan memberikan efek tempur yang lebih kuat
target: When pieces' EXP is full, their star rating increases, providing stronger combat effects

source: Setelah Energy karakter penuh, kamu dapat melancarkan Ultimate. Ultimate dapat dilancarkan kapan pun, memicu 1 kali aksi tambahan.
target: Ultimates can be used when a character's Energy is fully charged. Ultimates can be unleashed at any time as an extra action.

source: Setelah Energy karakter penuh, karakter dapat melancarkan Ultimate. Ultimate dapat dilancarkan kapan saja. Manfaatkanlah Ultimate sebaik-baiknya untuk memperoleh lebih banyak kesempatan beraksi.
target: Ultimates can be used when a character's Energy is fully charged. Ultimates can be unleashed at any time. Use it at the right moment to give you more actions.

source: Setelah Feixiao menggunakan Technique, akan memberikan efek peningkatan Movement SPD dan menarik musuh. Semakin banyak musuh yang tertarik, maka saat memasuki pertempuran, DMG akan semakin tinggi.
target: After Feixiao uses her Technique, she grants herself a movement speed boost and will pull enemies along her as she travels. The more enemies are pulled, the higher the DMG upon entering battle.

source: Setelah Hari Pameran dimulai, event Pesan Antar Pom-Pom akan muncul secara berkala. Menyelesaikan Pesan Antar Pom-Pom akan mempercepat progres Hari Pameran.
target: After the Exhibition Day starts, the Pom-Pom Delivery event will appear periodically. Completing Pom-Pom Delivery will advance the Exhibition Day progress.

source: Setelah Level Trailblaze meningkat, kamu dapat mengambil hadiah level dari kondektur Pom-Pom.
target: As Trailblaze Level increases, you can claim corresponding rewards from Pom-Pom, the Express' conductor.

source: Setelah Penyihir melancarkan Ultimate, tong sampah kecil akan berevolusi maksimal hingga menjadi wujud Emas Super. Setelah berevolusi, ATK tong sampah kecil akan meningkat pesat dan meningkatkan DMG Serangan Lanjutan seluruh rekan tim.
target: After the Magician uses their Ultimate, the minicans will evolve, up to the Ultra Gold form at max. After evolution, greatly increases minicans' ATK and increases all allies' Follow-Up ATK DMG.

source: Setelah aksi kamu dan rekanmu berakhir, dadu di zona sendiri baru bisa digunakan untuk memfinalisasi DMG terhadap musuh kuat.
target: After you and your teammates have both finished taking actions, the dice in your pool will be used to deal DMG to the formidable foe.

source: Setelah beraksi, anjing laut yang berhenti di Zona Aksi Ekstra dapat memperoleh aksi tambahan. Ini hanya dapat dipicu 1 kali setiap putaran.
target: If a baby seal stops in an Extra Action Zone after taking action, it gets an extra action. This can only be triggered 1 time per round.

source: Setelah berinteraksi dengan Perangkat Kontrol, Modul Mimpi terkait dan Jalur Lintasannya akan ditampilkan dengan jelas.
target: After interacting with the Control Panel, the corresponding Dream Modules and their trajectory will be highlighted.

source: Setelah berinteraksi dengan Perangkat Penyembuh, gunakan Cosmic Fragment untuk reset RAM, dan segera memulihkan HP karakter gugur dalam jumlah tertentu.
target: After interacting with the Reviver, you can use Cosmic Fragments to reset RAM, revive downed characters, and restore a certain amount of HP to them.

source: Setelah berinteraksi dengan perangkat ini, tampilan Modul Mimpi dan jalur lintasan yang sesuai akan disorot.
target: Interacting with this device highlights the corresponding Dream Modules and their trajectory.

source: Setelah berkembang, kemampuan serangan Trailblazer akan memperoleh peningkatan yang signifikan!
target: After Growing, the Trailblazer's attack capabilities will be greatly enhanced!

source: Setelah bintang karakter naik, selain memperoleh peningkatan stats, efek Pemberdayaan Karakter juga akan diperkuat. Contoh: Dr. Ratio dapat melemparkan kapur tulis secara beruntun untuk menyerang musuh dalam pertempuran.
target: After a character is upgraded, besides gaining stat increases, their Character Empowerment effects will also be enhanced. For example: Dr. Ratio can consecutively throw chalks to attack enemies in combat.

source: Setelah cahaya mutiara menyinari lokasi yang ditentukan, cobalah gunakan Buku Keajaiban untuk melintasi ruang-waktu. Mungkin akan ada penemuan baru.
target: After shining the orb's light to a specific location, try to traverse the space-time via the Tome of Miracles. There might be new discoveries to be found.

source: Setelah dibuka, mereka dapat dibeli di toko, dinaikkan bintang, dan dikenakan equipment seperti staf lainnya dalam ronde tersebut, serta memiliki Ikatan yang dimiliki sebelumnya.
target: Once unlocked, they'll function just like any other staff member in this round. You can buy them from the Store, upgrade their stars, equip them with gear, and they'll retain any Bonds they had before.

source: Setelah hari pameran dimulai, Event Tamu akan muncul setiap beberapa saat. Menyelesaikan Event Tamu akan mempercepat progres Hari Pameran.
target: After the Exhibition Day starts, Guest Occurrences will appear periodically. Completing Guest Occurrences will advance the Exhibition Day.

source: Setelah ingenium melewati balok tekanan, balok tekanan akan berubah menjadi hambatan.
target: After the ingenium passes by a pressure plate, the plate will be turned into an obstacle

source: Setelah ingenium melewati balok tekanan, balok tekanan akan berubah menjadi hambatan.
target: After the ingenium passes by a pressure plate, the plate will be turned into an obstacle.

source: Setelah karakter kedua dalam lineup tim melancarkan Ultimate, akan membantu Charge Energy karakter pertama, dan meningkatkan DMG serangan yang berikutnya dari karakter pertama dalam lineup tim.
target: After the ally positioned second in the Team Lineup uses their Ultimate, regenerates Energy for the ally positioned first, and increases their next attack's DMG.

source: Setelah karakter melancarkan Ultimate, Aksi didahulukan 100%. Kamu dapat memanfaatkan Ultimate untuk membuat karakter yang sama terus-menerus beraksi.
target: After characters cast their Ultimates, their actions are Advanced Forward by 100%. You can use Ultimates to make the same character act consecutively.

source: Setelah karakter tim melancarkan Skill, dia akan memulihkan Poin Skill dan meningkatkan batas maksimum Poin Skill, serta meningkatkan DMG.
target: After an ally character uses a Skill, they recover Skill Points, increase Max Skill Points, and increase DMG.

source: Setelah kartu karakter dilapisi dengan foil hingga tingkat kelangkaan tertinggi, tampilan kartu akan memiliki tekstur hologram.
target: After you Gild a Character Card to maximum Rarity, the card's appearance will gain a holographic texture.

source: Setelah keempat patung di ruang-waktu malam diaktifkan, kamu dapat membuka segel keilahian Nikador dan melanjutkan alur cerita.
target: After all four statues in the Night space-time are activated, you can break the shackles on Nikador's divinity and advance the story.

source: Setelah kembali ke Express, akan ada kesempatan untuk bertemu dengan mereka.
target: You might run into them after returning to the Express.

source: Setelah lampu dinyalakan, area termal berbentuk lingkaran akan tercipta. Area termal tersebut akan menyalakan area lampu lain yang belum dinyalakan.
target: When a lamp is ignited, it will create a a spherical thermal area that can ignite all other unlit lamps within its boundaries

source: Setelah melakukan pemesanan, dapur akan menyiapkan makanan sesuai urutan. Kamu bisa memesan lebih awal dan menyimpan hingga 3 porsi untuk setiap jenis hidangan.
target: After ordering, the kitchen will prepare meals in sequential order. You can order in advance, and up to 3 portions of each dish can be stored

source: Setelah melancarkan Mystic Code Konseptual apa pun, Archer dapat menghasilkan proyeksi dari Mystic Code Konseptual tersebut.
target: After Archer uses any Conceptual Mystic Code, he generates a Trace of the Conceptual Mystic Code.

source: Setelah memasuki status Ramai, semua hidangan akan mengalami peningkatan harga jual. Semakin banyak pelanggan yang dilayani secara berturut-turut, semakin besar peningkatan harga jualnya.
target: After entering Streak Fever, prices of all dishes will increase. The more customers you serve consecutively, the more the price increases

source: Setelah membuat musuh ini terkena Weakness Break dan memicu mekanisme "Targeted Break", "Buff Stage" dapat naik 1 peringkat. Seiring dengan peringkat "Buff Stage" yang naik, rating "Buff Stage" juga akan ikut naik.
target: After inflicting Weakness Break on the enemy to trigger "Targeted Break," you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: Setelah membuka bingkai percakapan, kamu dapat mengganti bingkai dan menggunakannya di fitur percakapan atau pesan
target: After unlocking chat boxes, you can change them to in the Chat and Message functions.

source: Setelah memenangkan permainan, Qingque dapat terus mengocok kartu. Setiap kali menang, akan mengisi Charge dalam jumlah besar untuk Kotak Kejutan.
target: After winning a hand, Qingque can continue to draw tiles. Each time she gains a winning hand, it provides massive Charge to the Surprise Box.

source: Setelah memenuhi semua persyaratan pemotretan, kamu dapat menekan tombol kamera untuk menyelesaikan pemotretan kali ini. Harap sebisa mungkin penuhi semua persyaratan pemotretan.
target: When all the photoshoot requirements are met, you can press the shutter to complete this shoot. Try to meet all the requirements if you can.

source: Setelah memicu mekanisme "Frenzied Absorption", "Buff Stage" dapat naik 1 peringkat. Seiring dengan peringkat "Buff Stage" yang naik, rating "Buff Stage" juga akan ikut naik.
target: After triggering "Frenzied Absorption," you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: Setelah memicu mekanisme "Solved Departure", "Buff Stage" dapat naik 1 peringkat. Seiring dengan peringkat "Buff Stage" yang naik, rating "Buff Stage" juga akan ikut naik.
target: After triggering "Solved Departure," you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: Setelah memilih Karunia tertentu, kamu dapat mengubah rasio Siang dan Malam, dan mungkin bisa membuat salah satu menjadi permanen.
target: After selecting specific Boons, you can change the ratio of Day and Night and may even be able to make one state permanent.

source: Setelah memilih Orientasi Kalkulasi, Tongkat Kuasa yang cocok dengan Orientasi yang dipilih akan memiliki peluang lebih besar untuk muncul di tantangan kali ini.
target: After selecting an Extrapolation Alignment, Scepters suited for the chosen alignment will have a higher probability of appearing in this run.

source: Setelah memiliki Punchline, Aha akan muncul di bar aksi. Semakin banyak karakter Path "Elation", SPD Aha akan semakin tinggi. Setelah Aha beraksi, seluruh Punchline akan dikonsumsi.
target: After gaining Punchline, Aha is added to the action bar. Aha's SPD increases based on the number of Elation characters present. After Aha's turn, all Punchline stacks are consumed.

source: Setelah memperoleh "Sertifikat Analis Kekuatan" dan membeli "Dadu Prismatik" baru, kamu dapat mengganti "Dadu Prismatik" yang berbeda untuk kartu karakter.
target: After obtaining the "Power Analyst Certificate" and purchasing new Prismatic Dice, you can equip different Prismatic Dice for your character cards

source: Setelah memperoleh Wallpaper Ponsel, kamu dapat mengganti wallpaper di Fitur Ponsel.
target: After obtaining Phone Wallpapers, they can be changed in the Phone function.

source: Setelah menanam penuh satu ladang dengan Labu, Buah Berduri, atau Kol Hijau, kamu akan memperoleh Tanaman Raksasa.
target: Plant Pumpkins, Quillorbs, or Greenie Cabbages in the same field fully to get a Giant Crop

source: Setelah menangkap ciptaan yang sama berulang kali sebanyak 3 kali, metode penempatan Kue Tumpuk akan terbuka.
target: Capture the same creation 3 times to unlock the Stack-a-Cake placement mode.

source: Setelah menangkap ciptaan yang sama berulang kali sebanyak 6 kali, metode penempatan Menara Meong akan terbuka.
target: After capturing the same creation 6 times, you can unlock the Meow Meow Tower placement mode.

source: Setelah mendapatkan Koin Hiburan yang cukup dan meningkatkan taman hiburan ke rating operasional yang sesuai, kamu dapat memperoleh Stellar Jade, Material Upgrade, dan hadiah lainnya.
target: Earn enough Arca Coins and raise your amusement park to the corresponding Rating to receive rewards including Stellar Jades, development materials, and more.

source: Setelah menemukan benda mencurigakan, serang benda tersebut untuk membuat reporter anjing rakun yang menyamar menampakkan wujud aslinya.
target: Attack aberrant objects to expose the mimicking furbo journalist and reveal their true form.

source: Setelah menemukan dan mengambil Kartu Pintu, pintu masuk menuju lantai berikutnya akan terbuka.
target: Upon finding and picking up the Door Card, the entrance to the next floor will be opened.

source: Setelah menerapkan panduan strategi, kamu dapat melacak equipment karakter yang direkomendasikan dalam panduan kapan saja.
target: After applying Strategy, you can track the recommended character's equipment in the strategy anytime.

source: Setelah mengakibatkan Break pada Mass-Production Machine, akan mengurangi 30% Toughness seluruh musuh saat ini, sehingga akan lebih mudah untuk mengakibatkan Break pada musuh lainnya.
target: After defeating Mass-Production Machine, all enemies will have their current Toughness reduced by 30%, making it easier to Break other enemies.

source: Setelah mengakibatkan Weakness Break pada target mana pun, efek Weakness Break yang sesuai dengan Tipe penyerang akan ditambahkan pada target dan target di sekitarnya, serta mengakibatkan DMG tambahan.
target: After inflicting Weakness Break on any target, implants Weakness of the same Type as the attacker on the target and units adjacent to the target, and additionally deals DMG to them.

source: Setelah mengalahkan musuh di Simulated Universe, kamu dapat mengonsumsi Cosmic Fragment pada saat memilih Blessing untuk me-reset Blessing yang muncul sebanyak 1 kali.
target: After defeating enemies in the Simulated Universe, you can consume Cosmic Fragments to reset the Blessing for just one time during the Blessing selection process.

source: Setelah mengalahkan musuh di Zona — Elite atau Zona — Boss, kamu dapat mengonsumsi Trailblaze Power atau menggunakan Immersifier untuk memperoleh Hadiah Immersion, termasuk Planar Ornament.
target: After defeating enemies in Domain - Elite or Domain - Boss, you can consume Trailblaze Power or Immersifiers to obtain Immersion Rewards, including Planar Ornaments.

source: Setelah mengambil inti termal, bawa inti termal dan dekati dudukan lampu untuk mengaktifkan Snowshine Lamp. Snowshine Lamp akan menghasilkan hawa panas di sekelilingnya.
target: After picking up the thermic core, approach the lamp base to activate the Snowshine Lamp, generating a thermal energy field around the lamp.

source: Setelah menggunakan Ultimate, Fiendfire akan segera berpindah menuju ke arah atas Susunan Aksi. Saat kobaran api merah hampir mencapai bagian teratas Susunan Aksi, menggunakan Ultimate dapat membuat rekan merebut Fiendfire.
target: After an Ultimate is used, Fiendfire will immediately shift towards the top of the Action Order. Using an Ultimate when the red Fiendfire is just about to reach the top of the Action Order will enable the team to capture the Fiendfire.

source: Setelah menggunakan kemampuan, akan memasuki status Kuat Perkasa dan memperoleh efek Cepat Kilat. Bertabrakan dengan mobil balap atau rintangan lain akan memperpanjang durasi.
target: After using the ability, enters an invincible state and gains a speed boost. Colliding with other racers or obstacles extends the duration.

source: Setelah menghancurkan "War Armor" musuh ini dan memicu mekanisme "Multi-Strike Shred", "Buff Stage" dapat naik 1 peringkat. Seiring dengan peringkat "Buff Stage" yang naik, rating "Buff Stage" juga akan ikut naik.
target: After destroying the enemy's "War Armor" and triggering "Multi-Strike Shred," you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: Setelah menghancurkan "War Armor" musuh ini, "Shadesever Bow" rekan tim di Bar Aksi akan segera beraksi untuk menyerang seluruh target musuh.
target: After destroying this enemy's "War Armor," the ally "Shadesever Bow" on the action bar will immediately take action and attack all enemy targets.

source: Setelah mengonfirmasi rute di atas kompas, mekanisme akan terpicu, jalan pelangi akan terbentuk di latar tempat sesuai kondisi pada kompas tersebut.
target: After confirming a route on the compass, a mechanism will be triggered. A rainbow path will be added to the map according to the specified state of the compass.

source: Setelah mengumpulkan nimfa-nimfa dari satu area, "Garmentmaker" akan mulai menafsirkan ramalan, dan mungkin akan memberikan informasi tak terduga, yang memberikan kejutan-kejutan tak terduga.
target: After collecting all the nymphs of an area, the Garmentmaker will begin deciphering the prophecy and may provide unexpected information to unknown surprises.

source: Setelah mengumpulkan stiker dalam jumlah yang ditentukan, kamu dapat mengambil hadiah progres koleksi yang sesuai di "Folder Koleksi Stiker"
target: Once you have collected the required number of stickers, you may claim progress rewards on the "Collection" page.

source: Setelah meninggalkan ruang pikiran, kamu dapat membangunkan Jam Dunia Mimpi yang sudah diperbaiki untuk memperoleh hadiah dari mereka.
target: After exiting the Emoscape, you can awaken the repaired Dream Tickers and receive gifts from them.

source: Setelah menjelajahi beberapa area tertentu, kamu dapat mengambil Misi Petualangan dari orang-orang lokal, agar kamu dapat mengenal masing-masing dunia.
target: After exploring certain areas in-depth, Adventure Missions can be received from people there, so you become more familiar with the different worlds.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan "Ujian Terakhir", Penyimpanan Data untuk tantangan kali ini tidak akan dihapus. Kamu dapat memilih Data Permukaan yang telah disimpan untuk menantang kembali "Ujian Terakhir".
target: After completing the Final Trial, the Save File for this challenge attempt will not be deleted. Planes with a Save File can be selected again to re-attempt the Final Trial.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan Misi Trailblaze, Misi Trailblaze Lanjutan, Misi Bersama bersangkutan, kamu dapat mengirim undangan ke rekan.
target: After completing related Trailblaze Missions, Trailblaze Continuances, and Companion Missions, you can send out invitations to your companions.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan Zona, sejumlah Zona akan diambil dari Antrean Kartu, pemain dapat memilih salah satunya sebagai konten Zona berikutnya. Setelah memilih, semua Zona yang ditampilkan akan masuk ke Zona Buang.
target: After completing a Domain, a certain number of Domains will be drawn from the Draw Pile. Players can select one of them as the next Domain. After making your selection, all displayed Domains will be placed in the Discard Pile.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan event "Panduan Dekorasi Rumah Alam Semesta", Trailblazer akan memiliki kamar sendiri di lantai dua "Party Car" Astral Express.
target: After completing the "Cosmic Home Décor Guide" event, Trailblazers will have their own room on the second floor of the Party Car of the Astral Express.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan pekerjaan kelima, jika Chimera dalam tim masih memiliki Stamina dan Efisiensi yang cukup, maka tugas tambahan akan terpicu.
target: After completing the fifth task, if the chimeras in the squad still have sufficient stamina and efficiency, extra assignments will be triggered.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan puzzle, objek-objek yang ada di dalam puzzle akan muncul di dalam dunia mimpi.
target: Once a puzzle is complete, the object within will appear in the Dreamscape.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan semua Stage Kuda, Raja yang kehilangan perlindungan akan melemah.
target: After clearing all Knight Stages, the King will be weakened without its guards.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan semua Stage Kuda, kekuatan Raja akan melemah. Mereset progres Stage Kuda tidak akan memengaruhi status pelemahan Raja.
target: After clearing all Knight Stages, the King will be weakened. Resetting the progress of the Knight Stages will not affect the weakened state of the King.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan semua tantangan, kamu juga akan membuka pertandingan ekshibisi untuk menantang kembali lawan tangguh yang pernah kamu temui.
target: After you complete all challenges, you will also unlock exhibition matches, which will allow you to re-challenge elite opponents that were encountered before.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan setidaknya 1 area di Simulated Universe pada siklus sebelumnya, kamu dapat memilih 1 Trailblaze Blessing ketika memasuki kembali Simulated Universe untuk memperkuat tim.
target: After completing at least one domain in the Simulated Universe in the last Cycle, you can select one Blessing of Trailblaze to enhance your own team upon re-entry into the Simulated Universe.

source: Setelah menyelesaikan tantangan Illusion, akan memperoleh Poin dan Rating stage terkait. Rating tertinggi adalah SS.
target: After clearing the Illusion Challenge, you will earn a score for each stage and a rank. Rank SS is the highest rating.

source: Setelah menyerang musuh dan mengurangi jumlah lapisan "War Armor"-nya hingga 0, musuh tersebut akan segera menyerap target di sekitarnya dan mengalahkannya.
target: After attacking the enemy and reducing their "War Armor" stacks to 0, the enemy will immediately absorb adjacent targets and defeat them.

source: Setelah musuh beraksi, rekan tim segera melancarkan Ultimate untuk menyerang musuh, dan musuh kemudian akan segera beraksi kembali dan menerima efek DoT.
target: After an enemy takes action, allies instantly use Ultimates to attack the enemy. The enemy then immediately takes action and receives a DoT effect.

source: Setelah objek panggilan menyerang, akan mengonsumsi jumlah "Resonance" dan segera beraksi.
target: After any summon attacked, consume "Resonance" and immediately take action.

source: Setelah rekan tim beraksi beruntun, rekan tim dapat memicu "Momen Puncak" dan memperoleh "Poin Atmosfer" dalam jumlah besar.
target: After ally targets perform consecutive actions, triggers Highlights and gains a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Setelah rekan tim diselamatkan dari "Soulstone", seluruh rekan tim akan memperoleh 1 lapis "Spiritual Torture" Setiap lapis "Spiritual Torture" dapat menambah jumlah DMG "Spiritual Caning".
target: After an ally is freed from the Soulstone, all allies obtain 1 stack of Spiritual Torture. Every stack of Spiritual Torture can apply more instances of DMG for Spiritual Caning.

source: Setelah rekan tim mana pun terus-menerus beraksi, "Nilai Ketangguhan" dalam jumlah besar dapat diakumulasi. Mengalahkan musuh atau menghalangi musuh beraksi juga dapat membantu agar rekan tim terus beraksi.
target: After any ally performs consecutive actions, a large amount of Grit Value can be obtained. Defeating enemies or stopping enemy actions are all viable means to have allies continue to take action.

source: Setelah rekan tim melancarkan Ultimate atau Serangan Lanjutan, akan memperoleh jumlah lapisan "Starlight" yang sesuai berdasarkan jumlah target yang terkena serangan, yang akan meningkatkan efek peningkatan DMG seluruh rekan tim.
target: After an ally character uses an Ultimate or launches a Follow-Up ATK, they gain corresponding "Starlight" stacks based on the number of targets hit, increasing the team's DMG boosting effect.

source: Setelah rekan tim melancarkan Ultimate untuk menyerang musuh, akan membuat musuh mengalami 100% Pendahuluan Aksi dan ATK musuh tersebut akan berkurang, serta akan menambahkan berbagai jenis efek DoT pada musuh tersebut.
target: After allies attack enemies with their Ultimates, enemy actions will be Advanced Forward by 100%, and they will deal less DMG and be inflicted with various DoT effects.

source: Setelah rekan tim mengakibatkan Weakness Break pada musuh ini, rekan tim tersebut akan mengalami 50% Pendahuluan Aksi, dan Break Effect meningkat 50%.
target: After an ally Breaks this enemy, the ally's action advances by 50% and Break Effect increases by 50%.

source: Setelah rekan tim terkena "Terror Grip", lancarkan 1 kali serangan terhadap penambah status "Terror Grip" untuk menghapus "Terror Grip".
target: When an ally is inflicted with Terror Grip, attacking the caster of Terror Grip once can dispel Terror Grip.

source: Setelah rekan tim terkena serangan, akan mengurangi jumlah Poin Skill serta batas maksimumnya.
target: After any ally unit is attacked, reduce the number of Skill Points and Max Skill Points.

source: Setelah salah satu karakter melancarkan total 3 kali Ultimate, karakter tersebut akan segera mengaktifkan Ultimate dirinya lagi.
target: After a single ally has used their Ultimate for a total of 3 times, they will immediately activate their Ultimate again.

source: Setelah setiap pertandingan berakhir, kamu akan memperoleh Poin Menonton. Semakin tinggi level pertandingannya, semakin banyak poin yang diperoleh. Poin yang terkumpul dapat digunakan untuk mengambil Hadiah Tonton.
target: After each match, you'll earn Spectator Points. Higher-tier matches award more points, and you can claim Spectator Rewards by accumulating points.

source: Setelah setiap putaran berakhir, pemain dengan kekuatan tempur di bawah target akan tereliminasi. Dalam satu pertandingan, setiap pemain hanya memiliki satu kesempatan untuk menghindari eliminasi.
target: After each round, players with combat power below the target level will be eliminated. During the entire match, each player has only one chance to avoid elimination.

source: Setelah setiap ronde selesai, pemain yang kekuatan tempurnya lebih rendah akan menerima DMG tetap. Saat HP pemain mencapai 0, pemain akan memasuki status Sekarat, dan akan tereliminasi jika menerima DMG lagi.
target: Player with the lower combat power after a round will take a set amount of DMG. When a player's HP becomes 0, they will enter the Near-Death state. Taking DMG again will result in defeat.

source: Setelah taman hiburan beroperasi, pengunjung wispae akan masuk secara bergiliran dan menyerahkan Koin Hiburan saat melewati fasilitas.
target: Once the park is open for business, wispae visitors will enter one by one and pay Arca Coins as they pass by the attractions.

source: Setelah terkena Weakness Break, aksinya akan tertunda ekstra, dan DMG yang diterimanya akan meningkat pesat.
target: After its Weakness is Broken, additionally delays action and greatly increases its DMG taken.

source: Setelah tong sampah kecil berevolusi hingga menjadi Emas Super, Poin Kinetik meningkat hingga 5 poin. Setelah Penyihir melancarkan Ultimate, tong sampah kecil juga akan memperoleh Poin Kinetik.
target: When minicans reach the Ultra Gold form, increases max Kinetic Points to 5. After the Magician uses their Ultimate, minicans will also gain Kinetic Points.

source: Setiap Debugger Ciptaan memiliki sejumlah Heat tertentu di awal. Kamu dapat mengonsumsi Heat untuk meningkatkan Blessing.
target: Each Workbench of Creation has a certain amount of initial Heat, which can be expended to enhance Blessings.

source: Setiap Kartu Aksi memiliki beban kerja yang berbeda. Setelah memilih Kartu Aksi, progres dalam jadwal piket akan maju sesuai jumlah langkah yang ditentukan, dan kamu akan berpindah ke petak yang sesuai.
target: Different Action Cards entail varying workloads. After selecting an Action Card, the schedule will advance by a set number of steps to reach the corresponding tile.

source: Setiap Path memiliki 1 Karakteristik yang sesuai. Efek dan status aktivasi Karakteristik dapat dilihat di menu.
target: Every Path has 1 corresponding Trait, the effect and activation condition of which can be viewed in the menu.

source: Setiap Synthesis akan memilih 1 dari 3 Benda Langka acak dengan kualitas lebih tinggi, dan bisa mendapatkan hingga Benda Langka 3★.
target: Each synthesis allows you to select one out of three random Curios with higher quality. The highest-quality Curio that can be obtained is a 3-star one.

source: Setiap anjing laut dapat beraksi 1 kali dalam setiap putaran. Setelah memasuki putaran baru, mereka akan bergantian untuk maju pertama.
target: Each seal can take action 1 time per round. At the start of a new round, the player who goes first is swapped.

source: Setiap area memiliki satu konsol game "Kelinci Rel Bintang", halaman utama konsol game akan menampilkan nomor seri, nickname pemain, serta skor game terbaik terkait di konsol tersebut.
target: There is a Star Rabbit Game Console in every area. The home page of the console will display its serial number, the player's nickname, and their best score.

source: Setiap awal tahap persiapan Node, toko akan refresh secara otomatis 1 kali. Kamu dapat membeli karakter yang kamu butuhkan di toko menggunakan Koin Emas.
target: The Store automatically refreshes 1 time at the start of the preparation phase for each Node. You can use Gold Coins to recruit desired Characters from the Store.

source: Setiap chapter harus melewati sesi uji coba tayang internal sebelum dirilis. Film yang berbeda memiliki Target Emosi yang berbeda.
target: Every chapter needs to pass Internal Screening before they are released, and different films have different Emotion Targets

source: Setiap ciptaan Ruan Mei di Debugger Ciptaan memiliki suatu fungsi penciptaan yang sesuai.
target: Each of Ruan Mei's creations in the Workbench of Creation corresponds to a creation function.

source: Setiap eksplorasi memiliki sejumlah Putaran Tambahan tertentu. Setelah Putaran Tambahan habis, musuh akan memasuki status Berserk dan meningkatkan ATK secara signifikan.
target: Every round of exploration has a certain number of extra Cycles. When all extra Cycles are used up, the enemy will enter a Berserk state and greatly increase their ATK.

source: Setiap hari sebelum taman beroperasi, kamu perlu memilih fasilitas untuk ditempatkan di petak yang sesuai.
target: Before the park opens each day, you'll need to select Attractions and place them on the appropriate tiles.

source: Setiap kali Gilgamesh menarik tambahan 1 kartu dalam gilirannya, ia dapat memperoleh 1 "Gate of Babylon!".
target: For every 1 extra card Gilgamesh draws during the turn, he gains 1 "Gate of Babylon!".

source: Setiap kali Qingque mengalahkan lawan baru di duel arkade, dia akan mengumpulkan reputasi. Fitur baru akan terbuka seiring dengan meningkatnya Level Reputasi.
target: Whenever Qingque wins against a new opponent in an arcade game, she will accumulate reputation. More new functions will become available with a higher Reputation Rank.

source: Setiap kali Qingque mengalahkan lawan baru di duel arkade, dia akan mengumpulkan reputasi. Fitur dan item tempur baru akan terbuka seiring dengan meningkatnya Level Reputasi.
target: Whenever Qingque wins against a new opponent in an arcade game, she will accumulate reputation. More new functions and new battle items will become available with a higher Reputation Rank.

source: Setiap kali kalkulasi dimulai, kamu dapat memilih satu topeng untuk dikenakan. Topeng tidak dapat diubah setelah dipilih.
target: At the start of each extrapolation, you can select one Mask to wear. Once selected, it cannot be changed.

source: Setiap kali melakukan Synthesis, dapat memilih 1 dari 3 Komponen
target: You can select 1 Component from 3 with every synthesis.

source: Setiap kali membentuk ulang kristal, area terang akan diperluas batasannya. Manfaatkan sifat ini untuk menyelesaikan ujian.
target: Every time you reforge a Crystal, the boundaries of the lit area will expand. Use this property to complete the trial.

source: Setiap kali menghancurkan 3 Bom Super, akan memulihkan 1 kali kesempatan penggunaan satu jenis alat secara acak.
target: Every time 3 Super Bombs are eliminated, randomly recover 1 item's usage count by 1.

source: Setiap kali menghancurkan kristal, area terang akan diperkecil batasannya. Manfaatkan sifat ini untuk menyelesaikan ujian.
target: Each time you break a Crystal, the boundary of the lit area shrinks. Use this property to complete the trial.

source: Setiap kali menyerap 1 target, akan memicu "Frenzied Absorption", dan mengakibatkan DMG pada semua musuh di medan pertempuran.
target: For each target absorbed, "Frenzied Absorption" will be triggered, dealing DMG to all enemies.

source: Setiap kali penimpaan akan memilih 1 dari 3 Blessing acak dan menimpa Blessing yang dipilih.
target: For each overwrite, you will select 1 out of 3 random Blessings and overwrite the selected Blessing.

source: Setiap kali rekan tim beraksi, akan membuat "Giftbox" mengalami Pendahuluan Aksi untuk memperoleh Buff "Giftbox" dengan lebih cepat.
target: Every time allies take action, they will Advance the Giftbox's action Forward to receive the Giftbox buff more quickly.

source: Setiap kali selesai mengumpulkan semua "Koin Muslihat" di sekitar, kamu dapat memperoleh harta karun "Tangan Zagreus".
target: After collecting all the Coins of Whimsy nearby, you can obtain the treasures of the specific Hand of Zagreus.

source: Setiap kali seluruh rekan tim melancarkan total 3 kali Ultimate, akan melancarkan beberapa kali "Brave Fist" untuk menyerang musuh.
target: Every time allies have used a total of 3 Ultimates, trigger multiple Brave Fists to attack enemies.

source: Setiap kali setelah menyelesaikan cerita melalui Peristiwa Latihan Pedang, March 7th akan memperoleh Pemahaman Pelatihan, yang akan meningkatkan stats-nya saat latihan pedang yang berikutnya dimulai.
target: Each time the story is completed through a Swordart Escapade, March 7th will gain Trialed Insight, which will enhance her stats when she starts a new round of training.

source: Setiap kali setelah menyelesaikan cerita melalui Peristiwa Latihan Pedang, fitur Retrospeksi Akhir dari Peristiwa terkait akan dibuka. Fitur ini dapat digunakan untuk mencoba berbagai akhir dengan cepat.
target: After completing the story through Swordart Escapade, the Finale Rewind feature for that specific Escapade will be unlocked, allowing you to quickly explore different story endings.

source: Setiap kategori area pameran hanya dapat menempatkan asisten yang sesuai dengan area kerja terkait.
target: Only assistants who match the exhibition area can be placed in that exhibition area.

source: Setiap memasuki 4 Zona, kamu dapat memilih 1 kali Karunia Darah Emas.
target: You can select Golden Blood's Boons once for every 4 domains entered.

source: Setiap menggunakan 8 kartu, Saber memperoleh 1 poin Mana. Hitungan terbawa antar giliran.
target: For every 8 cards used, Saber gains 1 point of magical energy. The tally carries over between turns.

source: Setiap menghancurkan 2 Bom Super, akan mengubah 1 buah di papan menjadi Ekspres Gelembung secara acak. Hancurkan buah di sekitar untuk memecahkan gelembung dan memperoleh item di dalamnya.
target: For every 2 Super Bombs cleared, randomly transform 1 fruit on the board to a Bubble Express. Clear adjacent fruits to pop the bubble and obtain the item inside
