source: Tối đa có thể thực hiện 9 lần cường hóa lên Chúc Phúc Giới Hạn Sự Kiện nhận nhiều lần trùng nhau. Cường hóa Chúc Phúc Giới Hạn Sự Kiện đến cấp cao hơn để chuẩn bị cho Thí Luyện Cuối Cùng.
target: Repeatedly obtain the same event-limited Blessings to enhance them for up to 9 times. Enhance event-limited Blessings to higher levels to prepare for the Final Trial.

source: Tổng số Xu Vàng thu được trong 1 ván sẽ ảnh hưởng rất lớn đến kết quả thắng thua. Hãy nhớ giữ lại 50 Xu Vàng để tích lãi suất, mỗi điểm mốc sẽ nhận được 5 Xu Vàng lãi suất, tích tiểu thành đại!
target: The total amount of Gold Coins acquired in a match will greatly influence the match's outcome. Remember to keep 50 Gold Coins to accumulate interest, which grants 5 Gold Coins in interest per Node. Every little bit adds up!

source: Tủ Trưng Bày có thể bố trí các loại đồ lưu niệm nhận được trong hành trình "Khai Phá". Sau khi hoàn tất bố trí, sẽ hiển thị trong Hồ Sơ Nhà Khai Phá.
target: You can showcase mementos from your Trailblazing journey in Collection Showcase. These will appear on your Trailblazer Profile once set up.

source: Từ cửa tiệm hoặc điểm cuối tuyến đường, nhấn kéo cho đến khi liên kết đến bến cảng, tuyến đường càng ngắn, điểm càng cao
target: Start from the store or the end of the route, and hold and drag to form a route to the docks. The shorter the route, the higher the score

source: Tự Sa Vào Lưới
target: Walk Into The Trap

source: Tự Động Chiến Đấu
target: Auto-Battle

source: Tự Động Sử Dụng
target: Auto-Use

source: Uhrwerk kann auch viele unerwartete Überraschungen mit sich bringen. Geh schön erkunden, ticktack!
target: Clockwork can also bring lots of unexpected surprises. Go and explore, tick tock!

source: Uhrwerk: Stimmungs-Harmonisierung
target: Clockwork: Emo Tuning

source: Uhrwerk: Stimmungs-Vollendung
target: Clockwork: Emotional Integration

source: Ujian Pedang
target: Sword Trial

source: Ujian Pedang harus diselesaikan oleh March 7th sendiri. Keseluruhan proses pertempuran akan dilakukan secara auto, dan tidak dapat menerima bantuan dari rekan tim.
target: The Sword Trial must be completed by March 7th alone. The entire battle will proceed automatically, and no assistance from teammates is allowed.

source: Ujian Penopang Dunia 1
target: Worldbearing Trial I

source: Ujian Penopang Dunia 2
target: Worldbearing Trial II

source: Ujian akan membentuk sebuah area terang. Bagian dalam dan luar area terletak di ruang waktu yang berbeda. Saat melintasi batas antara area terang dan gelap, karakter akan teleportasi ke area terang di seberang.
target: The trial will form a lit area, with different space-time inside and outside the area. When a character crosses the boundary between lit and dark areas, they will teleport to the lit area on the opposite side.

source: Ujian kali ini akan berlangsung di area yang diselimuti kegelapan. Bagian dalam dan luar area terletak di ruang waktu yang berbeda. Saat melintasi batas antara area terang dan gelap, karakter akan teleportasi ke area gelap di seberang.
target: This trial takes place in an area shrouded in darkness, with different space-time inside and outside the area. When a character crosses the boundary between lit and dark areas, they will teleport to the dark area on the opposite side.

source: Ujung Hidup dan Mati: Panduan Bermain
target: Perilous Threshold: Gameplay Details

source: Ultimate Yao Guang dapat segera memicu satu kali Aha Instant tambahan. Saat Yao Guang memiliki "Certified Banger", seluruh anggota tim dapat mengakibatkan ekstra Elation DMG.
target: Yao Guang's Ultimate immediately triggers 1 additional Aha Instant. When Yao Guang possesses "Certified Banger," the entire team deals additional Elation DMG.

source: Ultime
target: Ultimate

source: Ultime et énergie
target: Energy and Ultimate

source: Um Engenho de cachorrinho criado pela Comissão de Artesanato. Use sua Sonda de Localização para encontrar odores e resquícios suspeitos.
target: An ingenium dog crafted by the Artisanship Commission. Use its Locality Probe feature to find suspicious odors and traces.

source: Um alvo marcado com um anel foi detectado. Não se mexa até que o reconhecimento seja concluído.
target: A target with a ring mark is detected. Hold still until the recognition is complete.

source: Um alvo marcado em amarelo foi detectado. Ele precisa ser fotografado manualmente.
target: A target with a yellow mark is detected, which needs to be manually photographed.

source: Um das kleine Mädchen zu retten, schiebe die Kiste zu ihr.
target: Save the little girl by pushing boxes away to unblock her exit.

source: Um die Herausforderung Stellares Leuchtsignal zu bestehen, musst du Gegner in bestimmter Rundenzahl besiegen. Vor Beginn jedes Kampfes werden die LP, Fertigkeitspunkte und Energie deiner Figuren auf den vorgegebenen Wert wiederhergestellt.
target: Defeat enemies within specified number of Cycles to complete the Stellar Flare challenge. Before the start of each battle, your HP, Skill Points, and Energy will be restored to a specified amount.

source: Um die Rennatmosphäre anzuheizen, sind auf der Strecke „Arita-Pappaufsteller“ aufgetaucht. Bitte ramme sie nach Herzenslust!
target: To spice up the race atmosphere, "Arita Signboards" have been placed along the track. Feel free to ram into them!

source: Um efeito aplicado a um domínio. Domínios com sinalizadores concederão grandes recompensas.
target: An effect applied to a domain. Domains with beacons will net you great rewards.

source: Um efeito será acionado com base na casa em que você parar. Ao selecionar Cartas de Ação, dê seu melhor para parar em casas vantajosas.
target: An effect will be triggered based on the tile you stop on. When selecting Action Cards, do your best to end up on advantageous tiles.

source: Um ein bewegtes Objekt zu einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt anzuhalten, kannst du zuerst eine Zeitstoppzone erzeugen, dann zurückspulen und zum gewünschten Zeitpunkt den Rückspulvorgang manuell unterbrechen.
target: If you wish to freeze a moving object at a specific time, you can pre-emptively deploy a Time Stop Zone, then initiate Rewind, and manually interrupt the Rewind at the desired moment.

source: Um equipamento muito raro e valioso. Quando adquirido, aumenta o limite do tamanho do esquadrão em 1. Enquanto estiver continuamente equipado, também concede algumas Moedas de Ouro.
target: A very rare and valuable piece of equipment. When acquired, it increases the team size limit by 1. While continuously equipped, it also grants some Gold Coins.

source: Um número fixo de clientes visitará o restaurante todos os dias. Depois que o restaurante for promovido, mais clientes serão atraídas para o estabelecimento. Tente atender todas os clientes antes da hora de fechar
target: A fixed number of customers will visit each day. After the restaurant levels up, it will attract more customers. Try to serve all customers before closing time

source: Um objeto misterioso abençoado por Janus. Após quebrá-lo, a velocidade de movimento aumentará por um certo período.
target: A mysterious object blessed by Janus. After breaking it, movement speed will increase for a certain duration.

source: Um operador de carrinhos de mineração e seu aprendiz estão passando um certo aperto na Grande Mina... Ajude-os a empurrar os carrinhos de mineração para os bloqueadores designados. Pode ser que você encontre algo do seu interesse.
target: A mine cart operator and his apprentice seem to be having a bit of trouble in the Great Mine... Help them push the mine carts to the designated blockers, and you may find something of interest.

source: Um par de olhos aguçados como os de um lobo estão escondidos debaixo dos óculos escuros de Hanu. Use o botão para ativar a Visão Hanu para observar as ferramentas que podem ser utilizadas, e tente encontrar o tesouro escondido.
target: A pair of wolf-like sharp eyes are hidden under Hanu's sunglasses. Use the button to activate his Hanu Vision to observe the tools that can be utilized, and try to find the hidden treasure.

source: Um tipo de dispositivo de alarme opticamente oculto. Se o alarme for acionado na área de proteção, os guardas próximos serão alertados. Use o Diting para sondar sua forma exata.
target: A type of optically concealed alarm device. If the alarm is triggered in the guard zone, nearby guards will be alerted. Use Diting to probe its exact shape.

source: Uma Guia Poeirinha sem nome está posicionada perto do Console do "Coelho Estelar". Se ainda houver Poeirinhas sem nome não descobertas na área , você pode entregar "Moedix" para fazer com que a Guia aponte as localizações.
target: A Nameless Wispae Guide is stationed near the Star Rabbit Game Console. If there are still undiscovered nameless wispae in the area, you can submit "Pixcoin" to have the Guide point out their locations.

source: Uma criatura estranha com a forma de uma sépala de flor, com estames e pistilos dourados e pétalas pretas. Derrote inimigos para ganhar Materiais de EXP de Personagem, Materiais de EXP de Cone de Luz e Créditos.
target: A strange creation in the shape of a flower's sepal, with golden stamens and pistils and ink-black petals. Defeat enemies to gain Character EXP Materials, Light Cone EXP Materials, and credits.

source: Uma criatura estranha com a forma de uma sépala de flor, com estames e pistilos rubros e pétalas pretas. Derrote inimigos para ganhar Materiais de Rastro.
target: A strange creation in the shape of a flower's sepal, with crimson stamens and pistils and ink-black petals. Defeat enemies to gain Trace Materials.

source: Uma das funções da Bancada da Criação, que gasta Fragmentos Cósmicos para trocar as Bênçãos atuais.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Blessings.

source: Uma das funções da Bancada da Criação, que gasta Fragmentos Cósmicos para trocar as Equações atuais.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Equations.

source: Uma das funções da Bancada da Criação, que gasta o Calor da Bancada da Criação para aprimorar Bênçãos.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends the Workbench of Creation's Heat to enhance Blessings.

source: Uma das funções da Bancada da Criação, que sintetiza uma nova Curio utilizando 2 Curios da mesma qualidade.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can synthesize a new Curio using 2 Curios of the same quality.

source: Uma das funções da Bancada da Criação, que substitui Curios Pesadas já existentes.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can replace existing Weighted Curios.

source: Uma foquinha que colide com uma Boia aumenta a VEL e recebe 1 de ATQ na rodada atual.
target: A baby seal that collides with a Floatie increases SPD, and gains 1 ATK for the current round.

source: Uma grande quantidade de Cofrinhos apareceu no plano. Capture-os para obter mais Bênçãos.
target: A large number of Trotters have appeared in the plane. Capture them and obtain more Blessings.

source: Uma instalação de entretenimento que pode ser vista em qualquer lugar do Parque Aideen. Suas regras são simples, mas encantadoras. Incontáveis convidados ficam imersos nela e ficam completamente perdidos da realidade.
target: An amusement facility that can be seen anywhere in Aideen Park. Its rules are simple but charming. Countless guests are immersed in it and become completely oblivious to reality.

source: Uma lanterna cerimonial deixada pelos Vidyadharas que contém o poder de selamento dos Vidyadharas.
target: A ceremonial lamp left by the Vidyadhara that contains the Vidyadhara's power of sealing.

source: Uma mordida deixada pelo Fragmentum quando corroeu a realidade, levando a lugares desconhecidos. É possível usar a Caverna da Corrosão para adquirir Relíquias. Depois de ativá-las, você pode se teletransportar para elas pela Navegação.
target: A bite mark left by the Fragmentum when it corroded reality, leading to unknown places. Cavern of Corrosion can be used to acquire Relics. After activation, you can teleport to its location via Navigation.

source: Uma máquina antiga, construída pelos Arquitetos de Belobog, que obedece à vontade da Preservação. Em determinadas situações de combate, você e seus aliados podem Carregar a máquina para ativar a habilidade dela.
target: An ancient machine made by the Architects of Belobog that obeys the will of Preservation. In certain combat scenarios, you and your allies can Charge the machine to activate its ability.

source: Umbral del fluido magnetorreológico
target: Magnetorheological Fluid Threshold

source: Umgekehrte Trennung
target: Inverted Severance

source: Umzingelnde Angst
target: Terror Grip

source: Un efecto que se aplica a las zonas. Las zonas con balizas dan grandes recompensas.
target: An effect applied to a domain. Domains with beacons will net you great rewards.

source: Un flambeau rituel laissé par les Vidyadhariens, qui contient tous les pouvoirs d'emprisonnement de ce peuple.
target: A ceremonial lamp left by the Vidyadhara that contains the Vidyadhara's power of sealing.

source: Un guide d'Ætherae sans nom est posté près de la console de jeu Lapin stellaire. S'il reste encore des Ætherae sans nom non-découverts dans la zone, vous pouvez lui donner des pixaillons pour que le guide vous indique leur emplacement.
target: A Nameless Wispae Guide is stationed near the Star Rabbit Game Console. If there are still undiscovered nameless wispae in the area, you can submit "Pixcoin" to have the Guide point out their locations.

source: Un nombre fixe de clientes viendra chaque jour. Quand le restaurant sera plus populaire, il attirera plus de clientes. Essayez de servir toutes les clientes avant l'heure de fermeture.
target: A fixed number of customers will visit each day. After the restaurant levels up, it will attract more customers. Try to serve all customers before closing time

source: Un objet mystérieux béni par Janus. Après l'avoir brisé, la vitesse de mouvement augmentera pendant un certain temps.
target: A mysterious object blessed by Janus. After breaking it, movement speed will increase for a certain duration.

source: Un objeto misterioso bendecido por Jano. Después de romperlo, la VEL de movimiento aumentará durante cierto tiempo.
target: A mysterious object blessed by Janus. After breaking it, movement speed will increase for a certain duration.

source: Un par de ojos afilados similares a los de un lobo se ocultan bajo los lentes de sol de Hanu. Utiliza el botón para activar la visión de Hanu y observar las herramientas que pueden ser utilizadas, e intenta encontrar el tesoro oculto.
target: A pair of wolf-like sharp eyes are hidden under Hanu's sunglasses. Use the button to activate his Hanu Vision to observe the tools that can be utilized, and try to find the hidden treasure.

source: Un perro robot fabricado por la Comisión de Artesanía. Utiliza su función Localización de zona para encontrar olores y rastros sospechosos.
target: An ingenium dog crafted by the Artisanship Commission. Use its Locality Probe feature to find suspicious odors and traces.

source: Un personnage qui monte de niveau voit ses stats augmenter et ses effets de Spécialisation renforcés. Exemple : En combat, le Dr Ratio peut lancer des craies en continu pour attaquer ses ennemis.
target: After a character is upgraded, besides gaining stat increases, their Character Empowerment effects will also be enhanced. For example: Dr. Ratio can consecutively throw chalks to attack enemies in combat.

source: Un pont de répulsion peut être orange ou bleu. Utiliser le dispositif de contrôle pour changer le pont actif pourrait bien vous mener vers des destinations inattendues.
target: A repulsion bridge can either be orange or blue. Using the control device to change the active bridge will lead you to unexpected destinations.

source: Un tipo de dispositivo de alarma ópticamente oculto. Puedes usar al Diting para sondear su forma exacta. Si la alarma se activa en la zona acordonada, se alertará a los guardias cercanos.
target: A type of optically concealed alarm device. If the alarm is triggered in the guard zone, nearby guards will be alerted. Use Diting to probe its exact shape.

source: Un Écrantateur apparaîtra dans cet épisode. Surveillez ses expressions. Frappez-le quand il sourit pour gagner plus de points.
target: Mr. Domescreen will appear in this episode. Pay close attention to his expressions. Break him when he's smiling to get more points.

source: Un équipement très rare et précieux. Une fois acquis, il augmente la taille maximale de l'équipe de 1. Lorsqu'il est équipé en continu, il accorde également quelques pièces d'or.
target: A very rare and valuable piece of equipment. When acquired, it increases the team size limit by 1. While continuously equipped, it also grants some Gold Coins.

source: Una de las funciones del Banco de pruebas de la creación: consume el Calor del Banco de pruebas de la creación para potenciar bendiciones.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends the Workbench of Creation's Heat to enhance Blessings.

source: Una de las funciones del Banco de pruebas de la creación: gasta fragmentos cósmicos para intercambiar las bendiciones actuales.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Blessings.

source: Una de las funciones del Banco de pruebas de la creación: gasta fragmentos cósmicos para intercambiar las ecuaciones actuales.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Equations.

source: Una de las funciones del Banco de pruebas de la creación: sustituye objetos raros ponderados existentes.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can replace existing Weighted Curios.

source: Una de las funciones del Banco de pruebas de la creación: usa 2 objetos raros de la misma calidad para sintetizar otro.
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can synthesize a new Curio using 2 Curios of the same quality.

source: Una extraña creación en forma de capullo de flor con pistilo y estambres carmesí y pétalos de color azabache. Derrota a los enemigos para ganar material de Rastros.
target: A strange creation in the shape of a flower's sepal, with crimson stamens and pistils and ink-black petals. Defeat enemies to gain Trace Materials.

source: Una extraña creación en forma de capullo de flor con pistilo y estambres dorados, y pétalos de color azabache. Derrota a los enemigos para ganar materiales de EXP de personaje, materiales de EXP de conos de luz, créditos, etc.
target: A strange creation in the shape of a flower's sepal, with golden stamens and pistils and ink-black petals. Defeat enemies to gain Character EXP Materials, Light Cone EXP Materials, and credits.

source: Una instalación recreativa que se puede encontrar en cualquier lugar del Parque Aideen. Sus reglas son simples pero cautivadoras, e innumerables huéspedes se sumergen en ella y se vuelven completamente ajenos a la realidad.
target: An amusement facility that can be seen anywhere in Aideen Park. Its rules are simple but charming. Countless guests are immersed in it and become completely oblivious to reality.

source: Una lámpara ritual de los vidyadhara que contiene el poder de sellado de esta raza.
target: A ceremonial lamp left by the Vidyadhara that contains the Vidyadhara's power of sealing.

source: Una vez activada la cámara, la vista se puede mover y girar. Busca objetos reconocibles cercanos.
target: The view can be moved and rotated once the camera is launched. Search for recognizable objects nearby.

source: Una vez desbloqueados, funcionarán como cualquier otro empleado durante la partida. Podrás comprarlos en la tienda, mejorarlos y equiparlos, y conservarán los vínculos que tenían anteriormente.
target: Once unlocked, they'll function just like any other staff member in this round. You can buy them from the Store, upgrade their stars, equip them with gear, and they'll retain any Bonds they had before.

source: Una vez que comience el día de exposición, cada cierto tiempo aparecerá un evento de envío de Pom-Pom. Tras completar el envío de Pom-Pom, el progreso del día de exposición avanzará.
target: After the Exhibition Day starts, the Pom-Pom Delivery event will appear periodically. Completing Pom-Pom Delivery will advance the Exhibition Day progress.

source: Una vez que hayas superado Pura ficción y hayas ganado suficientes puntos, recibirás estrellas y recompensas de historia.
target: Once you have cleared Pure Fiction and earned enough points, you will receive Story Stars and Story Rewards.

source: Una vez que tú y tus compañeros de equipo hayan terminado de realizar sus acciones, solo se usarán los dados de tu zona para infligir daño al enemigo poderoso.
target: After you and your teammates have both finished taking actions, the dice in your pool will be used to deal DMG to the formidable foe.

source: Unabhängig davon, ob du online bist oder nicht, kämpfen die Figuren und produzieren kontinuierlich Ressourcen.
target: Characters will engage in combat and continuously generate resources, whether you're online or not.

source: Unbesiegbarkeitsmodus
target: Invincible Mode

source: Une ancienne machine fabriquée par les Architectes de Belobog, au service de la volonté de la Préservation. Dans certains scénarios de combat, vos alliés et vous pouvez charger la machine dans le but d'activer sa capacité.
target: An ancient machine made by the Architects of Belobog that obeys the will of Preservation. In certain combat scenarios, you and your allies can Charge the machine to activate its ability.

source: Une cible avec une marque d'anneau a été détectée. Ne bougez plus avant la fin de la reconnaissance.
target: A target with a ring mark is detected. Hold still until the recognition is complete.

source: Une cible avec une marque jaune a été détectée. Elle doit être photographiée manuellement.
target: A target with a yellow mark is detected, which needs to be manually photographed.

source: Une collision avec un pilier épineux inflige 3 points de DGT au bébé phoque.
target: Colliding with a Spiky Pillar deals 3 DMG to the baby seal.

source: Une fois la barre de progression remplie, vous obtenez 1 carte de Gigantisme.
target: When the progress is full, gain 1 Gigantification

source: Une fois le parc ouvert, les visiteurs Ætherae entreront un par un et paieront des récréapièces en passant devant les attractions.
target: Once the park is open for business, wispae visitors will enter one by one and pay Arca Coins as they pass by the attractions.

source: Une fois le puzzle terminé, l'objet qu'il représente apparaît dans le Pays des rêves.
target: Once a puzzle is complete, the object within will appear in the Dreamscape.

source: Une fois les affectations ajoutées (jusqu'à 4), les récompenses s'accumulent automatiquement à chaque heure en fonction des affectations sélectionnées.
target: After assignments (up to 4) are added, the rewards based on the selected assignments will be automatically accumulated per hour.

source: Une fois les quatre statues de l'espace-temps de la nuit activées, vous pourrez briser le sceau de la divinité de Nikador et progresser dans l'histoire.
target: After all four statues in the Night space-time are activated, you can break the shackles on Nikador's divinity and advance the story.

source: Une fois que vous aurez terminé vos actions avec votre coéquipier, les dés de votre camp serviront à infliger des DGT à l'ennemi puissant.
target: After you and your teammates have both finished taking actions, the dice in your pool will be used to deal DMG to the formidable foe.

source: Une fois que vous avez récupéré le nombre requis d'autocollants, vous pouvez obtenir la récompense de progression sur la page de collection.
target: Once you have collected the required number of stickers, you may claim progress rewards on the "Collection" page.

source: Une fois tous les niveaux Cavalier terminés, le roi perdra ses gardes et sera affaibli.
target: After clearing all Knight Stages, the King will be weakened without its guards.

source: Une fois tous les niveaux Cavalier terminés, le roi sera affaibli. Réinitialiser la progression des niveaux Cavalier n'affectera pas l'état d'affaiblissement du roi.
target: After clearing all Knight Stages, the King will be weakened. Resetting the progress of the Knight Stages will not affect the weakened state of the King.

source: Une fois toutes les conditions remplies, appuyez sur le bouton pour prendre la photo. Essayez de remplir toutes les conditions.
target: When all the photoshoot requirements are met, you can press the shutter to complete this shoot. Try to meet all the requirements if you can.

source: Une fois une zone terminée, un certain nombre de zones sont piochées dans la pioche. Vous pouvez en sélectionner une comme prochaine zone. Après la sélection, toutes les zones affichées sont placées dans la défausse.
target: After completing a Domain, a certain number of Domains will be drawn from the Draw Pile. Players can select one of them as the next Domain. After making your selection, all displayed Domains will be placed in the Discard Pile.

source: Une grande harde de Magorets est apparue dans le plan. Capturez-les pour obtenir des bénédictions supplémentaires.
target: A large number of Trotters have appeared in the plane. Capture them and obtain more Blessings.

source: Une ingéniosité canine fabriquée par la Commission de l'artisanat. Utilisez sa fonction sonde localisatrice pour détecter des odeurs ou des traces suspectes.
target: An ingenium dog crafted by the Artisanship Commission. Use its Locality Probe feature to find suspicious odors and traces.

source: Une mise à jour a été apportée à Pure fiction. N'hésitez pas à essayer les nouvelles mécaniques de combat.
target: Pure Fiction has received a gameplay update. Feel free to experience the new Grit Mechanics.

source: Une ombre dans le Fragmentum qui reste temporairement stagnante. Elle n'est pas dangereuse si on la laisse tranquille. Les Ombres stagnantes peuvent produire des ressources telles que des matériaux d'élévation de personnage.
target: A shadow in the Fragmentum that temporarily stays stagnant. It is not dangerous if left alone. Stagnant Shadows can yield resources such as Character Ascension Materials.

source: Une partie de la forme indiquée va changer. Alors faites attention à l'angle du motif de la matrice par rapport à la forme indiquée.
target: Part of the declared shape will change, so be sure to pay attention to the angle of the matrix pattern and the declared shape.

source: Une sorte d'alarme dissimulée visuellement. Si elle est déclenchée dans la zone gardée, les gardes à proximité seront alertés. Utilisez Truffie pour évaluer sa forme exacte.
target: A type of optically concealed alarm device. If the alarm is triggered in the guard zone, nearby guards will be alerted. Use Diting to probe its exact shape.

source: Une étrange création en forme de sépale de fleur composée d'étamines, de pistils pourpres et de pétales noirs comme de l'encre. Éliminez des ennemis pour gagner des matériaux de Trace.
target: A strange creation in the shape of a flower's sepal, with crimson stamens and pistils and ink-black petals. Defeat enemies to gain Trace Materials.

source: Uralte Relikte liefern Buffs für einzelne Kämpfe. Durch Abschluss von Relikt-Herausforderungen kannst du weitere Belohnungen erhalten.
target: Ancient Relics can provide buffs for single battles. Additionally, completing relic challenges grants additional rewards.

source: Ursprung des schwimmenden Schmieröls: Interplanare Rotation!
target: Floating Grease Origin Retrace: Shiftmation!

source: Usa "Reorganizar ideas" para descartar los informes seleccionados y sacar el mismo número de informes nuevos. Ten en cuenta que el número total de informes para cada miembro es limitado.
target: Using "Mental Reset", you can discard selected reports and draw the same number of new ones. Please note that each team member has a limit on the total number of reports.

source: Usa 2 gemas rojas/azules para sintetizar y obtener una Gema de la riqueza.
target: Perform synthesis using any 2 Red Gems/Blue Gems to obtain a Wealth Gem.

source: Usa Resonancia del Eco del espejismo para detectar a enemigos invisibles anticipadamente. Tras usarla, hay que esperar a que termine el TdE.
target: Using Mirage Echolocation can detect enemies in stealth mode in advance. There is a cooldown time after the ability is used.

source: Usa correctamente la habilidad básica o la habilidad definitiva para atacar al enemigo y activar Ausencia resuelta.
target: Correctly use Skill or Ultimate to attack the enemy to trigger "Solved Departure."

source: Usa cupones de combustible para obtener rápidamente materiales de mejora de Cáliz y Sombra paralizada.
target: Using a Fuel Voucher lets you quickly farm upgrade materials from Calyx / Stagnant Shadows.

source: Usa el disparador para lanzar energía de heliobus. Gira el receptor para cambiar la dirección de la conducción de la energía de heliobus.
target: Rotate receiver nodes to adjust heliobus energy's conduction direction. Then activate the trigger node to release heliobus energy along the conduction direction.

source: Usa el dispositivo de conducción de energía de la Comisión de Artesanía para destruir a la vez las raíces enredadas del Árbol de la Ambrosía y romper las ramas que bloquean el paso.
target: Ambrosial Arbor's branches can be found blocking the path. Use the Artisanship Commission's energy conduction device to destroy all the entangled Ambrosial Arbor's coils at the same time.

source: Usa el fonógrafo para cambiar la música del vagón. Al explorar los mundos encontrarás discos para desbloquear nuevos temas.
target: Use the Phonograph to change the music when on the Express. By exploring various worlds, you can obtain new records to unlock new tracks.

source: Usa la habilidad Estallido de nitrógeno para aumentar en gran medida la VEL.
target: Use the Nitrous Burst ability to greatly increase your speed

source: Usa la palanca izquierda para controlar sus movimientos y los botones de la derecha para controlar su altura. Usa el botón de salir para dejar de controlar la mano. La Mano de Zagreus permanecerá en su lugar.
target: Use the left joystick to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Usa la palanca izquierda para girar la cámara. Usa la palanca derecha para desplazar la pantalla. Presiona el botón de "Reiniciar" en la esquina inferior derecha para restablecer el ángulo de visión.
target: Use the right joystick to rotate the camera. Use the left joystick to move the screen. Press the reset button in the bottom right corner to reset your camera.

source: Usa las opciones de interacción para rotar el módulo y moverlo a lo largo de su trayectoria.
target: Use interactive operations to rotate or move the module along the set trajectory.

source: Usa las teclas de dirección para controlar sus movimientos y los botones de la derecha para controlar su altura. Usa el botón de salir para dejar de controlar la mano. La Mano de Zagreus permanecerá en su lugar.
target: Use the directional keys to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Usa los botones de Elegir para seleccionar un anillo específico y los botones de Rotar para girarlo. Cuando una ruta se conecte, aparecerá un aviso en la brújula. Pulsa el botón Confirmar ruta para confirmar la ruta actual.
target: Use the Select button to choose a specific ring, and use the Rotate button to turn it. When a route has been connected, a hint will appear on the compass. Tap the Confirm Route button to finalize your route.

source: Usa recuerdos anónimos para escribir las historias de los héroes en «Tal y como escribí».
target: Using "Nameless Recollection," heroes' stories can be written down in "As I've Written."

source: Usa tu colección de adhesivos para decorar tu cuaderno y completar su progreso.
target: Use your stickers collection to decorate your scrapbook and boost its completion progress.

source: Usando a Lembrança Inominada, as histórias dos heróis podem ser registradas em "Conforme Escrevi".
target: Using "Nameless Recollection," heroes' stories can be written down in "As I've Written."

source: Usando os foguetes fantásticos construídos pelos Pássaros de Origami, Hanu consegue alternar rapidamente entre as pontas de diferentes foguetes para alcançar lugares antes inacessíveis.
target: Using the fantastic rockets built by the Origami Bird, Hanu can quickly shift between the ends of different rockets to reach places otherwise inaccessible.

source: Usar a Ecolocalização de Miragem pode detectar inimigos em modo de furtividade com antecedência. Existe um tempo de recarga depois que a habilidade é usada.
target: Using Mirage Echolocation can detect enemies in stealth mode in advance. There is a cooldown time after the ability is used.

source: Usar ataques Imaginarios para causar Ruptura de Debilidad infligirá inmediatamente Daño de Ruptura Imaginario y aplicará al enemigo el estado de Prisión. El estado de Prisión reduce la VEL y retrasa la acción del enemigo.
target: Using Imaginary attacks to trigger Weakness Break will immediately deal Imaginary Break DMG and apply the Imprisonment effect. Imprisonment will cause enemies to have SPD Reduction and have their action delayed.

source: Usar ataques Imaginários para ativar a Quebra de Fraqueza causará imediatamente Dano de Quebra Imaginário e aplicará o efeito de Aprisionamento. Aprisionamento causará Redução de VEL aos inimigos, e atrasará as ações deles.
target: Using Imaginary attacks to trigger Weakness Break will immediately deal Imaginary Break DMG and apply the Imprisonment effect. Imprisonment will cause enemies to have SPD Reduction and have their action delayed.

source: Usar ataques de Fogo para ativar a Quebra de Fraqueza causará imediatamente Dano de Quebra de Fogo e aplicará o efeito de Queimadura. Queimadura causará Dano de Fogo Contínuo aos inimigos no início da rodada deles.
target: Using Fire attacks to trigger Weakness Break will immediately deal Fire Break DMG and apply the Burn effect. Burn will cause enemies to take Fire DoT at the start of their turn.

source: Usar ataques de Fuego para causar Ruptura de Debilidad infligirá inmediatamente Daño de Ruptura de Fuego y aplicará el estado de Quemadura. Cuando comience el turno del enemigo, el estado de Quemadura inflige Daño de Fuego con el tiempo.
target: Using Fire attacks to trigger Weakness Break will immediately deal Fire Break DMG and apply the Burn effect. Burn will cause enemies to take Fire DoT at the start of their turn.

source: Usar ataques de Raio para ativar a Quebra de Fraqueza causará imediatamente Dano de Quebra de Raio e aplicará o efeito de Choque. Choque causará Dano de Raio Contínuo aos inimigos no início da rodada deles.
target: Using Lightning attacks to trigger Weakness Break will immediately deal Lightning Break DMG and apply the Shock effect. Shock will cause enemies to take Lightning DoT at the start of their turn.

source: Usar essas habilidades pode te conceder pontos e recompensas nas Lendas do Passado e do Presente, e também desbloqueará gradualmente seções da Lenda do Desbravamento.
target: Using these abilities can earn you points and rewards in Legends Past and Present, and will also gradually unlock Legend of the Trailblazer sections.

target: Strategy Compendium: Apply Strategy

target: Using Cognition Chasm has a chance of restoring relevant hazy memories.

source: Usar seus Códigos Místicos Conceituais na ordem certa é a chave para a vitória!
target: Using your Conceptual Mystic Codes in the right order is the key to victory!

source: Usar um "Cupom de Combustível" permite que você consiga materiais de melhoria de Cálices / Sombras Estagnadas rapidamente.
target: Using a Fuel Voucher lets you quickly farm upgrade materials from Calyx / Stagnant Shadows.

source: Use a "Chave de Desmontagem" para reatribuir livremente o equipamento do personagem equipado e maximizar o Poder de Combate do seu esquadrão.
target: Use the Disassembly Wrench to freely reassign equipped gears and maximize your team's combat power.

source: Use a Balança da Justiça no mapa para concluir o teste de Oronyx.
target: Use the Scales of Justice in the map to complete Oronyx's test.

source: Use a Batalha Automática para conjurar habilidades e lutar automaticamente. No entanto, a Batalha Automática não pode ser usada em algumas situações de combate especiais.
target: Use auto-battle to cast abilities and fight automatically. However, auto-battle cannot be used in some special combat situations.

source: Use a Perícia ou a Perícia Suprema corretamente para atacar o inimigo e ativar "Partida Decifrada".
target: Correctly use Skill or Ultimate to attack the enemy to trigger "Solved Departure."

source: Use a chama sagrada que você carrega para iluminar o altar e trazer luz a este mundo!
target: Use the holy flame in hand to light up the altar and bring light to this world!

source: Use a escada para subir ou descer. Você só precisa realizar uma ação para cada escada, independentemente do seu comprimento.
target: Use the ladder to move up or down. You only need to take one step for each ladder, regardless of their length.

source: Use a função de "Personalização de Decoração" no seu quarto para colocar vários itens de mobília obtidos durante suas aventuras.
target: Use the "Décor Customization" feature in your room to place various furniture items obtained during your adventures.

source: Use a habilidade "Explosão de Nitrogênio" para aumentar bastante a sua velocidade.
target: Use the Nitrous Burst ability to greatly increase your speed

source: Use a velocidade ×2 para ter batalhas mais rápidas. No entanto, a velocidade ×2 será temporariamente desativada em algumas situações de combate especiais.
target: Use 2× speed to experience quicker battles. However, 2× speed will be temporarily turned off in some special combat situations.

source: Use as questões para descobrir possíveis detalhes escondidos por trás dos depoimentos prestados.
target: Use questions to discover possible details hiding behind given statements.

source: Use habilidades em Área para atacar inimigos. Após derrotar um inimigo comum, causa Dano com um alto multiplicador ao chefe com base no Dano Sobressalente deste ataque.
target: Use AoE abilities to attack enemies. After defeating a non-boss enemy, deals DMG with huge multipliers to the boss based on the Overflow DMG dealt in this attack.

source: Use o Fonógrafo para mudar a música no Expresso. Ao explorar diversos mundos, você poderá obter discos novos para desbloquear novas faixas.
target: Use the Phonograph to change the music when on the Express. By exploring various worlds, you can obtain new records to unlock new tracks.

source: Use o analógico esquerdo para controlar o movimento e os botões direitos para controlar a elevação. Aperte o botão "Sair" para finalizar o controle. A Mão de Zagreus permanecerá no local.
target: Use the left joystick to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Use o botão "Selecionar" para escolher um anel específico e use o botão "Rotacionar" para rotacioná-lo. Quando uma rota for conectada, uma dica aparecerá na bússola. Toque no botão Confirmar Rota para finalizar sua rota.
target: Use the Select button to choose a specific ring, and use the Rotate button to turn it. When a route has been connected, a hint will appear on the compass. Tap the Confirm Route button to finalize your route.

source: Use o botão Alternar no canto inferior direito para ligar ou desligar a luz dos orbes. Use o botão "Sair" para sair da interface de controle dos orbes.
target: Use the Switch button in the bottom-right corner to turn on or off the orb's light. Use the Quit button to exit the control interface of the orb.

source: Use o direcional direito para girar a câmera. Use o direcional esquerdo para mover a tela. Pressione o botão de reiniciar no canto inferior direito para reiniciar sua câmera.
target: Use the right joystick to rotate the camera. Use the left joystick to move the screen. Press the reset button in the bottom right corner to reset your camera.

source: Use o direcional no canto inferior esquerdo para controlar o movimento e os botões direitos para controlar a elevação. Aperte o botão "Sair" para finalizar o controle. A Mão de Zagreus permanecerá no local.
target: Drag the joystick at the bottom left to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Use operações interativas para girar ou mover o módulo junto à trajetória definida.
target: Use interactive operations to rotate or move the module along the set trajectory.

source: Use os botões direcionais para controlar o movimento e os botões direitos para controlar a elevação. Aperte o botão "Sair" para finalizar o controle. A Mão de Zagreus permanecerá no local.
target: Use the directional keys to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Use sua coleção de figurinhas para decorar seu livro e melhorar seu progresso de conclusão.
target: Use your stickers collection to decorate your scrapbook and boost its completion progress.

source: Utiliser des consommables peut vous aider à mieux faire face à toutes sortes de dangers que vous pourrez rencontrer au cours de votre voyage.
target: Use Consumables can help the Trailblazer better deal with all kinds of danger they might come across in the journey.

source: Utiliser la technique d'Achéron pendant l'exploration sur les ennemis normaux permet de les éliminer instantanément sans avoir à engager le combat. Aucun point de technique n'est utilisé si aucun ennemi n'est touché.
target: During exploration, using Acheron's Technique to hit normal enemies will instantly defeat them without entering combat. When the Technique does not hit an enemy, no Technique Points are consumed.

source: Utiliser vos Codes mystiques conceptuels dans le bon ordre est la clé de la victoire !
target: Using your Conceptual Mystic Codes in the right order is the key to victory!

source: Utilisez Vitesse ×2 pour expérimenter des combats plus rapides. Cependant, Vitesse ×2 sera temporairement désactivé lors de certains combats spéciaux.
target: Use 2× speed to experience quicker battles. However, 2× speed will be temporarily turned off in some special combat situations.

source: Utilisez correctement les compétences ou les ultimes pour attaquer l'ennemi et déclencher Départ résolu.
target: Correctly use Skill or Ultimate to attack the enemy to trigger "Solved Departure."

source: Utilisez des capacités à ZdE pour attaquer les ennemis. Après avoir vaincu un ennemi qui n'est pas un boss, inflige au boss des DGT avec d'importants multiplicateurs en fonction des DGT de débordement infligés lors de cette attaque.
target: Use AoE abilities to attack enemies. After defeating a non-boss enemy, deals DMG with huge multipliers to the boss based on the Overflow DMG dealt in this attack.

source: Utilisez des fragments cosmiques pour renforcer les bénédictions obtenues. Chaque bénédiction ne peut être renforcée qu'1 fois.
target: Consume Cosmic Fragments to enhance Blessings that have been obtained. Each Blessing can only be enhanced 1 time.

source: Utilisez l'ultime du personnage en position 1 dans l'équipe pour déclencher un moment de gloire et gagner d'importantes quantités de points d'engouement.
target: Have the character in Position 1 in the team use their Ultimate and trigger Highlights to obtain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: Utilisez l'ultime du personnage en position 1 dans l'équipe. Le personnage régénère 100 % de son énergie pour chaque tranche de 10 ennemis touchés.
target: Have the character in Position 1 in the team use their Ultimate. With every 10 enemies hit in total, they immediately regenerate 100% of Energy.

source: Utilisez l'échelle pour monter ou descendre. Utiliser une échelle ne coûte qu'une action, qu'importe sa longueur.
target: Use the ladder to move up or down. You only need to take one step for each ladder, regardless of their length.

source: Utilisez la Balance de la justice sur la carte pour terminer l'épreuve d'Oronyx.
target: Use the Scales of Justice in the map to complete Oronyx's test.

source: Utilisez la Clé de démontage pour réassigner librement les équipements équipés et maximiser la puissance de combat de votre équipe.
target: Use the Disassembly Wrench to freely reassign equipped gears and maximize your team's combat power.

source: Utilisez la capacité Explosion d'azote pour augmenter considérablement votre vitesse.
target: Use the Nitrous Burst ability to greatly increase your speed

source: Utilisez la carte en trois dimensions pour planifier votre itinéraire vers le coffre au trésor. Vous obtenez une récompense bonus si vous utilisez toutes les dalles Félicitâme de la carte avant d'ouvrir le coffre !
target: Adeptly use the three-dimensional map and plot a reasonable route toward the treasure chest. If you walk across all SoulGlad Floor Tiles in the map before opening the chest at the end, then you'll get a bonus reward!

source: Utilisez la flamme sacrée en votre possession pour illuminer l'autel, et apporter la lumière à ce monde !
target: Use the holy flame in hand to light up the altar and bring light to this world!

source: Utilisez la fonction « Personnalisation de la déco » dans votre chambre pour placer divers meubles obtenus lors de vos aventures.
target: Use the "Décor Customization" feature in your room to place various furniture items obtained during your adventures.

source: Utilisez le bouton dans le coin inférieur droit pour allumer ou éteindre les orbes. Utilisez le bouton Retour pour sortir de l'interface des orbes.
target: Use the Switch button in the bottom-right corner to turn on or off the orb's light. Use the Quit button to exit the control interface of the orb.

source: Utilisez le combat automatique pour lancer des capacités et combattre automatiquement. Cependant, vous ne pouvez pas utiliser le combat automatique lors de certains combats spéciaux.
target: Use auto-battle to cast abilities and fight automatically. However, auto-battle cannot be used in some special combat situations.

source: Utilisez le joystick droit pour pivoter la caméra. Utilisez le joystick gauche pour faire bouger l'écran. Appuyez sur le bouton de réinitialisation dans le coin inférieur droit pour réinitialiser votre caméra.
target: Use the right joystick to rotate the camera. Use the left joystick to move the screen. Press the reset button in the bottom right corner to reset your camera.

source: Utilisez le joystick en bas à gauche pour contrôler ses déplacements et les boutons sur la droite pour la faire monter ou descendre. Utilisez le bouton Quitter pour arrêter de contrôler la main. La Main de Zagreus restera à son emplacement.
target: Drag the joystick at the bottom left to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Utilisez le joystick pour contrôler ses déplacements et les boutons sur la droite pour la faire monter ou descendre. Utilisez le bouton Quitter pour arrêter de contrôler la main. La Main de Zagreus restera à son emplacement.
target: Use the left joystick to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

source: Utilisez le mécanisme Rupture de faiblesse pour infliger une Rupture de faiblesse à la Poubelle vénérable (projection) et augmenter le rang du bonus de niveau. À mesure que le rang du bonus de niveau augmente, sa note s'améliore.
target: After using the Weakness Break mechanic to break the Lordly Trashcan (Projection)'s Weakness, you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: Utilisez le phonographe pour changer la musique lorsque vous êtes à bord de l'Express. Lors de votre exploration, vous pourrez obtenir de nouveaux disques pour débloquer de nouveaux morceaux.
target: Use the Phonograph to change the music when on the Express. By exploring various worlds, you can obtain new records to unlock new tracks.

source: Utilisez le point d'intersection de plusieurs faisceaux lumineux de guidage pour déduire l'emplacement de la cible. Ensuite, utilisez le détecteur d'objets à usage domestique à cet emplacement pour trouver la cible.
target: By using the intersection points where multiple guiding light beams meet, you can deduce the target's location. At that location, use the Home-Use Object Finder again to locate the target.

source: Utilisez les flèches directionnelles pour contrôler ses déplacements et les boutons sur la droite pour la faire monter ou descendre. Utilisez le bouton Quitter pour arrêter de contrôler la main. La Main de Zagreus restera à son emplacement.
target: Use the directional keys to control the movement and the right-side buttons to ascend and descend. Hit the Quit button to disengage. The Hand of Zagreus will remain at the spot.

target: Use interactive operations to rotate or move the module along the set trajectory.

source: Utilisez vos autocollants pour décorer votre journal et avancer dans sa progression.
target: Use your stickers collection to decorate your scrapbook and boost its completion progress.

source: Utiliza el interruptor de la esquina inferior derecha para encender o apagar la luz de los orbes. Utiliza el botón de Volver para salir de la interfaz de control de los orbes.

source: Utiliza hábilmente el mapa tridimensional y traza una ruta adecuada hacia el cofre. Si atraviesas todas las losetas FelizAlma del mapa antes de abrir el cofre del final, ¡obtendrás una recompensa adicional!
target: Adeptly use the three-dimensional map and plot a reasonable route toward the treasure chest. If you walk across all SoulGlad Floor Tiles in the map before opening the chest at the end, then you'll get a bonus reward!

source: Utiliza los puntos de intersección donde se cruzan varias luces guía para deducir la ubicación del objetivo. Vuelve a utilizar el buscador doméstico de objetos en esa ubicación para localizar el objetivo.
target: By using the intersection points where multiple guiding light beams meet, you can deduce the target's location. At that location, use the Home-Use Object Finder again to locate the target.

source: Verschiedene Mülltonnen bringen unterschiedliche Punkte ein. Fotografiere so viele Mülltonnen wie möglich, um das Ziel der Etappe zu erreichen.
target: Different qualities of trashcans will give different scores. Take as many pictures of trashcans as possible and complete the stage objective.

source: Verschränkung fügt dem Ziel zu Beginn seiner Runde zusätzlichen Quanten-SCH zu. Wenn das Ziel angegriffen wird, während es sich im Status Verschränkung befindet, wird der zusätzliche SCH erhöht.
target: Entanglement will deal Additional Quantum DMG at the start of the enemy target's turn. If the target is attacked while under Entanglement, the Additional DMG taken will increase.

target: The enshadowed version of you is a foe that will strictly follow your previous actions and advance accordingly until the recorded steps have ended. Remember: Do not make contact with them.

source: Versorgungsvorräte füllen die zur Erkundung benötigte Ausdauer auf. Ist deine Ausdauer aufgebraucht, so werden stattdessen LP verbraucht.

target: Do your best to make the same character perform consecutive actions. You will accumulate a large amount of Grit Value after the same character performs consecutive actions

source: Versuche, dem Sichtfeld der Gegner auszuweichen, und sprinte, um dich deinen Gegnern anzunähern und sie alle auf einmal auszuschalten.

target: Use the Phonograph to change the music when on the Express. By exploring various worlds, you can obtain new records to unlock new tracks.

source: Verwende den rechten Joystick, um die Kamera zu drehen. Verwende den linken Joystick, um den Bildschirm zu verschieben. Drücke auf die Schaltfläche „Zurücksetzen“ in der unteren rechten Ecke, um die Kamera zurückzusetzen.
target: Use the right joystick to rotate the camera. Use the left joystick to move the screen. Press the reset button in the bottom right corner to reset your camera.

source: Verwende die Schaltfläche „Umschalten“ in der unteren rechten Ecke, um das Licht der Sphäre ein- oder auszuschalten. Verwende die Schaltfläche „Beenden“, um die Bedienoberfläche der Sphäre zu verlassen.
target: Use the Switch button in the bottom-right corner to turn on or off the orb's light. Use the Quit button to exit the control interface of the orb.

source: Veuillez améliorer la capacité de survie de votre équipe en trouvant des personnages orientés vers le soin, des synergies ou de l'équipement de soutien appropriés pour éviter que le combat ne se termine prématurément.
target: Please improve your team's survivability by finding suitable healer characters, Bonds, or sustain equipment to avoid combat ending prematurely.

source: Veuillez observer l'itinéraire des monstres et utiliser les objets sur la carte pour obstruer leur champ de vision. Atteignez la destination sans vous faire repérer par les monstres.
target: Please observe the monsters' paths and utilize objects in the map to obstruct their line of sight. Reach the destination without being detected by the monsters.

target: Please spray graffiti in the target area in accordance with the different requirements.
