source: 「2차원 JUMP!」 게임 「별의 궤도 토끼」의 개발팀은 곳곳에 각기 다른 성격의 이름 없는 진령을 배치했습니다. JUMP! 밖에서 가까이 다가가 상호작용을 하거나 JUMP! 안에서 그들에게 닿으면 즉시 이름 없는 진령을 소집할 수 있습니다
target: The developers of the Interplanar Jump! game "Star Rabbit" have placed nameless wispae with diverse personalities across different sites. You can gather them by interacting up close outside the Jump or by touching them inside the Jump.

source: 「2차원 JUMP!」에서는 다양한 형태의 개척 요정으로 변신해 각종 흥미로운 콘텐츠를 체험할 수 있습니다. 물론 「2차원 JUMP!」에는 다양한 보상도 준비되어 있으니 획득해 보세요
target: In "Interplanar Jump!," you can transform into different forms of Trailblazemon and experience all kinds of fun content. Of course, there are also various rewards in "Interplanar Jump!" just waiting to be claimed.

source: 「2차원 ROTATE!」에서는 맵을 회전시켜 다른 방식으로 세계를 바라볼 수 있습니다. 왜곡된 공간 속에 있던 작은 동물들의 색이 여기저기로 흩어졌어요. 당신의 능력을 발휘해 이 공간의 「물감을 회수」하고 동물들을 구해주세요~
target: In "Shiftmation!" you can rotate the scene to see the world from different perspectives. In this warped space, the colors of the little critters have scattered everywhere. Use your abilities to "recover paint" and save them!

source: 「Fate/stay night」では条件を満たした場合、キャラクターレベル、光円錐レベル、軌跡、遺物が強化されます。
target: In "Fate/stay night," character levels, Light Cone levels, Traces, and Relics can be enhanced if requirements are met.

source: 「Fate/stay night」에서 캐릭터 레벨, 광추 레벨, 행적과 유물은 조건 충족 시 강화됩니다
target: In "Fate/stay night," character levels, Light Cone levels, Traces, and Relics can be enhanced if requirements are met.

source: 「びっくり箱」は戦闘をサポートしてくれます。行動時に特殊な効果が発動し、戦闘を有利に進められます。
target: The Surprise Box will assist in combat. When it takes action, it triggers special effects that help during battles.

source: 「まとわりつく恐怖」状態が終了する時まで、付与者を攻撃して「まとわりつく恐怖」を解除できなかった場合、「恐怖」状態に陥り、行動できなくなります。
target: When Terror Grip ends, if the caster of Terror Grip is not attacked to dispel Terror Grip, then the affected ally will fall into the Terrified state and be unable to perform actions.

source: 「インテリアカスタマイズ」機能を利用して、冒険の中で手に入れた家具を部屋の中に配置できます。
target: Use the "Décor Customization" feature in your room to place various furniture items obtained during your adventures.

source: 「エディオンコイン」を消費して様々なゲームマシンをプレイできます。プレイすると、低確率で貴重な報酬を獲得できます。
target: You can use Aideen Tokens to play various amusement facilities and have a small chance of winning valuable rewards.

source: 「エリア-休憩」ではすべての宇宙の欠片を消費して、大量の祝福を購入することができます。
target: You can consume all your Cosmic Fragments within Domain — Respite to buy a great number of Blessings.

source: 「エリア-休憩」では所有している奇物の数に対応する数の祝福を獲得して、「ノーマル次元界」クリア後の高難易度の「最終試練」の戦闘に立ち向かうことができます。
target: While in a "Domain — Respite," you can gain Blessings equal in number to the number of Curios you already possess to handle the Final Trial that you must face after clearing all Ordinary Plane stages.

source: 「エリア-休憩」内のショップではイベント限定祝福を強化できます。各ショップ内では、各祝福を1回強化できます。
target: The store within Domain — Respite can Enhance event-limited Blessings. In each store, all Blessings can be Enhanced 1 time.

source: 「エンドレス次元界」ルール
target: "Planar Infinity" Plane Rules

source: 「エンドレス次元界」特殊ショップ
target: "Planar Infinity" Special Store

source: 「オロニクスの祈言」を使うと、崩れた浮き橋をしばらく浮遊した状態に戻すことができます。
target: Oronyx's Prayer can be used to temporarily rewind the collapsed floating bridge to its levitating state.

source: 「オロニクスの祈言」を使うと鎮球の彫像を台座が破壊される前の状態まで戻すことができます。
target: Oronyx's Prayer can be used to rewind the Ball-Holder Statue to when its base is undamaged.

source: 「オロニクスの神座」を調べると、歳月の界域を呼び出すことができます。界域内では、記憶を宿すものにおけるエネルギー波の色が変化します。この時、開拓者の時間を遡る能力に制約はなくなります。
target: Interacting with Oronyx's Shrine summons the Realm of the Ages. Within this realm, the color of the energy ripples on memory-laden objects changes, indicating that the Trailblazer's rewinding ability is now unrestricted.

source: 「キーワード」を含む任意の祝福または方程式を獲得すると、対応する特性を開放できます。
target: Obtain any Blessings or Equations that have the "keyword" to activate the corresponding Trait.

source: 「クロックトリック」：心境チューニング
target: Clockwork: Emo Tuning

source: 「クロックトリック」：感情補完
target: Clockwork: Emotional Integration

source: 「クロックマネー」を支払って彫像のレベルを上げると、報酬を受け取れます。
target: Spend Clock Credits to raise the Statue's level and gain rewards.

source: 「コズミック・ハウジングガイド」をクリアすると、開拓者は星穹列車の「パーティー車両」2階に自分の部屋を手に入れられます。
target: After completing the "Cosmic Home Décor Guide" event, Trailblazers will have their own room on the second floor of the Party Car of the Astral Express.

source: 「コズミック・フォース」は、キャラクターカードと、カード右上にある、対応するサイコロを使った対戦ゲームです。
target: "Cosmicon Collective" is a gameplay mode where you battle using character cards and their corresponding dice shown in the top-right corner of the cards.

source: 「コメディアン」は「耐笑度」が溜まると「びっくり箱」をチャージします。 「耐笑度」が高いほど、「びっくり箱」の効果は強くなります。
target: The Comedian can charge the Surprise Box by gaining Giggle Gauge. The higher the Giggle Gauge, the stronger the effect of the Surprise Box.

source: 「コレクションケース」機能を使うことで、「開拓」の旅で手に入れた様々な記念フィギュアや栄誉の勲章、旅の写真などを飾れます。「コレクションケース」は巡星ビザに表示されます。
target: Through the "Collection Showcase" feature, you can set up various commemorative figures, honor badges, and travel photos obtained during your Trailblaze journey. Your "Collection Showcase" will be shown in your Trailblazer Profile.

source: 「ザグレウスの手」が運搬可能な荷物を持っている場合、マークのついた荷物置き場が見えるようになります。運搬可能な荷物を持って荷物置き場に近づくと対応する置き場に運ぶことができます。
target: While the Hand of Zagreus is carrying a transportable object, placement spots with marks of placement can be seen. Interacting with the placement spots while carrying a transportable object will place it at the corresponding location.

source: 「ザグレウスの手」は「詭術」のタイタン、ザグレウスの神体の一部です。ザグレウスが命を落とした後、オンパロスの人々はその神体を自分たちの役に立てるよう改造しました。
target: Hand of Zagreus is the divine body left behind by Zagreus, the Trickery Titan. After the Titan had fallen, the people of Amphoreus learned to modify and utilize them.

source: 「ザグレウスの手」はチャージ後に一定の破壊力を持ちながら突進することができます。
target: The Hand of Zagreus can charge up, and then sprint in a straight line, during which it will gain a certain degree of destructive power.

source: 「ザグレウスの手」は運搬に使えます。
target: The Hand of Zagreus can be used for transportation.

source: 「ザグレウスの手」を操作してザグレウスの印に近づけると「橋渡し」が行えます。印のある位置で「ザグレウスの手」が橋となり、通過することができます。
target: While controlling the Hand of Zagreus, interact with the golden Zagreus rune to perform a Bridge Action, forming a bridge where the rune is located to provide passage to the Trailblazer.

source: 「ザグレウスの手」付近に藍石の山が存在する場合、「飛翔試練」の一部となることがあります。近くに散乱する藍石を拾って藍石の山を復元すると隠されている「飛翔する幣」を獲得できます。
target: Some indigo steel piles may be found near a Hand of Zagreus, and sometimes those piles can become part of the Trial of Whimsy. Transport the scattered indigo steel pieces and restore the pile to obtain the hidden Coin of Whimsy.

source: 「ザンダー」が「論証形態」の時、敵が消滅する、または記憶の精霊が退場することで「ザンダー」の形態切り替えを加速させ、脅威を軽減できます。
target: When Zandar switches to "Disputation Mode," defeating enemy targets or ally memosprites disappearing will accelerate Zandar's mode switching and reduce threat.

source: 「ザンダー」が「進化形態」の時、フィールドに敵が出現する、または記憶の精霊が召喚されることで「ザンダー」の形態切り替えが加速します。
target: When Zandar switches to "Evolution Mode," enemy targets appearing on the battlefield or ally memosprites being summoned can accelerate Zandar's mode-switching.

source: 「シンクロモード」でペペを操作しながら進んでいる時、もしモンスターに気づかれたら、ペペは脱出装置を起動し、強制的に最も近い安全ポイントに戻ります。
target: While controlling Peppy in Sync Mode, if Peppy gets detected by any nearby monsters, it will activate its emergency escape device and return to the nearest safety area.

source: 「シーフ」を制裁できるのはオロニクスの力だけです。飛翔する幣の近くで、逃走に使った空間の裂け目に向かって「オロニクスの祈言」の時間を遡る力を使うことで、「シーフ」を捕まえられます。
target: The only thing that can punish them is Oronyx's power. When near a Coin of Whimsy, use the rewinding powers provided by Oronyx's Prayer upon the fissures the thief escapes through to get the Spirithief to come back.

source: 「スタンダードゲーム」はマネーウォーズの通常プレイモードです。 スタンダードゲームに挑戦することで、職級を昇進させることができます。
target: "Standard Gambit" is the regular game mode for Currency Wars. Challenging Standard Gambit allows you to be promoted in rank.

source: 「ストレンジ・ビーン」は自動で通常エネミーを索敵および攻撃し、秘技PTを1消費して戦闘に入ることなく即座に倒す。
target: "Funky Munch Bean" will automatically search for and attack Normal Enemies. Consume 1 Technique Point to immediately defeat them without entering combat.

source: 「スペシャルレシピ」の隠し効果
target: "Special Mix Recipe" Hidden Effects

source: 「ドリームメイクパズル」には不安定なピースが存在します。そのピースに触れると、ピースが逃げ出し、マップ中の他の位置に移動します。
target: Some Dream Jigsaw pieces are unstable and may move to another location in the scene during interaction.

source: 「ドリームレンズ」を調べることで、ドリームメーカーの視点に入る、あるいは退出することができます。
target: Interact with the Dream's Eye to enter or exit the Dreamweaver's View.

source: 「ドリームレンズ」を起動するとドリームメーカーの視点に切り替わります。この視点では、切断された道や高低差がある道は不思議な方式で繋がります。
target: Activating the Dream's Eye allows you to switch to the Dreamweaver's View. In this mode, disconnected paths or those with height discrepancies will be connected in an incredible way.

source: 「ノーマル次元界」は7層の異なる探索エリアによって構成されています。「ノーマル次元界」の中で大量の祝福、奇物を集めることで「最終試練」の戦闘に立ち向かうことができます。
target: Ordinary Planes are made up of 7 different explorable domains. You can accumulate a vast amount of Blessings and Curios in Ordinary Planes before challenging the highly difficult Final Trial.

source: 「ノーマル次元界」をクリアすると、「最終試練」が解放されます。 「最終試練」は複数ウェーブある高難易度戦闘です。ウェーブが進むにつれ、獲得できる「試練ポイント」と報酬がアップします。
target: After clearing the Ordinary Planes, the Final Trial will be unlocked. The Final Trial is made up of multiple waves of extremely difficult battles that give increasingly greater amount of Trial Points and rewards the more waves you defeat.

source: 「ハイスピードゲーム」では、各パートの開始時に通常よりも多くの経験値とコインを自動で獲得しますが、利息は獲得できなくなっています。
target: In Overclock Gambit mode, at the start of each Node, you'll automatically gain more Experience and Gold Coins, but no longer receive Interest.

source: 「ハイスピードゲーム」では、各次元界が通常よりも少ないパートで構成されています。
target: In Overclock Gambit, each plane has fewer progression nodes.

source: 「ハイスピードゲーム」はプレイ時間が短いクイックモードで、各次元界は通常よりも少ないパートで構成されています。
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, with fewer progression nodes in each plane.

source: 「ハイスピードゲーム」はプレイ時間の短いクイックモードで、週間ポイントミッションの達成に利用できます。
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, and can be used to complete Weekly Points mission rewards.

source: 「ハイスピードゲーム」モードでは挑戦難易度を自由に選択できますが、クリアしても職級は昇進しません。
target: In Overclock Gambit mode, you can freely choose the challenge difficulty, but cannot increase your rank after completion.

source: 「ハッキング声明」
target: "Hacking Callcard"

source: 「ハヌロケット弾」を使って花火を誘爆させると、より範囲の大きい爆発を起こして敵を倒せます。その一撃で、壁を破壊することもできます。
target: If you use the Hanu Rocket to ignite the fireworks, it will trigger an explosion that defeats enemies, and is even capable of destroying walls.

source: 「ファイナルチャレンジ」段階では、敵を倒すことでポイントを獲得できます。 残りラウンドがある場合、追加ポイントを獲得できます。
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: 「ファイナルチャレンジ」段階では「ステージバフ」のランクを上げることはできません。
target: Your Stage Buff rank will not be upgraded during the Final Showdown phase.

source: 「プリズムサイコロ」には使用回数の制限があります。通常は1回の対戦につき2回までしか使用できません。
target: The Prismatic Dice has limited uses. You can typically only use it twice per match.

source: 「プリズムサイコロ」は、他のサイコロと同様に振り直しが可能です。
target: Prismatic Dice can be rerolled just like other dice.

source: 「プリズムサイコロ」は、他のサイコロと同様に振り直しが可能です。
target: The Prismatic Dice can be rerolled like other dice.

source: 「ボルダータウン・スーパーリーグ」
target: Boulder Town Super League

source: 「ボルダータウン・スーパーリーグ」では、様々なトーナメントに挑戦して報酬を勝ち取ることができます。
target: In the Boulder Town Super League, Trailblazers can challenge different tournaments to win the corresponding tournament rewards.

source: 「マイリトルゴミー」は戦闘中に「魔法使い」の一部ステータスとバフを引き継ぎます。 「マイリトルゴミー」が敵を攻撃したり、敵から攻撃を受けたりすると、「魔法使い」がEPを回復します。
target: Litter Pony will inherit the Magician's certain stat values and buff effects. When Litter Pony attacks an enemy or is attacked by an enemy, regenerates Energy for the Magician.

source: 「マネーウォーズ」でのキャラクターを雇用時、 該当キャラクターを所持している場合、キャラクターの育成データはそのまま引き継がれます。 該当キャラクターを所持していない場合、対応するお試しキャラを雇用してプレイできます。
target: When recruiting characters in "Currency Wars": If you already own the character, you will inherit your character's build data. If you don't own the character, you can recruit a trial version of the character to play with.

source: 「マネーウォーズ」では、メンバーを集めて、8～10人のパーティを編成して戦闘を行い、競争相手たちを打ち倒していきます。
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8-10 members, and defeat your opponents!

source: 「マネーウォーズ」では、メンバーを集めて、8～10人のパーティを編成して戦闘を行い、競争相手たちを打ち倒していきます。
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8–10 members, and defeat your competitors.

source: 「マネーウォーズ」では、各キャラクターに最大3つの装備を装着できます。 キャラクターに適切な装備を身につけさせることで、戦闘能力を大きく向上させることができます。
target: In Currency Wars, you can equip up to 3 pieces of Equipment on each Character. Equipping suitable gears on a character can significantly boost that character's combat ability.

source: 「マネーウォーズ」において、コインはキャラクターの雇用、パーティ規模の拡張、ショップの更新に使用する重要なリソースです。 より多くのコインを獲得することがパーティ全体の戦力向上に繋がります。
target: In "Currency Wars", Gold Coins are the core economic resource used for recruiting characters, upgrading team size, and refreshing Store offerings. Gain more Gold Coins to enhance your team's combat power.

source: 「マネーウォーズ」には、初期職級が設定されています。 スタンダードゲームで、現在の最高職級難度への挑戦に成功すると、決算時に残りのパーティHPに応じた挑戦評価が与えられ、職級を昇進させることができます。
target: In Currency Wars, you start with an initial rank. Successfully challenging the current highest rank difficulty in the Standard Gambit mode will earn you a battle rating based on your remaining squad HP, allowing you to rank up.

source: 「マネーウォーズ」の戦闘では、前衛キャラクターは自動的に秘技を使用して戦闘を開始します。
target: In "Currency Wars", on-field characters will automatically use Techniques in combat.

source: 「ヤドリギ」号が加速リングを通過すると、強力な加速効果が発動しますが、加速中は方向操作ができなくなります。
target: Piloting the Mistletoe through an Acceleration Ring will grant a powerful speed boost effect, during which directional control is disabled.

source: 「ライフカウント」を持つユニットは攻撃を受けた時、HPの代わりに「ライフカウント」が減少します。「ライフカウント」が0になった時、そのユニットは戦闘不能状態になります。「ライフカウント」の減少は、治療やバリアで防ぐことはできません。
target: Units with "HP Count" will not lose HP when attacked, but their "HP Count" will decrease instead. When the "HP Count" reaches zero, the unit will be knocked down. Healing and Shield effects cannot prevent "HP Count" reduction.

source: 「世負い」の試練・1
target: Worldbearing Trial I

source: 「世負い」の試練・2
target: Worldbearing Trial II

source: 「乗客の模範」はチームメンバー全員の当番レベルを、チーム内で最も当番レベルが高いメンバーと同じレベルまで引き上げることができます。
target: The Passenger Paragons card can elevate all members' Duty Level to match the highest Duty Level within the team.

source: 「二律背反」状態になると必殺技が使用可能になります。ただし、効果中に必殺技を発動すると大量のHPを失います。
target: The "Antinomy" state will activate Ultimates. However, using an Ultimate during this effect will cost massive HP.

source: 「二次元JUMP！」游戏「星轨之兔」的制作方在各地安置了性格各异的无名尘灵。在JUMP！外靠近交互或者在JUMP！内触碰即可召集无名尘灵。
target: The developers of the Interplanar Jump! game "Star Rabbit" have placed nameless wispae with diverse personalities across different sites. You can gather them by interacting up close outside the Jump or by touching them inside the Jump.

source: 「二次元JUMP！」遊戲「星軌之兔」的製作方在各地安置了性格各異的無名塵靈。在JUMP！外靠近互動或者在JUMP！內觸碰即可召集無名塵靈。
target: The developers of the Interplanar Jump! game "Star Rabbit" have placed nameless wispae with diverse personalities across different sites. You can gather them by interacting up close outside the Jump or by touching them inside the Jump.

source: 「二次元ジャンプ」ゲーム「星軌の兎」の制作チームは、性格の異なる「名もなき初」を各所に配置しました。「二次元ジャンプ」の外でインタラクトする、または「二次元ジャンプ」の中で直接触れることで、名もなき初を召集できます。
target: The developers of the Interplanar Jump! game "Star Rabbit" have placed nameless wispae with diverse personalities across different sites. You can gather them by interacting up close outside the Jump or by touching them inside the Jump.

source: 「二次元ジャンプ！」内では、さまざまな形態を持つ開拓の妖精に変身して、多彩なコンテンツを楽しめます。もちろん報酬も盛りだくさんで、あなたに獲得してもらうのを待っています。
target: In "Interplanar Jump!," you can transform into different forms of Trailblazemon and experience all kinds of fun content. Of course, there are also various rewards in "Interplanar Jump!" just waiting to be claimed.

source: 「二次元ローリング！」では、シーンを回転させることで、世界を別の角度から見ることができます。歪んだ空間の中で、動物たちの色が散ってしまいました。力を駆使し、空間内の「絵の具を回収」して生き物たちを助けましょう！
target: In "Shiftmation!" you can rotate the scene to see the world from different perspectives. In this warped space, the colors of the little critters have scattered everywhere. Use your abilities to "recover paint" and save them!

source: 「仮想訓練」では、より高難易度である番人に挑戦することができます。 演武試合を勝ち進んでいくと、新たな「仮想訓練」が解放されます。
target: Participate in Dreamscape Training to issue challenges against higher difficulty ringmasters. Every time you pass a Faceoff Match, you can unlock new Dreamscape Training.

source: 「仮想訓練」では行動を通して「白熱値」を獲得することはできません。 「ハイライトシーン」の上演を通してのみ「白熱値」を獲得でき、「応援強化」状態に入ることができます。
target: While in Dreamscape Training, you are unable to obtain Vibes through actions. Only by performing Highlights can you gain Vibes and enter the "Super Hype" state.

source: 「再考」することで選択中の報告を放棄し、放棄したものと同じ数の報告を獲得できます。メンバーごとに報告の数に上限があるため、ご注意ください。
target: Using "Mental Reset", you can discard selected reports and draw the same number of new ones. Please note that each team member has a limit on the total number of reports.

source: 「前衛」キャラ特別スキル： キャラクター本来のスキルが強化される、または新たなスキルを獲得できます。
target: "On-Field" Character Empowerment: Character's base abilities are enhanced, or they gain brand-new combat abilities.

source: 「区域-休整」内可消耗全部宇宙碎片，购买大量祝福。
target: You can consume all your Cosmic Fragments within Domain — Respite to buy a great number of Blessings.

source: 「区域-休整」内商店可对活动限定祝福进行强化。每个商店内，每个祝福可被强化1次。
target: The store within Domain — Respite can Enhance event-limited Blessings. In each store, all Blessings can be Enhanced 1 time.

source: 「區域-整備」內可消耗全部宇宙碎片，購買大量祝福。
target: You can consume all your Cosmic Fragments within Domain — Respite to buy a great number of Blessings.

source: 「區域-整備」內商店可對活動限定祝福進行強化。每個商店內，每個祝福可被強化1次。
target: The store within Domain — Respite can Enhance event-limited Blessings. In each store, all Blessings can be Enhanced 1 time.

source: 「千星カップ」決勝
target: Astropolis Cup Finals

source: 「千星杯」决赛
target: Astropolis Cup Finals

source: 「千星盃」決賽
target: Astropolis Cup Finals

source: 「古いボトルと新たな友」：ドリンク調合
target: "Old Brews & New Friends": Mixing Drinks

source: 「合金メカヨロイ・パムキング」が「高温殺菌モード」を発動すると、一定層数の「持続除菌」効果を獲得し、自身の受けるダメージが大幅にダウンする。
target: After "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom" uses "High-Temp Sterilization Mode," it gains several stacks of "Lasting Antibac," greatly reducing the DMG taken by it.

source: 「合金メカヨロイ・パムキング」の「持続除菌」効果が全部クリアされた時、大量のダメージを受ける。
target: When all "Lasting Antibac" effects are removed from "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom," it takes massive DMG.

source: 「喜剧人」可以获得「憋笑度」，为「惊笑盒」充能。 「憋笑度」越高，「惊笑盒」的效果越强。
target: The Comedian can charge the Surprise Box by gaining Giggle Gauge. The higher the Giggle Gauge, the stronger the effect of the Surprise Box.

source: 「喜劇人」可以獲得「憋笑度」，為「驚笑盒」充能。 「憋笑度」越高，「驚笑盒」的效果越強。
target: The Comedian can charge the Surprise Box by gaining Giggle Gauge. The higher the Giggle Gauge, the stronger the effect of the Surprise Box.

source: 「夕食会議」で当番報告書をパムに提出すると、パムポイントに応じて追加の「列車基金」を獲得できます。
target: During the Dinner Meeting phase, you can select and submit Duty Reports to obtain Express Funds based on the score received from Pom-Pom.

source: 「夢のワインタワー」を調べることで「夢泡チャージ」を獲得できます。
target: Approach Bubble Tower and interact with it to obtain Bubble Charges.

source: 「夢の並び替え」プレイガイド
target: Dreamy Slots Gameplay Details

source: 「夢泡チャージ」を持った状態で離散した夢の泡に近づいた時、「夢泡収束」を使用し、歩ける夢泡の橋を作り出せます。
target: While carrying Bubble Charges near a dispersed bubble, you can use Bubble Converge to construct a Bubble Bridge that can be traversed.

source: 「密径驱动机构」链接着翁法罗斯全域的雅努斯密径，将其启动后，所有已解锁的密径都将进入「瞬时生效」状态。
target: The Secret Path Mechanism connects to all Janus's Hidden Passages across Amphoreus. Once activated, all unlocked passages will enter an Instant Activation state.

source: 「密徑驅動機構」連結著翁法羅斯全域的雅努斯密徑，將其啟動後，所有已解鎖的密徑都將進入「瞬時生效」狀態。
target: The Secret Path Mechanism connects to all Janus's Hidden Passages across Amphoreus. Once activated, all unlocked passages will enter an Instant Activation state.

source: 「専門アドバイザー」は初期状態では通常のショップに登場しませんが、開拓者は挑戦中に特定の「投資環境」、「投資戦略」または「アドバイザー招待状」を通じて「専門アドバイザー」を解放できます。
target: Expert Advisors are initially unavailable through normal Store recruitment, but Trailblazers can unlock Expert Advisors during runs through specific Investment Environments, Investment Strategies, or Expert Invitations.

source: 「小桶宝力」在战斗中会继承「魔法师」的部分属性数值和增益效果。 「小桶宝力」攻击敌人或受到敌人攻击时，会为「魔法师」恢复能量。
target: Litter Pony will inherit the Magician's certain stat values and buff effects. When Litter Pony attacks an enemy or is attacked by an enemy, regenerates Energy for the Magician.

source: 「小桶寶力」在戰鬥中會繼承「魔法師」的部分屬性數值和增益效果。 「小桶寶力」攻擊敵人或受到敵人攻擊時，會為「魔法師」恢復能量。
target: Litter Pony will inherit the Magician's certain stat values and buff effects. When Litter Pony attacks an enemy or is attacked by an enemy, regenerates Energy for the Magician.

source: 「差分宇宙」中，透過啟動靈感迴路可解鎖命途特性。
target: In Divergent Universe, activate Inspiration Circuits to unlock Path Traits.

source: 「差分宇宙」中，通过激活灵感回路可解锁命途特性。
target: In Divergent Universe, activate Inspiration Circuits to unlock Path Traits.

source: 「常規次元」由7層不同的探索區域組成，在「常規次元」內可累積大量祝福、奇物，以應對高難度的「最終試煉」戰鬥。
target: Ordinary Planes are made up of 7 different explorable domains. You can accumulate a vast amount of Blessings and Curios in Ordinary Planes before challenging the highly difficult Final Trial.

source: 「常規次元」過關後，將開啟「最終試煉」。 「最終試煉」由多層高難度戰鬥組成，挑戰更高層數的敵人可獲得更高的「試煉點數」，並獲得更多獎勵。
target: After clearing the Ordinary Planes, the Final Trial will be unlocked. The Final Trial is made up of multiple waves of extremely difficult battles that give increasingly greater amount of Trial Points and rewards the more waves you defeat.

source: 「常规位面」由7层不同的探索区域组成，在「常规位面」内可积累大量祝福、奇物，以应对高难度的「最终试炼」战斗。
target: Ordinary Planes are made up of 7 different explorable domains. You can accumulate a vast amount of Blessings and Curios in Ordinary Planes before challenging the highly difficult Final Trial.

source: 「常规位面」通关后，将开启「最终试炼」。 「最终试炼」由多层高难度战斗组成，挑战更高层数的敌人可获得更高的「试炼点数」，并获得更多奖励。
target: After clearing the Ordinary Planes, the Final Trial will be unlocked. The Final Trial is made up of multiple waves of extremely difficult battles that give increasingly greater amount of Trial Points and rewards the more waves you defeat.

source: 「幸福」状態を付与されたキャラは、ターン開始時に層数が増加する。ターン終了時に一定の層数に達していると、「幸福傀儡」に変わる。
target: Characters afflicted with the "Happiness" state will gain stacks at the start of their turn. Once they reach a certain number of stacks at the end of their turn, they will be converted into a "Happiness Puppet."

source: 「开拓，友谊魔法！」活动中，熟悉的角色们将会作为「魔法师」登场，与「小桶宝力」并肩作战。
target: In the "Trailblaze: Friendship Is Magic!" event, familiar characters will appear as the Magician, fighting side by side with Litter Pony.

source: 「异变机制」：【反震还击】 攻击该敌人将会使其更快的行动，可反弹更多来自它的攻击。
target: Mutation Mechanic: Quake Counter Attacking this enemy Advances Forward its action, making it possible to rebound more of its attacks.

source: 「异变机制」：【反震还击】 角色行动后将获得护盾，护盾可反弹该敌人的攻击，触发【反震还击】机制，造成扩散伤害。
target: Mutation Mechanic: Quake Counter Characters gain Shield after taking action. While Shielded, characters can rebound this enemy's attacks, triggering the Quake Counter mechanic and dealing Blast DMG.

source: 「异变机制」：【弱点击破】 当该敌人被击破弱点时会被消灭，并使所有非「王下一桶（投影）」的敌方目标陷入弱点击破状态。
target: Mutation Mechanic: Weakness Break Breaking this enemy's Weakness will directly defeat them and inflict Weakness Break on all other enemy targets aside from Lordly Trashcan (Projection).

source: 「异变机制」：【微笑三消】 三个及以上处于【惊喜频道】的该敌人相邻时，触发【微笑三消】机制，立刻被消灭。
target: Mutation Mechanic: Grin Sweep When 3 or more of these enemies in the Surprise Channel are adjacent to each other, triggers the Grin Sweep effect, immediately defeating them.

source: 「弱点ブレイク」を利用して「王のゴミ箱（投影）」を弱点撃破すると、「ステージバフ」が1ランク上がります。 「ステージバフ」ランクが上がっていくにつれ、「ステージバフ」のトロフィー評価も上がります。
target: After using the Weakness Break mechanic to break the Lordly Trashcan (Projection)'s Weakness, you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: 「強化」状態中、「ボリュクス」または「憐憫の腕」が攻撃を受けると「死へと誘う泡」が削られ、味方のHPが回復します。「死へと誘う泡」がすべて削られると「強化」状態が解除されます。
target: In the "Enhanced" state, attacks against "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" can reduce "Desperate Bubble" and restore allies' HP. When "Desperate Bubble" depletes, dispels the "Enhanced" state.

source: 「征服か屈服か」のHPを減らすことで、対応するキャラの回復可能な最大HPをアップできます。また、キャラが自身に対応する「征服か屈服か」に攻撃を行う時、より大きいダメージを与えられます。
target: Reducing the HP of "Conquer or Be Conquered" restores the corresponding character's Maximum Restorable HP, and the character can deal increased DMG when attacking their corresponding "Conquer or Be Conquered."

source: 「後方ターゲット」はフィールドの後方に配置され、「単体攻撃」と「拡散攻撃」タイプのスキルの攻撃対象にはなりません。「全体攻撃」、「バウンド」、「追加攻撃」タイプのスキルは敵の後方ターゲットを攻撃できます。
target: "Back Row Target" is located in the back of the formation on the field and cannot be selected by "Single Target ATK" and "Blast"-type abilities. "AoE ATK," "Bounce," and "Follow-Up ATK" abilities can hit enemy Back Row Targets.

source: 「後衛」キャラ特別スキル： 強化されたスキルで後衛から戦闘に参加し、自動的にスキルを発動して敵を攻撃したり、味方をサポートしたりします。
target: "Off-Field" Character Empowerment: Characters will use enhanced abilities to fight off-field, automatically using abilities to attack enemies or support teammates in a battle.

source: 「循星の帰路」を解放すると、一定数の点火チケットを獲得できます。「循星の帰路」終了後、使用されなかった点火チケットは回収されます。
target: When you trigger Starlit Homecoming, you'll get a set number of Fuel Vouchers. Any unused vouchers will be removed once Starlit Homecoming ends.

source: 「惊笑盒」会协助战斗，当它行动时会触发特殊效果，为战斗提供帮助。
target: The Surprise Box will assist in combat. When it takes action, it triggers special effects that help during battles.

source: 「成長値」が5および20に達した時、開拓者は成長します。
target: When "Growth Value" reaches 5/20, the Trailblazer will gain Growth.

source: 「成長值」達到5/20時，開拓者將獲得成長。
target: When "Growth Value" reaches 5/20, the Trailblazer will gain Growth.

source: 「成长值」达到5/20时，开拓者将获得成长。
target: When "Growth Value" reaches 5/20, the Trailblazer will gain Growth.

source: 「战力币」可以在商店中兑换新的卡牌，「战力粉尘」可以用来为已获得的卡牌「镀闪」。
target: Power Tokens can be used to exchange for new cards in the Store, while Power Dust can be used to "Gild" your obtained cards.

source: 「战力币」和「决胜战力币」可以在商店处用于兑换新的卡牌和「曜彩骰」，「战力粉尘」可以用来为已获得的卡牌「镀闪」。
target: Power Tokens and Victorious Power Tokens can be used to exchange for new cards and Prismatic Dice in the Store, while Power Dust can be used to "Gild" your obtained cards.

source: 「战意汹涌」将持续一定行动值。 在退出此阶段时，会根据过程中击败敌方数量，返还一定的「战意值」，返还存在上限。
target: Surging Grit will last for a certain amount of action value. Upon exiting this phase, a portion of Grit Value will be returned based on the number of enemies defeated during the phase, with a limit on the amount returned.

source: 「战意阶段4：力量觉醒」
target: Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken

source: 「战意阶段4：力量觉醒」期间，每次攻击敌人可积累「觉醒攻击」。 根据阶段内积累的「觉醒攻击」次数，将在阶段结束时返还一定的「战意值」。
target: Every time you attack enemies during "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," Waken Attack accumulates. Based on the accumulated Waken Attacks during this phase, a certain amount of Grit Value will be returned after the phase concludes.

source: 「战意阶段」共有4个阶段。每提升至更高阶段，便可额外激活1项「辅助功能」，获取强大的关卡增益。 在进入战斗前，每个关卡均可选择添加不同的「辅助功能」。
target: There are a total of 4 Grit Phases. With each higher phase you reach, you can additionally unlock 1 Support Function and obtain powerful stage buffs. Before entering combat, you can choose to add different Support Functions for each stage.

source: 「戦力アナリスト証明書」を所持した状態で、新たな「プリズムサイコロ」を購入すると、キャラカードに他のさまざまな「プリズムサイコロ」を装備できます。
target: After obtaining the "Power Analyst Certificate" and purchasing new Prismatic Dice, you can equip different Prismatic Dice for your character cards

source: 「戦力コイン」や「決勝戦力コイン」をショップで使うと、新しいカードや「プリズムサイコロ」と交換できます。「戦力ダスト」を使うと、持っているカードを「ホロ加工」できます。
target: Power Tokens and Victorious Power Tokens can be used to exchange for new cards and Prismatic Dice in the Store, while Power Dust can be used to "Gild" your obtained cards.

source: 「戦力コイン」をショップで使うと、新しいカードと交換できます。「戦力ダスト」を使うと、持っているカードを「ホロ加工」できます。
target: Power Tokens can be used to exchange for new cards in the Store, while Power Dust can be used to "Gild" your obtained cards.

source: 「戦意の洶湧」は一定の行動値内で継続します。このフェーズが終わると倒した敵の数に応じて一定の戦意値が付与されますが、付与される「戦意値」には上限があります。
target: Surging Grit will last for a certain amount of action value. Upon exiting this phase, a portion of Grit Value will be returned based on the number of enemies defeated during the phase, with a limit on the amount returned.

source: 「戦意フェーズ4：力の覚醒」
target: Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken

source: 「戦意フェーズ4：力の覚醒」に入った時SPを回復し、全キャラの必殺技をアクティブにした後、即座に行動させます。また、効果抵抗を大アップします。
target: Recover Skill Points when entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken" and activate all characters' Ultimates, then all characters immediately take action while also greatly increasing their Effect RES.

source: 「戦意フェーズ4：力の覚醒」の期間中、HPが1500増加、または減少するごとに、バフを1層獲得できます。最大99層。
target: During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," every 1500 of HP increase or decrease grants 1 stack of buffs, up to 99 stacks.

source: 「戦意フェーズ4：力の覚醒」期間中、敵を攻撃するたび「覚醒攻撃」を累積できます。 累積した「覚醒攻撃」の回数は、この段階終了時に、一定の「戦意値」に返還されます。
target: Every time you attack enemies during "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," Waken Attack accumulates. Based on the accumulated Waken Attacks during this phase, a certain amount of Grit Value will be returned after the phase concludes.

source: 「戦意フェーズ」は合計4つに分かれています。フェーズを1つ上げるごとにつき、「サポート機能」を追加で1つ開放でき、強力なステージバフを獲得できます。 各ステージでは、戦闘前にさまざまな「サポート機能」を選択して、追加できます。
target: There are a total of 4 Grit Phases. With each higher phase you reach, you can additionally unlock 1 Support Function and obtain powerful stage buffs. Before entering combat, you can choose to add different Support Functions for each stage.

source: 「戦鎧」が破壊された敵を攻撃することで、さらにダメージを与えることができます。ターンが終了する時、「戦鎧」は完全に修復されます。

source: 「選択」ボタンで輪を選択し、「回転」ボタンで回転できます。ルートが繋がるとラインが表示され、この時に「確定」ボタンを押すとルートが確定します。
target: Use the Select button to choose a specific ring, and use the Rotate button to turn it. When a route has been connected, a hint will appear on the compass. Tap the Confirm Route button to finalize your route.

source: 「銀河カップ」決勝
target: Cosmic Cup Finals

source: 「銀河戰力黨」是使用角色卡牌和卡牌右上角對應的骰子進行對戰的玩法。
target: "Cosmicon Collective" is a gameplay mode where you battle using character cards and their corresponding dice shown in the top-right corner of the cards.

source: 「銀河盃」決賽
target: Cosmic Cup Finals

source: 「鐘錶把戲」：心緒調校
target: Clockwork: Emo Tuning

source: 「鐘錶把戲」：情緒補全
target: Clockwork: Emotional Integration

source: 「钟表把戏」：心绪调校
target: Clockwork: Emo Tuning

source: 「钟表把戏」：情绪补全
target: Clockwork: Emotional Integration

source: 「银河战力党」是使用角色卡牌、和卡牌右上角对应的骰子进行对战的玩法。
target: "Cosmicon Collective" is a gameplay mode where you battle using character cards and their corresponding dice shown in the top-right corner of the cards.

source: 「银河杯」决赛
target: Cosmic Cup Finals

source: 「開拓仲間」キャラが発動させた支援攻撃には特殊効果があります。
target: Support attacks beckoned by "Trailblaze Companions" characters have special effects

source: 「開拓伝説～星間旅行スゴロク～」では、サイコロを振って、ボードを進んでください。開拓者は、様々な遊び方を通じて開拓券を獲得できます。
target: In Cosmodyssey, you need to roll dice to advance on the map. Trailblazers can obtain Trailblaze Funds through a variety of game modes.

source: 「開拓行路」画面では、現在進行中、またはクリアしたクエストがどのキャラクター視点のものなのか確認することができます。
target: You can check the Fate's Atlas interface to see which characters' POV an ongoing mission or completed mission is in.

source: 「開拓行路」画面では、進行中の視点は「現在の視点」と表示されます。対応する視点で進行中のクエストがある場合、そのクエストのタイプが表示されます。
target: On the Fate's Atlas page, the ongoing POV will be labeled as "Current POV." If there are ongoing missions in this POV, then their mission types will be labeled.

source: 「開拓，友誼魔法！」活動中，熟悉的角色們將會作為「魔法師」登場，與「小桶寶力」並肩作戰。
target: In the "Trailblaze: Friendship Is Magic!" event, familiar characters will appear as the Magician, fighting side by side with Litter Pony.

source: 「階差宇宙」、「模擬宇宙・宇宙の蝗害」、「模擬宇宙・黄金と機械」で特定の挑戦をクリアすると、コレクションを獲得できます。
target: Receive collections after completing special challenges in Divergent Universe, Simulated Universe: Swarm Disaster, and Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.

source: 「階差宇宙」、「模擬宇宙・宇宙の蝗害」、「模擬宇宙・黄金と機械」で特定の挑戦をクリアすると、絵画を獲得できます。
target: Receive artworks after completing special challenges in Divergent Universe, Simulated Universe: Swarm Disaster, and Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.

source: 「階差宇宙」では、着想サーキットを開放することで運命の特性を解放できます。
target: In Divergent Universe, activate Inspiration Circuits to unlock Path Traits.

source: 「階差宇宙」でボスエネミーを撃破すると、「過剰変換」に挑戦できます。
target: In Divergent Universe, after defeating the Boss Enemy, you will enter the Excessive Conversion challenge.

source: 「階差宇宙」の「変換」エリアでは、「過剰変換」に挑戦することができます。
target: In Divergent Universe's Conversion Domains, you can enter the Excessive Conversion challenge.

source: 「階差宇宙・人間喜劇」では条件を満たした場合、キャラクターレベル、光円錐レベル、軌跡、遺物が強化されます。
target: Only in "Divergent Universe: The Human Comedy," character levels, Light Cone levels, Traces, and Relics can be enhanced if requirements are met.

source: 「隠れ道駆動機構」はオンパロス全域のヤーヌスの隠れ道と繋がっており、起動すると解放済みの全ての隠れ道が「瞬時起動」状態に入ります。
target: The Secret Path Mechanism connects to all Janus's Hidden Passages across Amphoreus. Once activated, all unlocked passages will enter an Instant Activation state.

source: 「霊液」が花壇に触れると「知識の花」が育ちます。巻き戻しの力でそれらを元の状態に戻すことができます。
target: When ichor comes into contact with the flower bed, it will grow Cognos Bloom. When Rewinding, you can Rewind both to their original states.

source: 「霊液箱」と「知識の花」の新芽
target: Ichor Vessels and Cognos Bloom Sprouts

source: 「霊液箱」の一部の側面は脆く薄い膜に覆われており、衝撃を受けると膜が破裂して、中から「霊液」がこぼれ出てきます。
target: Some sides of the ichor vessel are covered with a fragile membrane layer, which will break upon impact and cause ichor to flow out.

source: 「霊液箱」の側面はそれぞれ薄い膜が付いていることがあります。異なる方向の膜を破壊すると、結果も異なります。
target: Each side of the ichor vessel might be covered by different membranes. Destroying membranes on different sides might generate different results.

source: 「靈液」觸碰花圃會使其長出「識之花」。回溯時可以將它們一同回溯至原本的狀態。
target: When ichor comes into contact with the flower bed, it will grow Cognos Bloom. When Rewinding, you can Rewind both to their original states.

source: 「靈液匣」的不同側面可能各自覆蓋有薄膜，破壞不同朝向的薄膜會得到不一樣的結果。
target: Each side of the ichor vessel might be covered by different membranes. Destroying membranes on different sides might generate different results.

source: 「靈液匣」的某些側面覆蓋著一層脆弱的薄膜，受到衝擊便會破碎，使「靈液」滾出。
target: Some sides of the ichor vessel are covered with a fragile membrane layer, which will break upon impact and cause ichor to flow out.

source: 「靈液匣」與「識之花」幼體
target: Ichor Vessels and Cognos Bloom Sprouts

source: 「願い」を表す凝晶を3つ見つけ、それらを順番に再構築することで試練を達成できます。
target: Find the three Crystals representing "Wish" and reforge them in sequence to complete the trial.

source: 「風雲！にゃんこ城」は創造物たちが自発的に開催する障害物競走大会です。各レースには8名のプレイヤーが観戦に参加し、選手たちを応援します。
target: Snack Dash is an obstacle race event spontaneously organized by the creations, where 8 players can participate as spectators and cheer for the contestants.

source: 「駭入聲明」
target: "Hacking Callcard"

source: 「驚笑盒」會協助戰鬥，當它行動時會觸發特殊效果，為戰鬥提供幫助。
target: The Surprise Box will assist in combat. When it takes action, it triggers special effects that help during battles.

source: 「骇入声明」
target: "Hacking Callcard"

source: 「魔法使い」であるキャラは、その戦闘スキルと必殺技に新たな戦闘効果が追加され、「マイリトルゴミー」を指揮して戦います。
target: Characters acting as the Magician will see their Skill and Ultimate gain new combat effects, letting them command Litter Pony in battle.

source: 「魔王の印」が付いている敵は魔王の手下です。
target: Look, that fellow with the Demon King's Mark is the Demon King's Minion.

source: 「黄金と機械」にある、異なる「カスタムサイコロ」には異なるパッシブ効果があります。パッシブ効果の要求を満たした時、選んだ運命に応じて効果の異なるバフを得られます。
target: In Gold and Gears, Custom Dice have different Passive abilities. Every time you fulfill the die's passive ability requirements, different bonuses will be provided based on the chosen Path.

source: 「點心糕餅向前衝」是造物們自發舉辦的障礙賽跑大會，每場比賽共有8名玩家將參與觀賽並為選手應援。
target: Snack Dash is an obstacle race event spontaneously organized by the creations, where 8 players can participate as spectators and cheer for the contestants.

source: 「개조 기물」&「한정 축복」
target: Transformed Curios and Exclusive Blessings

source: 「개척, 우정의 마법!」 이벤트에서는 익숙한 캐릭터들이 「마법사」로 등장해 「리틀통 포니」와 함께 싸웁니다
target: In the "Trailblaze: Friendship Is Magic!" event, familiar characters will appear as the Magician, fighting side by side with Litter Pony.

source: 「겨우살이」호가 가속 링을 통과할 때 강력한 가속 효과를 얻지만, 그동안에는 방향을 제어할 수 없습니다
target: Piloting the Mistletoe through an Acceleration Ring will grant a powerful speed boost effect, during which directional control is disabled.

source: 「구역-정비」에서 보유한 기물 수량에 따라 대응하는 수량의 축복을 획득해 「일반 차원」 클리어 후 고난도의 「최종 시련」 전투에 대비할 수 있습니다
target: While in a "Domain — Respite," you can gain Blessings equal in number to the number of Curios you already possess to handle the Final Trial that you must face after clearing all Ordinary Plane stages.

source: 「구역-정비」에서는 모든 우주 조각을 소모하여 대량의 축복을 구매할 수 있습니다
target: You can consume all your Cosmic Fragments within Domain — Respite to buy a great number of Blessings.

source: 「구역-정비」의 상점에서는 이벤트 한정 축복을 강화할 수 있습니다. 상점마다 모든 축복은 1회 강화할 수 있습니다
target: The store within Domain — Respite can Enhance event-limited Blessings. In each store, all Blessings can be Enhanced 1 time.

source: 「금시계 크레딧」을 지불하여 조각상 레벨을 올리고 보상을 수령하세요
target: Spend Clock Credits to raise the Statue's level and gain rewards.

source: 「기본 게임」은 화폐 전쟁의 기본 플레이 모드입니다. 기본 게임에 도전하여 직급을 올릴 수 있습니다
target: "Standard Gambit" is the regular game mode for Currency Wars. Challenging Standard Gambit allows you to be promoted in rank.

source: 「기억의 파편」을 사용해 특정 상점에서 아이템을 교환하거나 「의상공」에게 아직 수집되지 않은 약충의 위치를 알려달라고 할 수 있습니다
target: Memory Crystal Shards can help you to redeem items in specific shops, or let the Garmentmaker point out the location of nymphs you have not collected.

source: 「꿈방울 술탑」과 다시 상호작용하면 현재 보유한 「꿈방울 에너지」가 회수됩니다. 동시에 이미 형성된 꿈방울 다리가 사라지고 흩어진 꿈방울로 복원됩니다
target: Interacting with the Bubble Tower again will retrieve the Bubble Charges you are currently carrying, and will also make the converged Bubble Bridge collapse and return to their original state.

source: 「꿈방울 술탑」에 접근하고 상호작용하면 「꿈방울 에너지」를 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Approach Bubble Tower and interact with it to obtain Bubble Charges.

source: 「꿈방울 에너지」를 가지고 흩어진 꿈방울에 다가가면 「꿈방울을 모아」 걸을 수 있는 꿈방울 다리를 건설할 수 있습니다
target: While carrying Bubble Charges near a dispersed bubble, you can use Bubble Converge to construct a Bubble Bridge that can be traversed.

source: 「꿈세계 훈련」에 참가하면 더 높은 난이도의 챔피언에게 도전할 수 있습니다. 연무전에서 다음 단계로 진출 시 새로운 「꿈세계 훈련」을 개방할 수 있습니다
target: Participate in Dreamscape Training to issue challenges against higher difficulty ringmasters. Every time you pass a Faceoff Match, you can unlock new Dreamscape Training.

source: 「꿈세계 훈련」에서는 행동을 통해 「무대 열기」를 획득할 수 없습니다. 「하이라이트」를 통해서만 「무대 열기」를 획득해 「격려 강화」 상태에 진입할 수 있습니다
target: While in Dreamscape Training, you are unable to obtain Vibes through actions. Only by performing Highlights can you gain Vibes and enter the "Super Hype" state.

source: 「꿈의 눈」과 상호작용하면 꿈 건축가 시점에 진입하거나 나갈 수 있습니다
target: Interact with the Dream's Eye to enter or exit the Dreamweaver's View.

source: 「꿈의 눈」을 가동하면 꿈 건축가 시점으로 전환됩니다. 해당 시점에서는 끊어져 있거나, 높낮이가 달랐던 길이 불가사의한 방식으로 연결됩니다
target: Activating the Dream's Eye allows you to switch to the Dreamweaver's View. In this mode, disconnected paths or those with height discrepancies will be connected in an incredible way.

source: 「나쁜꿈 방송국」 이벤트엔 전파가 납치된 텔레비전 스크린이 총 5개 있습니다. 해당 스크린을 찾아 전투에 진입하여 배후 세력을 처치하세요
target: In the Dreamjolt TV event, a total of 5 TV screens have been hacked. Locate the screens and fight the culprits to foil the mastermind's plan.

source: 「낡은 잔, 새로운 벗」: 음료 제조
target: "Old Brews & New Friends": Mixing Drinks

source: 「달려라, 디저트!」는 창조물들이 자진해서 개최한 장애물 달리기 대회입니다. 경기마다 플레이어 8명이 관전에 참여하여 선수들을 응원합니다
target: Snack Dash is an obstacle race event spontaneously organized by the creations, where 8 players can participate as spectators and cheer for the contestants.

source: 「동기화」 모드에서 페피를 조종할 때 근처에 있는 몬스터에게 발각되면 페피가 탈출 장치를 작동해 가장 가까운 안전 지점에 착륙합니다
target: While controlling Peppy in Sync Mode, if Peppy gets detected by any nearby monsters, it will activate its emergency escape device and return to the nearest safety area.

source: 「리틀통 포니」는 전투에서 「마법사」의 일부 속성 수치와 버프 효과를 계승받게 됩니다. 「리틀통 포니」가 적을 공격하거나 적에게 피격되면 「마법사」는 에너지를 회복합니다
target: Litter Pony will inherit the Magician's certain stat values and buff effects. When Litter Pony attacks an enemy or is attacked by an enemy, regenerates Energy for the Magician.

source: 「마법사」로 선택된 캐릭터의 전투 스킬과 필살기는 새로운 전투 효과를 얻게 되며, 「리틀통 포니」를 지휘해 전투를 진행합니다
target: Characters acting as the Magician will see their Skill and Ultimate gain new combat effects, letting them command Litter Pony in battle.

source: 「모범적 태도」는 모든 멤버의 당직 레벨을 팀 내 최고 당직 레벨로 올립니다
target: The Passenger Paragons card can elevate all members' Duty Level to match the highest Duty Level within the team.

source: 「무한 팽창 기물」 차원 규칙
target: "Infinite Expansion Curio" Plane Rules

source: 「무한 팽창 레벨업」 차원 규칙
target: "Infinite Expansion Upgrade" Plane Rules

source: 「무한 팽창 육성」 차원 규칙
target: "Infinite Expansion Nurture" Plane Rules

source: 「무한 팽창 조각」 차원 규칙
target: "Infinite Expansion Fragment" Plane Rules

source: 「무한 팽창 조각별 미끼」 차원 규칙
target: "Infinite Expansion Bait" Plane Rules

source: 「무한의 차원」 이벤트 내 무한 아이콘이 표시된 기물 또는 축복은 특수 효과를 보유한 차원 전용 개조 기물과 한정 축복입니다
target: In the Planar Infinity event, Curios or Blessings marked with the infinite icon bear special effects and are plane-exclusive Transformed Curios and Exclusive Blessings.

source: 「무한의 차원」 이벤트에서는 모든 차원이 「일반 차원」 과 「최종 시련」 으로 구성되어 있습니다
target: In the Planar Infinity event, each plane comprises Ordinary Planes and the Final Trial.

source: 「무한의 차원」 이벤트의 모든 기물, 축복, 사건은 「시뮬레이션 우주 도감」을 개방할 수 없습니다
target: In the Planar Infinity event, all Curios, Blessings, and Occurrences encountered will not unlock Simulated Universe Index entries.

source: 「무한의 차원」 차원 규칙
target: "Planar Infinity" Plane Rules

source: 「무한의 차원」 특별 상점
target: "Planar Infinity" Special Store

source: 「변이 메커니즘」: [약점 격파] 해당 적은 약점이 격파되면 처치되며, 「왕의 쓰레기통(투영)」을 제외한 모든 적을 약점 격파 상태에 빠트립니다
target: Mutation Mechanic: Weakness Break Breaking this enemy's Weakness will directly defeat them and inflict Weakness Break on all other enemy targets aside from Lordly Trashcan (Projection).

source: 「변이 메커니즘」: [진동 반격] 캐릭터는 행동 후 실드를 획득합니다. 실드는 해당 적의 공격을 반사하며, [진동 반격] 메커니즘을 발동하여 확산 피해를 가할 수 있습니다
target: Mutation Mechanic: Quake Counter Characters gain Shield after taking action. While Shielded, characters can rebound this enemy's attacks, triggering the Quake Counter mechanic and dealing Blast DMG.

source: 「변이 메커니즘」: [진동 반격] 해당 적을 공격하면 적의 행동이 빨라져 더 많은 공격을 반사할 수 있습니다
target: Mutation Mechanic: Quake Counter Attacking this enemy Advances Forward its action, making it possible to rebound more of its attacks.

source: 「변이 메커니즘」: [트리플팡] [서프라이즈 채널]의 적이 3기 이상 인접해 있으면 [트리플팡] 메커니즘이 발동되어 즉시 소멸됩니다
target: Mutation Mechanic: Grin Sweep When 3 or more of these enemies in the Surprise Channel are adjacent to each other, triggers the Grin Sweep effect, immediately defeating them.

source: 「별의 궤도 토끼」 오락기 근처에는 이름 없는 진령의 「가이드」가 주둔하고 있습니다. 해당 구역에 발견되지 않은 이름 없는 진령이 있으면 「픽셀 코인」을 제출해 「가이드」에게 위치를 알려달라고 할 수 있습니다
target: A Nameless Wispae Guide is stationed near the Star Rabbit Game Console. If there are still undiscovered nameless wispae in the area, you can submit "Pixcoin" to have the Guide point out their locations.

source: 「별의 궤도 토끼」 오락기마다 총 세 가지 도전 목표가 있으며, 목표를 달성하면 상응하는 보상을 획득할 수 있습니다. 「치트 모드」를 선택하면 도전 목표가 「치트 난이도」로 변경되며, 목표를 더 쉽게 달성할 수 있습니다
target: Each Star Rabbit Game Console has three challenge goals. Complete these goals to obtain corresponding rewards. Selecting Cheat Mode will lower the difficulty of the challenge goals to "Cheat Difficulty," making them easier to achieve.

source: 「별의 궤도 토끼」에는 총 두 가지 게임 모드가 있습니다. 초기에는 「지옥 모드」만 선택할 수 있으나, 주변의 이름 없는 진령을 전부 수집하면 「치트 모드」를 활성화할 수 있습니다
target: Star Rabbit has two game modes. At first, you can only select Hell Mode, but once you've collected the nearby nameless wispae, you can unlock Cheat Mode.

source: 「별이 돌아오는 길」 발동 시 일정 수량의 연소 촉진 티켓을 획득합니다. 「별이 돌아오는 길」 종료 후 사용하지 않은 연소 촉진 티켓은 회수됩니다
target: When you trigger Starlit Homecoming, you'll get a set number of Fuel Vouchers. Any unused vouchers will be removed once Starlit Homecoming ends.

source: 「볼더 타운 슈퍼리그」
target: Boulder Town Super League

source: 「볼더 타운 슈퍼리그」에서는 여러 시합에 도전해 대응하는 시합 보상을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: In the Boulder Town Super League, Trailblazers can challenge different tournaments to win the corresponding tournament rewards.

source: 「부세」의 시련•1
target: Worldbearing Trial I

source: 「부세」의 시련•2
target: Worldbearing Trial II

source: 「분쟁」의 정복에 대항
target: Resist Strife's Domination

source: 「불씨 상자」는 중요한 물품을 저장하는 용기입니다. 활성화 시 「불씨 상자」 외부에 열쇠 구멍이 나타나며, 상응하는 열쇠 조각이 여러 개 활성화됩니다
target: The Coreflame Casket is used to contain important items. When activated, keyholes will appear on the exterior of the Coreflame Casket and activate the corresponding number of key fragments.

source: 「비밀 통로 구동기」는 앰포리어스 전역의 야누스의 비밀 통로와 연결되어 있으며, 이를 가동하면 모든 개방된 비밀 통로가 「즉시 발동」 상태에 진입합니다
target: The Secret Path Mechanism connects to all Janus's Hidden Passages across Amphoreus. Once activated, all unlocked passages will enter an Instant Activation state.

source: 「비밀 통로 구동기」와 다시 상호작용하면 자유롭게 상태를 전환할 수 있습니다
target: Interact with the Secret Path Mechanism again to freely toggle its state.

source: 「새벽과 황혼의 두루마리」 이벤트엔 총 5개의 두루마리가 있습니다. 두루마리를 찾아 전투에 진입하여 적을 처치하고 봉인된 과거를 해제하세요
target: In the Enscrolled Crepusculum event, there are a total of 5 scrolls. Locate the scrolls, enter combat, and defeat the enemies to unlock memories that are sealed away.

source: 「생명 오븐」에서는 부모 세대 창조물 두 마리의 기본 특징이 새로운 창조물에게 랜덤으로 유전될 수 있습니다
target: In the Lifeform Oven, the Base Traits of the two parental creations have a random chance of being inherited by new creations.

source: 「선택」 버튼으로 특정 고리를 선택하고, 「회전」 버튼으로 회전할 수 있습니다. 루트가 연결되면 나침반에 알림이 나타나며, 이때 「루트 확인」 버튼을 눌러 루트를 확정할 수 있습니다
target: Use the Select button to choose a specific ring, and use the Rotate button to turn it. When a route has been connected, a hint will appear on the compass. Tap the Confirm Route button to finalize your route.

source: 「성장도」가 5/20 도달 시, 개척자는 성장합니다
target: When "Growth Value" reaches 5/20, the Trailblazer will gain Growth.

source: 「수집품 진열장」 기능을 통해 「개척」 여정 중에 획득한 각종 기념 피규어, 명예훈장, 그리고 여정 사진을 배치할 수 있습니다. 「수집품 진열장」은 투어 패스에 표시됩니다
target: Through the "Collection Showcase" feature, you can set up various commemorative figures, honor badges, and travel photos obtained during your Trailblaze journey. Your "Collection Showcase" will be shown in your Trailblazer Profile.

source: 「스페셜 블렌드 레시피」의 숨겨진 효과
target: "Special Mix Recipe" Hidden Effects

source: 「시계 트릭」: 감정 보완
target: Clockwork: Emotional Integration

source: 「시계 트릭」: 감정 조율
target: Clockwork: Emo Tuning

source: 「시뮬레이션 우주: 인지 불가 영역」에서는 전투마다 표준 라운드 카운트가 존재하며, 전투 시간이 표준 라운드를 초과하면 추가 라운드를 소모합니다
target: In Simulated Universe: Unknowable Domain, every battle has a standard number of Cycles. When the battle exceeds the standard Cycles, it will consume extra Cycles.

source: 「시상의」는 오로닉스 사제들이 제작한 시간의 제기로, 크기와 형태가 다양합니다. 「시상의」를 파괴하면 주변의 시간이 정지됩니다
target: The Chrono Vessel is a temporal ritual tool crafted by Oronyx's priests, with various sizes and styles. Breaking the Chrono Vessel will pause time in the area around it.

source: 「신주 암브로시아」를 물에 녹여 공양 레벨을 올리고 보상을 수령하세요
target: Dissolve the Celestial Ambrosia in the water to raise the Offering Level and gain rewards.

source: 「아스트로컵」 결승전
target: Astropolis Cup Finals

source: 「아이디어 재정비」를 통해 선택한 보고서를 포기하고 같은 개수의 보고서를 다시 뽑을 수 있습니다. 단, 각 멤버의 보고서 총 개수는 제한되어 있습니다
target: Using "Mental Reset", you can discard selected reports and draw the same number of new ones. Please note that each team member has a limit on the total number of reports.

source: 「알려진 효과」를 제조하거나, 맛과 효과가 완전히 다른 「숨겨진 효과」에 도전할 수 있습니다. 2가지 효과는 독립적이니, 취향에 따라 자유롭게 제조해 보세요
target: You can try mixing "Known Effects", or challenge yourself with "Hidden Effects" that have completely different tastes and properties. The two effects are independent of each other, so feel free to mix them however you like.

source: 「알현의 방」에서 각 운명의 길의 현재 「알현의 행적」 포인트를 확인할 수 있습니다. 운명의 길에 따라 다른 버프 효과를 획득할 수 있습니다
target: You can view the current Communing Trail points for each Path in the Audience Chamber. Every Path will bring different buffs

source: 「암브로시아」를 물에 녹여 공양 레벨을 올리고 보상을 수령하세요
target: Dissolve the ambrosia in water to raise the Offering Level and gain rewards.

source: 「에이딘 코인」을 소모해 다양한 놀이시설을 이용할 수 있으며, 낮은 확률로 진귀한 보상을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: You can use Aideen Tokens to play various amusement facilities and have a small chance of winning valuable rewards.

source: 「염원」을 나타내는 응축된 결정 3개를 찾아 순서대로 재구성하면 시련을 완료할 수 있습니다
target: Find the three Crystals representing "Wish" and reforge them in sequence to complete the trial.

source: 「영액 상자」와 「학식의 꽃」의 싹
target: Ichor Vessels and Cognos Bloom Sprouts

source: 「영액 상자」의 일부 측면은 부서지기 쉬운 얇은 막으로 덮여 있어, 충격을 받으면 파괴되고 「영액」이 흘러 나오게 됩니다
target: Some sides of the ichor vessel are covered with a fragile membrane layer, which will break upon impact and cause ichor to flow out.

source: 「영액 상자」의 측면에는 각각 얇은 막이 존재할 수 있으며, 파괴하는 막의 방향에 따라 결과가 달라질 수 있습니다
target: Each side of the ichor vessel might be covered by different membranes. Destroying membranes on different sides might generate different results.

source: 「영액」이 꽃밭에 닿으면 「학식의 꽃」이 자라납니다. 되돌릴 시 원래 상태로 돌아갑니다
target: When ichor comes into contact with the flower bed, it will grow Cognos Bloom. When Rewinding, you can Rewind both to their original states.

source: 「오로닉스의 감실」과 상호작용하면 세월의 경계를 소환할 수 있습니다. 경계 내에선 기억이 남아 있는 오브젝트의 에너지 파동 색깔이 변하며, 이는 현재 개척자의 되돌리기 능력이 제약을 받지 않는다는 것을 의미합니다
target: Interacting with Oronyx's Shrine summons the Realm of the Ages. Within this realm, the color of the energy ripples on memory-laden objects changes, indicating that the Trailblazer's rewinding ability is now unrestricted.

source: 「오로닉스의 기도문」을 이용하여 무너진 다리를 공중에 떠 있는 상태로 잠시 되돌릴 수 있습니다
target: Oronyx's Prayer can be used to temporarily rewind the collapsed floating bridge to its levitating state.

source: 「오로닉스의 기도문」을 이용해 돌 고정 조각상을 온전한 상태로 되돌릴 수 있습니다
target: Oronyx's Prayer can be used to rewind the Ball-Holder Statue to when its base is undamaged.

source: 「오버클록 게임」 모드는 도전 난이도를 자유롭게 선택할 수 있지만, 클리어 후 직급을 올릴 수 없습니다
target: In Overclock Gambit mode, you can freely choose the challenge difficulty, but cannot increase your rank after completion.

source: 「오버클록 게임」에서는 노드가 시작될 때마다 자동으로 더 많은 경험치와 금화를 획득하지만, 더 이상 이자를 획득할 수 없습니다
target: In Overclock Gambit mode, at the start of each Node, you'll automatically gain more Experience and Gold Coins, but no longer receive Interest.

source: 「오버클록 게임」은 차원마다 진행 노드가 더 적습니다
target: In Overclock Gambit, each plane has fewer progression nodes.

source: 「오버클록 게임」은 플레이 타임이 더 짧은 빠른 모드로, 주간 점수 임무 보상을 효율적으로 완료할 수 있습니다
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, and can be used to complete Weekly Points mission rewards.

source: 「오버클록 게임」은 플레이 타임이 더 짧은 빠른 모드로, 차원마다 진행 노드가 더 적습니다
target: Overclock Gambit is a fast-paced mode that requires less time to play, with fewer progression nodes in each plane.

source: 「용솟음치는 전의」는 일정 행동 수치 동안 지속됩니다. 해당 단계 종료 시, 단계 중에 처치한 적의 수량에 따라 「전의 수치」가 일정량 반환되며, 반환 수치에는 상한이 있습니다
target: Surging Grit will last for a certain amount of action value. Upon exiting this phase, a portion of Grit Value will be returned based on the number of enemies defeated during the phase, with a limit on the amount returned.

source: 「우주 인테리어 가이드」 이벤트 완료 후, 개척자는 은하열차의 「파티 칸」 2층에서 자신의 방을 가질 수 있습니다
target: After completing the "Cosmic Home Décor Guide" event, Trailblazers will have their own room on the second floor of the Party Car of the Astral Express.

source: 「운명의 길 틈새」의 행자의 길을 완료하면 「알현의 행적」 포인트를 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Complete the Trail of Pathstrider in the Path Space to increase Communing Trail points

source: 「웃음 상자」는 전투를 서포트하며, 행동할 때마다 특수 효과가 발동되어 전투에 도움을 줍니다
target: The Surprise Box will assist in combat. When it takes action, it triggers special effects that help during battles.

source: 「은하 오디세이」에서는 주사위를 던져 맵에서 전진하고, 다양한 콘텐츠를 통해 개척 크레딧을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: In Cosmodyssey, you need to roll dice to advance on the map. Trailblazers can obtain Trailblaze Funds through a variety of game modes.

source: 「이름 없는 추억」을 통해 [내가 쓰는 대로]에서 영웅들의 이야기를 쓸 수 있습니다
target: Using "Nameless Recollection," heroes' stories can be written down in "As I've Written."

source: 「일반 차원」 클리어 후 「최종 시련」이 오픈됩니다. 「최종 시련」은 여러 층의 고난도 전투로 구성되어 있으며, 더 높은 층의 적에 도전하면 더 많은 「시련 포인트」와 보상을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: After clearing the Ordinary Planes, the Final Trial will be unlocked. The Final Trial is made up of multiple waves of extremely difficult battles that give increasingly greater amount of Trial Points and rewards the more waves you defeat.

source: 「일반 차원」은 각기 다른 7층의 탐사 구역으로 구성되어 있습니다. 「일반 차원」내에서 대량의 축복과 기물을 누적해 고난도의 「최종 시련」 전투에 대비할 수 있습니다
target: Ordinary Planes are made up of 7 different explorable domains. You can accumulate a vast amount of Blessings and Curios in Ordinary Planes before challenging the highly difficult Final Trial.

source: 「자그레우스의 손」 근처엔 청남석 더미가 있을 수 있습니다. 이는 가끔 「변화의 시련」의 일부가 되기도 하며, 근처에 흩어져 있는 청남석을 옮겨 돌 더미를 복원하면 숨겨진 「변화의 동전」을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Some indigo steel piles may be found near a Hand of Zagreus, and sometimes those piles can become part of the Trial of Whimsy. Transport the scattered indigo steel pieces and restore the pile to obtain the hidden Coin of Whimsy.

source: 「자그레우스의 손」에 운반 가능한 오브젝트가 있으면 배치 표식이 있는 배치 지점이 보입니다. 운반 가능한 오브젝트를 집은 상태로 배치 지점과 상호작용하면 해당 위치에 오브젝트를 배치할 수 있습니다
target: While the Hand of Zagreus is carrying a transportable object, placement spots with marks of placement can be seen. Interacting with the placement spots while carrying a transportable object will place it at the corresponding location.

source: 「자그레우스의 손」은 계략의 티탄 자그레우스가 남긴 성체입니다. 이 티탄이 죽은 후 앰포리어스 사람들은 이를 개조하여 자신들이 원하는 대로 사용했습니다
target: Hand of Zagreus is the divine body left behind by Zagreus, the Trickery Titan. After the Titan had fallen, the people of Amphoreus learned to modify and utilize them.

source: 「자그레우스의 손」은 차지 후 직선으로 돌진할 수 있으며, 돌진하는 동안 일정 수준의 파괴력을 획득합니다
target: The Hand of Zagreus can charge up, and then sprint in a straight line, during which it will gain a certain degree of destructive power.

source: 「자그레우스의 손」을 사용해 물건을 운반할 수 있습니다
target: The Hand of Zagreus can be used for transportation.

source: 「자그레우스의 손」을 조종해 황금색 자그레우스 룬 문자와 상호작용하면 「다리 놓기」 동작을 취할 수 있으며, 룬이 있는 위치에 다리를 생성해 개척자가 통과할 수 있도록 합니다
target: While controlling the Hand of Zagreus, interact with the golden Zagreus rune to perform a Bridge Action, forming a bridge where the rune is located to provide passage to the Trailblazer.

source: 「잔다르」가 [논증 형태]로 전환 시, 적을 처치하거나 아군 기억 정령이 사라지면 「잔다르」의 형태 전환이 빨라지고 위협을 줄일 수 있습니다
target: When Zandar switches to "Disputation Mode," defeating enemy targets or ally memosprites disappearing will accelerate Zandar's mode switching and reduce threat.

source: 「잔다르」가 [진화 형태]로 전환 시, 필드에 적이 생성되거나 아군 기억 정령이 소환되면 「잔다르」의 형태 전환을 가속할 수 있습니다
target: When Zandar switches to "Evolution Mode," enemy targets appearing on the battlefield or ally memosprites being summoned can accelerate Zandar's mode-switching.

source: 「저녁 회의」 중에 당직 보고서를 선택하고 제출할 수 있으며, 획득한 폼폼 점수에 따라 「열차 기금」을 획득합니다
target: During the Dinner Meeting phase, you can select and submit Duty Reports to obtain Express Funds based on the score received from Pom-Pom.

source: 「전의 4단계: 힘의 각성」
target: Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken

source: 「전의 4단계: 힘의 각성」 동안, HP가 1,500pt 증가 또는 감소할 때마다 버프 1스택을 획득할 수 있습니다. 최대 중첩수: 99스택
target: During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," every 1500 of HP increase or decrease grants 1 stack of buffs, up to 99 stacks.

source: 「전의 4단계: 힘의 각성」 중엔 적을 공격할 때마다 「각성 공격」을 누적할 수 있습니다. 단계 내에 누적한 「각성 공격」 횟수는 단계 종료 시 일정량의 「전의 수치」를 반환합니다
target: Every time you attack enemies during "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," Waken Attack accumulates. Based on the accumulated Waken Attacks during this phase, a certain amount of Grit Value will be returned after the phase concludes.

source: 「전의 4단계: 힘의 각성」 진입 시 전투 스킬 포인트를 회복하고, 모든 캐릭터의 필살기를 활성화하고 즉시 행동하게 한다. 동시에 효과 저항이 대폭 증가한다
target: Recover Skill Points when entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken" and activate all characters' Ultimates, then all characters immediately take action while also greatly increasing their Effect RES.

source: 「전의 단계」는 총 4단계입니다. 더 높은 단계로 오를 때마다 「서포트 기능」을 1개 추가로 활성화하고 강력한 스테이지 버프를 획득할 수 있습니다. 전투 진입 전 스테이지마다 다른 「서포트 기능」을 선택하여 추가할 수 있습니다
target: There are a total of 4 Grit Phases. With each higher phase you reach, you can additionally unlock 1 Support Function and obtain powerful stage buffs. Before entering combat, you can choose to add different Support Functions for each stage.

source: 「절망」을 나타내는 응축된 결정 3개를 찾아 순서대로 부수면 시련을 완료할 수 있습니다
target: Find the three Crystals representing "Despair" and break them in sequence to complete the trial.

source: 「종말의 환영」에서는 「종말」의 투영을 직시하고 이전에 맞섰던 보스 강적에게 승리해야 합니다
target: In Apocalyptic Shadow, Trailblazers must face projections of Finality and defeat bosses they have faced before.

source: 「종이새 팡팡」은 매치3 대전 게임으로 정해진 횟수 내에 과일을 제거해 종이새의 전투력을 높여야 합니다
target: Origami Bird Clash is a Match Three battling game where you have to eliminate fruits within a certain number of moves to increase the Origami Bird's Combat Power.

source: 「종이새 팡팡」은 매치3 대전 게임으로 정해진 횟수 내에 과일을 제거해 종이새의 전투력을 높여야 합니다
target: Origami Bird Clash is a Match Three battling game where you have to match and clear fruits within a certain number of moves and increase the Origami Bird's Combat Power.

source: 「종이새 팡팡」은 매치3 대전 게임입니다. 새들의 전쟁 모드에서는 게임당 총 30명의 플레이어가 대전에 참여합니다
target: "Origami Bird Clash" is a match-3 battle game. In the Best of the Flock mode, each match features 30 players competing against each other.

source: 「좋은꿈 슬롯머신」 콘텐츠 안내
target: Dreamy Slots Gameplay Details

source: 「차분화 우주•인간 희극」에서 제공되는 기능으로, 캐릭터의 레벨, 광추 레벨, 행적과 유물은 조건 충족 시 강화됩니다
target: Only in "Divergent Universe: The Human Comedy," character levels, Light Cone levels, Traces, and Relics can be enhanced if requirements are met.

source: 「차분화 우주」, 「시뮬레이션 우주·곤충 떼 재난」과 「시뮬레이션 우주·황금과 기계」에서 특정 도전을 완료하면 미술품을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Receive artworks after completing special challenges in Divergent Universe, Simulated Universe: Swarm Disaster, and Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.

source: 「차분화 우주」, 「시뮬레이션 우주·곤충 떼 재난」과 「시뮬레이션 우주·황금과 기계」에서 특정 도전을 완료하면 소장품을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Receive collections after completing special challenges in Divergent Universe, Simulated Universe: Swarm Disaster, and Simulated Universe: Gold and Gears.

source: 「차분화 우주」에서 보스 적을 처치하면 「초과 전환」 도전에 진입합니다
target: In Divergent Universe, after defeating the Boss Enemy, you will enter the Excessive Conversion challenge.

source: 「차분화 우주」에서 영감 회로를 활성화해 운명의 길 특성을 개방할 수 있습니다
target: In Divergent Universe, activate Inspiration Circuits to unlock Path Traits.

source: 「차분화 우주」의 「전환」 구역에서는 「초과 전환」 도전에 진입할 수 있습니다
target: In Divergent Universe's Conversion Domains, you can enter the Excessive Conversion challenge.

source: 「초과 전환」 도전 진입 시 모든 아군의 필살기를 활성화하고 전투 스킬 포인트를 5pt 회복합니다
target: When entering the Excessive Conversion challenge, all allies will activate their Ultimates and recover 5 Skill Points.

source: 「초과 전환」 도전에서 적 HP를 소모하면 전환 데이터를 획득할 수 있습니다
target: During Excessive Conversion, reduce the enemy's HP to obtain Conversion Data.

source: 「초과 전환」 도전에서 첫 2 웨이브의 도전 목표를 달성하면 전리품 상자를 획득할 수 있습니다. 달성한 목표가 많을수록 보상이 더욱 풍성해집니다
target: In Excessive Conversion Challenge, complete the challenge goals of the first two waves to obtain treasure chests. The more challenge goals you complete, the better the rewards.

source: 「초과 전환」 도전에서는 적에게 처치당해도 전투 승리로 간주하며, 전환 데이터에 따라 결산을 진행합니다
target: If you are defeated by the enemy during the Excessive Conversion challenge, you will still be regarded as having won the battle and your data will be finalized based on Conversion Data.

source: 「최종 도전」 단계에서는 「스테이지 버프」 랭크가 더 이상 상승하지 않습니다
target: Your Stage Buff rank will not be upgraded during the Final Showdown phase.

source: 「최종 도전」 단계에서는 많은 적을 처치할수록 더 높은 점수를 획득할 수 있습니다. 남은 라운드가 있을 경우 추가 점수를 획득합니다
target: Defeat more enemies during the Final Showdown phase to earn more points. You will earn additional points if you have any remaining Cycles.

source: 「최종 시련」
target: Final Trial

source: 「최종 시련」 도전 종료 후 이번 도전의 저장 파일은 삭제되지 않습니다. 저장 파일이 있는 차원을 선택하여 「최종 시련」에 다시 도전할 수 있습니다
target: After completing the Final Trial, the Save File for this challenge attempt will not be deleted. Planes with a Save File can be selected again to re-attempt the Final Trial.

source: 「최종 시련」은 여러 층의 연속 전투로 진행되며, 6라운드의 카운트다운이 적용됩니다. 보스 적은 특수 전투 메커니즘을 보유하고 있습니다
target: The Final Trial is a continuous battle with a countdown timer of 6 Cycles. Boss enemies in the trial will have their special battle mechanics.

source: 「추억 잔상」은 앰포리어스 세계의 기억 물질 잔재로, 과거의 세월을 담고 있으며 과거의 영상을 엿볼 수 있습니다
target: Fragments of Recollection are memoria residues in the world of Amphoreus. They bear bygone days, and you can glean images of the past from within.

source: 「코미디언」은 「웃음 참기 게이지」를 획득하여 「웃음 상자」를 충전할 수 있습니다. 「웃음 참기 게이지」가 높을수록 「웃음 상자」의 효과가 강해집니다
target: The Comedian can charge the Surprise Box by gaining Giggle Gauge. The higher the Giggle Gauge, the stronger the effect of the Surprise Box.

source: 「코스믹 포스」는 캐릭터 카드와 카드 우측 상단의 대응하는 주사위를 사용하여 대전하는 콘텐츠입니다
target: "Cosmicon Collective" is a gameplay mode where you battle using character cards and their corresponding dice shown in the top-right corner of the cards.

source: 「코스믹컵」 결승전
target: Cosmic Cup Finals

source: 「탐식」의 침식
target: Voracity Corrosion

source: 「포스 분석가 자격증」을 획득하고 새로운 「프리즘 주사위」를 구매하면, 캐릭터 카드의 「프리즘 주사위」를 다양하게 변경할 수 있습니다
target: After obtaining the "Power Analyst Certificate" and purchasing new Prismatic Dice, you can equip different Prismatic Dice for your character cards

source: 「포스 코인」과 「결승 포스 코인」은 상점에서 새로운 카드와 「프리즘 주사위」를 교환하는 데 사용되며, 「포스 파우더」는 이미 획득한 카드를 「포일링」하는 데 사용됩니다
target: Power Tokens and Victorious Power Tokens can be used to exchange for new cards and Prismatic Dice in the Store, while Power Dust can be used to "Gild" your obtained cards.

source: 「포스 코인」은 상점에서 새로운 카드를 교환하는 데 사용되며, 「포스 파우더」는 이미 획득한 카드를 「포일링」하는 데 사용됩니다
target: Power Tokens can be used to exchange for new cards in the Store, while Power Dust can be used to "Gild" your obtained cards.

source: 「프리즘 주사위」는 다른 주사위처럼 다시 던질 수 있습니다
target: Prismatic Dice can be rerolled just like other dice.

source: 「프리즘 주사위」는 다른 주사위처럼 다시 던질 수 있습니다
target: The Prismatic Dice can be rerolled like other dice.

source: 「프리즘 주사위」는 사용 횟수 제한이 있으며, 보통 대전당 2회만 사용할 수 있습니다
target: The Prismatic Dice has limited uses. You can typically only use it twice per match.

source: 「프리즘 주사위」의 사용 횟수는 일부 캐릭터 카드의 특성이나 일부 날씨의 영향으로 인해 일시적으로 증가할 수 있습니다
target: Some Character Traits and weather effects may temporarily increase the number of times you can use the Prismatic Dice.

source: 「하누 미사일」로 폭죽을 터트리면 더 넓은 범위의 폭발을 일으켜 적을 처치할 수 있고, 벽도 부술 수 있습니다
target: If you use the Hanu Rocket to ignite the fireworks, it will trigger an explosion that defeats enemies, and is even capable of destroying walls.

source: 「학식의 꽃」
target: Cognos Bloom

source: 「학식의 꽃」은 침식의 영향을 받을 수 있으며, 되돌리더라도 자동으로 능력을 발동하기 전의 상태로 되돌아갑니다
target: Cognos Bloom sometimes becomes corrupted. Even after it has been Rewound, it will still return to its state before the ability was used.

source: 「해킹 성명」
target: "Hacking Callcard"

source: 「행자의 길」을 실행하고, 「알현의 행적」 포인트를 올리고, 모든 「곤충 떼 재난」 챕터를 수집하세요
target: Carry out the Trails of Pathstrider, increase Communing Trail points, and collect all chapters of the Swarm Disaster.

source: 「허구 이야기」의 모든 전투에는 라운드 제한이 있습니다. 행동 라운드가 끝나거나 모든 웨이브의 적을 처치하면 전투가 종료됩니다. 적을 더 많이 처치하거나 보스 HP를 감소시키면 더 높은 점수를 얻어 더 많은 보상을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: All battles in Pure Fiction have a Cycle limit, and battles finish when action cycles end or enemies from all waves are defeated. Defeating more enemies or reducing Boss enemy's HP will earn you higher scores and greater rewards.

source: 「화폐 전쟁」에서 금화는 가장 핵심적인 경제 자원입니다. 더 많은 금화를 획득하여 팀의 전투력을 높이세요
target: In "Currency Wars", Gold Coins are the core economic resource. Gain more Gold Coins to enhance your team's combat power.

source: 「화폐 전쟁」에서 금화는 캐릭터 구매, 팀 규모 레벨업, 상점 재배치에 사용되는 가장 핵심적인 경제 자원입니다. 더 많은 금화를 획득하여 팀의 전투력을 높이세요
target: In "Currency Wars", Gold Coins are the core economic resource used for recruiting characters, upgrading team size, and refreshing Store offerings. Gain more Gold Coins to enhance your team's combat power.

source: 「화폐 전쟁」에서 전방 캐릭터는 자동으로 비술을 사용하여 전투에 진입합니다
target: In "Currency Wars", on-field characters will automatically use Techniques in combat.

source: 「화폐 전쟁」에서 캐릭터 고용 시: 보유 중인 캐릭터의 경우, 해당 캐릭터의 육성 데이터를 계승합니다. 미보유 캐릭터의 경우, 상응하는 체험 캐릭터를 고용해 플레이할 수 있습니다
target: When recruiting characters in "Currency Wars": If you already own the character, you will inherit your character's build data. If you don't own the character, you can recruit a trial version of the character to play with.

source: 「화폐 전쟁」에서 팀원을 고용하여 8~10명의 팀을 구성해 전투를 진행하고, 상대를 쓰러트리세요
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8-10 members, and defeat your opponents!

source: 「화폐 전쟁」에서 파티원을 고용하여 8~10인 파티를 구성해 전투를 진행하고, 경쟁자를 쓰러트리세요
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8–10 members, and defeat your competitors.

source: 「화폐 전쟁」에서는 초기 직급을 가지고 시작합니다. 기본 게임 모드의 현재 가장 높은 직급 난이도에 도전해 성공하면, 결산 시 남은 파티 HP에 따라 대전 평가를 획득하고 직급을 올릴 수 있습니다
target: In Currency Wars, you start with an initial rank. Successfully challenging the current highest rank difficulty in the Standard Gambit mode will earn you a battle rating based on your remaining squad HP, allowing you to rank up.

source: 「화폐 전쟁」에서는 캐릭터마다 최대 3개의 장비를 장착할 수 있습니다. 캐릭터에게 적합한 장비를 장착시키면 캐릭터의 전투력을 대폭 향상시킬 수 있습니다
target: In Currency Wars, you can equip up to 3 pieces of Equipment on each Character. Equipping suitable gears on a character can significantly boost that character's combat ability.

source: 「황금과 기계」에서는 「사용자 정의 주사위」마다 각기 다른 패시브 효과를 가집니다. 패시브 효과 조건을 충족하면 선택한 운명의 길에 따라 다른 버프 효과가 제공됩니다
target: In Gold and Gears, Custom Dice have different Passive abilities. Every time you fulfill the die's passive ability requirements, different bonuses will be provided based on the chosen Path.

source: 『ちびっ子ハヌの大作戦』では、ブラザーハヌはボス・ストーンの奇怪な装置によって身体が縮みます。小さくなった身体で冒険を繰り広げ、ボス・ストーンに奪われた街のお宝を取り戻しましょう。
target: In the story of Hanu's Adventure, he was made smaller by Boss Stone's strange device. He then had to experience a grand adventure with his small body and take back the treasure Boss Stone took from the town.

source: 『オオカミの道・終』の撮影内容が全面的にアップグレード！ストーリーで、ボス・ストーンの挑戦に立ち向かうことになります。
target: The content for the Way of the Wolf film has been fully upgraded. You will directly face Boss Stone in the story

source: 『クロックボーイ』外伝の撮影イベントに、様々なアトラクションが開放されました。ぜひ体験してみてください！
target: The Clockie's Extras filming experience event now has more available activities. Guests are welcome to try them out!

target: Clockie's Extras: Way of the Wolf (End)

target: Clockie's Extras: Senior Animator's Secret Volume

target: Clockie's Extras: Filming Experience

source: 『クロックボーイ』外伝・映画モード
target: Clockie's Extras: Movie Mode

source: 『クロックボーイ』外伝・続編モード
target: Clockie's Extras: Sequel Mode

source: 『サイコロ最高！コズミック・フォース！』・プレイガイド
target: Cosmicon, Roll On!: Event Gameplay

source: 『週刊タヌキ』のたぬき記者たちは外回りの時に油を売っているらしいです。よろしくありません！やんちゃな子たちを捕まえて「お仕置き」しましょう。
target: The furbo journalists from Furbobo Weekly are slacking off on the job? That won't do! Round up these little rascals and give them a good "talking-to"!

source: 『週刊タヌキ』のたぬき記者たちは色んなところに隠れて、こっそり社長の足取りを追っています。力の使いどころをわかってもらうためにも、こちらから出撃する必要がありそうですね。
target: The furbo journalists from Furbobo Weekly lurk around all over the place, secretly tailing the president! If we want these guys to use their skills for good, we need to take the initiative.

source: 『週刊タヌキ』の社長として「楽園の記念コイン」を貯金箱に入れると、レベルが上がるのにつれて、たぬきたちが特典を届けてくれる。
target: As the president of Furbobo Weekly, drop your Arcadian Tokens into the Piggy Bank. As it levels up, the furbos will deliver rewards to you.

source: 【专家顾问】初始不参与普通的商店招募，但开拓者可以在对局中通过特定的【投资环境】、【投资策略】或【专家邀请函】解锁【专家顾问】。
target: Expert Advisors are initially unavailable through normal Store recruitment, but Trailblazers can unlock Expert Advisors during runs through specific Investment Environments, Investment Strategies, or Expert Invitations.

source: 【二律背反】状态会激活终结技。但在效果持续期间施放终结技会损失大量生命值。
target: The "Antinomy" state will activate Ultimates. However, using an Ultimate during this effect will cost massive HP.

source: 【二律背反】狀態會啟動終結技。但在效果持續期間施放終結技會損失大量生命值。
target: The "Antinomy" state will activate Ultimates. However, using an Ultimate during this effect will cost massive HP.

source: 【前台】的角色赋能： 角色本体技能得到强化，或者获得全新的战斗技能。
target: "On-Field" Character Empowerment: Character's base abilities are enhanced, or they gain brand-new combat abilities.

source: 【合金机铠•帕姆王】施放【高温消毒模式】后获得数层【长效抗菌】效果，使自身受到的伤害大幅度降低。
target: After "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom" uses "High-Temp Sterilization Mode," it gains several stacks of "Lasting Antibac," greatly reducing the DMG taken by it.

source: 【合金机铠•帕姆王】的【长效抗菌】效果全部被移除时，会受到大量伤害。
target: When all "Lasting Antibac" effects are removed from "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom," it takes massive DMG.

source: 【合金機鎧•帕姆王】施放【高溫消毒模式】後獲得數層【長效抗菌】效果，使自身受到的傷害大幅度降低。
target: After "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom" uses "High-Temp Sterilization Mode," it gains several stacks of "Lasting Antibac," greatly reducing the DMG taken by it.

source: 【合金機鎧•帕姆王】的【長效抗菌】效果全部移除時，會受到大量傷害。
target: When all "Lasting Antibac" effects are removed from "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom," it takes massive DMG.

source: 【后台】的角色赋能： 使用角色强化后的技能在后台进行战斗，战斗中自动施放技能攻击敌人或辅助队友。
target: "Off-Field" Character Empowerment: Characters will use enhanced abilities to fight off-field, automatically using abilities to attack enemies or support teammates in a battle.

source: 【后排目标】位于战场阵型后方，无法被【单攻】和【扩散】类型的技能选中。【群攻】【弹射】【追加攻击】类型的技能可攻击到敌方后排目标。
target: "Back Row Target" is located in the back of the formation on the field and cannot be selected by "Single Target ATK" and "Blast"-type abilities. "AoE ATK," "Bounce," and "Follow-Up ATK" abilities can hit enemy Back Row Targets.

source: 【場上】的角色賦能： 角色本體技能得到強化，或者獲得全新的戰鬥技能。
target: "On-Field" Character Empowerment: Character's base abilities are enhanced, or they gain brand-new combat abilities.

source: 【專家顧問】初始不參與普通的商店召募，但開拓者可以在對局中透過特定的【投資環境】、【投資策略】或【專家邀請函】解鎖【專家顧問】。
target: Expert Advisors are initially unavailable through normal Store recruitment, but Trailblazers can unlock Expert Advisors during runs through specific Investment Environments, Investment Strategies, or Expert Invitations.

source: 【开拓同行】角色呼唤的支援攻击具有特殊效果
target: Support attacks beckoned by "Trailblaze Companions" characters have special effects

source: 【強化】狀態下，【玻呂刻斯】或【哀憫長臂】受到攻擊時可削減【瀕死夢泡】並回復我方生命值。【瀕死夢泡】完全耗盡時解除【強化】狀態。
target: In the "Enhanced" state, attacks against "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" can reduce "Desperate Bubble" and restore allies' HP. When "Desperate Bubble" depletes, dispels the "Enhanced" state.

source: 【强化】状态下，【玻吕刻斯】或【哀悯长臂】受到攻击时可削减【濒死梦泡】并回复我方生命值。【濒死梦泡】完全耗尽时解除【强化】状态。
target: In the "Enhanced" state, attacks against "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" can reduce "Desperate Bubble" and restore allies' HP. When "Desperate Bubble" depletes, dispels the "Enhanced" state.

source: 【後台】的角色賦能： 使用角色強化後的技能在後台進行戰鬥，在戰鬥中會自動施放技能攻擊敵人或輔助隊友。
target: "Off-Field" Character Empowerment: Characters will use enhanced abilities to fight off-field, automatically using abilities to attack enemies or support teammates in a battle.

source: 【後排目標】位於戰場陣型後方，無法被【單體攻擊】和【擴散】類型的技能選中。【群體攻擊】、【彈射】、【追加攻擊】類型的技能可攻擊到敵方後排目標。
target: "Back Row Target" is located in the back of the formation on the field and cannot be selected by "Single Target ATK" and "Blast"-type abilities. "AoE ATK," "Bounce," and "Follow-Up ATK" abilities can hit enemy Back Row Targets.

source: 【怪怪怪味豆】会自动搜寻并攻击普通敌人，消耗1个秘技点立即将其消灭，不会进入战斗。
target: "Funky Munch Bean" will automatically search for and attack Normal Enemies. Consume 1 Technique Point to immediately defeat them without entering combat.

source: 【怪怪怪味豆】會自動搜尋並攻擊普通敵人，消耗1個秘技點立即將其消滅，不會進入戰鬥。
target: "Funky Munch Bean" will automatically search for and attack Normal Enemies. Consume 1 Technique Point to immediately defeat them without entering combat.

source: 【恐惧萦绕】结束时，若未能对施加者发起攻击解除【恐惧萦绕】，则会陷入【恐惧】状态，无法行动。
target: When Terror Grip ends, if the caster of Terror Grip is not attacked to dispel Terror Grip, then the affected ally will fall into the Terrified state and be unable to perform actions.

source: 【恐懼縈繞】結束時，若未能對施加者發動攻擊解除【恐懼縈繞】，則會陷入【恐懼】狀態，無法行動。
target: When Terror Grip ends, if the caster of Terror Grip is not attacked to dispel Terror Grip, then the affected ally will fall into the Terrified state and be unable to perform actions.

source: 【战甲】被破坏时，使敌人受到伤害、行动延后，并使攻击者恢复能量。
target: When "War Armor" is destroyed, deals DMG to enemies, delays their action, and regenerates Energy for the attacker.

source: 【戰甲】被破壞時，使敵人受到傷害、行動延後，並使攻擊者恢復能量。
target: When "War Armor" is destroyed, deals DMG to enemies, delays their action, and regenerates Energy for the attacker.

source: 【沉沦于长眠】使该目标对敌方目标造成伤害时，敌方目标受到的伤害降低，我方目标恢复至一定生命值可解除此状态。
target: "Indulging Slumber" decreases DMG received by enemy targets when this target deals DMG to them. Restore an ally target's HP to a certain threshold to dispel this effect.

source: 【沉淪於長眠】使該目標對敵方目標造成傷害時，敵方目標受到的傷害降低，我方目標恢復至一定生命值可解除此狀態。
target: "Indulging Slumber" decreases DMG received by enemy targets when this target deals DMG to them. Restore an ally target's HP to a certain threshold to dispel this effect.

source: 【烈毒】层数越高，受到的暴击伤害越高；攻击携带4层【烈毒】的敌方时，还会对其和相邻目标激发持续伤害。
target: The higher the "Toxic" stacks are, the higher the CRIT DMG taken becomes. When attacking enemies with 4 stacks of "Toxic," you can also trigger DoT on the target and adjacent targets.

source: 【烈毒】層數越高，受到的暴擊傷害越高；攻擊攜帶4層【烈毒】的敵方時，還會對其和相鄰目標激發持續傷害。
target: The higher the "Toxic" stacks are, the higher the CRIT DMG taken becomes. When attacking enemies with 4 stacks of "Toxic," you can also trigger DoT on the target and adjacent targets.

source: 【開拓同行】角色呼喚的支援攻擊具有特殊效果
target: Support attacks beckoned by "Trailblaze Companions" characters have special effects

source: 【黑潮热】属于持续伤害类负面状态，持续伤害来源于目标受到伤害的一部分，叠加时刷新【黑潮热】的持续回合。
target: "Black Tide Fever" is a type of DoT debuff. The DoT originates from a part of the DMG that the target takes. When stacking, it resets the duration of "Black Tide Fever."

source: 【黑潮热】状态下，目标每回合开始时受到风化、灼烧、触电、裂伤持续伤害。
target: While in "Black Tide Fever," targets receive Wind Shear, Burn, Shock, and Bleed DoT at the start of every turn.

source: 【黑潮熱】屬於持續傷害類負面狀態，持續傷害來源於目標受到傷害的一部分，疊加時重置【黑潮熱】的持續回合。
target: "Black Tide Fever" is a type of DoT debuff. The DoT originates from a part of the DMG that the target takes. When stacking, it resets the duration of "Black Tide Fever."

source: 【黑潮熱】狀態下，目標每回合開始時受到風化、灼燒、觸電、裂傷持續傷害。
target: While in "Black Tide Fever," targets receive Wind Shear, Burn, Shock, and Bleed DoT at the start of every turn.

source: あなたの行動は虚空の暗闇に記録されているから気をつけて！運命の歩数が0になると闇に染まったもう1人の自分が敵として現れ、これまで刻んできた運命の軌跡に沿って1歩ずつ迫ってきます……
target: Watch out! Your each and every move will be recorded by the shadows in the void. When fate's footsteps returns to zero, an enshadowed version of you will manifest as an enemy and process along the fate you have etched into being...

source: いつでも、ここで記憶の中で体験したことを確認できます。
target: You can check all the timestamps of your experiences in the memories here at any time.

source: いつでも通常モードの忘却の庭ステージ12に切り替えられ、既存の報酬を獲得できます。
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 12 of the regular Forgotten Hall and obtain the original rewards.

source: いつでも通常モードの末日の幻影難易度04に切り替えられ、既存の報酬を獲得できます。
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Difficulty 4 of the regular Apocalyptic Shadow and obtain the original rewards.

source: いつでも通常モードの虚構叙事ステージ04に切り替えられ、既存の報酬を獲得できます。
target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 4 of the regular Pure Fiction and obtain the original rewards.

source: おすすめ武器
target: Weapon Recommendations

source: おすすめ武器 デバフ：虚無の警鐘、寒霜消火器 必殺技発動で触発：純美の祈り、侠客の長弓
target: Recommended Weapon Combo: Debuff State: Nihility's Warning and Icy Fire Extinguisher Triggered By Ultimate: Prayers of Beauty and Ranger's Longbow

source: おすすめ武器 単体攻撃で敵撃破後に触発：甘く深い眠り、疾風のハンマー、レインボーバット 量子属性、虚数属性、物理属性：甘く深い眠り、ラッキールーレット
target: Recommended Weapon Combo: Upon defeating enemy targets with single-target attacks, triggers the following: Sweet Slumber, Storm Gale Hammer, Rainbow Bat Quantum, Imaginary, and Physical-Type: Sweet Slumber, Lucky Roulette

target: Recommended Weapon Combo: Action Triggered Weapon: Prayers of Beauty, Ranger's Longbow, Rainbow Bat, and Will of Architects
