target: Xianzhou Luofu Zone

source: 仙舟罗浮区
target: Xianzhou Luofu Zone

source: 仙舟羅浮區
target: Xianzhou Luofu Zone

source: 以太战线
target: Aetherium Wars

source: 以太灵共有机械，人形，异形三种相互克制的属性，合理运用克制关系是胜利的关键
target: Aether Spirits can be sorted into the Mechanical, Humanoid, and Aberrant types that counteract each other. Utilizing their counteracting relationship is the key to victory.

source: 以太灵对战
target: Aether Spirit Battle

source: 以特定順序點亮燃燈，可解除鱗淵境中對應封印。
target: By lighting them up in a specific sequence, the corresponding seals in Scalegorge Waterscape can be removed.

source: 以貼紙裝飾手帳頁面可提升對應頁面的完成度
target: Use your stickers collection to decorate your scrapbook and boost its completion progress.

source: 仮想の味に酔いしれて
target: Virtual Scentventure

source: 仮面のレベルアップ時に、奇跡を1つ獲得できます。仮面のレベルが4の倍数に達するごとに、より強力な世にも珍しい奇跡を選べます。
target: When the Mask levels up, you'll gain a miracle. When the Mask reaches a level that is a multiple of 4, you can select a more powerful Grand Miracle.

source: 任何属性的攻击都可以给该敌人添加对应属性的弱点。
target: Attacks of any Type can implant a Weakness of the corresponding Type on this enemy.

source: 任何屬性的攻擊都可以向該敵人附加對應屬性的弱點。
target: Attacks of any Type can implant a Weakness of the corresponding Type on this enemy.

source: 任何时候，你都可以在这里确认记忆中所有经历的时间点。
target: You can check all the timestamps of your experiences in the memories here at any time.

source: 任务
target: Mission

source: 任務
target: Mission

source: 任意の2つのレッドダイヤモンドまたはブルーダイヤモンドを使用して合成を行うと、富の宝石を獲得できます。
target: Perform synthesis using any 2 Red Gems/Blue Gems to obtain a Wealth Gem.

source: 任意の2個のフルーツ爆弾を入れ替えると、コンボ消去を発動できます。
target: Swap any 2 Fruit Bombs to trigger a combo elimination.

source: 任意の加重奇物を選んでスロットに装備できます。加重奇物の効果は、装備しているもののみ発揮されます。鍛造エリアのレベルが上がると、装備できる数も増えていきます。
target: You can select any Weighted Curio to equip in a slot. Only equipped Weighted Curios will take effect. As the Forge Domain level increases, the number of slots available will also increase.

source: 任意の味方キャラが連続行動した後、大量の「戦意値」を累積できます。 敵を撃破、または敵の行動を阻止した場合は、いずれも味方キャラの行動を維持できます。
target: After any ally performs consecutive actions, a large amount of Grit Value can be obtained. Defeating enemies or stopping enemy actions are all viable means to have allies continue to take action.

source: 任意の属性の攻撃で、敵に対応する属性の弱点を付与することができます。
target: Attacks of any Type can implant a Weakness of the corresponding Type on this enemy.

source: 任意の敵を弱点撃破した後、その敵および隣接する敵に攻撃者の属性を弱点として付与し、さらにダメージを与えます。
target: After inflicting Weakness Break on any target, implants Weakness of the same Type as the attacker on the target and units adjacent to the target, and additionally deals DMG to them.

source: 任意の概念礼装を発動すると、アーチャーはその概念礼装の投影を生成します。
target: After Archer uses any Conceptual Mystic Code, he generates a Trace of the Conceptual Mystic Code.

source: 任意两件简易装备可以合成一件进阶装备。 可以点击简易装备，查看合成表。
target: Any two basic equipment can be synthesized into a piece of advanced equipment. Click on the basic equipment to view the synthesis chart.

source: 任意兩件簡易裝備可以合成一件進階裝備。 可以點選簡易裝備，查看合成表。
target: Any two basic equipment can be synthesized into a piece of advanced equipment. Click on the basic equipment to view the synthesis chart.

source: 任意我方目标在连续行动后，可积累大量「战意值」。 消灭敌人或阻止敌方行动，均可维持我方角色行动。
target: After any ally performs consecutive actions, a large amount of Grit Value can be obtained. Defeating enemies or stopping enemy actions are all viable means to have allies continue to take action.

source: 任意我方目標在連續行動後，可累積大量「戰意值」。 消滅敵人或阻止敵方行動，均可維持我方角色行動。
target: After any ally performs consecutive actions, a large amount of Grit Value can be obtained. Defeating enemies or stopping enemy actions are all viable means to have allies continue to take action.

source: 会场中有来自银河各地的特色展台，可邀请熟悉的角色们作为助理到场，共同经营展会。
target: The venue has unique booths from all over the cosmos. You can invite familiar characters as assistants to run the exhibition together.

source: 会場には銀河各地からの特色あるブースが設置されており、お馴染みのキャラクターをアシスタントとして招待し、一緒に展示会を経営することができます。
target: The venue has unique booths from all over the cosmos. You can invite familiar characters as assistants to run the exhibition together.

source: 会場管理画面で、エリアにいるアシスタントの絆情報を確認でき、各キャラの絆の組み合わせをチェックできる
target: You can view the Bond Info for assistants currently on the exhibition floor from the Venue Management screen, making it easier to see each character's Bond combo.

source: 传送带：落在传送带上的造物不会跳跃，而是会随着传送带移动
target: Conveyor Belt: Creations that land on the Conveyor Belt will not jump, but will move along with the Conveyor Belt

source: 传送模块会将其上方的兆算模块传送到另一端。
target: Teleportation modules will teleport the computing modules above it to the other end.

source: 传送锅：造物进入传送锅后，会随机传送到某个其他传送锅处
target: Teleportation Pot: After a creation enters a Teleportation Pot, it will be randomly teleported to another Teleportation Pot

source: 但可以透過在夢境中探索，使用「情緒汲取」取得需要的齒輪。
target: However, you can obtain the required gear using Emotion Absorption by exploring the Dreamscape.

source: 但可以通过在梦境中探索，使用「情绪汲取」，获得需要的齿轮。
target: However, you can obtain the required gear using Emotion Absorption by exploring the Dreamscape.

source: 但当我方的共享生命扣除至0时，就视为对战失败。
target: However, when the ally's Shared HP is depleted to 0, the battle is considered lost.

source: 但是当机兵没有一次性击晕所有敌人或者被敌人发现时，会挑战失败而被报废
target: But if the Automaton fails to stun all its enemies at once or is discovered by enemies, the challenge will be failed and written off

source: 但是當機兵沒有一次擊暈所有敵人或者被敵人發現時，會挑戰失敗而被報廢
target: But if the Automaton fails to stun all its enemies at once or is discovered by enemies, the challenge will be failed and written off

source: 但當我方的共享生命扣除至0時，就視為對戰失敗。
target: However, when the ally's Shared HP is depleted to 0, the battle is considered lost.

source: 佈設在藏品展示區域上的藏品，能為「差分宇宙」中的挑戰提供增益。
target: Collections placed in the collection display areas can provide buffs for challenges in Divergent Universe.

source: 位面与节点
target: Planes and Nodes

source: 位面内出现大量扑满，抓住扑满，获得更多祝福。
target: A large number of Trotters have appeared in the plane. Capture them and obtain more Blessings.

source: 位面内可获得各命途对应的活动限定祝福。
target: All kinds of event-limited Blessings corresponding to each Path can be obtained in this plane.

source: 位面内存在大量可破坏物，敲碎破坏物后可获取大量奇物。
target: Many destructible objects exist within the planes. Destroy them to obtain a large number of Curios.

source: 位面内所有区域均为「区域-事件」（「区域-首领」除外），完成事件获得额外祝福。
target: All domains in this plane are Domain — Occurrence (except Domain — Boss). Additional Blessing can be obtained after completing Occurrences.

source: 位面内进入新区域、战斗胜利、敲碎可破坏物都将获得大量宇宙碎片。
target: Entering a new domain, achieving victory in battle, or destroying destructible objects will all get you a large number of Cosmic Fragments in this plane.

source: 位面必定可遇见「阮•梅」全新「切片」。
target: In this plane, you are guaranteed to encounter Ruan Mei's new "World Slice."

source: 体力が尽きた時、体力を消費するたびにパーティ内の全キャラクターのHPを一定割合削ります。
target: When Stamina is exhausted, every subsequent use of it will deduct a percentage of HP from all characters in the team.

source: 体力を消費することで、明るいエリアを探索できます。
target: By consuming Stamina, you can explore the illuminated areas.

source: 作为「魔法师」的角色，其战技和终结技将获得全新战斗效果，指挥「小桶宝力」进行战斗。
target: Characters acting as the Magician will see their Skill and Ultimate gain new combat effects, letting them command Litter Pony in battle.

source: 作为美梦小镇的大哥，能屈能伸是一项基本素质。如果有必要，可以躲进箱子里避开石头老板的爪牙。
target: As the boss of Dreamville, it is a basic requirement to adjust yourself to the situation. If needed, you can hide in the box to avoid Boss Stone's lackeys.

source: 作為「魔法師」的角色，其戰技和終結技將獲得全新戰鬥效果，指揮「小桶寶力」進行戰鬥。
target: Characters acting as the Magician will see their Skill and Ultimate gain new combat effects, letting them command Litter Pony in battle.

source: 作物を育てるには資金が必要です。
target: Growing crops requires money

source: 你可以回忆与丹恒在翁法罗斯生活的片段，将它们化作固定数量的「记忆残晶」。每周开始时刷新。
target: You can recall the life you led with Dan Heng in Amphoreus and convert them into a fixed amount of Memory Crystal Shards. Refreshes at the beginning of each week.

source: 你可以回憶與丹恆在翁法羅斯生活的片段，將它們化作固定數量的「記憶殘晶」。每週開始時重置。
target: You can recall the life you led with Dan Heng in Amphoreus and convert them into a fixed amount of Memory Crystal Shards. Refreshes at the beginning of each week.

source: 你可以在任何時候從這裡確認記憶中所有經歷的時間點。
target: You can check all the timestamps of your experiences in the memories here at any time.

source: 你可以在未解鎖事件詳情頁面中查看該事件的解鎖條件。
target: You can review the current event's unlock criteria on the locked event details page.

source: 你可以在未解锁事件详情页中查看当前事件的解锁条件。
target: You can review the current event's unlock criteria on the locked event details page.

source: 你在終末任務的經歷，也可以在命路歧圖中進行查看。
target: The experience you gained during the Finality Mission can also be viewed in Fate's Atlas.

source: 你在终末任务的经历，也可以在命路歧图中进行查看。
target: The experience you gained during the Finality Mission can also be viewed in Fate's Atlas.

source: 你将作为剑术助教，安排三月七的练剑日程，并帮助她领悟剑招，在15日后击败斯科特。
target: As the swordplay assistant, you will be arranging March 7th's Swordplay Sessions and helping her with mastering Sword Moves to prepare her to defeat Skott in 15 days.

target: As the swordplay assistant, you will be arranging March 7th's Swordplay Sessions and helping her with mastering Sword Moves to prepare her to defeat Skott in 15 days.

target: Match 4 or more identical fruits to generate a corresponding bomb.

target: Match more than 3 fruits of the same color to generate a corresponding bomb.

source: 使用下載裝置可以為本次探索加入新的角色。每個下載裝置只能新增1名角色，請謹慎選擇。
target: New characters can be added to the current exploration by using the Downloader. One Downloader can only add one character, so please make it count.

source: 使用下载装置可以为本次探索添加新的角色。每个下载装置只能添加1名角色，请认真选择。
target: New characters can be added to the current exploration by using the Downloader. One Downloader can only add one character, so please make it count.

source: 使用二倍速功能，可以体验更快节奏的战斗，但在某些特殊战斗时会暂时关闭二倍速功能。
target: Use 2× speed to experience quicker battles. However, 2× speed will be temporarily turned off in some special combat situations.

source: 使用云吟法术的刺客处于隐身状态，很难被发现。被隐身状态的敌人主动攻击，进入战斗后敌方全体的行动会大幅提前，并隐藏自身的弱点。
target: Assassins using the cloudhymn are in stealth mode and are difficult to detect. After being attacked by an enemy in stealth mode and entering battle, all enemies' actions are greatly advanced and their weaknesses are hidden.

source: 使用助燃券，可以快速刷取拟造花萼/凝滞虚影掉落的养成材料。
target: Using a Fuel Voucher lets you quickly farm upgrade materials from Calyx / Stagnant Shadows.

source: 使用助燃券，可以快速收取擬造花萼/凝滯虛影掉落的養成素材。
target: Using a Fuel Voucher lets you quickly farm upgrade materials from Calyx / Stagnant Shadows.

source: 使用可能なスキルがある場合、ランダムにスキル牌を1枚引きます
target: When the racer has an available skill, an ability tile will be drawn at random.

source: 使用右下角的开关按钮，可以开关宝珠的光芒。使用退出按钮，可以退出宝珠的操作界面。
target: Use the Switch button in the bottom-right corner to turn on or off the orb's light. Use the Quit button to exit the control interface of the orb.

source: 使用右下角的開關按鈕，可以開關寶珠的光芒。使用退出按鈕，可以退出寶珠的操作介面。
target: Use the Switch button in the bottom-right corner to turn on or off the orb's light. Use the Quit button to exit the control interface of the orb.

source: 使用右搖桿，可以旋轉視角觀察。使用左搖桿，可以平移畫面觀察。點選右下角重置按鈕可重置視角。
target: Use the right joystick to rotate the camera. Use the left joystick to move the screen. Press the reset button in the bottom right corner to reset your camera.

source: 使用右摇杆，可旋转视角观察。使用左摇杆，可平移画面观察。点击右下角重置按钮可重置视角。

target: Summon Queue

target: Summon Queue

target: Enemies with Summoning Abilities will start a countdown based on your actions. When the countdown ends, a non-Elite Enemy will be summoned in an empty area. This enemy will immediately appear, but will not lock down the surrounding area.

source: 可以利用「欧洛尼斯祷言」让镇球塑像溯回至基座完好的状态。
target: Oronyx's Prayer can be used to rewind the Ball-Holder Statue to when its base is undamaged.

source: 可以利用拆装扳手，自由调配已穿戴的角色装备，以最大化提升团队战力。
target: Use the Disassembly Wrench to freely reassign equipped gears and maximize your team's combat power.

source: 可以利用拆裝扳手自由調配已穿戴的角色裝備，以盡可能提升團隊戰力。
target: Use the Disassembly Wrench to freely reassign equipped gears and maximize your team's combat power.

source: 可以嘗試調製「已知功效」，或是挑戰口感和效果都完全不同的「隱藏功效」。 2個功效彼此獨立，請根據喜好隨意調製。
target: You can try mixing "Known Effects", or challenge yourself with "Hidden Effects" that have completely different tastes and properties. The two effects are independent of each other, so feel free to mix them however you like.

source: 可以在自己的派对车厢里寻找，也可以通过拜访好友或陌生人的派对车厢来抓住更多造物。
target: You can search in your own Party Car, or catch more creations by visiting Friends' or Strangers' Party Cars.

source: 可以在自己的派對車廂裡尋找，也可以藉由拜訪好友或陌生人的派對車廂抓住更多造物。
target: You can search in your own Party Car, or catch more creations by visiting Friends' or Strangers' Party Cars.

source: 可以将心仪的造物摆放在不同的区域。 相似的造物放置在一起，会相处得更加融洽。
target: You may place your favorite creations in different areas. Similar creations tend to get along better when placed together.

source: 可以將心儀的造物擺放在不同的區域。 相似的造物放置在一起，會相處得更加融洽。
target: You may place your favorite creations in different areas. Similar creations tend to get along better when placed together.

target: You can try mixing "Known Effects", or challenge yourself with "Hidden Effects" that have completely different tastes and properties. The two effects are independent of each other, so feel free to mix them however you like.

target: You can push the Snowshine Lamps and place them atop the armory boxes within the gameplay area to ignite the other lamps that remain out of reach and complete the challenge goal

source: 可以推動玩法區域內放置在軍械箱上的照雪燈爐，將其他接觸不到的照雪燈爐點燃，完成挑戰目標
target: You can push the Snowshine Lamps and place them atop the armory boxes within the gameplay area to ignite the other lamps that remain out of reach and complete the challenge goal

target: Attacking this enemy can make it switch between Surprise Channel and Fright Channel.

source: 可以查看对当前角色推荐的套装、主属性和副属性。套装和主属性数据来自近期活跃玩家的统计数据。
target: You can view the recommended Set, Main Stat, and Subsidiary Stats for the current character. The Set and Main Stat data are based on statistics from recently active players.

source: 可以查看對當前角色推薦的套裝、主屬性和副屬性。套裝和主屬性資料來自近期活躍玩家的統計資料。
target: You can view the recommended Set, Main Stat, and Subsidiary Stats for the current character. The Set and Main Stat data are based on statistics from recently active players.

source: 可以消耗「艾迪恩代币」游玩各种游艺设施，有较低概率获得珍贵奖励。
target: You can use Aideen Tokens to play various amusement facilities and have a small chance of winning valuable rewards.

source: 可以消耗「艾迪恩代幣」遊玩各種遊樂設施，有低機率獲得珍貴獎勵。
target: You can use Aideen Tokens to play various amusement facilities and have a small chance of winning valuable rewards.

source: 可以消耗宇宙碎片进行区域升级、附加/删除信标或是删除指定区域。随着铸造区域等级提高，可使用的功能类型和可使用次数也会增加。
target: Consume Cosmic Fragments to upgrade Domains, add or remove beacons, or delete designated Domains. As the Forge Domain level increases, more function types and uses will become available.

source: 可以消耗宇宙碎片进行占卜，获得拥有强大效果的奇物。随着铸造区域等级提高，可获得奇物的数量和类型也会增加。
target: Consume Cosmic Fragments to perform divinations to obtain Curios with powerful effects. As the Forge Domain level increases, the quantity and variety of Curios you can obtain will also increase.

source: 可以消耗宇宙碎片進行區域升級、附加/刪除信標或是刪除指定區域。隨著鑄造區域等級提高，可使用的功能類型和可使用次數也會增加。
target: Consume Cosmic Fragments to upgrade Domains, add or remove beacons, or delete designated Domains. As the Forge Domain level increases, more function types and uses will become available.

source: 可以消耗宇宙碎片進行占卜，獲得擁有強大效果的奇物。隨著鑄造區域等級提高，可獲得奇物的數量和類型也會增加。
target: Consume Cosmic Fragments to perform divinations to obtain Curios with powerful effects. As the Forge Domain level increases, the quantity and variety of Curios you can obtain will also increase.

source: 可以直接选择首领进行挑战，战斗胜利后可获得对应的位面饰品。
target: You can select the boss enemy to challenge it directly and earn corresponding Planar Ornaments upon victory.

source: 可以直接選擇頭目進行挑戰，戰鬥勝利後可獲得對應的次元飾品。
target: You can select the boss enemy to challenge it directly and earn corresponding Planar Ornaments upon victory.

source: 可以选择任意加权奇物装配于栏位上，只有装配后的加权奇物才有效果。随着铸造区域等级提高，可装配的数量也会增加。
target: You can select any Weighted Curio to equip in a slot. Only equipped Weighted Curios will take effect. As the Forge Domain level increases, the number of slots available will also increase.

source: 可以透過便捷按鈕打開夢境護照；也可以藉由背包內的「夢境護照」道具將其打開
target: You can open the Dreamscape Pass via the shortcut button, or by using the "Dreamscape Pass" item in the Inventory.

source: 可以透過攻擊和消滅敵方目標降低層數，避免轉化並克服【幸福】效果。
target: Attacking and defeating enemy targets can reduce stacks to avoid being converted and overcome the "Happiness" effect.

target: You can open the Dreamscape Pass via the shortcut button, or by using the "Dreamscape Pass" item in the Inventory.

target: Attacking and defeating enemy targets can reduce stacks to avoid being converted and overcome the "Happiness" effect.

target: Attacking this enemy can make it switch between Surprise Channel and Fright Channel.

target: You can select any Weighted Curio to equip in a slot. Only equipped Weighted Curios will take effect. As the Forge Domain level increases, the number of slots available will also increase.

target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 12 of the regular Forgotten Hall and obtain the original rewards.

target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Difficulty 4 of the regular Apocalyptic Shadow and obtain the original rewards.

target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Difficulty 4 of the regular Apocalyptic Shadow and obtain the original rewards.

target: You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 4 of the regular Pure Fiction and obtain the original rewards.

source: 可使用2金币进行商店刷新，重置其中的出现的角色。 也可使用锁定功能，下个节点开始时商店将停止自动刷新。
target: You can use 2 Gold Coins to refresh the Store and reset the Characters appearing within it. You can also use the Lock feature, which will prevent the Store from automatically refreshing at the start of the next Node.

source: 可使用2金幣進行商店重置，重置其中的出現的角色。 也可使用鎖定功能，下個節點開始時商店將停止自動重置。
target: You can use 2 Gold Coins to refresh the Store and reset the Characters appearing within it. You can also use the Lock feature, which will prevent the Store from automatically refreshing at the start of the next Node.

target: Perform synthesis using any 2 Red Gems/Blue Gems to obtain a Wealth Gem.

source: 可使用任意2個紅鑽/藍鑽進行合成，可獲得財富寶鑽。
target: Perform synthesis using any 2 Red Gems/Blue Gems to obtain a Wealth Gem.

source: 可在会场管理界面查看当前场上助理的羁绊信息，方便查看每个角色的羁绊组合
target: You can view the Bond Info for assistants currently on the exhibition floor from the Venue Management screen, making it easier to see each character's Bond combo.

source: 可在會場管理介面查看當下場上助理的羈絆資訊，方便查看每個角色的羈絆組合
target: You can view the Bond Info for assistants currently on the exhibition floor from the Venue Management screen, making it easier to see each character's Bond combo.

target: Check the specific Character Empowerment effects in the Character Information Card.

source: 可在角色卡中，查看角色适合的推荐装备。
target: You can view the recommended equipment suitable for a character on the Character Card.

source: 可在角色卡中，查看角色適合的推薦裝備。
target: You can view the recommended equipment suitable for a character on the Character Card.

source: 可旋轉枘鑿六合上對應的區域，使枘鑿六合的實體方塊與兩側的薄板對應。
target: Rotate the corresponding area of the Hexanexus so that the physical block of the Hexanexus corresponds to the plates on both sides.

target: You can move to a domain adjacent to the current domain. At the same time, the domains to the left of the targeted domain will collapse and cannot be entered.

source: 台座を回転する
target: Turn the Base

source: 右スティックでカメラを回転させ、左スティックでカメラを移動できます。画面右下のリセットボタンを押すと、カメラをリセットできます。
target: Use the right joystick to rotate the camera. Use the left joystick to move the screen. Press the reset button in the bottom right corner to reset your camera.

source: 右下にあるスイッチボタンを使うことで、宝珠の光が切替できます。退出ボタンを押すと、宝珠の操作画面を閉じることができます。
target: Use the Switch button in the bottom-right corner to turn on or off the orb's light. Use the Quit button to exit the control interface of the orb.

source: 右側に向かって出勤していくキメラを数えましょう
target: Count the number of chimeras leaving the area via the right side to go to work.

source: 各ウェーブのすべての敵はHPを共有します。
target: All enemies in each wave have Shared HP.

source: 各エリアには「星軌の兎」のゲーム機が1台ずつ設置されています。ゲームのホーム画面では、番号、プレイヤー名、最高スコアを確認することができます。
target: There is a Star Rabbit Game Console in every area. The home page of the console will display its serial number, the player's nickname, and their best score.

source: 各キャラクターはそれぞれに「前衛」、「後衛」、「前後衛」という「ポジション」を持っています。 キャラクターが適切なポジションに配置されている時、「マネーウォーズ」専用の新しい能力——キャラ特別スキルが発動します！
target: Characters have their own "positioning", classified as either "On-Field", "Off-Field", and "On/Off-Field". When characters are in the correct position, you can gain a new ability exclusive to Currency Wars: Character Empowerment!

source: 各キャラクターはそれぞれに「前衛」、「後衛」というポジションを持っています。 一部のキャラクターは「前後衛」であり、前衛と後衛のどちらに配置しても能力を発揮できます。
target: Characters have their own "positioning", classified as either "On-Field" and "Off-Field". Some characters are "On/Off-Field", meaning they can be placed either on-field or off-field.

source: 各ステージで、応援している選手が優勝すると、今回の応援に消費されたお菓子と、該当選手の勝利配当に応じた一定数のお菓子が返還されます。
target: In each race segment, if the player's supported contestant wins the segment, snacks will be returned based on the amount of snacks spent on the support and the racer's victory bonus.

source: 各ターンの開始時に、戦術ポイントを2獲得できます。
target: Gains 2 Tactics Points at the start of each turn.

source: 各パートの準備開始時、自動的に1回ショップが更新されます。ショップではコインを使って必要なキャラクターを雇用できます。
target: The Store automatically refreshes 1 time at the start of the preparation phase for each Node. You can use Gold Coins to recruit desired Characters from the Store.

source: 各ライブでは、それぞれ対応する音楽スタイルのインスピレーションを集める必要があります。ノーマルモードの音楽チャレンジをクリアすると、インスピレーションを獲得できます。
target: Each performance needs to collect Inspiration of the corresponding music style. Pass the music challenge in Easy Mode to obtain inspiration

source: 各ラウンドの仕事を終えるとチーム編成画面に戻ります。その際、倒れなかったキメラの属性は継承され、疲れて倒れたキメラは次のラウンドの仕事に参加できなくなります。
target: After each round of work, you will return to the lineup interface. At this time, the previous round's surviving chimeras' stats will be carried forward, and chimeras that collapsed will not be able to enter the next round.

source: 各ラウンドの戦闘終了後、戦力が低いプレイヤーは固定ダメージを受けます。プレイヤーのHPが0になると瀕死状態になり、再びダメージを受けると脱落となります。
target: Player with the lower combat power after a round will take a set amount of DMG. When a player's HP becomes 0, they will enter the Near-Death state. Taking DMG again will result in defeat.

source: 各ラウンドの終了時点で目標戦力に達していないプレイヤーは脱落となります。各プレイヤーには試合中に1度だけ脱落を回避するチャンスがあります。
target: After each round, players with combat power below the target level will be eliminated. During the entire match, each player has only one chance to avoid elimination.

source: 各ラウンド開始時、プレイヤーは前のラウンドの最終フィールドを引き継ぎ、同時に新たなフィールドの効果を獲得します。
target: When the turn starts, the players will inherit the final field from the previous round, and all players will receive the same additional field effect.

source: 各レース終了後に観戦ポイントを獲得でき、レベルの高いアリーナほど、ポイントをより多く獲得できます。ポイントを集めることで、観戦報酬を獲得できます。
target: After each match, you'll earn Spectator Points. Higher-tier matches award more points, and you can claim Spectator Rewards by accumulating points.

source: 各世界と深い関わりを持つと、当地の人々から冒険クエストを受注し、さらにその世界を知ることができます。
target: After exploring certain areas in-depth, Adventure Missions can be received from people there, so you become more familiar with the different worlds.

source: 各創造物の培養器は初期状態で一定のエネルギーを有しており、このエネルギーを消費することで祝福を強化できます。
target: Each Workbench of Creation has a certain amount of initial Heat, which can be expended to enhance Blessings.

source: 各地に散らばった「マイリトルゴミー」の分身を見つけ出し、彼らと一緒に敵を撃退しましょう！
target: Find the clones of Litter Pony scattered all over and join hands toward defeating the enemies!

source: 各地に散在する書物、開拓者の皆様も是非閲覧してみましょう。各世界の人々の生活とかつて起こった色んな物語を知ることができるかもしれません…
target: You may find lots of readable items on your journey. Do spend some time reading them to learn about people's lives and the lore in different worlds.

source: 各対戦中、「アッハ」は3つの基本装備をランダムに所持し、「愉悦」の絆が3/4/5に達するごとに順次解放されていく。
target: In each match, Aha randomly carries 3 pieces of basic equipment, which are unlocked sequentially as the Elation Bond activates at 3/4/5 characters.

source: 各星ごとに、開拓者は4つのパーティを派遣し、4つのルートをそれぞれ攻略する必要があります。 パーティ内のキャラクターたちは自動で怪物と戦闘を行い、派遣終了後に戦闘レポートを1つ生成します。
target: On each planet, 4 teams must be dispatched simultaneously to tackle 4 separate routes. Characters in the team will automatically engage in combat with monsters and generate a combat report once the dispatch ends.

source: 各次元界は異なるタイプのエリアで構成されており、「？」をタップすることですべてのエリアのタイプを表示できます。
target: Every plane consists of different types of domains. Select the "?" button to view all domain types.

source: 各演算開始時に、仮面を1つ選んで被ることができます。選択後は変更できません。
target: At the start of each extrapolation, you can select one Mask to wear. Once selected, it cannot be changed.

source: 各章の上映前には内部試写をクリアする必要があります。それぞれの映画には異なる感情値目標が存在します。
target: Every chapter needs to pass Internal Screening before they are released, and different films have different Emotion Targets

source: 合成するたび、よりレア度の高い3つのランダムな奇物の中から1つを選んで獲得できます。最高で★3奇物を獲得できます。
target: Each synthesis allows you to select one out of three random Curios with higher quality. The highest-quality Curio that can be obtained is a 3-star one.

source: 合成するたびに、3個のコンポーネントから1個選択して獲得できます。
target: You can select 1 Component from 3 with every synthesis.

source: 合理安排施放概念礼装的顺序是制胜的关键！
target: Using your Conceptual Mystic Codes in the right order is the key to victory!

source: 合理安排發動概念禮裝的順序是制勝的關鍵！
target: Using your Conceptual Mystic Codes in the right order is the key to victory!

source: 合理搭配不同的武器組合以及配飾，可以獲得更強力的組合效果。
target: Make reasonable Weapon-Accessory combinations to obtain stronger combo effects.

source: 合理搭配不同的武器组合以及配饰，可以获得更强力的组合效果。
target: Make reasonable Weapon-Accessory combinations to obtain stronger combo effects.

source: 合理規劃魔力，解放聖劍的全力吧！
target: Manage your magical energy wisely, and unleash the holy sword's full power!

source: 合理规划魔力，解放圣剑的全力吧！
target: Manage your magical energy wisely, and unleash the holy sword's full power!

source: 合金メカヨロイ・パムキング
target: Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom

source: 合金机铠•帕姆王
target: Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom

source: 合金機鎧•帕姆王
target: Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom

source: 吉尔伽美什在回合内每额外抽取1张牌，可获得1张「王之财宝！」。
target: For every 1 extra card Gilgamesh draws during the turn, he gains 1 "Gate of Babylon!".

source: 吉爾伽美什在回合內每額外抽取1張牌，可獲得1張「王之財寶！」。
target: For every 1 extra card Gilgamesh draws during the turn, he gains 1 "Gate of Babylon!".

source: 同じ★ランクのキャラクターを3体集めると自動的にランクアップし、戦闘能力が大幅にアップします。 通常では★ランク3が、キャラクターの最強形態となります。
target: 3 characters of the same star rating can be automatically upgraded, greatly boosting their combat power. 3-star is typically a character's most powerful form.

source: 同じ★ランクのキャラクターを3体集めると自動的にランクアップし、戦闘能力が大幅にアップします。 通常では★ランク3が、キャラクターの最強形態となります。
target: 3 characters with identical star ratings can be automatically upgraded, greatly enhancing their combat powers. 3-star is typically a character's most powerful form.

source: 同じイベント限定祝福を重複して獲得すると、祝福を最大で9回まで強化できます。 イベント限定祝福を最高レベルまで強化して、「最終試練」に備えましょう。
target: Repeatedly obtain the same event-limited Blessings to enhance them for up to 9 times. Enhance event-limited Blessings to higher levels to prepare for the Final Trial.

source: 同じフルーツを4個以上繋げると、対応する爆弾を生成できます。
target: Match 4 or more identical fruits to generate a corresponding bomb.

source: 同じ創造物の培養器では、その培養器にいるルアン・メェイの創造物のすべての機能を使用できます。
target: In the same Workbench of Creation, you can use the functions of all of Ruan Mei's creations present on the workbench.

source: 同じ創造物を3回捕まえると、ケーキツミツミ配置モードが解放されます。
target: Capture the same creation 3 times to unlock the Stack-a-Cake placement mode.

source: 同じ創造物を6回捕まえると、にゃんこタワー配置モードが解放されます。
target: After capturing the same creation 6 times, you can unlock the Meow Meow Tower placement mode.

source: 同じ報告書を提出すると一括報告と見なされ、ポイント獲得効率が上がり、より高いパムポイントを獲得できます。
target: When submitting similar reports, you can create a report bundle, increase your score efficiency, and obtain higher scores from Pom-Pom.

source: 同じ絆に属するキャラクターを多く編成すると、絆のレベルが上がります。 絆のレベルが高いほど、効果も強力になります。
target: Deploying more characters with the same Bond will increase the Bond Level. The higher the Bond Level, the stronger the effect.

source: 同じ絆を持つキャラクターを雇用すると、パーティの戦闘力が大幅にアップします。
target: Recruiting characters with matching Bonds can greatly enhance your team's combat effectiveness.

source: 同じ絆を持つキャラクターを雇用すると、パーティの戦闘力が大幅にアップします。 絆登録機能を利用することで、ショップで目当ての絆を持つキャラクターを見つけやすくなります！
target: Recruiting staff members with the same Bond will greatly enhance your team's combat effectiveness. Master the Bond Tracking function to quickly find characters with desired Bonds in the Store!

source: 同じ色のフルーツを4個以上繋げると、対応する爆弾を生成できます。
target: Match more than 3 fruits of the same color to generate a corresponding bomb.

source: 同じ駒を購入すると、駒の経験値が上がります
target: When you purchase identical pieces, it increases the piece's EXP

source: 同一时间只有一种颜色生效。当配控装置的开关亮起，与其对应颜色的斥力桥就会出现。
target: Only one color can be turned on at any given time. When the switch on the control device lights up, the repulsion bridge of the same color will appear.

source: 同一時間只有一種顏色生效。當配控裝置的開關亮起，與其對應顏色的斥力橋就會出現。
target: Only one color can be turned on at any given time. When the switch on the control device lights up, the repulsion bridge of the same color will appear.

source: 同时，值日中的「晚餐会议」环节，可通过选取并提交值日报告，根据得到的帕姆评分额外获取「列车基金」。
target: At the same time, during the Dinner Meeting phase of every duty period, you can choose to submit the Duty Reports and additionally obtain Express Funds based on the score from Pom-Pom.

source: 同时，奇美拉会减少等同于工作消耗数量的体力。
target: At the same time, the chimeras will reduce their stamina by an amount equal to their Task Consumption.

source: 同時に、キメラは仕事をこなすのに必要な数の体力を消費します。
target: At the same time, the chimeras will reduce their stamina by an amount equal to their Task Consumption.

source: 同時，值日中的「晚餐會議」階段，可透過選取並交付值日報告，根據得到的帕姆評分額外獲得「列車基金」。
target: At the same time, during the Dinner Meeting phase of every duty period, you can choose to submit the Duty Reports and additionally obtain Express Funds based on the score from Pom-Pom.

source: 同時，奇美拉會減少等同於工作消耗數量的體力。
target: At the same time, the chimeras will reduce their stamina by an amount equal to their Task Consumption.

source: 名もなき初
target: Nameless Wispae

source: 名もなき初・ガイドの導き
target: Nameless Wispae: Guide's Direction

source: 后排目标
target: Back Row Target

source: 启动「筑梦遥眼」后将切换至筑梦师视角。在该视角下，原本被截断的、存在高低落差的道路会以不可思议的方式被连通。
target: Activating the Dream's Eye allows you to switch to the Dreamweaver's View. In this mode, disconnected paths or those with height discrepancies will be connected in an incredible way.

source: 吹き出しを獲得すると、チャットまたはメッセージ機能で使用できます。
target: After unlocking chat boxes, you can change them to in the Chat and Message functions.

source: 周期演算では毎週特別なコンテンツが更新されます。
target: Special gameplay content will be updated weekly in Cyclical Extrapolations.

source: 周期演算では追加の適合値報酬を獲得できますが、毎週上限が設けられています。
target: Play Cyclical Extrapolations to earn bonus Synchronicity Points rewards. Weekly rewards are capped.

source: 周期演算中每周都会更新特殊的玩法内容。
target: Special gameplay content will be updated weekly in Cyclical Extrapolations.

source: 味方1枠目のキャラは「ロックオン」状態の敵のみを攻撃可能。また、ターゲットに追加のダメージを与えます。
target: The ally character in position 1 can only designate enemy targets afflicted with "Aimed" as the attack target, and deals extra damage to them.

source: 味方が必殺技を使用すると「英雄、星々の如く輝きて」または「一緒に紡ぐ物語」をチャージできます。「英雄、星々の如く輝きて」や「一緒に紡ぐ物語」を発動すると「オンパロスの『憎悪』」を大幅にダウンさせることができます！
target: Ally targets can use Ultimate to charge "Heroes, Ever Ablaze" or "Epics, as We've Written," which greatly reduces "Amphorean Hatred"!

source: 味方が攻撃を受けた後、SPとその上限が減ります。
target: After any ally unit is attacked, reduce the number of Skill Points and Max Skill Points.

source: 味方が爆笑ネタを獲得した時、「銀狼LV.999」は「シークレットスコア」を獲得し、強化通常攻撃「ボーナスステージ『ウルフロードタイム』」の与ダメージがアップする。
target: When allies gain Punchline, "Hidden MMR" is accumulated for Silver Wolf LV.999, allowing her Enhanced Basic ATK "Bonus Stage: αWolf Instant" to deal higher DMG.

source: 味方が追加攻撃を発動し、15体の敵に命中するたびに、「燎原の烈火」を発動して敵全体を攻撃します。
target: When allies launch Follow-Up ATKs, for every 15 enemies hit, triggers "Raging Wildfire" to attack all enemies.

source: 味方が連続で行動した時、「ハイライトシーン」が上演され、大量の「白熱値」を獲得することができます。
target: After ally targets perform consecutive actions, triggers Highlights and gains a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 味方が連続で行動する回数が多いほど、獲得できる「白熱値」と味方の必殺技ダメージがアップします。 優先的に敵の召喚物を倒すことで敵の行動を妨害し、味方の連続行動を維持することができます。
target: The more consecutive actions allies take, the more Vibes gained, and allies' Ultimate DMG is increased. Prioritize defeating enemy summons to block enemy actions and maintain ally consecutive actions.

source: 味方には3の共有HPがあります。いずれかのカードのHPが0になった時、共有HPが1減り、その後そのカードのHPを1回復してバトルを続けます。
target: Allies have 3 Shared HP. When any card's HP drops to 0, 1 Shared HP will be consumed, then that card will be restored to 1 HP and continue battling.

source: 味方の2、3、4枠目のキャラが敵を攻撃すると、ターゲットを「ロックオン」状態にします。同時に1枠目のキャラの行動順が早まります。
target: When characters at positions 2, 3, or 4 in the team attack an enemy, the enemy enters the "Aimed" state, and advances the action of the character in position 1.

source: 味方のHPが減った時、「死へと誘う泡」を獲得します。「死へと誘う泡」が上限に達すると、「ボリュクス」の行動順が早まり、次の行動で「強化」状態に入ります。
target: When ally targets' HP is reduced, accumulates "Desperate Bubble." Upon reaching the limit, causes "Pollux" to advance its action and enter the "Enhanced" state in its next turn.

source: 味方の「白熱値」が上がると、相手の「白熱値」が下がります。 反対に、相手が行動すると、相手の「白熱値」が上がり、味方の「白熱値」が下がります。
target: When the team gains Vibes, the opponent side's Vibes get lowered. When the opponent acts, it will also raise their Vibes while lowering the team's Vibes.

source: 味方のキャラ単体が累計3回必殺技を発動すると、すぐに再度必殺技を発動することができます。
target: After a single ally has used their Ultimate for a total of 3 times, they will immediately activate their Ultimate again.

source: 味方のリトルゴミーが敵に攻撃を行う時、敵を即座に行動させ、敵に持続ダメージを与えます。
target: When allied minicans attack enemies, the enemy immediately takes action and suffers DoT.

source: 味方の撃破特効が高いほど、弱点撃破ダメージがアップする
target: The higher the character's Break Effect, the greater the Break DMG dealt becomes.

source: 味方は「まとわりつく恐怖」状態を付与された後、「まとわりつく恐怖」状態の付与者に攻撃を1回行うことで「まとわりつく恐怖」状態を解除できます。
target: When an ally is inflicted with Terror Grip, attacking the caster of Terror Grip once can dispel Terror Grip.

source: 味方をそれぞれ2つの戦場に分けて戦闘します。異なる戦場にいる味方と敵は、もう一方の戦場のターゲットを攻撃できません。
target: All ally targets are split between two battlefields. Ally and enemy targets cannot attack targets on a different battlefield.

source: 味方キャラがHPが0になる攻撃を受けた場合、戦闘不能状態に陥らず、HPを100%、EPを50%を回復します。
target: When allies receive killing blows, they will not be downed, but instead restore 100% HP and regenerate 50% Energy.

source: 味方キャラがHPを失うことで、「ハイライトシーン」が上演され、大量の「白熱値」を獲得することができます。
target: Have ally characters lose HP and trigger Highlights to gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 味方キャラが「幻惑」状態になると「一時離脱」し、「幻惑」状態で召喚されたユニットがそのキャラのステータスを引き継ぎ、代わりに戦闘を行います。
target: When an ally character enters the "Phantom Illusion" state, they will be "Departed". Units summoned during the "Phantom Illusion" state will fight in their place and inherit some of that character's stats.

source: 味方キャラが「魂魄石」から解放された時、味方全体が「魂の拷問」を1層獲得します。 「魂の拷問」1層につき、「魂の鞭打ち」のダメージ発生回数がアップします。
target: After an ally is freed from the Soulstone, all allies obtain 1 stack of Spiritual Torture. Every stack of Spiritual Torture can apply more instances of DMG for Spiritual Caning.

source: 味方キャラがカウンターを発動することで「ハイライトシーン」が上演され、大量の「白熱値」を獲得することができます。
target: Have ally characters launch Counters to attack enemies and trigger Highlights to gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 味方キャラが必殺技で敵を攻撃すると、敵の行動順を100%早め、攻撃力をダウンさせると共に、さまざまな持続ダメージ効果を付与できます。
target: After allies attack enemies with their Ultimates, enemy actions will be Advanced Forward by 100%, and they will deal less DMG and be inflicted with various DoT effects.

source: 味方キャラが必殺技または追加攻撃を発動すると、命中した敵の数に応じた層数の「星の光」を獲得でき、それにより全体のダメージアップ効果を引き上げられます。
target: After an ally character uses an Ultimate or launches a Follow-Up ATK, they gain corresponding "Starlight" stacks based on the number of targets hit, increasing the team's DMG boosting effect.

source: 味方キャラが必殺技を発動する時、「反響」回数を獲得し、召喚物の与ダメージがアップします。
target: When an ally character uses Ultimate, gains "Resonance" that boosts summons' DMG dealt.

source: 味方キャラが必殺技を発動する時、リトルゴミーが動力ポイントを1獲得します。 動力ポイントが最大値に達する時、さらにリトルゴミーを4体召喚し、リトルゴミーが自爆アタックを発動します。
target: When allies use their Ultimates, grants 1 Kinetic Point to minicans. When Kinetic Points are at max, summons 4 additional minicans and immediately launches Self-Destructive Impacts.

source: 味方キャラが戦闘スキルを発動した後、SPを回復し、最大SPと与ダメージがアップします。
target: After an ally character uses a Skill, they recover Skill Points, increase Max Skill Points, and increase DMG.

source: 味方キャラが治癒を受ける時、HP回復量がHP減少量に変換されます。
target: When an ally character receives healing, the HP restored is converted into HP lost instead.

source: 味方キャラが獲得するKPIは累積することができます。また、KPIは味方が与える必殺技ダメージをアップさせます。 味方単体が合計で3つのKPIを獲得した時、行動順が100%早まります。
target: The Performance Points that the team obtains can be stacked, which increases the team's Ultimate DMG dealt. When a single ally has gained a total of 3 Performance Points, their action is immediately advanced 100%.

source: 味方キャラが行動するたびに「ギフトボックス」の行動順が早まり、加速度的に「ギフトボックス」のバフを獲得できます。
target: Every time allies take action, they will Advance the Giftbox's action Forward to receive the Giftbox buff more quickly.

source: 味方キャラのHPが増加、または減少した時、「戦意値」を累積できます。
target: Grit Value accumulates when allies' HP increases or decreases.

source: 味方キャラはHPが0になる攻撃を受けても戦闘不能状態にならず、即座に復活し、行動順が早まります。
target: When an ally character takes fatal damage, they will not be downed but will instead immediately revive and advance their action.

target: During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," every 1500 of HP increase or decrease grants 1 stack of buffs, up to 99 stacks.

target: You can view the current Communing Trail points for each Path in the Audience Chamber. Every Path will bring different buffs

source: 在「贊達爾」切換到【論證形態】時，消滅敵方目標或使我方憶靈消失可以加速「贊達爾」的形態切換，並降低威脅。
target: When Zandar switches to "Disputation Mode," defeating enemy targets or ally memosprites disappearing will accelerate Zandar's mode switching and reduce threat.

source: 在「货币战争」中招募角色时： 若你已拥有该角色，则继承你的角色的养成数据。 若你未拥有该角色，则可招募到其对应的试用角色进行游玩。
target: When recruiting characters in "Currency Wars": If you already own the character, you will inherit your character's build data. If you don't own the character, you can recruit a trial version of the character to play with.

source: 在「货币战争」中，逐步招募你的团队，组成8-10人队伍进行战斗，击败对手！
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8-10 members, and defeat your opponents!

source: 在「货币战争」中，逐步招募你的团队，组成8-10人队伍进行战斗，击败竞争对手。
target: In Currency Wars, gradually recruit your team, form a team of 8–10 members, and defeat your competitors.

source: 在「赞达尔」切换到【演化形态】时，敌方目标从场上生成或召唤我方忆灵可以加速「赞达尔」的形态切换。
target: When Zandar switches to "Evolution Mode," enemy targets appearing on the battlefield or ally memosprites being summoned can accelerate Zandar's mode-switching.

source: 在「赞达尔」切换到【论证形态】时，消灭敌方目标或使我方忆灵消失可以加速「赞达尔」的形态切换，并降低威胁。
target: When Zandar switches to "Disputation Mode," defeating enemy targets or ally memosprites disappearing will accelerate Zandar's mode switching and reduce threat.

source: 在「超頻博弈」中，每個節點開始時，將自動獲得更多經驗值與金幣，但不再獲得利息。
target: In Overclock Gambit mode, at the start of each Node, you'll automatically gain more Experience and Gold Coins, but no longer receive Interest.

source: 在「超频博弈」中，每个节点开始时，将自动获得更多经验与金币，但不再获得利息。
target: In Overclock Gambit mode, at the start of each Node, you'll automatically gain more Experience and Gold Coins, but no longer receive Interest.

source: 在「过量转化」挑战中被敌方击败，仍然视为战斗胜利，并根据转化数据进行结算。
target: If you are defeated by the enemy during the Excessive Conversion challenge, you will still be regarded as having won the battle and your data will be finalized based on Conversion Data.

source: 在「过量转化」挑战中，削减敌方生命值可以获得转化数据。
target: During Excessive Conversion, reduce the enemy's HP to obtain Conversion Data.

source: 在「过量转化」挑战中，达成前两个波次的挑战目标可获取战利品宝箱。达成目标越多，奖励越丰厚。
target: In Excessive Conversion Challenge, complete the challenge goals of the first two waves to obtain treasure chests. The more challenge goals you complete, the better the rewards.

source: 在「過量轉化」挑戰中被敵方擊敗，仍然視為戰鬥勝利，並根據轉化資料進行結算。
target: If you are defeated by the enemy during the Excessive Conversion challenge, you will still be regarded as having won the battle and your data will be finalized based on Conversion Data.

source: 在「過量轉化」挑戰中，削減敵方生命值可以獲得轉化資料。
target: During Excessive Conversion, reduce the enemy's HP to obtain Conversion Data.

source: 在「過量轉化」挑戰中，達成前兩個波的挑戰目標可獲得戰利品寶箱。達成目標越多，獎勵越豐厚。
target: In Excessive Conversion Challenge, complete the challenge goals of the first two waves to obtain treasure chests. The more challenge goals you complete, the better the rewards.

source: 在「銀河大富翁」中，需要擲骰子在地圖中前進。開拓者可在多種玩法中取得開拓券。
target: In Cosmodyssey, you need to roll dice to advance on the map. Trailblazers can obtain Trailblaze Funds through a variety of game modes.

source: 在「银河强手棋」中，需要投掷骰子在地图中前进。开拓者可在多种玩法中获取开拓券。
target: In Cosmodyssey, you need to roll dice to advance on the map. Trailblazers can obtain Trailblaze Funds through a variety of game modes.

source: 在「驚夢電視台」活動中，共有5處訊號被劫持的電視螢幕，找到對應螢幕，進入戰鬥並擊敗幕後黑手。
target: In the Dreamjolt TV event, a total of 5 TV screens have been hacked. Locate the screens and fight the culprits to foil the mastermind's plan.

source: 在「黃金與機械」中，每種「自訂骰」都有不同的被動效果，滿足被動效果的要求時，會根據所選的命途，提供不同效果的增益。
target: In Gold and Gears, Custom Dice have different Passive abilities. Every time you fulfill the die's passive ability requirements, different bonuses will be provided based on the chosen Path.

source: 在「黄金与机械」中，每种「自定义骰」都有不同的被动效果，满足被动效果的要求时，会根据所选的命途，提供不同效果的增益。
target: In Gold and Gears, Custom Dice have different Passive abilities. Every time you fulfill the die's passive ability requirements, different bonuses will be provided based on the chosen Path.

source: 在【命路歧图】页面下，你可以查看当前正在进行的任务或已完成的任务分别属于哪一角色视角。
target: You can check the Fate's Atlas interface to see which characters' POV an ongoing mission or completed mission is in.

source: 在【命路歧图】页面下，正在进行中的视角将以【当前视角】标注。若对应视角下有正在进行中的任务，则会标注对应的任务类型。
target: On the Fate's Atlas page, the ongoing POV will be labeled as "Current POV." If there are ongoing missions in this POV, then their mission types will be labeled.

source: 在【命路歧圖】頁面下，你可以查看目前正在進行的任務或已完成的任務分別屬於哪一角色視角。
target: You can check the Fate's Atlas interface to see which characters' POV an ongoing mission or completed mission is in.

source: 在【命路歧圖】頁面下，正在進行中的視角將以【目前視角】標注。若對應視角下有正在進行中的任務，則會標註對應的任務類型。
target: On the Fate's Atlas page, the ongoing POV will be labeled as "Current POV." If there are ongoing missions in this POV, then their mission types will be labeled.

source: 在不同的应用场景中，机巧鸟能够做到的事情也有不同。
target: Cycranes can be used in different scenarios to accomplish various tasks.

source: 在不同的應用場景中，機巧鳥能夠做到的事情也有不同。
target: Cycranes can be used in different scenarios to accomplish various tasks.

source: 在乙太戰線中完成各種任務，可提升決勝者評價，獲得獎勵
target: Complete various missions in Aetherium Wars to raise your Victory Rating and unlock rewards

source: 在以太战线中完成各种任务，可提升决胜者评级，获得奖励
target: Complete various missions in Aetherium Wars to raise your Victory Rating and unlock rewards

source: 在以太战线中，敌我双方操作以太灵进行对战
target: In Aetherium Wars, you and your opponent will engage in battle using Aether Spirits

source: 在你的談判回合中，可以使用「談判策略」來施展不同的談判技巧，幫助你達成談判成功。
target: During your negotiation turn, you can use "Negotiation Strategies" to apply various negotiation techniques to help you succeed.

source: 在你的谈判回合中，可以使用「谈判策略」来施展不同的谈判技巧，帮助你达成谈判成功。
target: During your negotiation turn, you can use "Negotiation Strategies" to apply various negotiation techniques to help you succeed.

source: 在倒數計時歸零前消滅所有敵人，則戰鬥勝利，並累積一次連勝計數。 獲得越多連勝，將獲得越多金幣獎勵。
target: Defeat all enemies before the countdown hits zero to win the battle and add to your winning streak. The longer your winning streak, the more Gold Coins you'll earn as rewards.

source: 在倒计时归零前消灭所有敌人，则战斗胜利，并积累一次连胜计数。 获得更多连胜时，将获得更多金币奖励。
target: Defeat all enemies before the countdown hits zero to win the battle and add to your winning streak. The longer your winning streak, the more Gold Coins you'll earn as rewards.

source: 在值日过程中，将会遇到「普通」、「稀有」和「特殊」三种「行动卡」。「稀有行动卡」可以获得更多值日经验与列车基金；「特殊行动卡」会提供各种特殊效果。
target: During the duty periods, you will encounter three types of Action Cards: "Normal," "Rare," and "Special." Rare Action Cards grant more Duty Experience and Express Funds, while Special Action Cards provide various special effects.

source: 在值日過程中，將會遇到「普通」、「稀有」和「特殊」三種「行動卡」。「稀有行動卡」可以獲得更多值日經驗與列車基金；「特殊行動卡」會提供各種特殊效果。
target: During the duty periods, you will encounter three types of Action Cards: "Normal," "Rare," and "Special." Rare Action Cards grant more Duty Experience and Express Funds, while Special Action Cards provide various special effects.

source: 在冒险中会结识新的伙伴，通过完成特定任务，可以邀请伙伴登上列车。
target: Completing certain missions allows you to invite companions that you meet in your journey onto the Astral Express.

source: 在冒险中还有游荡的敌人，它们扮演着石头老板的爪牙。「哈努视野」可以看到它们的目光，请小心避开他们的目光，如果被它们攻击则会面临失败！
target: There are still wandering enemies in the adventure. They are playing the role of Boss Stone's lackeys. Hanu Vision can see their fields of vision. Please avoid their sight, as you will fail if they attack you!

source: 在冒险中遇到的敌人，通常有多个属性的弱点。使用和弱点相同属性的攻击进入战斗，可以削减具有该弱点的敌方目标的韧性。
target: During your adventures, you will encounter enemies with multiple Weaknesses. Entering combat using attacks that match these Weaknesses can reduce the Toughness of enemies who have these Weaknesses.

source: 在冒險中會結識新的夥伴。完成特定任務便可邀請夥伴登上列車。
target: Completing certain missions allows you to invite companions that you meet in your journey onto the Astral Express.

source: 在冒險中會遇到各式各樣的敵方目標，它們都有各自的弱點。利用和敵人弱點相同的屬性發動攻擊能夠削減敵方目標的韌性。
target: You will encounter all kinds of enemies during your adventure. Each of them has Weaknesses that can be exploited to reduce their Toughness by using attacks of the same Type.

source: 在冒險中遇到的敵人，通常會有多個屬性的弱點。使用和弱點相同屬性的攻擊進入戰鬥，可以削減具有該弱點的敵方目標的韌性。
target: During your adventures, you will encounter enemies with multiple Weaknesses. Entering combat using attacks that match these Weaknesses can reduce the Toughness of enemies who have these Weaknesses.

source: 在冒險中還有遊蕩的敵人，它們扮演著石頭老闆的爪牙。「哈努視野」可以看到它們的目光，請小心避開他們的目光，如果被它們攻擊便會面臨失敗！
target: There are still wandering enemies in the adventure. They are playing the role of Boss Stone's lackeys. Hanu Vision can see their fields of vision. Please avoid their sight, as you will fail if they attack you!

source: 在决战中，你的队伍将挑战难度最高的工作！
target: In the final battle, your squad will challenge the most difficult task!

source: 在加班模式中，你的队伍需要完成多轮工作。
target: In Overtime Mode, your squad needs to complete multiple rounds of tasks.

source: 在加班模式中，你的隊伍需要完成多輪工作。
target: In Overtime Mode, your squad needs to complete multiple rounds of tasks.

source: 在匹諾康尼之夢中，偶爾會發現故障的夢境迷鐘，與之互動可以進入其心境空間，修復這些可憐的傢伙。
target: Occasionally, you may find malfunctioning Dream Tickers in Penacony. Interacting with them allows you to enter their Emoscape and repair these poor guys.

source: 在匹諾康尼之夢中，舉著「築夢拼圖」的拼圖紳士會出沒於世界各處。完成拼圖可使其中的事物在世界中顯現。
target: Puzzle Gentleman holding Dream Jigsaws may appear anywhere in Penacony. Completing the jigsaw puzzle will make the object within it appear in the Dreamscape.

source: 在匹诺康尼之梦中，举着「筑梦拼图」的拼图绅士出没于世界各处。完成拼图可使其中的事物在世界中显现。
target: Puzzle Gentleman holding Dream Jigsaws may appear anywhere in Penacony. Completing the jigsaw puzzle will make the object within it appear in the Dreamscape.

source: 在匹诺康尼之梦中，偶尔会发现故障的梦境迷钟，与之交互可以进入其心境空间，修复这些可怜的家伙。
target: Occasionally, you may find malfunctioning Dream Tickers in Penacony. Interacting with them allows you to enter their Emoscape and repair these poor guys.

source: 在双人对战中，交换2个超级炸弹触发组合消除时，也将获得额外步数。
target: In a Duo Duel, you can also obtain extra moves when triggering a combo elimination via Swapping 2 Super Bombs.

source: 在双人对战中，双方在同一场地上轮流行动。每回合双方各能行动2步，4个回合后战力更高的一方获得胜利。
target: In a Duo Duel, the two sides take turns acting on the same field. Each side can act 2 moves per turn. After 4 turns, the side with more combat power will win.

source: 在双人对战中，将4个或以上相同的水果相连生成炸弹时，将获得额外步数。
target: In a Duo Duel, when 4 or more identical fruits are connected to generate a bomb, you will gain extra moves.

source: 在双人对战中，玩家将与对手在同一场地上进行对战。
target: In a Duo Duel, the player and their opponent fights on the same field.

source: 在同一造物调试台中，可以使用处于该调试台上的所有阮梅造物的功能。
target: In the same Workbench of Creation, you can use the functions of all of Ruan Mei's creations present on the workbench.

source: 在同一造物除錯台中，可以使用處於該除錯台上的所有阮•梅造物的功能。
target: In the same Workbench of Creation, you can use the functions of all of Ruan Mei's creations present on the workbench.

source: 在后续挑战中，可以在第二位面的【首领】区域选择「回响推演」所模拟的「命途回响」效果。
target: During later challenges, you can select Path Resonance effects as simulated by Resonance Extrapolation from the boss domain in the Second Plane.

source: 在员工培训中，可以招募到更多妖精员工
target: During staff training, you can recruit more fairy staff members

source: 在命运之路上，被过去束缚是很悲惨的……不可以接近黑暗版的自己。
target: While on the road of destiny, it is a tragic thing to be tethered by the past... Do not approach the Enshadowed Version of You.

source: 在命運之路上，被過去束縛是很悲慘的……不可以接近黑暗版的自己。
target: While on the road of destiny, it is a tragic thing to be tethered by the past... Do not approach the Enshadowed Version of You.

source: 在員工培訓中，可以召募到更多妖精員工
target: During staff training, you can recruit more fairy staff members

source: 在场景中偶尔会发现一些离散的梦泡，由于没有和可供通行的平台相接，这些梦泡无法聚合成为梦泡桥梁。
target: You will occasionally discover some scattered dream bubbles in the map. Due to them being unconnected to passable platforms, these dream bubbles cannot form Bubble Bridges.

source: 在場景中偶爾會發現一些離散的夢泡，由於沒有和可供通行的平台相接，因此這些夢泡無法聚合成為夢泡橋樑。
target: You will occasionally discover some scattered dream bubbles in the map. Due to them being unconnected to passable platforms, these dream bubbles cannot form Bubble Bridges.

source: 在复行模式下可以在任意协议等级下挑战，但不会影响积分
target: In Retrace Mode, you can start a challenge under any protocol level, but your points will not be affected

source: 在多人乱斗中，每场共有6名玩家参与对战。每回合开始时，玩家将从剩余对手中抽取一名进行对战。
target: In Battle Royale mode, every battle will have 6 participating players. Players will draw one from remaining opponents in each turn to battle against.

source: 在多人乱斗中，每轮对战后战力更低的玩家将受到固定伤害。当玩家血量为0时，将进入濒死状态，再次受到伤害则会被淘汰。
target: In Battle Royale, the player with the lower combat power after a round will take a set amount of DMG. When a player's HP becomes 0, they will enter the Near-Death state. Taking DMG again will result in defeat.

source: 在多人亂鬥中，每場共有6名玩家參與對戰。每回合開始時，玩家將從所剩對手中抽取一名進行對戰。
target: In Battle Royale mode, every battle will have 6 participating players. Players will draw one from remaining opponents in each turn to battle against.

source: 在多人亂鬥中，每輪對戰後戰力更低的玩家將受到固定傷害。當玩家生命值為0時，將進入瀕死狀態，再次受到傷害則會被淘汰。
target: In Battle Royale, the player with the lower combat power after a round will take a set amount of DMG. When a player's HP becomes 0, they will enter the Near-Death state. Taking DMG again will result in defeat.

source: 在好友挑战中，玩家可以挑战对方的防守阵容。防守阵容可以在活动主界面进行设置。
target: In Friendly Challenges, players can challenge their opponent's Defense Lineup. The Defense Lineup can be set up in the main event interface.

source: 在好友挑戰中，玩家可以挑戰對方的防守陣容。防守陣容可以在活動主介面進行設定。
target: In Friendly Challenges, players can challenge their opponent's Defense Lineup. The Defense Lineup can be set up in the main event interface.

source: 在完成活动「宇宙家装指南」后，开拓者在星穹列车的「派对车厢」二楼会拥有自己的房间。
target: After completing the "Cosmic Home Décor Guide" event, Trailblazers will have their own room on the second floor of the Party Car of the Astral Express.

source: 在完成活動「宇宙家裝指南」後，開拓者在星穹列車的「派對車廂」二樓會擁有自己的房間。
target: After completing the "Cosmic Home Décor Guide" event, Trailblazers will have their own room on the second floor of the Party Car of the Astral Express.

source: 在完成第五份工作后，如果队伍中的奇美拉依然拥有充足的体力和效率，就会触发额外委托。
target: After completing the fifth task, if the chimeras in the squad still have sufficient stamina and efficiency, extra assignments will be triggered.

source: 在完成第五份工作後，如果隊伍中的奇美拉依然擁有充足的體力和效率，就會觸發額外委託。
target: After completing the fifth task, if the chimeras in the squad still have sufficient stamina and efficiency, extra assignments will be triggered.

source: 在对局中击败对手时，可以获得「战力币」和「战力粉尘」作为奖励。而在与魔古拉帮的作战中，还可以额外获得特别的「决胜战力币」。
target: Defeat opponents in matches to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards. When fighting against the Mogura Gang, you can also obtain special "Victorious Power Tokens" as an extra bonus.

source: 在对局中，攻略系统将根据你拥有的角色阵容自动推荐适合的攻略。 使用应用攻略功能，可快速在商店中找到想要的攻略推荐角色！
target: During the match, the strategy system will automatically recommend suitable strategies based on the character lineups you have unlocked. Use the Apply Strategy feature to quickly find the characters recommended by the strategy in the Store!

source: 在将宝珠的光芒照向指定地点之后，尝试使用奇迹典籍穿梭时空，或许会有新的发现。
target: After shining the orb's light to a specific location, try to traverse the space-time via the Tome of Miracles. There might be new discoveries to be found.

source: 在將寶珠的光芒照向指定地點之後，嘗試使用奇跡典籍穿梭時空，或許會有新的發現。
target: After shining the orb's light to a specific location, try to traverse the space-time via the Tome of Miracles. There might be new discoveries to be found.

source: 在對局中擊敗對手時，可以獲得「戰力幣」和「戰力粉塵」作為獎勵。而在與魔古拉幫的作戰中，還可以額外獲得特別的「決勝戰力幣」。
target: Defeat opponents in matches to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards. When fighting against the Mogura Gang, you can also obtain special "Victorious Power Tokens" as an extra bonus.

source: 在對局中，攻略系統將根據你擁有的角色陣容自動推薦適合的攻略。 使用應用攻略功能，可快速在商店中找到想要的攻略推薦角色！
target: During the match, the strategy system will automatically recommend suitable strategies based on the character lineups you have unlocked. Use the Apply Strategy feature to quickly find the characters recommended by the strategy in the Store!

source: 在差分宇宙中战斗时，可以获得造成伤害提高和受到伤害降低的效果。效果会随着面具等级提高而增强。
target: When battling in the Divergent Universe, you can gain increased DMG dealt and reduced DMG taken. These effects will be enhanced as the Mask level increases.

source: 在差分宇宙中戰鬥時，可以獲得造成傷害提高和承受傷害降低的效果。效果會隨著面具等級提高而增強。
target: When battling in the Divergent Universe, you can gain increased DMG dealt and reduced DMG taken. These effects will be enhanced as the Mask level increases.

source: 在差分宇宙中，可以通过选择金血祝颂强化自己的战斗效果。
target: In the Divergent Universe, you can enhance your combat effectiveness by selecting Golden Blood's Boons.

source: 在差分宇宙中，可以選擇金血祝頌強化自己的戰鬥效果。
target: In the Divergent Universe, you can enhance your combat effectiveness by selecting Golden Blood's Boons.

source: 在幻障迷境中难以追上逃跑的白露，只能引导白露逃进藏月瓠的阵法之中。
target: It would be difficult to catch up to Bailu as she flees in the Illusory Maze. We can only drive Bailu to run into the Lunaumbra Gourd's matrix.

target: It would be difficult to catch up to Bailu as she flees in the Illusory Maze. We can only drive Bailu to run into the Lunaumbra Gourd's matrix.

source: 在後續挑戰中，可以在第二次元的【頭目】區域選擇「迴響推演」所模擬的「命途迴響」效果。
target: During later challenges, you can select Path Resonance effects as simulated by Resonance Extrapolation from the boss domain in the Second Plane.

source: 在復行模式下可以在任意協議等級下挑戰，但不會影響積分
target: In Retrace Mode, you can start a challenge under any protocol level, but your points will not be affected

source: 在战斗、遭遇、首领节点获得胜利时，小队生命值维持不变。 若未获得胜利，则会失去一定小队生命值。 小队生命值降低至0时，对局失败。
target: When you achieve victory at Battle, Encounter, or Boss Nodes, the squad HP remains unchanged. If you do not achieve victory, you will lose a certain amount of squad HP. The match is lost if the squad HP drops to 0.

source: 在战斗中积累「战意值」，可提升「战意阶段」。 进入「战意阶段4：力量觉醒」阶段时，可获取强大的关卡增益，显著提升作战效率。
target: Accumulating Grit Value during battle can elevate your Grit Phase. When entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken", you can obtain powerful stage buffs and significantly improve your combat effectiveness.

source: 在战斗中，「阿哈」基于自身速度行动，以触发阿哈时刻。 施放欢愉技时，阿哈作为攻击者共同攻击敌人，因此攻击类属性和装备效果会在欢愉技中生效。
target: In combat, Aha takes action based on THEIR own SPD to trigger Aha Instants. When Elation Skills are used, Aha joins in as an attacker to strike enemies together, so offensive stats and equipment effects will take effect in Elation Skills.

source: 在战斗中，每次击败敌人都会提升「战意值」。 每期故事均设有独特的「战意机制」，触发「战意机制」可积累大量「战意值」，加速进入「战意汹涌」阶段。
target: Every time an enemy is defeated in combat, Grit Value will be accumulated. Every period will have unique Grit Mechanics, and triggering them will greatly accumulate Grit Value, quickening the entry to the Surging Grit phase.

source: 在战斗中，消灭扑满可获得更高的分数。
target: Defeating a Trotter during battle will award even higher points.

source: 在战斗中，角色的每次行动都会积累「战意值」。 每个关卡均设有独特的「战意机制」，触发「战意机制」可大幅增加「战意值」，迅速提升「战意阶段」。
target: Every time a character takes action in combat, Grit Value will be accumulated. Every stage will have unique Grit Mechanics, and triggering them will greatly increase Grit Value, thus allowing you to quickly elevate your Grit Phase.

source: 在战斗中，非首领敌人被击败后会不断补充。 存在此标记的非首领敌人被击败时，会对首领敌人造成伤害。当首领敌人被击败后，可完成该波次。
target: During battle, non-Boss enemies will continuously replenish after being defeated. When non-Boss enemies with this mark are defeated, it will deal DMG to the Boss enemy. When Boss enemies are defeated, the wave is considered complete.

source: 在战斗内，部分角色在满足条件时，会自动触发的1次额外的攻击，称为追加攻击。反击也属于追加攻击的范畴。
target: During combat, some characters will automatically trigger an additional attack, known as Follow-Up ATK, when certain conditions are met. Counters are also considered a type of Follow-Up ATK.

source: 在战斗内，部分角色在满足条件时，会获得额外回合。额外回合不消耗回合数，且在此回合中无法插入施放终结技。
target: During combat, some characters will receive an extra turn when certain conditions are met. This extra turn does not consume any turn counts, and Ultimates cannot be used during this extra turn.

source: 在战斗开始时，敌人处于弱点锁定状态。
target: At the start of the battle, enemies are in the Weaknessproof State.

source: 在战斗的过程中，扑满会因为迷路而误入其中。在扑满逃跑之前击败它，可以获得额外的敌方其他目标掉落材料。

target: The required objectives are listed in the top left corner of the photoshoot interface.

source: 在拓星模式下，只能进入与星阶相匹配的协议等级，成功通关后可以点亮智瞳。若未能成功结算，则会熄灭智瞳。
target: In Star-Pioneer Mode, you can only enter the protocol level matching your Astronomical Division. You will light Cognoculi after passing stages and will extinguish Cognoculi if you do not successfully finalize.

target: In Star-Pioneer Mode, you can only enter the protocol level matching your Astronomical Division. You will light Cognoculi after passing stages and will extinguish Cognoculi if you do not successfully finalize.

source: 在挑战赛中，玩家可以与熟悉的奇美拉训练家或是其余好友进行对战。
target: In the Challenge Match, players can battle against familiar chimera trainers or other friends.

source: 在挑戰賽中，玩家可以與熟悉的奇美拉訓練家或是其餘好友進行對戰。

source: 在探索中，可以通过许多方式获得「乐园纪念币」，也就是人们俗称的愿宝，诸如完成开拓任务、冒险任务、世界任务、开启世界中的战利品等等。
target: While exploring, you can obtain Arcadian Tokens (or as folks like to call them, Wishbae) in multiple ways, like completing Trailblaze Missions, Adventure Missions, world missions, opening treasures around the world, and more.

source: 在探索中，可以通過許多方式獲得「樂園紀念幣」，也就是人們俗稱的願寶，諸如完成開拓任務、冒險任務、世界任務、開啟世界中的戰利品等等。
target: While exploring, you can obtain Arcadian Tokens (or as folks like to call them, Wishbae) in multiple ways, like completing Trailblaze Missions, Adventure Missions, world missions, opening treasures around the world, and more.

source: 在探索中，有时可以发现金色的记忆尘影，代表目标位于另一个时空的此处。
target: You may discover Golden Memory Dust when exploring, indicating that the target is located here in the other space-time.

source: 在探索中，有時可以發現金色的記憶塵影，代表目標位於另一個時空的此處。
target: You may discover Golden Memory Dust when exploring, indicating that the target is located here in the other space-time.

source: 在探索中，黃泉發動秘技命中普通敵人時，會立即將其消滅，不會進入戰鬥。未命中敵人時不消耗秘技點。
target: During exploration, using Acheron's Technique to hit normal enemies will instantly defeat them without entering combat. When the Technique does not hit an enemy, no Technique Points are consumed.

source: 在探索中，黄泉施放秘技击中普通敌人时，会立即将其消灭，不会进入战斗。未击中敌人时不消耗秘技点。
target: During exploration, using Acheron's Technique to hit normal enemies will instantly defeat them without entering combat. When the Technique does not hit an enemy, no Technique Points are consumed.

source: 在探索的过程中，会遇到各式各样的玩法，这些玩法会被收录到常时传略中，以便快速检索和体验。
target: You will encounter different kinds of gameplay as you explore. These gameplays will be recorded in Conventional Memoir for faster review and access.

source: 在探索的過程中，會遇到各式各樣的玩法。這些玩法會收錄在常時傳略中，以供快速檢索和體驗。
target: You will encounter different kinds of gameplay as you explore. These gameplays will be recorded in Conventional Memoir for faster review and access.

source: 在撲滿逃跑前，消滅撲滿，上演「經典時刻」，獲得大量「氣氛值」。
target: Defeat the Trotter before it escapes and trigger Highlights to obtain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 在敌人行动后，我方角色立即施放终结技攻击敌人，敌人将立即再次行动并受到持续伤害效果。
target: After an enemy takes action, allies instantly use Ultimates to attack the enemy. The enemy then immediately takes action and receives a DoT effect.

source: 在敵人行動後，我方角色立即施放終結技攻擊敵人，敵人將立即再次行動並受到持續傷害效果。
target: After an enemy takes action, allies instantly use Ultimates to attack the enemy. The enemy then immediately takes action and receives a DoT effect.

source: 在星啟模式中完成第4關且獲得10200分，即可獲得稜彩星和額外的新獎勵。 累積獲得12星和稜彩星還可以獲得本期末日幻影限時完成勳章。
target: Clear Difficulty 4 in Starward Mode and score 10200 points to obtain a Prismatic Star and additional new rewards. Collect a total of 12 Stars and the Prismatic Star to obtain this period's Apocalyptic Shadow Limited-Time Clearance Medal.

source: 在星啟模式中完成第4關且獲得99000分，即可獲得稜彩星和額外的新獎勵。 累積獲得12星和稜彩星還可以獲得本期虛構敘事限時完成勳章。
target: Clear Stage 4 in Starward Mode and score 99000 points to obtain a Prismatic Star and additional new rewards. Collect a total of 12 stars and the Prismatic Star to obtain this period's Pure Fiction Limited-Time Clearance Medal.

source: 在晚餐会议中，可获取「建造蓝图」和「装饰」。「建造蓝图」可解锁区域内的装修项目；「装饰」可在家居定制中布设在房间的不同位置。
target: You can obtain Construction Blueprints and Decorations during Dinner Meeting. Construction Blueprints can unlock renovation projects in the area, and Decorations can be placed in different areas across the room based on your choice.

source: 在晚餐會議中，可獲得「設計圖」和「裝飾」。「設計圖」可解鎖區域內的裝潢計畫；「裝飾」可在家居訂製中佈設在房間的不同位置。
target: You can obtain Construction Blueprints and Decorations during Dinner Meeting. Construction Blueprints can unlock renovation projects in the area, and Decorations can be placed in different areas across the room based on your choice.

source: 在有限的重整思緒與交付彙報次數內，儘可能提高帕姆評分，換取更多列車基金吧！
target: Get as high of a score as you can from Pom-Pom within the limited number of "Mental Reset" and "Submit Report" attempts. Do your best to earn Express Funds!

source: 在有限的重整思路与提交汇报次数内，尽可能提高帕姆评分，换取更多列车基金吧！
target: Get as high of a score as you can from Pom-Pom within the limited number of "Mental Reset" and "Submit Report" attempts. Do your best to earn Express Funds!

source: 在有限輪數內擊敗儘可能多的敵人，努力提升隊伍等級。 隊伍等級提升後，可以從隨機出現的武器或配飾中進行一次選擇。
target: Defeat as many enemies as possible to raise your team's level within the allotted Cycles. After your Team Level goes up, you'll be able to choose one of the randomly drawn weapons or Accessories.

source: 在有限轮次内击败尽可能多的敌人，努力提升队伍等级。 队伍等级提升后，可以从随机出现的武器或配饰中进行一次选择。
target: Defeat as many enemies as possible to raise your team's level within the allotted Cycles. After your Team Level goes up, you'll be able to choose one of the randomly drawn weapons or Accessories.

source: 在本关内消灭扑满，可积累大量「战意值」。 需要在扑满逃跑前尽快消灭扑满。
target: Defeat the Trotters in this stage to obtain a large amount of Grit Value. You need to defeat the Trotter before it escapes.

source: 在本試煉中，角色將身處黑暗籠罩的區域，區域內外位於不同時空。角色穿越光暗區域的邊界時，會傳送至對側的黑暗區域。
target: This trial takes place in an area shrouded in darkness, with different space-time inside and outside the area. When a character crosses the boundary between lit and dark areas, they will teleport to the dark area on the opposite side.

source: 在本關內消滅撲滿，可累積大量「戰意值」。 需要在撲滿逃跑前儘快消滅撲滿。
target: Defeat the Trotters in this stage to obtain a large amount of Grit Value. You need to defeat the Trotter before it escapes.

source: 在标准博弈中，可自由选择想要挑战的职级难度。 职级越高，挑战难度越高，奖励也越丰厚。
target: In Standard Gambit, you can freely select the rank difficulty you wish to challenge. The higher the rank, the greater the challenge and the more luxurious the rewards.

source: 在標準博弈中，可自由選擇想要挑戰的職級難度。 職級越高，挑戰難度越高，獎勵也越豐厚。
target: In Standard Gambit, you can freely select the rank difficulty you wish to challenge. The higher the rank, the greater the challenge and the more luxurious the rewards.

source: 在模拟宇宙内，战胜敌人后可以选择祝福，祝福仅在本次探索内生效。
target: In Simulated Universe, Blessings can be chosen after defeating enemies, which are effective only in the current exploration.

source: 在模拟宇宙的战斗过程中，主动消耗能量可引发命途回响，收获战斗收益。
target: During combat in the Simulated Universe, actively consuming Energy might lead to Path Resonance, which will earn you a buff in combat.

source: 在模擬宇宙內，戰勝敵人後可以選擇祝福，祝福僅在本次探索內生效。
target: In Simulated Universe, Blessings can be chosen after defeating enemies, which are effective only in the current exploration.

target: During combat in the Simulated Universe, actively consuming Energy might lead to Path Resonance, which will earn you a buff in combat.

target: In the Corridor of Fading Echoes's Victory Zone, Trailblazers need to use the flame-transference feature of the modified lamps and ignite all lamps bearing the marks

source: 在殘響迴廊決勝樂園內，開拓者需要利用燈爐改造過的傳火特性，點燃樂園內所有有徽章標記的燈爐
target: In the Corridor of Fading Echoes's Victory Zone, Trailblazers need to use the flame-transference feature of the modified lamps and ignite all lamps bearing the marks

target: On each planet, 4 teams must be dispatched simultaneously to tackle 4 separate routes. Characters in the team will automatically engage in combat with monsters and generate a combat report once the dispatch ends.

target: On each planet, 4 teams must be dispatched simultaneously to tackle 4 separate routes. Characters in the team will automatically engage in combat with monsters and generate a combat report once the dispatch ends.

target: In each race segment, if the player's supported contestant wins the segment, snacks will be returned based on the amount of snacks spent on the support and the racer's victory bonus.
