target: Each seal can take action 1 time per round. At the start of a new round, the player who goes first is swapped.

source: 在比賽中完成指定戰鬥行為，上演「經典時刻」，可為我方增加大量「氣氛值」。
target: Complete designated combat actions and achieve Highlights during the matches to gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 在比賽過程中，玩家可以使用賽場道具影響比賽。使用任意道具後，所有道具都會進入冷卻。
target: During the match, players can use arena items to influence the game. After using any item, all items will enter cooldown.

source: 在比赛中完成指定战斗行为，上演「高光时刻」，可为我方增加大量「气氛值」。
target: Complete designated combat actions and achieve Highlights during the matches to gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 在比赛过程中，玩家可以使用赛场道具来影响比赛。使用任意道具后，所有道具都会进入冷却。
target: During the match, players can use arena items to influence the game. After using any item, all items will enter cooldown.

source: 在決戰中，你的隊伍將挑戰難度最高的工作！
target: In the final battle, your squad will challenge the most difficult task!

source: 在活动期间内完成「限时挑战」，还可获取限时额外奖励。
target: If you complete the "Limited Time Challenge" during the event period, you can also get bonus rewards.

source: 在活動期間內完成「限時挑戰」，還可獲得限時額外獎勵。
target: If you complete the "Limited Time Challenge" during the event period, you can also get bonus rewards.

source: 在特定角度下，多个不完整标识接近拼合时，可再次使用相机功能，将完整的光印拓片记录下来。
target: At a certain angle, piece together multiple incomplete markings and use the Camera to record the completed optical rubbing.

source: 在特定角度下，多個不完整標識接近拼合時，可再次使用相機功能，將完整的光印拓片記錄下來。
target: At a certain angle, piece together multiple incomplete markings and use the Camera to record the completed optical rubbing.

source: 在特殊动作期间拍摄可获得额外的抓拍得分。
target: Take the picture during the Special Action to obtain extra Capture Scores.

source: 在特殊動作期間拍攝可獲得額外的抓拍得分。
target: Take the picture during the Special Action to obtain extra Capture Scores.

source: 在电影模式中，影片长度是有限的，下方的进度条代表着拍摄的进度。
target: The film's length is limited in Movie Mode. The progress bar below indicates the filming progress.

source: 在磐岩鎮鬥技表演賽中，玩家每回合獲得的增益不再固定，可以自由選擇
target: While competing in the Boulder Town Martial Exhibition, players can now freely choose the buffs they receive each round, instead of having fixed ones.

source: 在磐岩镇斗技表演赛中，玩家每回合获得的增益不再固定，可以自由选择
target: While competing in the Boulder Town Martial Exhibition, players can now freely choose the buffs they receive each round, instead of having fixed ones.

source: 在第三位面的首领战斗中会出现「回响推演」。 「回响推演」会通过模拟不同的「命途回响」对我方造成严重的影响。
target: During the boss fight in the Third Plane, Resonance Extrapolation will occur. Resonance Extrapolations will simulate different types of Path Resonance and have a serious impact on all allies.

source: 在第三次元的頭目戰鬥中會出現「迴響推演」。 「迴響推演」會透過模擬不同的「命途迴響」對我方造成嚴重的影響。
target: During the boss fight in the Third Plane, Resonance Extrapolation will occur. Resonance Extrapolations will simulate different types of Path Resonance and have a serious impact on all allies.

source: 在筑梦师视角下，角色的活动区域将受到限制。只有退出「筑梦遥眼」后，角色才能移动出画面边界。
target: In the Dreamweaver's View, your character's movement is limited within the screen boundaries. To move beyond these boundaries, you need to deactivate the Dream's Eye.

source: 在築夢師視角下，角色的活動區域將受到限制。只有退出「築夢遙眼」後，角色才能移動出畫面邊界。
target: In the Dreamweaver's View, your character's movement is limited within the screen boundaries. To move beyond these boundaries, you need to deactivate the Dream's Eye.

source: 在練劍過程中，三月七可以獲得同伴的協助，提升訓練與遊歷的效率。
target: During sword training, March 7th can receive assistance from companions, enhancing the efficiency of her Training and Excursions.

source: 在續集模式中，軌道將無止盡地延申下去。挑戰自己、創造歷史最高評分吧！
target: In Sequel Mode, the tracks will continue endlessly. Challenge yourself and achieve your highest all-time score!

source: 在练剑过程中，三月七可以获得同伴的协助，提升训练与游历的效率。
target: During sword training, March 7th can receive assistance from companions, enhancing the efficiency of her Training and Excursions.

source: 在续集模式中，轨道将无止尽地延申下去。挑战自己、创造历史最高评分吧！
target: In Sequel Mode, the tracks will continue endlessly. Challenge yourself and achieve your highest all-time score!

source: 在翁法罗斯的探索中，开拓者能够发现两种不同样貌的「密径之门」，与它们交互可以跨入「雅努斯密径」，在门与门之间实现快速移动。
target: During exploration in Amphoreus, Trailblazers will notice Hidden Passages with two different appearances. Interact with them to enter Janus' Hidden Passage and quickly traverse between different doors.

source: 在翁法罗斯，有些门只能在特定的时空开启。亮着太阳灯纹的门，只能在白昼时空开启。亮着月亮灯纹的门，只能在永夜时空开启。
target: In Amphoreus, some doors can only be opened in a specific space-time. Sun-marked doors can only be opened during the day, and moon-marked doors can only be opened in the evernight.

source: 在翁法羅斯的探索中，開拓者能夠發現兩種不同樣貌的「密徑之門」，與它們互動可以跨入「雅努斯密徑」，在門與門之間實現快速移動。
target: During exploration in Amphoreus, Trailblazers will notice Hidden Passages with two different appearances. Interact with them to enter Janus' Hidden Passage and quickly traverse between different doors.

source: 在翁法羅斯，有些門只能在特定的時空開啟。亮著太陽燈紋的門，只能在白晝時空開啟。亮著月亮燈紋的門，只能在永夜時空開啟。
target: In Amphoreus, some doors can only be opened in a specific space-time. Sun-marked doors can only be opened during the day, and moon-marked doors can only be opened in the evernight.

source: 在联机模式的双人对战中，所有对战道具将默认强化至3星效果。
target: In the multiplayer Duo Duel mode, all battle items are enhanced to their 3-star effects by default.

source: 在联机模式的多人乱斗中，所有对战道具将默认强化至3星效果。
target: In the multiplayer Battle Royale mode, all battle items are enhanced to their 3-star effects by default.

source: 在艾迪恩公园中随处可见的游艺设施，规则简单但令人着迷。无数宾客沉迷其中，将现实彻底忘却。
target: An amusement facility that can be seen anywhere in Aideen Park. Its rules are simple but charming. Countless guests are immersed in it and become completely oblivious to reality.

source: 在艾迪恩公園中隨處可見的遊樂設施，規則簡單但令人著迷。無數賓客沉迷其中，將現實徹底忘卻。
target: An amusement facility that can be seen anywhere in Aideen Park. Its rules are simple but charming. Countless guests are immersed in it and become completely oblivious to reality.

source: 在行动轮数结束前消灭所有敌人，则视为战斗胜利，战斗胜利会对对方造成伤害
target: Defeat all enemies before the Action Cycles end to achieve victory in battle. Achieving victory in battle will deal DMG to opponents.

source: 在行動輪數結束前消滅所有敵人，則視為戰鬥勝利，戰鬥勝利會對對方造成傷害
target: Defeat all enemies before the Action Cycles end to achieve victory in battle. Achieving victory in battle will deal DMG to opponents.

source: 在角色培养页面，可以使用快速刷取来补足缺失的拟造花萼/凝滞虚影材料。
target: On the Character Build Screen, you can use Quick Farm to obtain missing Calyx / Stagnant Shadow materials.

source: 在角色培養頁面，可以使用快速收取來補足缺失的擬造花萼/凝滯虛影素材。
target: On the Character Build Screen, you can use Quick Farm to obtain missing Calyx / Stagnant Shadow materials.

source: 在該任務過程中，需要達成更多的目標條件以完成拍攝任務。
target: During this mission, more conditions need to be met to complete the photoshoot.

source: 在談判結束時，若你的氣勢值高於或等於對手，即為談判成功。反之，即為談判失敗。
target: At the end of negotiation, if your morale is higher than or equal to your opponent's, it is considered a successful negotiation. Otherwise, it is deemed a failure.

source: 在談判過程中，任意一方氣勢值為0時，談判過程立即結束。
target: During the negotiation process, if either party's morale drops to zero, the negotiation immediately ends.

source: 在该任务过程中，需要达成更多的目标条件以完成拍摄任务。
target: During this mission, more conditions need to be met to complete the photoshoot.

source: 在谈判结束时，若你的气势值高于或等于对手，即为谈判成功。反之，即为谈判失败。
target: At the end of negotiation, if your morale is higher than or equal to your opponent's, it is considered a successful negotiation. Otherwise, it is deemed a failure.

source: 在谈判过程中，任意一方气势值为0时，谈判过程立即结束。
target: During the negotiation process, if either party's morale drops to zero, the negotiation immediately ends.

source: 在貨運星槎上堆放貨物，完成運單目標以賺取商會儲值金
target: Complete Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and reach shipping targets to earn Merchant Guild's funds

source: 在貨運星槎上堆放貨物，滿足左側運單目標所需的指定貨物數量。
target: Conduct Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and fulfill the designated number of goods as stated on the shipping targets on the left.

source: 在货运星槎上码放货物，完成运单目标以赚取商会储值金
target: Complete Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and reach shipping targets to earn Merchant Guild's funds

source: 在货运星槎上码放货物，满足左侧运单目标所需的指定货物数量。
target: Conduct Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and fulfill the designated number of goods as stated on the shipping targets on the left.

source: 在这款游戏中，玩家的目标是赚大钱、提升会场等级，进而让会场更繁荣。
target: In this game, your objective is to get rich and raise the Venue Level to make the exhibition more prosperous.

source: 在进阶试炼中，所有提示都会关闭。跟随节奏做出回应吧。
target: During the Advanced Trial, all hints will be disabled. Respond based on the rhythm.

source: 在逐光捡金中可以查看好友通关阵容
target: You can view your Friend Clearance Lineup in Treasures Lightward

source: 在逐光撿金中可以查看好友完成陣容
target: You can view your Friend Clearance Lineup in Treasures Lightward

source: 在這次海原市的「商業街爭霸賽」中，《銀河戰力黨》將以二對一的方式進行，請與銀狼通力合作戰勝強敵！
target: In this Seafeld City "Commerce Street Showdown," the "Cosmicon Collective" will fight in a 2v1 format. Work together with Silver Wolf to defeat formidable foes!

source: 在這款遊戲中，玩家的目標是賺大錢、提升會場等級，進而讓會場更繁榮。
target: In this game, your objective is to get rich and raise the Venue Level to make the exhibition more prosperous.

source: 在連線模式的多人亂鬥中，所有對戰道具將預設強化至三星效果。
target: In the multiplayer Battle Royale mode, all battle items are enhanced to their 3-star effects by default.

source: 在連線模式的雙人對戰中，所有對戰道具將預設強化至三星效果。
target: In the multiplayer Duo Duel mode, all battle items are enhanced to their 3-star effects by default.

source: 在進階試煉中，所有提示都會關閉。跟隨節奏做出回應吧。
target: During the Advanced Trial, all hints will be disabled. Respond based on the rhythm.

source: 在部分特殊场景玩法中，会出现「辅助指引」。跟随「辅助指引」并完成相应的操作，即可抵达当前任务目标点。
target: Support Guide will appear in certain specific overworld gameplay. Follow Support Guide and finish the corresponding operations to arrive at the destination for the current mission.

source: 在部分特殊場景玩法中，會出現「輔助指引」。跟隨「輔助指引」並完成相應的操作，即可抵達當下任務目標點。
target: Support Guide will appear in certain specific overworld gameplay. Follow Support Guide and finish the corresponding operations to arrive at the destination for the current mission.

source: 在阿哈时刻期间，欢愉技始终只能对副战场的敌方目标发动攻击。
target: During Aha Instants, Elation Skills can only attack enemy targets on the sub-field.

source: 在阿哈時刻期間，歡愉技始終只能對副戰場的敵方目標發動攻擊。
target: During Aha Instants, Elation Skills can only attack enemy targets on the sub-field.

source: 在限定的輪數內消滅敵方目標以完成星芒戰幕挑戰。每場戰鬥開始前，挑戰者的生命值、戰技點和能量會恢復到指定數目。
target: Defeat enemies within specified number of Cycles to complete the Stellar Flare challenge. Before the start of each battle, your HP, Skill Points, and Energy will be restored to a specified amount.

source: 在限定的轮数内消灭敌方目标以完成星芒战幕挑战。每场战斗开始前，挑战者的生命值、战技点和能量会恢复到指定数量。
target: Defeat enemies within specified number of Cycles to complete the Stellar Flare challenge. Before the start of each battle, your HP, Skill Points, and Energy will be restored to a specified amount.

source: 在雙人對戰中，交換2個超級炸彈觸發組合消除時，也將獲得額外步數。
target: In a Duo Duel, you can also obtain extra moves when triggering a combo elimination via Swapping 2 Super Bombs.

source: 在雙人對戰中，將4個以上相同的水果相連生成炸彈時，將獲得額外步數。
target: In a Duo Duel, when 4 or more identical fruits are connected to generate a bomb, you will gain extra moves.

source: 在雙人對戰中，玩家將與對手在同一場地上進行對戰。
target: In a Duo Duel, the player and their opponent fights on the same field.

source: 在雙人對戰中，雙方在同一場地上輪流行動。每回合雙方各能行動2步，4個回合後戰力更高的一方獲得勝利。
target: In a Duo Duel, the two sides take turns acting on the same field. Each side can act 2 moves per turn. After 4 turns, the side with more combat power will win.

source: 在電影模式中，影片長度是有限的，下方的進度條代表拍攝的進度。
target: The film's length is limited in Movie Mode. The progress bar below indicates the filming progress.

source: 在非开拓者视角下将仅能前往个别场景，且无法游玩个别任务，以及【拟造花萼】、【凝滞虚影】、【侵蚀隧洞】、【历战余响】、【模拟宇宙】、【忘却之庭】等内容。
target: While in a non-Trailblazer POV, you can only access specific maps and cannot play certain missions as well as certain content such as Calyxes, Stagnant Shadows, Caverns of Corrosion, Echoes of War, Simulated Universe, Forgotten Hall, etc.

source: 在非指定位置堆叠方块时，两侧薄板上将出现错误提示。点击撤销或重置，可以回退堆叠操作。
target: When stacking cubes on a non-designated spot, the plates on the two sides will show an error hint. Select Cancel or Reset to revert the stacking process.

source: 在非指定位置堆疊方塊時，兩側薄板上將出現錯誤提示。點選撤銷或重置，可以回退堆疊操作。
target: When stacking cubes on a non-designated spot, the plates on the two sides will show an error hint. Select Cancel or Reset to revert the stacking process.

source: 在非開拓者視角下將僅能前往個別場景，且無法遊玩個別任務，以及【擬造花萼】、【凝滯虛影】、【侵蝕隧洞】、【歷戰餘響】、【模擬宇宙】、【忘卻之庭】等內容。
target: While in a non-Trailblazer POV, you can only access specific maps and cannot play certain missions as well as certain content such as Calyxes, Stagnant Shadows, Caverns of Corrosion, Echoes of War, Simulated Universe, Forgotten Hall, etc.

source: 在飛行的過程中，可以遙控機巧鳥上升或者下降。
target: While flying a cycrane, you can control it to ascend or descend.

source: 在飛行的過程中，可以遙控機巧鳥上升或者下降。
target: While in control of a cycrane, you have the option to either ascend or descend as desired.

source: 在飛行的過程中，可以遙控機巧鳥進行上升或者下降。
target: While in control of a cycrane, you can control it to ascend or descend.

source: 在飞行的过程中，可以遥控机巧鸟进行上升或者下降。
target: While flying a cycrane, you can control it to ascend or descend.

source: 在飞行的过程中，可以遥控机巧鸟进行上升或者下降。
target: While in control of a cycrane, you can control it to ascend or descend.

target: While in control of a cycrane, you have the option to either ascend or descend as desired.

source: 在餐館佈置中，可以透過購買餐桌來讓更多顧客同時就餐
target: When setting up your restaurant, you can serve more customers simultaneously by purchasing dining tables

source: 在餐馆布设中，可以通过购买餐桌来让更多顾客同时就餐
target: When setting up your restaurant, you can serve more customers simultaneously by purchasing dining tables

source: 在騎士關卡中，當剩餘輪數較少時，我方將在輪次開始時獲得戰鬥增益。
target: In Knight Stages, when there are only a few Cycles remaining, allies will receive Combat buffs at the start of each Cycle.

source: 在骑士关卡中，当剩余轮次较少时，我方将在轮次开始时获得战斗增益。
target: In Knight Stages, when there are only a few Cycles remaining, allies will receive Combat buffs at the start of each Cycle.

source: 地图上存在特殊的按钮，踩下后会重置相同能量颜色的一组传送门。按钮在传送门开启状态下不会弹出。
target: There are special buttons on the map. Stepping on them will reset a set of teleporters of the same energy color. The buttons will not appear while the teleporters are active.

source: 当你和队友同时死亡时，游戏结束
target: It's game over when you and your teammates all fall in battle.

source: 当前「认知值」及「认知值目标区间」均会展示在「认知条」上。 可在棋盘上方查阅。 解锁「秘闻」所需「认知值」将会展示在「秘闻」上方。
target: Current Cognition Value and Cognition Value Target Range are both displayed in the Cognition Bar. Check it at the top of the board. The Cognition Value required to unlock each Secret is displayed above the Secret.

source: 当前命途的祝福达到3个后，获取另一特定命途的祝福达到3个时，会触发回响交错。回响交错的具体效果可在命途选择时的「命途回响」页签查看。
target: When you receive 3 Blessings for your current Path and then receive 3 Blessings for another specific Path, Resonance Interplay will be triggered. You can find the effect of Resonance Interplay on the Path Resonance tab when choosing a Path.

source: 当前战斗的剩余轮数将通过倒计时的形式展示于左侧行动序列。 轮数结束或消灭全部敌人前，对敌方任意目标造成伤害都可获得积分。
target: Cycles remaining from this battle will be displayed as a countdown in the Action Order shown on the left. Dealing DMG to any enemy target before the Cycles run out or all enemies are defeated will earn you points.

source: 当区域内超过8个涂鸦时，最先喷涂的涂鸦将会被替换。离开当前区域后，涂鸦也会消失。
target: When more than 8 graffitis are made in the domain, the earliest graffiti will be replaced. When you exit the current domain, existing graffitis will also disappear.

source: 当发现场景里有多片决胜纹样碎片时，开拓者可以通过移动和调整视角，在特定角度和位置下，将多片决胜纹样碎片组合成完整的决胜纹样。
target: When multiple fragments of a Victory Marking are found in a scene, Trailblazers can piece these fragments together into a complete Victory Marking by moving and changing the view to a specific angle and position.

source: 当哈努兄弟获得哈努火箭炮后，石头老板的爪牙就要遭殃了！瞄准敌人后，按下攻击键即可使用「哈努飞弹」，消耗弹药击败敌人
target: Boss Stone's minions will experience true calamity when Hanu gets his Hanu Launcher! After taking aim at an enemy, hitting the fire button will unleash the Hanu Rocket and consume ammunition.

source: 当场上存在多个待解救目标时，需要全部解救才算成功。
target: When there are multiple targets to be rescued on the field, all of them must be rescued to be considered a success.

source: 当多片决胜纹样碎片接近拼合时，会出现特殊拍照按钮，按下特殊拍照按钮后会自动将完整的决胜纹样记录下来，从而完成挑战。
target: When the Victory Marking fragments are close to assembly, a special Camera button will appear and the complete Victory Marking will be saved after the picture is taken, thus concluding the challenge.

source: 当妖火出现在我方单位旁时，会呈现为青色火焰。 生效时可补充藏月瓠中的驱邪术能量。
target: When Fiendfire appears next to allies, it will appear as a green flame. When it takes effect, it can replenish the Lunaumbra Gourd's exorcismics energy.

source: 当妖火出现在敌方单位旁时，会呈现为红色火焰。 生效时会大幅强化敌方获取单位。
target: When Fiendfire appears next to enemies, it will appear as a red flame. When it takes effect, it can greatly enhance the enemy that receives it.

source: 当存在多个弹珠机时，可先发射至其他弹珠机作为中转站，最后发射至终点弹珠机。
target: When multiple pinball machines exist, you can first fire the shot to another pinball machine as an interchange stop, then finally to the last pinball machine as the eventual destination.

source: 当开拓者自己站在不稳定的桥上时，无法对这座桥发动祷言进行回溯。
target: When the Trailblazer themself is standing atop the unstable bridge, they will not be able to activate the prayer to rewind the bridge.

source: 当心运动中的物体，它们可能会撞到开拓者。不小心可是会受伤的。
target: Watch out for moving objects. They may collide with the Trailblazer. You may get hurt if you're not being careful.

source: 当我方角色的生命值提升或降低时，将积累「战意值」。
target: Grit Value accumulates when allies' HP increases or decreases.

source: 当抽出最高点数时，可以使惊笑盒立即行动。
target: When drawing the highest number, the Surprise Box will immediately take action.

source: 当有队友存活时，你不会失败，而是在一定时间后复活
target: As long as a teammate is still standing, you won't be eliminated. You'll respawn after a short time.

source: 当残留有记忆的物件相互接触时，记忆会暂时冲突消散，并使它们都回到平时的稳定状态。
target: When memory-laden objects come into contact with each other, the memories they contain will temporarily collide and dissipate, causing them to revert to their usual stable states.

source: 当满足全部拍摄条件时，便可以按下快门，完成本次拍照。请尽可能满足所有拍摄条件吧。
target: When all the photoshoot requirements are met, you can press the shutter to complete this shoot. Try to meet all the requirements if you can.

source: 当灯炉被点燃后，灯炉会产生圆形的热能区域，热能区域会点燃区域内其他未被点燃的灯炉
target: When a lamp is ignited, it will create a a spherical thermal area that can ignite all other unlit lamps within its boundaries

source: 当玩家血量为0时，将进入濒死状态，再次受到伤害则会被淘汰。
target: When the player's HP is at 0, they will enter the Near-Death state. Taking DMG again will result in defeat.

source: 当生命值为0时，模拟测试将结束并退场，请务必努力存活。
target: When HP reaches 0, the simulation test will end, and you will exit the test. Please do your best to survive.

source: 当生命值为0时，选手将视为失败并退场，请务必努力存活
target: When a contestant's HP reaches 0, they will be considered as defeated and leave the war. Please do your best to survive

source: 当番の間、「コモン」「レア」「スペシャル」、3種類の「行動カード」が出現します。「レア行動カード」を使用すると、より多くの当番経験値と列車基金を獲得できます。「スペシャル行動カード」を使用すると、さまざまな特殊効果を得られます。
target: During the duty periods, you will encounter three types of Action Cards: "Normal," "Rare," and "Special." Rare Action Cards grant more Duty Experience and Express Funds, while Special Action Cards provide various special effects.

source: 当番チームのリーダーは独自の「リーダー特性」を持っており、当番の仕事をサポートできます。
target: Every Duty Squad's leader will have a unique Leader Trait. This can be useful during duties.

source: 当白厄在队伍中，探索时可提高秘技点上限，施放秘技消灭前方一定范围内的敌人
target: When Phainon is in the team, Technique Point limit increases, and using his Technique defeats enemies within a certain range ahead

source: 当离散梦泡所在的位置满足梦泡桥梁的建造条件时，这些梦泡将会聚拢。此时携带梦泡充能靠近即可建造出梦泡桥梁。
target: When the placement of the scattered dream bubbles meets the requirements of forming a Bubble Bridge, these dream bubbles will congeal. When this happens, approach with a Bubble Charge to manifest a Bubble Bridge.

source: 当耐力值耗尽时，每次消耗耐力值，将扣除全队所有角色一定百分比的生命值。
target: When Stamina is exhausted, every subsequent use of it will deduct a percentage of HP from all characters in the team.

source: 当行动条上的【礼盒】行动时，击破全部敌人弱点并大幅提高我方攻击力，持续至效果结束。 【礼盒】效果持续期间，全力输出攻击敌人，造成更高伤害！
target: When the Giftbox on the action bar takes action, Breaks all enemy Weaknesses and greatly increases ally ATK until the effect ends. While the Giftbox's effect is active, go all out and attack the enemy to deal more DMG!

source: 当角色等级低于当前均衡等级要求时，会被提升至适配当前均衡等级的角色等级。
target: When a character's level is below what is required by the current Equilibrium Level, it will be raised to a level that is compatible with the current Equilibrium Level.

source: 当角色装备的遗器总强化等级低于当前均衡等级要求时，遗器会被替换为适配当前均衡等级的临时遗器。
target: When the total level of Relics equipped on a character is lower than that required in the current Equilibrium Level, the Relics will be replaced with temporary Relics that are compatible with the current Equilibrium Level.

source: 当遗器的主属性或副属性是当前查看角色的建议属性，会在属性面板中高亮显示。
target: When the Relic's Main Stat or Subsidiary Stats is the recommended stat for the character currently being viewed, they would be highlighted in the Stats interface.

source: 彥卿擁有多重護盾，並在開場時鎖定弱點。 擊破任意召喚物可解除彥卿的弱點保護，並使我方單位行動提前50%。
target: Yanqing possesses multiple layers of Shields and will become Weaknessproof at the start of the match. Break any summon to dispel Yanqing's Weakness Protection and advance allies' actions by 50%.

source: 彦卿は複数のバリアを持っており、戦闘開始時に弱点保護状態になります。 任意の召喚物を弱点撃破すると彦卿の弱点保護を解除でき、味方の行動順を50%早めることができます。
target: Yanqing possesses multiple layers of Shields and will become Weaknessproof at the start of the match. Break any summon to dispel Yanqing's Weakness Protection and advance allies' actions by 50%.

source: 彦卿または召喚物を弱点撃破すると「ハイライトシーン」が上演され、大量の「白熱値」を獲得することができます。
target: Break Yanqing or his summons' Weaknesses to trigger Highlights and obtain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 彦卿拥有多重护盾，并在开场时锁定弱点。 击破任意召唤物可解除彦卿的弱点保护，并使我方单位行动提前50%。
target: Yanqing possesses multiple layers of Shields and will become Weaknessproof at the start of the match. Break any summon to dispel Yanqing's Weakness Protection and advance allies' actions by 50%.

source: 战斗中会实时显示当前战斗波次，以及当前波次中击败敌人进度。
target: The current wave of enemies and the number of enemies defeated in the current wave will be displayed during battle.

source: 战斗中敌人会不断刷新，击败敌人或对首领敌人造成伤害均可获得积分。 尽快进入「战意汹涌」阶段，以击败敌人获得更高积分！
target: In battle, enemies will continuously appear. You can earn points by defeating enemies or dealing DMG to the Boss enemy. Prioritize entering the Surging Grit phase and defeat enemies to obtain even higher points!

source: 战斗中积累「战意值」，充满后进入「战意汹涌」阶段，可获取强大的关卡增益，显著提升作战效率。
target: Accumulate Grit Value during battle. Upon fully filling the gauge, enters the Surging Grit phase that grants powerful stage buffs and significantly improves combat efficiency.

source: 战斗开始时，依据「欢愉」命途角色的数量，获得一定数量的笑点。
target: At the start of battle, gains a certain number of Punchlines based on the number of Elation characters present.

source: 战斗时会遭遇不同级别的敌人，级别越高实力越强劲。
target: In combat, you'll encounter enemies of different levels. The higher the level, the tougher they are.

source: 战斗结束时将获得： 本节点金币收入 = 基础金币 + 连胜金币 + 利息。
target: At the end of combat, you will receive: Current Node's Gold Coins = Base Gold Coins + Winning Streak Gold Coins + Interest.

source: 战斗结束时，每拥有10金币，都会获得1金币利息（最多5金币）。 适度积累金币也是获得更多经济的有效手段。
target: At the end of combat, for every 10 Gold Coins you own, you'll earn 1 Gold Coin as interest (up to 5 Gold Coins). Moderately saving up Gold Coins is an effective way to gain more economic advantage.

source: 战斗胜利时，连胜计数+1。 连胜越多，连胜金币奖励越多。
target: When you win a battle, your winning streak tally increases by 1. The longer your winning streak, the more Gold Coin Rewards you'll earn.

source: 战术卡仅能在交换阶段中使用，其中攻击和防御类型的战术卡只能在攻击或防御时使用。
target: Tactics Cards can only be used during the Swap Phase, with Attack-type and Defense-type Tactics Cards usable only when attacking or defending respectively.

target: Purchasing and refreshing Tactics Cards consumes Tactics Points. In Co-Op Mode, players can earn Tactics Points by dealing DMG, successfully defending, launching Counters, and more.

source: 戦術カードは交換フェーズでのみ使用可能です。そのうち、攻撃および防御タイプの戦術カードは、攻撃または防御時にのみ使用できます。
target: Tactics Cards can only be used during the Swap Phase, with Attack-type and Defense-type Tactics Cards usable only when attacking or defending respectively.

source: 戦闘、遭遇、ボスパートで勝利した場合、現在のパーティHPが維持されます。 勝利できなかった場合、パーティHPが一定量失われます。 パーティHPが0になると、ゲームは終了します。
target: When you achieve victory at Battle, Encounter, or Boss Nodes, the squad HP remains unchanged. If you do not achieve victory, you will lose a certain amount of squad HP. The match is lost if the squad HP drops to 0.

source: 戦闘で経験値を獲得するか、コインで経験値を購入してレベルアップすることで、パーティ規模を拡張し、より多くのキャラクターを配置できるようになります！
target: Participate in battles to gain Experience, or spend Gold Coins to buy Experience and level up, increasing your team size to deploy more characters!

source: 戦闘に勝利することで、連勝数が+1されます。 連勝数が多いほど、ボーナスで獲得できる連勝コインが多くなります。
target: When you win a battle, your winning streak tally increases by 1. The longer your winning streak, the more Gold Coin Rewards you'll earn.

source: 戦闘の残りラウンド数はカウントダウン形式で左側のアクションバーに表示されます。 残りラウンド数が0になる、またはすべての敵を倒すまで、任意の敵にダメージを与えることでポイントを獲得できます。
target: Cycles remaining from this battle will be displayed as a countdown in the Action Order shown on the left. Dealing DMG to any enemy target before the Cycles run out or all enemies are defeated will earn you points.

target: Skills and Skill Points

source: 戦闘スキルまたは必殺技を正しく使用してこの敵を攻撃すると、「謎解き退場」を触発できます。
target: Correctly use Skill or Ultimate to attack the enemy to trigger "Solved Departure."

source: 戦闘中、「アッハ」は自身の速度に基づいて行動し、アッハタイムを発動する。 愉悦スキルを発動する時、アッハは攻撃者として共に敵を攻撃する。その際、攻撃系ステータスと装備効果が愉悦スキルに反映される。
target: In combat, Aha takes action based on THEIR own SPD to trigger Aha Instants. When Elation Skills are used, Aha joins in as an attacker to strike enemies together, so offensive stats and equipment effects will take effect in Elation Skills.

source: 戦闘中、キャラが行動するごとに「戦意値」を累積できます。 各ステージには独自の「戦意メカニズム」が設けられています。「戦意メカニズム」を触発すると、「戦意値」を大幅に上昇させられ、「戦意フェーズ」を短時間で上げられます。
target: Every time a character takes action in combat, Grit Value will be accumulated. Every stage will have unique Grit Mechanics, and triggering them will greatly increase Grit Value, thus allowing you to quickly elevate your Grit Phase.

source: 戦闘中、プーマンを倒すとより多くのポイントを獲得できます。
target: Defeating a Trotter during battle will award even higher points.

source: 戦闘中、ボスエネミー以外の敵が絶えず出現します。このマークが付いているボスエネミー以外の敵を倒すと、ボスエネミーにダメージを与えられます。ボスエネミーが倒されると、そのウェーブが終了します。
target: During battle, non-Boss enemies will continuously replenish after being defeated. When non-Boss enemies with this mark are defeated, it will deal DMG to the Boss enemy. When Boss enemies are defeated, the wave is considered complete.

source: 戦闘中、異なるレベルの敵に遭遇します。レベルが高いほど、敵は強くなります。
target: In combat, you'll encounter enemies of different levels. The higher the level, the tougher they are.

source: 戦闘中、迷子になったプーマンが間違って戦闘に入る場合もあります。プーマンが逃げる前に倒せば、追加の報酬を受け取れます。
target: During battle, Trotters might accidentally enter the battle as a result of being lost. Defeat the Trotter before they run away to obtain bonus rewards dropped from other enemies.

source: 戦闘中に「戦意値」をMAXまで溜めると、「戦意の洶湧」フェーズに入ります。これにより強力なステージバフ効果が得られ、戦闘効率を大幅に向上させることができます。
target: Accumulate Grit Value during battle. Upon fully filling the gauge, enters the Surging Grit phase that grants powerful stage buffs and significantly improves combat efficiency.

source: 戦闘中にウェーブ数、および現在のウェーブの進捗がリアルタイムで表示されます。
target: The current wave of enemies and the number of enemies defeated in the current wave will be displayed during battle.

source: 戦闘中にキャラクターのHPが0になる攻撃を受けた際、その戦闘の残りカウントが減少し、戦闘がより早く終了します。 これにより、カウントが0になる前に全ての敵を倒すことがより困難になっています。
target: When a character takes a killing blow in combat, the battle countdown timer will decrease, causing the combat to end early. This means it will be harder to defeat all enemies before the countdown expires.

source: 戦闘中にキャラクターのHPが0になる攻撃を受けた際、戦闘不能状態にならず、HPを一定量回復します。
target: When a character receives a killing blow in combat, they will not be knocked down and will immediately recover some HP.

source: 戦闘中にスキルを発動したり、敵を倒したり、または攻撃を受けたりすると、EPが回復します。
target: Regenerate Energy in battle when using abilities, defeating enemies, or receiving attacks.

source: 戦闘中に敵を倒すと「戦意値」が溜まります。 周期ごとの虚構叙事には異なる「戦意メカニズム」が設定されており、これを発動させると大量の「戦意値」を溜められ、より早く「戦意の洶湧」フェーズに入ることができます。
target: Every time an enemy is defeated in combat, Grit Value will be accumulated. Every period will have unique Grit Mechanics, and triggering them will greatly accumulate Grit Value, quickening the entry to the Surging Grit phase.

source: 戦闘中は敵が絶えず出現します。敵を倒す、またはボスエネミーにダメージを与えることでポイントを獲得できます。 なるべく早く「戦意の洶湧」フェーズに入り、敵を倒してより多くのポイントを獲得しましょう！
target: In battle, enemies will continuously appear. You can earn points by defeating enemies or dealing DMG to the Boss enemy. Prioritize entering the Surging Grit phase and defeat enemies to obtain even higher points!

source: 戦闘中は白昼と黒夜を交互に繰り返します。
target: The entire battle will cycle between Day and Night.

source: 戦闘中累積した「戦意値」によって、「戦意フェーズ」を上げられます。 「戦意フェーズ4：力の覚醒」に入ると、強力なステージバフを獲得でき、戦闘効率が飛躍的に向上します。
target: Accumulating Grit Value during battle can elevate your Grit Phase. When entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken", you can obtain powerful stage buffs and significantly improve your combat effectiveness.

source: 戦闘内で、一部キャラクターは条件を満たした時、追加の攻撃を1回自動で発動します。その攻撃は追加攻撃と呼ばれます。カウンターも追加攻撃に含まれます。
target: During combat, some characters will automatically trigger an additional attack, known as Follow-Up ATK, when certain conditions are met. Counters are also considered a type of Follow-Up ATK.

source: 戦闘内で、一部キャラクターは条件を満たした時、追加ターンを獲得します。追加ターンはターン数を消費しません。追加ターン中では必殺技を発動できません。
target: During combat, some characters will receive an extra turn when certain conditions are met. This extra turn does not consume any turn counts, and Ultimates cannot be used during this extra turn.

source: 戦闘終了時、所持しているコイン10枚につき、1枚の利子（最大5枚まで）を獲得できます。 コインを適度に貯めることも、より多くのリソースを獲得するための効率的な方法です。
target: At the end of combat, for every 10 Gold Coins you own, you'll earn 1 Gold Coin as interest (up to 5 Gold Coins). Moderately saving up Gold Coins is an effective way to gain more economic advantage.

source: 戦闘終了時に獲得できるコインの総数は以下のように決定されます。 本パートのコイン収入 = 基礎コイン + 連勝コイン + 利子
target: At the end of combat, you will receive: Current Node's Gold Coins = Base Gold Coins + Winning Streak Gold Coins + Interest.

source: 戦闘開始時、愉悦の運命を歩むキャラの数に応じて、爆笑ネタを獲得します。
target: At the start of battle, gains a certain number of Punchlines based on the number of Elation characters present.

source: 戦闘開始時、敵は弱点保護状態にあります。
target: At the start of the battle, enemies are in the Weaknessproof State.

target: Yellow light patterns on the door means the door can be opened in the current space-time. White light patterns on the door means the door cannot be opened in the current space-time.

target: Rotate the clues and assemble the pattern. Once the progress bar is full, you can quickly move to the target.

target: Exploring, battling, picking up items, or using items each counts as 1 action, with each action further reducing the countdown timer.

source: 探索する際に、開拓クエスト、冒険クエスト、世界クエストをクリアしたり、戦利品を開けるなど、様々な方法で「楽園の記念コイン」、いわゆる「投げ願」を獲得できます。
target: While exploring, you can obtain Arcadian Tokens (or as folks like to call them, Wishbae) in multiple ways, like completing Trailblaze Missions, Adventure Missions, world missions, opening treasures around the world, and more.

source: 探索中、様々な遊び方に遭遇します。これらの遊び方は常時略伝に収録され、いつでも検索し体験することができます。
target: You will encounter different kinds of gameplay as you explore. These gameplays will be recorded in Conventional Memoir for faster review and access.

source: 探索中、金色の記憶の塵影を見つけることがあります。この場合、対象は異なる時空の同じ場所に存在することを意味します。
target: You may discover Golden Memory Dust when exploring, indicating that the target is located here in the other space-time.

source: 探索中、黄泉の秘技が通常エネミーに命中すると、ターゲットはその場で倒され、戦闘に入らない。敵に命中しなかった場合、秘技PTは消費されない。
target: During exploration, using Acheron's Technique to hit normal enemies will instantly defeat them without entering combat. When the Technique does not hit an enemy, no Technique Points are consumed.

source: 探索中に強敵に遭遇することがあります。倒すことができたら、豊富な報酬をゲットできます。
target: While exploring, you may encounter powerful enemies. Defeat them to win bountiful rewards.

source: 探索中に知り合った仲間と、メッセージを通して旅の見聞や楽しい出来事を分かち合えます。
target: Share your experience and anecdotes with your companions by sending them Messages.

source: 探索中有时会遭遇实力强劲的对手，如果能击败它们，即可获得丰富的奖励。
target: While exploring, you may encounter powerful enemies. Defeat them to win bountiful rewards.

source: 探索中有時會遭遇實力強勁的對手，如果能擊敗它們，即可獲得豐富的獎勵。
target: While exploring, you may encounter powerful enemies. Defeat them to win bountiful rewards.

source: 探索中結交的夥伴，可以透過訊息一同分享各種見聞和趣事。
target: Share your experience and anecdotes with your companions by sending them Messages.

source: 探索中结交的伙伴，可以通过短信一同分享各种见闻和趣事。
target: Share your experience and anecdotes with your companions by sending them Messages.

source: 探索回忆并通过与角色的重要对话获得关键线索记忆盲点，收集足够的记忆盲点来洗清自己的嫌疑吧。
target: Explore your memories and obtain crucial clues in the form of Cognition Chasms through conducting key conversations with characters. Collect enough Cognition Chasms to exculpate yourself.

source: 探索回憶並透過與角色的重要對話獲得關鍵線索記憶盲點，蒐集足夠的記憶盲點來洗清自己的嫌疑吧。
target: Explore your memories and obtain crucial clues in the form of Cognition Chasms through conducting key conversations with characters. Collect enough Cognition Chasms to exculpate yourself.

source: 探索寻宝者区域，会邂逅熟悉的伙伴加入探索，成为可供选择的试用角色。
target: Explore Treasure Hunter Areas to encounter familiar companions who will join up and become selectable trial characters.

source: 探索尋寶者區域，會遇到熟悉的夥伴加入探索，成為可供選擇的試用角色。
target: Explore Treasure Hunter Areas to encounter familiar companions who will join up and become selectable trial characters.

source: 探索招募区域，可以选择你拥有的角色，加入探索队伍。
target: Explore Recruitment Areas to select characters you already own to join the exploration team.

target: Explore Recruitment Areas to select characters you already own to join the exploration team.

source: 探索翁法罗斯，与场景中的特殊物件交互，倾听居民们的故事…初次与世界的记忆相遇时，可以获取散落的「记忆残晶」。
target: Explore Amphoreus, interact with special objects in the map, and listen to the peoples' stories... When you encounter the world's memories for the first time, you can collect the scattered Memory Crystal Shards.

source: 探索翁法羅斯，與場景中的特殊物件互動，傾聽居民們的故事……初次與世界的記憶相遇時，可以獲得散落的「記憶殘晶」。
target: Explore Amphoreus, interact with special objects in the map, and listen to the peoples' stories... When you encounter the world's memories for the first time, you can collect the scattered Memory Crystal Shards.

source: 探索開始時、一定数の追加ラウンドが付与されます。追加ラウンドは戦闘ごとではなく、探索ごとに一定数付与されます。追加ラウンドを消費し尽くすと、敵が凶暴状態に入り、攻撃力が大幅にアップします。
target: Every round of exploration has a certain number of extra Cycles. When all extra Cycles are used up, the enemy will enter a Berserk state and greatly increase their ATK.

source: 控制「扎格列斯之手」与金色的扎格列斯符文交互，可以做出「搭桥动作」，在符文所在位置形成桥面供开拓者通过。
target: While controlling the Hand of Zagreus, interact with the golden Zagreus rune to perform a Bridge Action, forming a bridge where the rune is located to provide passage to the Trailblazer.

target: While controlling the Hand of Zagreus, interact with the golden Zagreus rune to perform a Bridge Action, forming a bridge where the rune is located to provide passage to the Trailblazer.

target: Trotter

source: 撲滿效應•玩法說明
target: Trotter Effect: Gameplay Details

source: 擁有【生命計數】的單位受到攻擊時不會損失生命值，但是會減少【生命計數】。【生命計數】歸零時單位將陷入無法戰鬥狀態。治療和護盾效果無法避免【生命計數】減少。
target: Units with "HP Count" will not lose HP when attacked, but their "HP Count" will decrease instead. When the "HP Count" reaches zero, the unit will be knocked down. Healing and Shield effects cannot prevent "HP Count" reduction.

source: 擁有多層韌性的敵人，每層韌性被削減至0時會觸發一次擊破傷害，最後一層韌性削減至0時會觸發弱點擊破。
target: Enemies with multiple layers of Toughness will suffer an instance of Break DMG each time a layer of Toughness is reduced. When the last layer is reduced to 0, the Weakness Break effect will trigger.

source: 擁有對應屬性或特性加成的配飾，可以強化武器的效果。
target: Having accessories with the corresponding stats or trait boosts will enhance a weapon's effectiveness.

source: 擁有笑點後，行動條上出現阿哈，「歡愉」命途角色越多，阿哈的速度越快。阿哈行動後會消耗全部笑點。
target: After gaining Punchline, Aha is added to the action bar. Aha's SPD increases based on the number of Elation characters present. After Aha's turn, all Punchline stacks are consumed.

source: 擊敗具有鎮守能力的敵人可獲得門禁卡。
target: Defeat enemies with Garrison abilities to obtain Door Card.

source: 擊敗區域 - 菁英或區域 - 頭目中的敵人後，可以消耗開拓力或使用沉浸器獲得包含次元飾品在內的沉浸獎勵。
target: After defeating enemies in Domain - Elite or Domain - Boss, you can consume Trailblaze Power or Immersifiers to obtain Immersion Rewards, including Planar Ornaments.

source: 擊敗對手時，可以獲得「戰力幣」和「戰力粉塵」作為獎勵。
target: Defeat opponents to earn Power Tokens and Power Dust as rewards.

source: 擊敗對手時，可以獲得用於兌換卡牌的「戰力幣」和為卡牌鍍閃的「戰力粉塵」。
target: Defeat opponents to earn Power Tokens for redeeming cards and Power Dust for gilding cards.

source: 擊敗敵人會提升「戰意值」。 啟動「戰意機制」可累積大量「戰意值」，加速進入「戰意洶湧」階段，以額外獲得強大的關卡增益。
target: Defeating enemies increases Grit Value. Activating the Grit Mechanics rapidly accumulates Grit Value, speeding up entry into the Surging Grit phase, granting additional powerful stage buffs.

source: 擊敗敵方小海豹可獲得積分，滿分即可獲得勝利
target: Defeat enemy seals to earn points — reach the maximum score to win.

source: 擊殺魔王爪牙，獲得魔王寶藏
target: Defeat the Demon King's Minions to obtain the Demon King's Treasures.

source: 擊破任意目標弱點後，將為其與相鄰目標附加攻擊者屬性的弱點並造成額外傷害。
target: After inflicting Weakness Break on any target, implants Weakness of the same Type as the attacker on the target and units adjacent to the target, and additionally deals DMG to them.

source: 擊破傷害•屬性與韌性
target: Break DMG: Types and Toughness

source: 擊破傷害•擊破特攻
target: Break DMG: Break Effect

source: 擊破冰、虛數屬性可以施加凍結、禁錮狀態，可以減少敵方的行動次數。
target: Causing Weakness Break with Ice and Imaginary DMG will inflict Frozen and Imprisonment effects respectively and reduce the enemy's actions.

source: 擊破場上敵人的弱點，上演「經典時刻」，獲得大量「氣氛值」。
target: Break the Weaknesses of enemies on the field to trigger Highlights and gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 擊破帶有蘇樂達標誌的道具，則可以幫「鐘錶時間」技能槽充能。
target: Break items with the SoulGlad insignia to charge up the Clock Time ability bar.

source: 擊破帶有蘇樂達標誌的道具，則可以替「鐘錶時間」技能槽充能。
target: Break items with the SoulGlad insignia to charge up the Clock Time ability bar.

source: 擊破彥卿或召喚物的弱點，觸發「經典時刻」，獲得大量「氣氛值」。
target: Break Yanqing or his summons' Weaknesses to trigger Highlights and obtain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 擊破敵人弱點時，行動提前100%並恢復1個戰技點。
target: When Breaking an enemy's Weakness, Advances Action Forward by 100% and recovers 1 Skill Point.

source: 擊破敵人弱點，可對敵方全體造成韌性削減。 在「戰意階段4：力量覺醒」中，敵方頭目無弱點保護，攻擊處於弱點擊破狀態的敵人將獲得大幅增益。
target: Breaking an enemy's Weakness can inflict Toughness reduction on all enemies. During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," the enemy Boss will not have Weakness Protection. Attacking enemies in the Weakness Broken state will provide immense buffs.

source: 擊破敵人的弱點或攻擊處於弱點擊破狀態的敵人，均可累積「戰意值」。
target: Break the enemy's Weakness or attack Weakness Broken enemies to accumulate Grit Value.

source: 擊破敵方弱點時，會立刻造成一次擊破傷害。擊破傷害的傷害值隨著擊破特攻提高而增加，且無法暴擊。
target: When Breaking enemies' Weakness, immediately deals Break DMG once. Break DMG increases with Break Effect and cannot CRIT.

source: 擊破敵方頭目，上演「經典時刻」，獲得大量「氣氛值」。
target: Break the enemy Boss to trigger Highlights and gain a massive amount of Vibes.

source: 擊破模擬宇宙內的物品可隨機獲得宇宙碎片、回復生命值或恢復秘技點數。
target: Break objects in the Simulated Universe to gain a random number of Cosmic Fragments, restore HP, or recover Technique Points.

source: 擊破火、雷、風、物理屬性可以施加灼燒、觸電、風化、裂傷持續傷害狀態，在目標行動開始時，目標會受到對應屬性的傷害。
target: Causing Weakness Break with Fire, Lightning, Wind, or Physical DMG will inflict Burn, Shock, Wind Shear, or Bleed DoT effects respectively. When taking action, the target will take DMG of the corresponding Types.

source: 擊破該敵人弱點可使其為我方附加增益。
target: Break this enemy's Weakness to apply buffs to allies.

source: 擊破該敵人觸發【定點擊破】機制後，可將「關卡增益」提高1個層級。 隨著「關卡增益」層級提升，「關卡增益」的評價也將提升。
target: After inflicting Weakness Break on the enemy to trigger "Targeted Break," you may upgrade your Stage Buff by 1 rank. As you increase your Stage Buff rank, the rating for the Stage Buff will also increase.

source: 擊破量產機後，會對敵方全體削減目前韌性的30%，更易擊破其他敵人。
target: After defeating Mass-Production Machine, all enemies will have their current Toughness reduced by 30%, making it easier to Break other enemies.

source: 擊破量產機，上演「經典時刻」，獲得大量「氣氛值」。
target: Break the Mass-Production Machine and trigger Highlights to gain massive Vibes.

source: 擊破非頭目敵人的弱點，可解除敵方頭目的弱點保護。 在「戰意階段4：力量覺醒」期間，敵方頭目無弱點保護，攻擊處於弱點擊破狀態的敵人將獲得大幅增益。
target: Weakness Breaking non-boss enemies can remove the boss's Weakness Protection. During "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken," the enemy Boss will not have Weakness Protection. Attacking enemies in the Weakness Broken state will provide immense buffs.

source: 擊碎特殊的可破壞物或使用特定消耗品可以恢復秘技點。提升均衡等級可以提高秘技點上限，最多可以提高至5個。
target: Destroy destructible objects and use special Consumables to recover Technique Points. Increasing your Equilibrium Level will increase the number of Technique Points available to you, up to a maximum of 5.

source: 擋板開啟時，可以設定其旋轉方向。
target: When the plate is activated, you can set its rotation direction.

source: 操作台を調べて「ザグレウスの手」を操作しましょう。
target: Interact with the stone control platform to start the control of the Hand of Zagreus.

source: 操作哈努兄弟左右移动并瞄准他的敌人，使用攻击键发射哈努飞弹击碎挡路的敌人！
target: Control Brother Hanu by moving him left or right, and aim at his foes. Use the Attack Button to fire the Hanu Rocket at enemies blocking your path!

source: 操作哈努兄弟左右移動並瞄準他的敵人，使用攻擊鍵發射哈努飛彈擊敗擋路的敵人！
target: Control Brother Hanu by moving him left or right, and aim at his foes. Use the Attack Button to fire the Hanu Rocket at enemies blocking your path!

source: 操作潜爆机兵时，按下攻击键自爆后可以将攻击范围内的所有敌人击晕从而完成玩法挑战
target: When controlling the Automaton Stealth Bomb, press the attack button to trigger self-detonation and stun all enemies in the attack radius to complete the challenge

source: 操控【拓星者】开火，范围内的所有敌人会被直接消灭
target: Control the "Starblazer" to open fire, and all enemies within range will be instantly defeated.

source: 操控【拓星者】開火，範圍內的所有敵人會被直接消滅
target: Control the "Starblazer" to open fire, and all enemies within range will be instantly defeated.

source: 操控扎格列斯之手，尋找並拿取場景中可以利用的物件，放置在天秤右側的托盤上，嘗試解開歐洛尼斯的謎題。
target: Control the Hand of Zagreus to find and take the appropriately weighted items available in the map, then place them on the plate on the right side of the scale to try to solve Oronyx's puzzle.

source: 操纵扎格列斯之手，寻找并拿取场景中可以利用的配重物，放置在天秤右侧的托盘上，尝试解开欧洛尼斯的谜题。
target: Control the Hand of Zagreus to find and take the appropriately weighted items available in the map, then place them on the plate on the right side of the scale to try to solve Oronyx's puzzle.

target: Rumor has it that if you gather all the nameless wispae in an area, the difficulty of clearing the corresponding area in Star Rabbit will be greatly reduced.

target: You can showcase mementos from your Trailblazing journey in Collection Showcase. These will appear on your Trailblazer Profile once set up.

target: The remaining points after subtracting DEF from ATK will deal corresponding HP DMG to the defender, after which the roles of attacker and defender will switch.

target: When enemies receive Break DMG, they are inflicted with 1 stack of Vulnerability. Focus attacks on enemies with the most Vulnerability stacks to deal more Break DMG.

source: 敌人在陷入负面状态时或行动时，均会获得1层终结技易伤。 集中攻击易伤层数最高的敌人，可对全体敌人造成更高伤害。
target: When enemies become debuffed or when they take action, they will receive 1 stack of Ultimate Vulnerability. Focus your attacks on the enemy that has the highest Vulnerability stacks to deal more DMG to the whole enemy team.

target: Enemy distribution-type abilities will attack multiple targets within the team, and the attacked targets will evenly distribute either the DMG coefficient of the ability or any additional effect coefficient attached to that ability.

source: 敌人的横扫类型技能会固定从阵营的某一侧发起，按顺序依次攻击一定数量的目标，不会受到任何改变攻击目标效果的影响。
target: Enemy sweep-type abilities will always initiate from a fixed side of the team, sequentially attacking a set number of targets without being influenced by any effects that alter target selection.

source: 跟随西衍先生完成英雄之旅可以充实主角模板的能力。
target: Follow Mr. Xiyan and complete the Hero's Journey to unlock new abilities for the Protagonist Model.

source: 跟隨指引尋回散落在場景中的碎片後，可以最終完成拼圖。
target: Follow the instructions to retrieve the scattered pieces and complete the puzzle.

source: 跟隨西衍先生完成英雄之旅可以充實主角範本的能力。
target: Follow Mr. Xiyan and complete the Hero's Journey to unlock new abilities for the Protagonist Model.

source: 路上的远古晶石控制器会改变相同能量颜色的地板状态，利用它们的帮助抵达祭坛吧。
target: The Ancient Crystalline Controllers you find on the path can alter the state of the flooring that has the same energy color. Use them to help you reach the altar.

source: 路上的遠古晶石控制器會改變相同能量顏色的地板狀態，利用它們的幫助抵達祭壇吧。
target: The Ancient Crystalline Controllers you find on the path can alter the state of the flooring that has the same energy color. Use them to help you reach the altar.

source: 路線を計画して路線バフを利用すると、その路線の物流スコアを上昇させられます
target: Plan a route and use the route advantages to increase the logistic score of the route

source: 路边和角落放置的物品，尝试击碎的话，说不定有意外的收获…
target: Try breaking objects lying in corners or along the path. You may find something useful.

source: 路邊和角落放置的物品，嘗試擊碎的話，說不定有意外的收穫……
target: Try breaking objects lying in corners or along the path. You may find something useful.

source: 践行「行者之道」，提升「觐见行迹」点数，收集「寰宇蝗灾」全部章节。
target: Carry out the Trails of Pathstrider, increase Communing Trail points, and collect all chapters of the Swarm Disaster.

source: 踐行「行者之道」，提升「覲見行跡」點數，蒐集「寰宇蝗災」全部章節。
target: Carry out the Trails of Pathstrider, increase Communing Trail points, and collect all chapters of the Swarm Disaster.

source: 身为《狸狸周刊》的社长，将「乐园纪念币」放入你的存钱罐，随着等级提升，狸狸们就会为你送来福利。
target: As the president of Furbobo Weekly, drop your Arcadian Tokens into the Piggy Bank. As it levels up, the furbos will deliver rewards to you.

source: 身為《狸狸週刊》的社長，將「樂園紀念幣」放入你的存錢罐，隨著等級提升，狸狸們就會為你送來福利。
target: As the president of Furbobo Weekly, drop your Arcadian Tokens into the Piggy Bank. As it levels up, the furbos will deliver rewards to you.

source: 身為美夢小鎮的大哥，能屈能伸是一項基本素質。如果有必要，可以躲進箱子裡避開石頭老闆的爪牙。
target: As the boss of Dreamville, it is a basic requirement to adjust yourself to the situation. If needed, you can hide in the box to avoid Boss Stone's lackeys.

source: 躲避怪物
target: Evade Monsters

source: 転送枢核は、その上にある兆算枢核をもう片端に転送できます。
target: Teleportation modules will teleport the computing modules above it to the other end.

source: 輔助指引
target: Support Guide

source: 輪廻する運命においては、時おり転送ゲートが出現します。転送ゲートには「開かれている」と「閉ざされている」の2つの状態があります。同じエネルギー色を持つ転送ゲートのどちらかに入ると、もう片方のゲートへ転送され、同時に、ゲートは閉鎖されます。
target: Teleporters occasionally appear in the recurring destiny. Teleporters have two states: open and closed. When you enter any teleporter with the same energy color, you will be teleported to the other end, and the teleporter will close.

source: 輪迴的命運中，偶爾會出現傳送門。傳送門有開啟、關閉兩種狀態。進入相同能量顏色的傳送門中的任一個，會被傳送至另一端，同時傳送門會關閉。
target: Teleporters occasionally appear in the recurring destiny. Teleporters have two states: open and closed. When you enter any teleporter with the same energy color, you will be teleported to the other end, and the teleporter will close.

source: 輸送用星槎に貨物を積み、伝票を完成すると商会貯蓄金を獲得できます
target: Complete Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and reach shipping targets to earn Merchant Guild's funds

source: 輸送用星槎に貨物を積み、左側の伝票目標に必要な貨物数を満たしてください。
target: Conduct Inventory Arrangement on freight starskiffs and fulfill the designated number of goods as stated on the shipping targets on the left.

source: 轉動模組可調整線路，將電流從電源起點引向終點。連通終點模組內的所有電流通路，即可完成修復。
target: Rotate the modules to adjust the circuit and direct the electrical current from the power supply to the end point. Repairs are complete when all end point circuits are connected to the current.

source: 轉動羅盤，使內外圈的天軸朝向一致。
target: Turn the compass to align the inner and outer rings' Celestial Axis to the same direction.

source: 轉盤有兩種旋向，分別為順時針轉動和逆時針轉動。
target: Two types of rotations exist: Clockwise and counterclockwise.

source: 转动模块可调整线路，将电流从电源起点引向终点。当使终点模块内的所有电流通路都连通时，即可完成修复。
target: Rotate the modules to adjust the circuit and direct the electrical current from the power supply to the end point. Repairs are complete when all end point circuits are connected to the current.

source: 转动罗盘，使内外圈的天轴朝向一致。
target: Turn the compass to align the inner and outer rings' Celestial Axis to the same direction.

source: 转盘有两种旋向，分别为顺时针转动和逆时针转动。
target: Two types of rotations exist: Clockwise and counterclockwise.

source: 轮回的命运中，偶尔会出现传送门。传送门有开启，关闭两种状态。进入相同能量颜色的传送门中的任一个，会被传送至另一端，同时传送门会关闭。
target: Teleporters occasionally appear in the recurring destiny. Teleporters have two states: open and closed. When you enter any teleporter with the same energy color, you will be teleported to the other end, and the teleporter will close.

source: 辅助指引
target: Support Guide

source: 辨音調律
target: Discernment Tuning

source: 辨音调律
target: Discernment Tuning

source: 达成挑战目标可获取战利品宝箱。达成目标越多，奖励越丰厚。
target: Complete the challenge goals to obtain treasure chests. The more challenge goals you complete, the better the rewards.

source: 近くの「飛翔する幣」をすべて集めるたびに、当該「ザグレウスの手」の財宝を獲得できます。
target: After collecting all the Coins of Whimsy nearby, you can obtain the treasures of the specific Hand of Zagreus.

source: 返回列車後，將有機會遇見他們。
target: You might run into them after returning to the Express.

source: 返回列车后，将有机会遇见他们。
target: You might run into them after returning to the Express.

source: 还会有些特殊的决胜纹样碎片会贴合在集装箱上，可以移动集装箱拼合决胜纹样。
target: There are also special Victory Marking fragments that are fitted upon the containers. You can move the containers to assemble the Victory Markings.

source: 这些强敌的投影，会与常规的首领敌人存在一定差异，开拓者可在战斗开始时阅读其特性了解详情。
target: These formidable foe materializations will have slight differences between them and regular Enemy Bosses. Trailblazers can check out the details by reading about the enemies' traits when the battle begins.

source: 这是一款以「开拓」为主题的模拟经营游戏。玩家将扮演策展人，经营「星铁☆WORLD」的分会场。
target: This is a "Trailblaze" themed management simulation game. You will run a branch of "Star Rail WORLD" as the exhibition manager.

source: 这是一款以星穹列车的开拓旅程为原型的放置类自动战斗游戏。
target: This is an idle auto-battle game based on the Trailblaze journey of the Astral Express.

source: 这是广告牌， 撞倒广告牌会带来减速效果。 请不要得罪广告商！
target: This is a Billboard. You will be Slowed when you run into a Billboard. Please don't offend the advertisers!

source: 这里显示博物馆的振兴阶段和已获取的振兴值
target: The museum's Revitalization Stage and obtained RevitaScore are shown here

source: 进入「战意阶段4：力量觉醒」时恢复战技点，激活所有角色的终结技并使其立即行动，同时大幅提高效果抵抗。
target: Recover Skill Points when entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken" and activate all characters' Ultimates, then all characters immediately take action while also greatly increasing their Effect RES.

source: 进入「过量转化」挑战时，我方全体激活终结技并恢复5个战技点。
target: When entering the Excessive Conversion challenge, all allies will activate their Ultimates and recover 5 Skill Points.

source: 进入弃牌区的区域不会消失。当待抽区中的区域用光后，会触发【洗牌】，所有弃牌区中的区域会重新回到待抽区。
target: Domains sent to the Discard Pile will not disappear. When the Draw Pile runs out of Domains, "Shuffle" will trigger, returning all Domains from the Discard Pile back to the Draw Pile.

source: 进入火爆状态后，全部菜品的售价都会提升。连续服务顾客越多，售价提升的幅度越大
target: After entering Streak Fever, prices of all dishes will increase. The more customers you serve consecutively, the more the price increases

source: 进度满时可以获得1张巨大化
target: When the progress is full, gain 1 Gigantification

source: 进度满时可以获得丰厚回报
target: Earn generous rewards when the progress bar is full

source: 进度满时可获得觉醒卡牌，给魁伟魂灵升级
target: When the progress bar is full, obtain an Awakening Card to level up Towering Soul

source: 进行对局可以获得战力党资历，提升「资历等级」。到达一定级别后，还会获得「战力分析家证书」，让开拓者能够为角色卡更换不同的「曜彩骰」。
target: You can gain Collective Experience to increase your Experience Level. After reaching certain levels, you'll receive the "Power Analyst Certificate," which allows Trailblazers to equip different Prismatic Dice on character cards.

source: 进阶技巧•如何找到角色
target: Ascension Tips: How to Locate Character

source: 进阶技巧•提升战力
target: Ascension Tips: Combat Power Increase

source: 进阶技巧•经济与运营
target: Ascension Tips: Economy and Operations

source: 进阶技巧•装备进阶
target: Ascension Tips: Equipment Advancement

source: 进阶装备拥有合成表中简易装备的基础属性。 除此之外，进阶装备拥有独特的战斗效果，可以大幅提升角色战斗能力。
target: Advanced equipment retains the Base Stats of the basic equipment from the synthesis table. In addition, advanced equipment provides unique combat effects that can greatly enhance a character's combat capabilities.

source: 进阶装备的同名强化版本，除了具有更强力的数值属性外，独特的战斗效果也会被强化。
target: The enhanced version of advanced equipment with the same name. In addition to having more powerful stats, its unique combat effects will also be strengthened.

source: 连续攻击该敌人将破坏其【战甲】并将其消灭。
target: Consecutive attacks on this enemy will destroy their "War Armor" and defeat them.

source: 连麦PK
target: Live Showdown

source: 迷子のプーマン
target: Lost Trotter

source: 迷路的扑满
target: Lost Trotter

source: 迷路的撲滿
target: Lost Trotter

target: Extra Turn

target: If you enter a battle when extra Cycles are at 0, then the enemy will enter a Berserk state at the end of the standard Cycle for this battle.

source: 追加依頼では、より多くのガオクッキーが貰えるほか、依頼を一定数達成すると、段階目標を前倒しで達成できます！
target: You can get more Awoo Cookies from extra assignments. After completing a certain number of extra assignments, you can achieve the stage target ahead of schedule!

source: 追加攻击
target: Follow-Up ATK

target: Follow-Up ATK

target: Follow-Up ATK

target: Fragments of Recollection

source: 追憶のルーンを持っている状態で、もう一度台座を調べるとルーンを置くことができます。すると、奇跡の宝珠の照射範囲も移動を停止します。
target: With the Rune of Recollection in possession, interact with the rune base to drop the rune, and the Miracle Orb's illumination radius will stop following your character.

source: 追憶殘像
target: Fragments of Recollection

source: 追跡
target: Trailing

source: 追跡中、画面上部にサポーターが表示されます。
target: When Trailing Mode is active, the Gameplay Prompter will appear on top of the screen.

source: 选中不可转动模块时，边缘会呈红色。
target: The edges of fixed modules will appear red when selected.

source: 选取挑战场地•一
target: Select the challenge arena 1

source: 选取挑战场地•二
target: Select the challenge arena 2

source: 选取特定祝颂后，可以改变昼夜的占比，有可能会达成某种永恒的状态。
target: After selecting specific Boons, you can change the ratio of Day and Night and may even be able to make one state permanent.

source: 选择指定好友，即可求助或赠送指定回忆卡碎片。每日参与还可获得重转硬币。
target: Select designated friends to gift or request specific Memory Card fragments. Participate in this every day to obtain reroll coins.

source: 选择添加最多4个委托，每小时会根据所选委托自动积累奖励。
target: After assignments (up to 4) are added, the rewards based on the selected assignments will be automatically accumulated per hour.

source: 选择演算倾向后，本局中适配所选倾向的权杖出现概率会有所提升。
target: After selecting an Extrapolation Alignment, Scepters suited for the chosen alignment will have a higher probability of appearing in this run.

source: 选择目标
target: Select Target

source: 选择航点图标后点击开始巡航，「槲寄生」号将自动飞行至所选航点并降落。
target: Select the waypoint icon and click Start Cruise, and the Mistletoe will automatically fly to and land at the selected waypoint.

source: 选择行动卡， 推进值日日程，提升队员「值日等级」，最终在「晚餐会议」中汇报值日报告，获取「列车基金」！
target: Select an Action Card, progress your duty schedule, raise your members' Duty Level, and submit your Duty Reports at the Dinner Meeting to gain Express Funds when the day ends!

source: 选择行动卡，可以推进值日日程，提升对应队员的值日等级，获取列车基金。
target: Select an Action Card to progress your duty schedule, raise the corresponding member's Duty Level, and obtain Express Funds.

source: 选择非首领敌人中生命值较低的敌人，对其使用单体输出技能。 消灭敌人后，将根据本次攻击造成的溢出伤害，对敌方首领造成高额倍率的单体伤害。
target: Select a non-boss enemy with low HP and use single-target DMG ability on it. After defeating the enemy, deals single-target DMG with huge multipliers to the boss based on the Overflow DMG dealt to the defeated unit.

source: 透過「收藏展示櫃」功能，可以佈置各種在「開拓」旅途中獲得的紀念模型、榮譽勳章還有旅途照片。「收藏展示櫃」會在漫遊簽證中顯示。
target: Through the "Collection Showcase" feature, you can set up various commemorative figures, honor badges, and travel photos obtained during your Trailblaze journey. Your "Collection Showcase" will be shown in your Trailblazer Profile.

source: 透過「重整思緒」，可以捨棄選取的報告，並重新抽取相同數量的報告。請注意，每個成員的報告總數設有上限。
target: Using "Mental Reset", you can discard selected reports and draw the same number of new ones. Please note that each team member has a limit on the total number of reports.

source: 透過互動選項可使對應的模組按指定的軌跡移動或旋轉。
target: Use interactive operations to rotate or move the module along the set trajectory.

source: 透過交付相同的報告，可以形成彙報組合、提高得分效率，從而得到更高的帕姆評分。
target: When submitting similar reports, you can create a report bundle, increase your score efficiency, and obtain higher scores from Pom-Pom.

source: 透過培育造物獲得新的特徵或特殊造物，可提升研究等級。
target: By nurturing creations and obtaining new traits or rare creations, you can increase your Research Level.

source: 透過完成裝潢推進房間裝潢完成度，可以提高家居評價，獲得裝潢津貼。
target: Completing renovations to increase the renovation progress of the room and raise your Décor Rating. This will earn you Renovation Subsidy.

source: 透過左右翻閱，逐句查看發言。
target: Examine each statement by flipping through them to the left or right.

source: 透過房間中的「家居訂製」功能，可以將冒險中獲得的各種家具佈置在房間中。
target: Use the "Décor Customization" feature in your room to place various furniture items obtained during your adventures.

source: 透過房間裝潢和家居訂製，你可以逐步妝點自己的房間。
target: You can gradually liven up your room by renovating and customizing it.

source: 透過拋出記憶盲點將有機會喚醒與之相關的模糊記憶。
target: Using Cognition Chasm has a chance of restoring relevant hazy memories.

source: 透過指派助理提升經營指標
target: Appoint assistants to improve operational parameters

source: 透過掃描區域中的「駭入聲明」塗鴉，可解析銀狼使用的網路攻擊演算法。蒐集「駭入聲明」可提高模擬演算法的強度等級。
target: Scan the hacking callcard graffiti in the domain to decipher the attack algorithm used by Silver Wolf. Collect hacking callcards to increase Simulated Calculation's intensity level.

source: 透過探索匹諾康尼和完成任務獲得「金錶鈔」。
target: Obtain "Clock Credits" by exploring Penacony and completing missions.

source: 透過擊發器發射歲陽能量，旋轉承接器改變歲陽能量的傳導方向。
target: Rotate receiver nodes to adjust heliobus energy's conduction direction. Then activate the trigger node to release heliobus energy along the conduction direction.

source: 透過禱言回溯【黃金短矛】，可以重演它的路徑。跟隨並抓住回溯後的【黃金短矛】，可以獲得對應的獎勵
target: Rewinding the "Golden Short Spear" via the prayer will replay its path. Follow and capture the rewound "Golden Short Spear" to obtain corresponding rewards

source: 透過與控制裝置互動，可以控制築夢模組按指定的軌跡移動。築夢模組移動時，附著在其表面的離散夢泡也會隨著一起移動。
target: By interacting with Control Panels, the Dream Module can be moved along the designated trajectory. When moving the Dream Module, the scattered dream bubbles on its surface will also move with it.

source: 透過裝潢和家居訂製，你可以逐步妝點自己的房間。
target: You can gradually liven up your room by renovating and customizing it.

source: 透過訓練可以提升三月七的屬性。每種訓練進行一定程度後，訓練的效果會提升。
target: Through training, March 7th can improve her stats. With each type of training, its effectiveness increases after a certain level of progress.

source: 透過追問，發掘發言背後可能的資訊
target: Use questions to discover possible details hiding behind given statements.

source: 這些強敵的投影，會與常規的頭目敵人有一定差異，開拓者可在戰鬥開始時閱讀其特性瞭解詳情。
target: These formidable foe materializations will have slight differences between them and regular Enemy Bosses. Trailblazers can check out the details by reading about the enemies' traits when the battle begins.

source: 這是一款以「開拓」為主題的模擬經營遊戲。玩家將扮演策展人，經營「星鐵☆WORLD」的分會場。
target: This is a "Trailblaze" themed management simulation game. You will run a branch of "Star Rail WORLD" as the exhibition manager.

source: 這是一款以星穹列車的開拓旅程為原型的放置類自動戰鬥遊戲。
target: This is an idle auto-battle game based on the Trailblaze journey of the Astral Express.

source: 這是看板， 撞倒看板會帶來減速效果。 請不要得罪廣告商！
target: This is a Billboard. You will be Slowed when you run into a Billboard. Please don't offend the advertisers!

source: 這裡顯示博物館的振興階段和已取得的振興值
target: The museum's Revitalization Stage and obtained RevitaScore are shown here

source: 通关全部骑士关卡后，失去护卫的王棋将被削弱。
target: After clearing all Knight Stages, the King will be weakened without its guards.

source: 通关全部骑士关卡后，王棋的实力将被削弱。重置骑士关卡成绩时不会影响王棋的削弱状态。
target: After clearing all Knight Stages, the King will be weakened. Resetting the progress of the Knight Stages will not affect the weakened state of the King.

source: 通关差分宇宙时的构筑内容可以保存下来，以相同的构筑内容进行快速挑战。
target: When you clear Divergent Universe, the build content can be saved, allowing for quick challenges with the same build content.

source: 通关忘却之庭并达成指定条件，可以获得「印记星数」。累计获得一定的星数后，可以领取「印记馈赠」。
target: Clear Forgotten Hall and meeting specific conditions to obtain Marks of Starre. A Mark Gift can be obtained after collecting enough Marks of Starre.

source: 通关忘却之庭第11关开启星启模式。 通关星启模式中第12关需要挑战3个节点。
target: Clear Stage 11 of Forgotten Hall to unlock Starward Mode. Clearing Stage 12 in Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes.

source: 通关时，小队生命值不低于70，则职级提升+3。 通关时，小队生命值不低于40，则职级提升+2。 通关时，小队生命值不足40，则职级提升+1。
target: When clearing the stage, if squad HP is 70 or above, rank increases by 3. When clearing the stage, if squad HP is 40 or above, rank increases by 2. When clearing the stage, if squad HP is below 40, rank increases by 1.

source: 通关末日幻影难度3开启星启模式。 通关星启模式中难度4需要挑战3个节点。
target: Clear Apocalyptic Shadow Difficulty 3 to unlock Starward Mode. Clearing Starward Mode Difficulty 4 requires challenging 3 Nodes.

source: 通关虚构叙事并达到指定分数，可获得【故事星数】，领取【故事馈赠】。
target: Once you have cleared Pure Fiction and earned enough points, you will receive Story Stars and Story Rewards.

source: 通关虚构叙事第3关开启星启模式。 通关星启模式中第4关需要挑战3个节点。
target: Clear Stage 3 of Pure Fiction to unlock Starward Mode. Clearing Stage 4 in Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes.

source: 通常攻撃を受ける、または他の敵に攻撃されると、この敵は戦闘スキル状態と必殺技状態の間で切り替わります。
target: When attacking the enemy with Basic ATK or causing this enemy to be damaged by other enemies, the enemy will switch between Skill and Ultimate modes.

source: 通常来说，使用红钻/蓝钻+简易装备进行合成，可获得各羁绊的星徽。
target: Usually, synthesizing Red Gems/Blue Gems with a piece of basic equipment results in Emblems of various Bonds.

source: 通常，使用紅鑽/藍鑽與簡易裝備合成，可獲得各羈絆的星徽。
target: Usually, synthesizing Red Gems/Blue Gems with a piece of basic equipment results in Emblems of various Bonds.

source: 通过「收藏展柜」功能，可以布设各种在「开拓」旅途中获得的纪念手办，荣誉勋章还有旅途照片。「收藏展柜」会在漫游签证中显示。
target: Through the "Collection Showcase" feature, you can set up various commemorative figures, honor badges, and travel photos obtained during your Trailblaze journey. Your "Collection Showcase" will be shown in your Trailblazer Profile.

source: 通过「重整思路」，可以舍弃选中的报告，并重新抽取相同数量的报告。请注意，每个成员的报告总数存在上限。
target: Using "Mental Reset", you can discard selected reports and draw the same number of new ones. Please note that each team member has a limit on the total number of reports.

source: 通过与控制装置交互，可以操作筑梦模块按指定的轨迹移动。筑梦模块移动时，附着在其表面的离散梦泡也会随着一起移动。
target: By interacting with Control Panels, the Dream Module can be moved along the designated trajectory. When moving the Dream Module, the scattered dream bubbles on its surface will also move with it.

source: 通过交互选项可使对应的模块按指定的轨迹移动或旋转。
target: Use interactive operations to rotate or move the module along the set trajectory.

source: 通过击发器发射岁阳能量，旋转承接器改变岁阳能量的传导方向。
target: Rotate receiver nodes to adjust heliobus energy's conduction direction. Then activate the trigger node to release heliobus energy along the conduction direction.

source: 通过切换涂鸦组合可以喷涂出有趣的图像——配合撤销和清除全部可以更方便地进行喷涂。
target: Switch graffiti combos to spray interesting images — Use Undo and Erase All to spray with more convenience.

source: 通过培育造物获得新的特征或特殊造物，可提升研究等级。
target: By nurturing creations and obtaining new traits or rare creations, you can increase your Research Level.

source: 通过完成装修推进房间装修完成度，可以提高家居评级，获取装修津贴。
target: Completing renovations to increase the renovation progress of the room and raise your Décor Rating. This will earn you Renovation Subsidy.

source: 通过左右翻阅，逐句查看发言。
target: Examine each statement by flipping through them to the left or right.

source: 通过房间中的「家居定制」功能，可以将冒险中获得的各种家具布设在房间中。
target: Use the "Décor Customization" feature in your room to place various furniture items obtained during your adventures.

source: 通过房间装修和家居定制，你可以逐步丰富自己的房间。
target: You can gradually liven up your room by renovating and customizing it.

source: 通过扫描区域中的「骇入声明」涂鸦，可解析银狼使用的网络攻击算法。收集「骇入声明」可提高模拟算法的强度等级。
target: Scan the hacking callcard graffiti in the domain to decipher the attack algorithm used by Silver Wolf. Collect hacking callcards to increase Simulated Calculation's intensity level.

source: 通过抛出记忆盲点将有机会唤醒与之相关的模糊记忆。
target: Using Cognition Chasm has a chance of restoring relevant hazy memories.

source: 通过指派助理以提升经营维度
target: Appoint assistants to improve operational parameters

source: 通过探索、完成任务和世界事件可以收集到各类贴纸
target: You can get stickers by exploring the world, completing missions, and participating in happenings in the world.

source: 通过探索匹诺康尼和完成任务获得「金表钞」。
target: Obtain "Clock Credits" by exploring Penacony and completing missions.

source: 通过提交相同的报告，可以形成汇报组合、提高得分效率，从而得到更高的帕姆评分。
target: When submitting similar reports, you can create a report bundle, increase your score efficiency, and obtain higher scores from Pom-Pom.

source: 通过特定顺序点亮燃灯，可解除鳞渊境中对应封印。
target: By lighting them up in a specific sequence, the corresponding seals in Scalegorge Waterscape can be removed.

source: 通过祷言回溯【黄金短矛】，可以重演它的路径。跟随并抓住回溯后的【黄金短矛】，可以获得对应的奖励
target: Rewinding the "Golden Short Spear" via the prayer will replay its path. Follow and capture the rewound "Golden Short Spear" to obtain corresponding rewards

source: 通过装修和家居定制，你可以逐步丰富自己的房间。
target: You can gradually liven up your room by renovating and customizing it.

source: 通过训练可以提升三月七的属性。每种训练进行一定程度后，训练的效果会提升。
target: Through training, March 7th can improve her stats. With each type of training, its effectiveness increases after a certain level of progress.

source: 通过贴纸装点手账页以提升对应页面的完成度
target: Use your stickers collection to decorate your scrapbook and boost its completion progress.

source: 通过追问，发掘发言背后可能的信息
target: Use questions to discover possible details hiding behind given statements.

source: 速度
target: Speed

target: SPD will affect the interval between a target's actions. The faster their speed, the shorter the interval. At the same time, SPD also affects the Action Order when entering battle.

source: 速度会影响目标两次行动之间的间隔，速度越快，间隔越短。同时速度也会影响进入战斗时的行动序列。
target: SPD will affect the interval between a target's actions. The faster their speed, the shorter the interval. At the same time, SPD also affects the Action Order when entering battle.

source: 速度會影響目標兩次行動之間的間隔，速度越快，間隔越短。同時速度也會影響進入戰鬥時的行動序列。
target: SPD will affect the interval between a target's actions. The faster their speed, the shorter the interval. At the same time, SPD also affects the Action Order when entering battle.

source: 造成伤害与击败敌人均可以获得「试炼点数」。 通关时如有剩余轮次可获得额外「试炼点数」。
target: Dealing damage and defeating enemies will award Trial Points. If there are remaining Cycles when the trial is cleared, extra Trial Points will be awarded.

source: 造成傷害與擊敗敵人均可以獲得「試煉點數」。 過關時如有剩餘輪可獲得額外「試煉點數」。
target: Dealing damage and defeating enemies will award Trial Points. If there are remaining Cycles when the trial is cleared, extra Trial Points will be awarded.

source: 造物佈置區最多可放置13隻造物。
target: Up to 13 creations can be placed in the Creation Placement Zone.

source: 造物喵喵箱每周将随机开出3只造物，离开箱子的造物们会躲藏在派对车厢里。 重置时间是每周一04:00（服务器时间）。
target: The Creation Meow Box will randomly release 3 creations each week. Once they've escaped the box, these creations will hide somewhere in the Party Car. Resets every Monday at 04:00 (server time).

source: 造物喵喵箱每週將隨機開出3隻造物，離開箱子的造物們會躲藏在派對車廂裡。 重置時間是每週一04:00（伺服器時間）。
target: The Creation Meow Box will randomly release 3 creations each week. Once they've escaped the box, these creations will hide somewhere in the Party Car. Resets every Monday at 04:00 (server time).

source: 造物布设区最多可放置13只造物。
target: Up to 13 creations can be placed in the Creation Placement Zone.

target: Each of Ruan Mei's creations in the Workbench of Creation corresponds to a creation function.

source: 造物调试台的功能之一，使用2个相同品质的奇物进行合成。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can synthesize a new Curio using 2 Curios of the same quality.

source: 造物调试台的功能之一，消耗宇宙碎片置换已有方程。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Equations.

source: 造物调试台的功能之一，消耗宇宙碎片置换已有的祝福。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Blessings.

source: 造物调试台的功能之一，消耗造物调试台的热量强化祝福。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends the Workbench of Creation's Heat to enhance Blessings.

source: 造物调试台的功能之一，能置换已有加权奇物。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can replace existing Weighted Curios.

source: 造物调试台能够将1个组件覆写为同星级的随机组件。
target: Workbench of Creation can Overwrite 1 Component to a random Component of the same star rating.

source: 造物调试台能将4个同星级组件合成为更高星级的组件。
target: Workbench of Creation can synthesize 4 Components of the same star rating to become higher-rated Components.

source: 造物除錯台中的每個阮•梅造物對應一個造物功能。
target: Each of Ruan Mei's creations in the Workbench of Creation corresponds to a creation function.

source: 造物除錯台的功能之一，使用2個相同品質的奇物進行合成。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can synthesize a new Curio using 2 Curios of the same quality.

source: 造物除錯台的功能之一，消耗宇宙碎片置換已有方程式。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Equations.

source: 造物除錯台的功能之一，消耗宇宙碎片置換已有的祝福。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends Cosmic Fragments to swap current Blessings.

source: 造物除錯台的功能之一，消耗造物除錯台的熱量強化祝福。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which expends the Workbench of Creation's Heat to enhance Blessings.

source: 造物除錯台的功能之一，能置換已有加權奇物。
target: One of the functions of the Workbench of Creation, which can replace existing Weighted Curios.

source: 造物除錯台能夠將1個元件覆寫為同星級的隨機元件。
target: Workbench of Creation can Overwrite 1 Component to a random Component of the same star rating.

source: 造物除錯台能將4個同星級元件合成為更高星級的元件。
target: Workbench of Creation can synthesize 4 Components of the same star rating to become higher-rated Components.

target: Multiplayer Bonanza Mode

target: In Multiplayer Bonanza mode, every match will have 6 participating players. Players will draw one from remaining opponents in each turn to battle against.

target: Live Showdown

target: Co-op Challenge

target: In Co-Op Challenges, you can team up with other Trailblazers to take on formidable foes. These enemies use more powerful cards compared to story battles.

target: Multiplayer Mode — Battle Royale

target: Multiplayer Mode — Duo Duel

target: Consecutive attacks on this enemy will destroy their "War Armor" and defeat them.

source: 週期演算中每週都會更新特殊的玩法內容。
target: Special gameplay content will be updated weekly in Cyclical Extrapolations.

source: 進入「戰意階段4：力量覺醒」時恢復戰技點，啟動所有角色的終結技並使其立即行動，同時大幅提高效果抗性。
target: Recover Skill Points when entering "Grit Phase 4: Power Awoken" and activate all characters' Ultimates, then all characters immediately take action while also greatly increasing their Effect RES.

source: 進入「過量轉化」挑戰時，我方全體啟動終結技並恢復5個戰技點。
target: When entering the Excessive Conversion challenge, all allies will activate their Ultimates and recover 5 Skill Points.

source: 進入棄牌區的區域不會消失。當待抽區中的區域用光後，會觸發【洗牌】，所有棄牌區中的區域都會重新回到待抽區。
target: Domains sent to the Discard Pile will not disappear. When the Draw Pile runs out of Domains, "Shuffle" will trigger, returning all Domains from the Discard Pile back to the Draw Pile.

source: 進入火爆狀態後，全部菜品的售價都會提升。連續服務顧客越多，售價提升的幅度越大
target: After entering Streak Fever, prices of all dishes will increase. The more customers you serve consecutively, the more the price increases

source: 進度蓄滿時可以獲得1張巨大化
target: When the progress is full, gain 1 Gigantification

source: 進度蓄滿時可以獲得豐厚回報
target: Earn generous rewards when the progress bar is full

source: 進度蓄滿時可獲得覺醒卡牌，為魁偉魂靈升級
target: When the progress bar is full, obtain an Awakening Card to level up Towering Soul

target: You can gain Collective Experience to increase your Experience Level. After reaching certain levels, you'll receive the "Power Analyst Certificate," which allows Trailblazers to equip different Prismatic Dice on character cards.

target: Ascension Tips: How to Locate Character

target: Ascension Tips: Combat Power Increase

target: Advanced equipment retains the Base Stats of the basic equipment from the synthesis table. In addition, advanced equipment provides unique combat effects that can greatly enhance a character's combat capabilities.

source: 進階裝備的同名強化版本，除了具有更強力的數值屬性外，獨特的戰鬥效果也會被強化。
target: The enhanced version of advanced equipment with the same name. In addition to having more powerful stats, its unique combat effects will also be strengthened.

source: 遊戲的目標是賺大錢，提升會場等級，讓展會變得更加熱鬧。

target: While on the road of destiny, it is a tragic thing to be tethered by the past... Do not approach the Enshadowed Version of You.

source: 강적 카드는 점차 강력해지는 여러 가지 단계를 보유하고 있으며, 강적 카드의 모든 단계를 격파하면 대전에서 승리한 것으로 간주합니다
target: Formidable foe cards have multiple phases that grow progressively stronger. Break through all phases of a formidable foe card to win the battle.

source: 강적과 교전한 선명한 기억, 전쟁의 여운을 통해 과거의 전투 기억을 돌아볼 수 있습니다. 처치 후 일정 확률로 행적 재료, 희귀 광추, 유물 등을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: War memories of past formidable foes are still fresh. Use Echo of War to relive past battles. Upon victory, there is a chance that you will gain rewards such as Trace Materials, Rare Light Cones, and Relics.

source: 같은 과일을 4개 이상 연결하면 상응하는 폭탄이 생성됩니다
target: Match 4 or more identical fruits to generate a corresponding bomb.

source: 같은 보고서를 제출하면 보고서 조합이 형성되고 점수 효율이 증가하여 더 높은 폼폼 점수를 획득할 수 있습니다
target: When submitting similar reports, you can create a report bundle, increase your score efficiency, and obtain higher scores from Pom-Pom.

source: 같은 색 과일을 4개 이상 연결하면 상응하는 폭탄이 생성됩니다
target: Match more than 3 fruits of the same color to generate a corresponding bomb.

source: 같은 유대를 보유한 캐릭터를 더 많이 출전시키면 유대 레벨을 높일 수 있습니다. 유대 레벨이 높을수록 효과가 더욱 강력해집니다
target: Deploying more characters with the same Bond will increase the Bond Level. The higher the Bond Level, the stronger the effect.

source: 같은 이름의 고급 장비 버전은 더 강력한 수치 속성뿐만 아니라 고유 전투 효과 역시 강화됩니다
target: The enhanced version of advanced equipment with the same name. In addition to having more powerful stats, its unique combat effects will also be strengthened.

source: 같은 창조물 작업대에서는 해당 작업대에 있는 모든 완•매 창조물의 기능을 사용할 수 있습니다
target: In the same Workbench of Creation, you can use the functions of all of Ruan Mei's creations present on the workbench.

source: 개념예장의 발동 순서를 전략적으로 짜는 것이 승리의 관건입니다!
target: Using your Conceptual Mystic Codes in the right order is the key to victory!

source: 개방 후, 전문 컨설턴트들은 이번 게임에서 다른 직원들과 마찬가지로 상점에서 구매, 성급업 및 장비 착용이 가능해지며, 이전에 소속된 유대를 보유하게 됩니다
target: Once unlocked, they'll function just like any other staff member in this round. You can buy them from the Store, upgrade their stars, equip them with gear, and they'll retain any Bonds they had before.

source: 개장 후, 진령 방문객들이 차례대로 입장하며, 시설을 지나갈 때 놀이공원 코인을 지불합니다
target: Once the park is open for business, wispae visitors will enter one by one and pay Arca Coins as they pass by the attractions.

source: 개조된 미의 가운(무한)은 차원 내에서 획득한 모든 우주 조각이 전투 중 아군이 가하는 피해를 증가시킵니다. 더 많은 우주 조각을 획득하여 「최종 시련」에 대비하세요
target: The Robe of The Beauty (Infinite) has been modified. All Cosmic Fragments that have been obtained within the plane can now increase the DMG Boost effect for allies in battle. Obtain more Cosmic Fragments to prepare for the Final Trial.

source: 개척 가이드
target: Trailblaze Guide

source: 개척 레벨을 올리면 차장 「폼폼」에게서 상응하는 레벨 보상을 수령할 수 있습니다
target: As Trailblaze Level increases, you can claim corresponding rewards from Pom-Pom, the Express' conductor.

source: 개척 레벨의 상승에 따라 균형의 시련을 완료해 균형 레벨을 올려야 합니다. 개척자의 능력이 증가할수록 더 많은 보상을 얻을 수 있습니다. 다만 각 세계의 몬스터도 더욱 강해집니다…
target: As your Trailblaze Level goes up, you will need to complete Trials of Equilibrium to increase your Equilibrium Level. The enemies will have stronger stats, but so will you — and of course, defeating them will drop more rewards...

source: 개척 여정에서 동료와 만나고, 더 강력한 장비를 획득해 함께 강적을 물리치세요
target: Meet companions on your Trailblaze journey, obtain powerful equipment, and defeat formidable foes together.

source: 개척 임무, 모험 임무, 세계 임무, 세계 내 전리품 개방 등, 탐사 중 여러 방식을 통해 「낙원 기념 코인」, 흔히 원보라 불리는 재화를 획득할 수 있습니다
target: While exploring, you can obtain Arcadian Tokens (or as folks like to call them, Wishbae) in multiple ways, like completing Trailblaze Missions, Adventure Missions, world missions, opening treasures around the world, and more.

source: 개척 임무를 진행하면 「이름 없는 추억」을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Progressing the Trailblaze Mission grants "Nameless Recollections"

source: 개척 축복
target: Blessings of Trailblaze

source: 개척 후문 완료. 개척 임무를 계속 진행하여 개척 레벨을 올리면 더 많은 이벤트에 참여할 수 있습니다

source: 개척 후문을 완료하였습니다. 계속해서 콜라보 이벤트에 참여해 「무한의 시련」에 도전하면 시련 보상을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Trailblaze Continuance completed. Continue participating in the collaboration event and challenge the "Infinite Trial" to obtain Trial Rewards.

target: Trailbirder

source: 개척자가 도달했던 세계의 위치는 모두 별의 궤도 맵에 기록됩니다
target: The worlds that you have been to will be marked on the Star Rail Map.

source: 개척자는 공격 발동 시 「성장도」를 획득합니다
target: The Trailblazer gains "Growth Value" when using an attack.

source: 개척자님은 소모품을 사용해 탐사 도중 생기는 각종 위기에 더 쉽게 대처할 수 있습니다
target: Use Consumables can help the Trailblazer better deal with all kinds of danger they might come across in the journey.

source: 개척자의 방
target: Trailblazer's Room

source: 개척자의 시점이 아닐 경우 특정 필드로만 이동할 수 있으며, 특정 임무 및 [모조 꽃받침], [정체된 허영], [침식된 터널], [전쟁의 여운], [시뮬레이션 우주], [망각의 정원] 등 콘텐츠를 플레이할 수 없습니다
target: While in a non-Trailblazer POV, you can only access specific maps and cannot play certain missions as well as certain content such as Calyxes, Stagnant Shadows, Caverns of Corrosion, Echoes of War, Simulated Universe, Forgotten Hall, etc.

source: 갬블 플롯에서는 좋은꿈 슬롯머신을 통해 다양한 결과를 뽑을 수 있으며, 대량의 관객 감정을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Lucky Scene allows you to draw different results in Dreamy Slots, potentially granting a large amount of Audience Emotions

source: 거대 무덤 장치가 해당 공간에 투영한 티탄 룬을 수집하여 계속 진행하세요
target: Collect the Titan Runes projected by the tomb device in this space to proceed.

source: 거대 작물
target: Giant Crops

source: 거품 공격을 발동하면 거품 에너지가 소모됩니다. 주변에 떠다니는 거품 공을 주우면 거품 에너지를 보충할 수 있습니다. 「거품의 집」을 연속 공격하면 파괴하여 거품 공을 획득할 수 있습니다
target: Releasing bubble attacks consumes bubble energy. Collect floating bubble orbs in the environment to replenish bubble energy. Continuously attack the Bubble House to break it and obtain bubble orbs.

target: Swordart Ascension represents the culmination of March 7th's sword training. The higher the Swordart Ascension ranks, the stronger March 7th's combat prowess becomes. Swordart Ascension can be improved by continuously learning Sword Moves.

target: The Sword Trial must be completed by March 7th alone. The entire battle will proceed automatically, and no assistance from teammates is allowed.

source: 검술 초식 습득

source: 검술 훈련 과정 중, Mar. 7th는 동료의 서포트를 받아 훈련 및 유람의 효율을 높일 수 있습니다
target: During sword training, March 7th can receive assistance from companions, enhancing the efficiency of her Training and Excursions.
